AI.title_translation: 机器人基础模型中的具身鸿沟
AI.tldr: 机器人基础模型（RFMs）的通用性受限于“具身鸿沟”，即模型、数据或表示与在特定机器人上执行之间的差距。本调查审视了跨机器人载体的可重用性，并提出了一个适应性报告框架，以促进跨载体学习的评估和未来研究。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型（RFMs）的通用性可以通过扩展数据、模型和基准来提高，但模型在特定机器人上的实际部署仍面临挑战。模型泛化能力和在特定机器人上运行的能力之间存在差距，即“具身鸿沟”，这影响了实际部署。
AI.method: 本调查审视了可重用的机器人基础模型（RFMs）组件，并提出了一个将现有方法置于基于共享结构类型和适应阶段的双轴地图上的框架。调查还研究了三个研究方向：共享语义和感知、共享机器人数据和接口、以及跨载体学习对应关系。此外，还提出了一个报告框架，用于评估适应性工作。
AI.result: 本调查对现有机器人基础模型（RFMs）方法进行了分类，并提出了一个报告框架，以量化跨载体学习的适应性工作，超越了单纯的成功率指标。重点研究了共享语义、感知、数据、接口以及跨载体对应关系学习。
AI.conclusion: 机器人基础模型（RFMs）的通用性可以通过扩展数据、模型和基准来提高，但模型在特定机器人上的实际部署仍面临挑战。模型泛化能力和在特定机器人上运行的能力之间存在差距，即“具身鸿沟”，这影响了实际部署。本调查提出了一个框架和报告机制，以更好地理解和解决这一问题，并为未来的研究指明了方向。
AI.translation: 机器人基础模型（RFMs），包括视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，通常通过扩展的视角来讨论：更多的数据、更大的模型和更广泛的基准应该能提高泛化能力。然而，在机器人领域，模型可以泛化，但在特定身体的机器人上运行仍有工作要做。所需工作因方法和目标机器人的不同而异，这些差异会影响实际部署。我们将可重用模型、表示或数据与其在目标机器人上使用的差距称为具身鸿沟。本调查审视了哪些可以跨机器人载体重用，哪些仍需在新机器人上实现。我们将现有方法置于一个双轴地图上，展示共享结构的类型以及为在目标机器人上执行所需进行的适应阶段。然后，我们通过三个重叠的研究方向来审视近期工作：共享语义和感知、共享机器人数据和接口、以及学习跨载体的对应关系。我们还提出了一个适应性工作的报告框架，该框架的成功率本身并不能完全揭示。该框架确定了在比较跨载体学习时应检查的工作，并突出了在新机器人上剩余的工作和未来研究的问题。
AI.summary: 本调查探讨了机器人基础模型（RFMs）中的“具身鸿沟”，即模型、数据或表示与在特定机器人上执行之间的差距。作者对现有方法进行了分类，并提出了一个报告框架，以量化跨载体学习的适应性工作，超越了单纯的成功率指标。调查强调了共享语义、感知、数据、接口以及跨载体对应关系学习的重要性，并为未来的研究指明了方向。
AI.keywords: 机器人基础模型, 具身鸿沟, 跨载体学习, 适应性报告, 视觉-语言-动作
AI.comments: 该论文对机器人基础模型（RFMs）领域提出了一个重要的概念——“具身鸿沟”，并提供了一个全面的调查。通过将现有方法置于一个双轴地图上，并提出一个报告框架，该研究为理解和解决RFMs在不同机器人平台上的部署挑战提供了宝贵的见解。未来研究方向的确定也为该领域的发展提供了指导。

title: Tangut Word Segmentation under Extreme Resource Scarcity: Integrating Traditional Lexicons and Unlabeled Text
summary: Tangut is an extinct language whose script does not explicitly mark word boundaries. We present the first systematic study of Tangut word segmentation using 2,750 expert-annotated segments(31,893 tokens), traditional lexicons, and unlabeled text. Our framework combines a reliability-calibrated lexicon-lattice representation, explicit distributional statistics, and a lightweight character encoder pretrained with MLM. Segment-level five-fold cross-validation shows that lexical and statistical features raise CRF F1 to approximately 0.91. The full TangutEncoder reaches the highest mean F1 (0.911) and improves recall beyond the labeled training vocabulary. These results demonstrate generalization beyond the limited supervised vocabulary across thematically diverse held-out passages, while document-level transfer remains to be evaluated.

AI.title_translation: 极端资源匮乏下的西夏语分词：整合传统词典与无标签文本
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种在极端资源匮乏下结合传统词典与无标签文本的西夏语分词方法，取得了优异的泛化性能与F1分数。
AI.motivation: 西夏语是一种没有显式标记词边界的灭绝语言，缺乏大规模标注数据，因此需要研究如何在极端资源匮乏的情况下进行有效的西夏语分词。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合可靠性校准的词典格表示、显式分布统计以及使用MLM预训练的轻量级字符编码器的框架。
AI.result: 基于词汇和统计特征的CRF模型的F1值达到了约0.91；完整的TangutEncoder模型达到了最高的平均F1值（0.911），并且提升了超出有监督训练词汇范围的召回率。
AI.conclusion: 结合传统词典、分布统计以及预训练字符编码器的框架在西夏语分词任务上表现优异，显著提升了模型在未标注词汇上的召回率和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 西夏语是一种其文字不显式标记词边界的灭绝语言。我们使用2,750个专家标注的片段（31,893个标记）、传统词典和无标签文本，对西夏语分词进行了首次系统研究。我们的框架结合了可靠性校准的词典格表示、显式分布统计以及通过MLM预训练的轻量级字符编码器。片段级别的五折交叉验证表明，词汇和统计特征将CRF的F1值提高到了大约0.91。完整的TangutEncoder达到了最高的平均F1值（0.911），并提高了超出有监督训练词汇表的召回率。这些结果证明了跨主题多样化的保留文本对有限监督词汇表的泛化能力，而文档级别的迁移仍有待评估。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了极端资源匮乏条件下的西夏语分词，提出了一种整合传统词典、无标签文本以及预训练字符编码器的系统框架，实验表明该方法能有效提升分词的F1值并增强模型泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 西夏语, 分词, 极端资源匮乏, 词典格表示, 掩码语言建模
AI.comments: 该论文首次对灭绝语言西夏语进行了系统分词研究，巧妙地结合了专家标注数据、传统字典和无标签文本，在极端资源匮乏的情况下取得了极高的F1分数，具有很高的学术价值和方法论创新性。

title: Pedagogical AI in Mental Health: A Tri-Stream Fine-Tuned LLM Framework for Automated Clinical Supervision and Risk Triage
comments: 14 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted for publication in AICTC 2026, Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems, vol. 2165, Springer
summary: Modern mental healthcare faces a critical shortage of senior supervisory oversight, leading to a "supervision gap" where novice therapists manage high-stakes risks with delayed professional feedback. This paper proposes a new framework utilizing a fine-tuned Mistral-7B-instruct model as an automated "Supervisor-in-the-Loop" system. By leveraging 106 sessions from the DAIC-WOZ dataset, the model performs a tri-stream analysis: (1) Therapeutic Alliance tracking via semantic adherence, (2) Latent risk prediction using attention-weighted analytics, and (3) Supervisory Triage via a Dynamic Clinical Urgency Index (D-CUI). Our multi-modal VAL (Visual-Acoustic-Linguistic) framework achieves 95% technique identification accuracy [95% CI: 75.1%-99.9%], alliance assessment MAE of 0.105 on a 5-point scale [95% CI: 0.059-0.151], therapeutic fidelity alpha = 0.423, and mean D-CUI of 0.370 [95% CI: 0.322-0.419]. Training converged in 105 steps with 85.2% loss reduction on a single Tesla T4 GPU. The system reduces supervisory triage latency from 72 hours to real time (~10 seconds per session), enabling proactive intervention in high-risk cases. The system addresses the cold-start problem through Bayesian priors and implements timestamp-based modality synchronization for robust multi-modal fusion.

AI.title_translation: 精神卫生中的教育型AI：用于自动化临床督导与风险分诊的三流微调大语言模型框架
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于大语言模型的三流AI框架，实现了心理健康治疗中的实时自动化临床督导和风险分诊，大幅降低了督导延迟并提高了干预效率。
AI.motivation: 现代心理医疗面临严重的资深督导短缺问题（即“督导鸿沟”），导致新手治疗师在处理高风险情况时缺乏及时专业反馈，因此需要一种自动化系统来提供实时监督和风险分诊。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于微调的Mistral-7B-instruct模型的三流分析框架（包含治疗联盟追踪、潜在风险预测和基于动态临床紧急指数的督导分诊），并利用DAIC-WOZ数据集进行了多模态（视觉-声学-语言）训练与验证。
AI.result: 多模态VAL框架实现了95%的技术识别准确率、0.105的治疗联盟评估平均绝对误差、0.423的治疗忠意度alpha值以及0.370的平均D-CUI；训练在单张Tesla T4 GPU上105步收敛，损失降低85.2%，并将分诊延迟从72小时缩短至约10秒。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过结合大语言模型与多模态分析，成功实现了自动化临床督导和风险分诊，有效缓解了心理健康领域的督导资源短缺和延迟问题，具有重要的临床应用前景。
AI.translation: 现代精神卫生保健面临着严重的资深督导短缺问题，导致出现“督导鸿沟”，即新手治疗师在管理高风险情况时缺乏及时的专业反馈。本文提出了一个新框架，利用经过微调的Mistral-7B-instruct模型作为自动化的“监督回路”系统。通过利用DAIC-WOZ数据集中的106个会话，该模型执行三流分析：（1）通过语义依从性追踪治疗联盟，（2）使用注意力加权分析进行潜在风险预测，以及（3）通过动态临床紧急指数（D-CUI）进行督导分诊。我们的多模态VAL（视觉-声学-语言）框架实现了95%的技术识别准确率[95% CI: 75.1%-99.9%]，在5分制评分下治疗联盟评估的MAE为0.105[95% CI: 0.059-0.151]，治疗忠实度alpha = 0.423，平均D-CUI为0.370[95% CI: 0.322-0.419]。在单张Tesla T4 GPU上，训练在105个步骤内收敛，损失减少了85.2%。该系统将督导分诊延迟从72小时缩短至实时（每会话约10秒），从而能够在高风险案例中进行主动干预。该系统通过贝叶斯先验解决了冷启动问题，并实现了基于时间戳的模态同步，以实现稳健的多模态融合。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于微调大语言模型的三流分析框架，用于自动化心理健康领域的临床督导与风险分诊。通过多模态融合与动态临床紧急指数计算，该系统实现了实时、高精度的督导反馈，有效缓解了行业内资深监督资源不足的痛点。
AI.keywords: Pedagogical AI, Mental Health, Large Language Models, Clinical Supervision, Risk Triage
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于微调大语言模型的“监督回路”框架，针对心理健康领域中资深督导短缺的问题，创新性地实现了自动化的临床督导和风险分诊。通过三流分析和多模态融合，大幅缩短了督导延迟，展现出极高的应用价值和技术可行性。

title: Formal Verification of Romanov's Triplet Logic: A Verified Filter for Sliding-window 3-CNF with Application to Structured Formulas
comments: 25 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables, 3 listings, 16 bibliographic references, more than 23,000 lines of Rocq code across 17 files, with 427 proved lemmas and theorems and zero admitted goals
summary: We present the first mechanised formalisation of Romanov's Triplet Logic (TLS) in the Rocq proof assistant. TLS is a triplet-based combinatorial framework for reasoning about compatible paths through layered triplet structures, called Compact Triplets Structures (CTS), and their intersection via Romanov's Effective Procedure, which we refer to as Simple Vertex Intersection (SVI). Originally motivated by Boolean satisfiability, TLS constitutes a self-contained mathematical theory whose formal properties had not been previously established. We formalise the core of TLS in Rocq, including Compact Triplets Formulas (CTF), CTS, hyperstructures, clearing, and SVI. For the well-formed sliding-window fragment we verify a clause-by-clause CNF-to-CTF translation, the clearing procedure, and aligned intersection, and we prove explicit polynomial-time bounds for the filter stages. Our main contribution is a precise correctness boundary: the existence of a joint satisfying set implies non-emptiness of SVI, but the converse does not hold in general; for aligned structures we recover a complete bi-implication, extended to systems of structures. We also formalise soundness of grouped-window translation and exhibit a formal counterexample to its completeness. We introduce VFR, an extracted OCaml prototype that provides a verified decision procedure for the sliding-window fragment and a sound one-sided filter for general 3-CNF, with a Python runtime and reproducible Docker packaging. Benchmarks on random and structured instances confirm the predicted behaviour, and the complete toolchain is available as a curated Zenodo artifact. The Rocq development comprises more than 23,000 lines of code across seventeen files, with 427 proved lemmas and theorems and zero admitted goals.
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables, 3 listings, 16 bibliographic references, more than 23,000 lines of Rocq code across 17 files, with 427 proved lemmas and theorems and zero admitted goals

AI.title_translation: Romanov三元组逻辑的形式化验证：用于滑动窗口3-CNF及结构化公式应用的已验证过滤器
AI.tldr: 本文首次在Rocq证明助手中对Romanov的三元组逻辑（TLS）进行了全面的形式化验证，并开发了经过验证的决策与过滤工具VFR。
AI.motivation: Romanov的三元组逻辑（TLS）是一个用于推理分层三元组结构中兼容路径的组合框架，原本用于布尔可满足性（SAT），但其形式化性质此前尚未建立，因此需要进行机械化的形式验证来确立其严谨的数学基础。
AI.method: 在Rocq证明助手（Rocq proof assistant）中实现了TLS核心的形式化，包括紧凑三元组公式、超结构、清理和简单顶点交集（SVI）；验证了滑动窗口片段的CNF到CTF翻译、清理过程和对齐交集；提取了OCaml原型工具VFR，并进行了基准测试。
AI.result: 证明了联合满足集的存正在SVI非空时成立（但逆之不成立），对于对齐结构恢复了完全的双向蕴涵；形式化了分组窗口翻译的可靠性并展示了其完备性的形式化反例；开发了VFR并在随机和结构化实例上通过了基准测试。
AI.conclusion: 作者在Rocq中完成了Romanov三元组逻辑的核心形式化，定义了其正确性边界，并开发了经过验证的VFR决策/过滤工具，为布尔可满足性及结构化公式的研究提供了坚实的基础。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了在Rocq证明助手中对Romanov的三元组逻辑（TLS）的首次机械化形式化。TLS是一个基于三元组的组合框架，用于推理分层三元组结构（称为紧凑三元组结构，CTS）中的兼容路径，以及通过Romanov的有效程序（我们称之为简单顶点交集，SVI）进行的路径交集。最初受布尔可满足性启发，TLS构成了一个自包含的数学理论，其形式化性质此前尚未建立。我们在Rocq中形式化了TLS的核心，包括紧凑三元组公式（CTF）、CTS、超结构、清理和SVI。对于良构的滑动窗口片段，我们验证了逐子句的CNF到CTF翻译、清理过程以及对齐交集，并证明了过滤阶段的显式多项式时间界限。我们的主要贡献是一个精确的正确性边界：联合满足集的存在意味着SVI的非空性，但在一般情况下逆之不成立；对于对齐结构，我们恢复了完整的双向蕴涵，并将其扩展到了结构系统。我们还形式化了分组窗口翻译的可靠性，并展示了其完备性的形式化反例。我们引入了VFR，一个提取出的OCaml原型，它为滑动窗口片段提供了经过验证的决策程序，并为通用3-CNF提供了可靠的单向过滤器，带有Python运行时和可复现的Docker打包。随机和结构化实例上的基准测试证实了预测的行为，完整的工具链作为精心整理的Zenodo构件提供。Rocq开发包含超过23,000行代码，分布在十七个文件中，包含427个已证明的引理和定理，且零假设（admitted goals）。
AI.summary: 本文在Rocq证明助手完成了Romanov三元组逻辑（TLS）的首次机器形式化，涵盖核心理论、滑动窗口片段的验证、正确性边界的建立，并提取了经验证的OCaml原型工具VFR，通过了基准测试。
AI.keywords: Romanov's Triplet Logic, Formal Verification, Rocq Proof Assistant, Sliding-window 3-CNF, SVI
AI.comments: 该论文首次对Romanov的三元组逻辑进行了机器形式化验证，填补了该领域形式化证明的空白，并提供了可运行、经验证的原型系统VFR，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用潜力。

title: HarvestPoint-ACT: Explicit Target Selection and Harvest-Point Conditioning for Robotic Fruit Harvesting under Occlusion
summary: End-to-end imitation learning avoids hand-made robot motion for approaching and grasping, but the policy must still decide which fruit to pick and where to close the gripper. Occlusion can make the policy lose the selected fruit during harvesting, and the correct closing point is difficult to infer from pixels alone. This paper presents HarvestPoint-ACT, which makes both decisions explicit in perception and provides them to the policy. An instance segmentation front end with a keypoint branch predicts a mask and a harvest point for each visible fruit, where the harvest point specifies the location to close the gripper. A scheduler ranks detected candidates by occlusion and travel distance and selects one target. After each attempt, it redetects and reranks the candidates because the canopy may have changed. The selected fruit is encoded for an action chunking transformer as an eight-dimensional state, containing the absolute harvest point, the vector from the gripper to that point, a validity flag, and a confidence score. When the selected fruit is temporarily undetected, the system retains the last harvest point estimate in the robot base frame and marks it as stale, and aborts the attempt if the loss persists. On a canopy mock-up, HarvestPoint-ACT achieves a success rate of 88%, and of 75% under heavy occlusion.

AI.title_translation: HarvestPoint-ACT：遮挡下机器人水果采摘的显式目标选择与收获点条件化
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为HarvestPoint-ACT的机器人水果采摘方法，通过显式指定采摘目标和夹爪闭合点，有效解决了遮挡环境下的采摘难题。
AI.motivation: 端到端模仿学习避免了人工设计机器人运动，但策略仍需决定采摘哪个果实以及在哪里闭合夹爪；遮挡会导致策略在收获过程中丢失选定的果实，且正确的闭合点很难仅从像素中推断。
AI.method: 提出HarvestPoint-ACT系统，包含一个带有关键点分支的实例分割前端（预测掩码和收获点）、一个基于遮挡和移动距离的调度器（用于选择和重新评估目标），以及将目标编码为8维状态输入到动作分块转换器（ACT）中的机制。
AI.result: 在冠层模拟测试中，HarvestPoint-ACT取得了88%的总体成功率，在重度遮挡下成功率为75%。
AI.conclusion: HarvestPoint-ACT通过显式目标选择和收获点条件化，有效克服了果实收获中的遮挡难题，在实体冠层模拟测试中取得了优异的成功率。
AI.translation: 端到端模仿学习避免了手工制作机器人接近和抓取运动的需求，但策略仍然必须决定采摘哪个水果以及在哪里关闭夹爪。遮挡会使策略在收获过程中丢失所选的水果，并且很难仅从像素推断出正确的闭合点。本文提出了HarvestPoint-ACT，它在感知中明确了这两项决策并将其提供给策略。带有关键点分支的实例分割前端为每个可见水果预测一个掩码和一个收获点，其中收获点指定了关闭夹爪的位置。调度器按遮挡和行程距离对检测到的候选者进行排序并选择一个目标。每次尝试后，它会重新检测并重新对候选者进行排名，因为冠层可能已经改变。所选水果被编码为动作分块转换器（ACT）的八维状态，包含绝对收获点、从夹爪到该点的向量、有效性标志和置信度得分。当所选水果暂时未被检测到时，系统保留机器人基座坐标系中的最后一次收获点估计并将其标记为陈旧，如果损失持续存在则中止尝试。在冠层模拟装置上，HarvestPoint-ACT实现了88%的成功率，在重度遮挡下实现了75%的成功率。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了HarvestPoint-ACT，一种用于机器人在遮挡环境下采摘水果的新方法。该方法通过显式目标选择和收获点条件化，利用实例分割前端预测收获点，结合调度器动态管理目标，并将其输入动作分块转换器（ACT）中，从而有效解决了遮挡和夹爪闭合点推断的难题。
AI.keywords: 机器人水果收获, 模仿学习, 显式目标选择, 收获点条件化, 遮挡处理
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将显式目标选择与收获点条件化引入端到端模仿学习中，有效解决了果实遮挡和夹爪闭合点推断难题，显著提升了机器人在复杂冠层环境下的收获成功率。

title: More Context, Same Budget: Dual-Bounded Relational Recall Beyond Top-K Retrieval
comments: 20 pages, 4 figures. Complete supporting-evidence recovery under a frozen HotpotQA FullWiki retrieval design; not answer accuracy
summary:
More context does not require a larger retrieval budget. Under the same ceiling, a retrieval system can recover more of the evidence a question requires by following relationships between evidence that flat top-k ranking leaves behind. We test that proposition with Dual-Bounded Relational Recall (DBRR), which allocates a fixed retrieval budget between relevance-selected seeds and bounded graph-adjacent context, against matched flat top-k retrieval using the same relevance-ranking stage and the same maximum number of retrieval units and tokens. The outcome is complete recovery of the official HotpotQA supporting-evidence set for each question.
  Across 7,405 FullWiki questions, the Primary DBRR allocation increased complete supporting-evidence recovery by 23.8 percentage points over its matched flat baseline (paired risk difference 0.2377; question-level bootstrap 95% interval 0.2269 to 0.2489). It improved 1,952 questions, tied on 5,261, and harmed 192. Bridge questions drove the effect, with a 28.7-point increase; comparison questions showed a smaller 4.2-point difference. In a prespecified, evaluation-only diagnostic population, real relationships also outperformed random-neighbor and degree-preserving shuffled-graph controls.
  The result is straightforward: under the same context budget, complete-evidence retrieval depends not only on which items rank highest, but on how context is allocated around them. Relational allocation recovered complete evidence sets that flat top-k retrieval left incomplete.

AI.title_translation: 更多上下文，相同预算：Top-K检索之外的双边界关系召回
AI.tldr: 在不增加预算的前提下，通过利用证据间的图关系进行双边界关系召回（DBRR），显著提升了复杂问答任务中完整证据的恢复率。
AI.motivation: 传统的扁平化top-k检索往往遗漏证据之间的关键关系，而拥有更多上下文并不一定需要更大的检索预算，因此需要探索如何在相同的预算下通过利用证据间的关系来恢复更多必要证据。
AI.method: 提出了双边界关系召回（DBRR）方法，在相同的最大检索单元数和token预算下，将固定的检索预算分配给相关性选定的种子和有界的图邻近上下文。
AI.result: 在7,405个FullWiki问题中，主要DBRR分配方案将完整支持证据的恢复率比扁平基线提高了23.8个百分点，其中桥接问题（bridge questions）的提升尤为显著（28.7个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 在相同的上下文预算下，利用证据间的关系进行双边界关系召回（DBRR）能够显著提高复杂问答任务中的完整证据恢复率，优于传统的扁平化top-k检索。
AI.translation:
更多上下文并不需要更大的检索预算。在相同的上限下，检索系统可以通过追踪传统扁平top-k排序所遗漏的证据之间的关系，来恢复问题所需的更多证据。我们通过双边界关系召回（DBRR）来验证这一命题，该方法在相关性选定的种子和有界的图邻近上下文之间分配固定的检索预算，并与使用相同相关性排序阶段、最大检索单元数和token数的匹配扁平top-k检索进行对比。其结果是完整恢复了每个官方HotpotQA支持证据集。
在7,405个FullWiki问题中，主要的DBRR分配方案使完整的支持证据恢复率比其匹配的扁平基线提高了23.8个百分点（配对风险差0.2377；问题级bootstrap 95%区间为0.2269至0.2489）。它改善了1,952个问题，5,261个问题持平，192个问题变差。桥接问题（Bridge questions）驱动了这一效果，提升了28.7个百分点；比较问题（Comparison questions）显示出较小的4.2个百分点差异。在一个预先指定的、仅用于评估的诊断群体中，真实关系也优于随机邻居和保持度数的随机图控制。
结果很直接：在相同的上下文预算下，完整证据检索不仅取决于哪些项目的排名最高，还取决于上下文是如何围绕它们分配的。关系分配恢复了扁平top-k检索无法完全获取的完整证据集。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为双边界关系召回（DBRR）的新方法，它在不增加预算的前提下，通过结合相关性种子与有界的图邻近上下文，显著提高了复杂问答（如HotpotQA）中完整支持证据的恢复率。
AI.keywords: 信息检索, 关系召回, 证据恢复, 上下文预算, 图结构上下文
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出双边界关系召回（DBRR）方法，在不增加检索预算的前提下，通过利用证据之间的关系显著提高了复杂问答任务中完整证据的召回率，展示了图结构上下文在信息检索中的巨大潜力。

title: Adaptive Multi-Agent Feature Selection for Personalized Fall Risk Prevention
comments: 38 pages, 10 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC 2026)
summary: Falls among older adults represent a major public health challenge driven by complex, time-varying interactions across multiple risk domains. Effective fall risk factor identification requires learning from heterogeneous longitudinal data while accounting for sparse and delayed fall-related outcome events. However, existing approaches are largely static and fail to adaptively model evolving, individualized risk factors across modalities and time. We propose PAFIR, a Personalized and Adaptive Feature selection framework for fall risk Identification and pRevention, which formulates adaptive feature selection as a reinforcement learning problem over longitudinal multimodal health data. PAFIR jointly models structural dependencies among correlated assessment variables and temporal dynamics in wearable-derived physical activity data, and learns adaptive selection policies across repeated study visits using reward signals derived from sparse fall incidence outcomes. We apply PAFIR to data from the Physio fEedback Exercise pRogram (PEER) cluster-randomized trial. Experimental results demonstrate that PAFIR more effectively captures longitudinal and structural patterns of feature relevance than state-of-the-art baselines, and enables dynamic, subject-specific feature selection. By adapting selected features over time, PAFIR supports more timely and personalized fall prevention strategies.
comment: 38 pages, 10 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC 2026)

AI.title_translation: 面向个性化跌倒风险预防的自适应多智能体特征 selection（注：Feature Selection译为特征选择）
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于强化学习的自适应特征选择框架（PAFIR），用于处理纵向多模态健康数据，从而实现对老年人跌倒风险的个性化和动态预防。
AI.motivation: 现有的老年人跌倒风险识别方法大多是静态的，无法自适应地对跨模态和时间的演变、个性化风险因素进行建模，难以应对复杂且时变的跌倒风险交互。
AI.method: 提出PAFIR框架，将自适应特征选择建模为强化学习问题，结合结构依赖性与时间动态性，在重复研究访问中学习自适应选择策略。
AI.result: 在PEER集群随机试验数据集上的实验结果表明，PAFIR比现有最先进的基线更能有效地捕捉特征相关性的纵向和结构模式，并支持动态的、受试者特定的特征选择。
AI.conclusion: PAFIR框架有效克服了传统静态方法的局限性，能够捕捉跌倒风险因素的纵向和结构演变，支持及时、个性化的跌倒预防策略。
AI.translation: 老年人跌倒是一个主要的公共卫生挑战，由多个风险领域之间复杂、随时间变化的交互作用驱动。有效的跌倒风险因素识别需要从异构的纵向数据中学习，同时还要考虑稀疏且延迟的跌倒相关结果事件。然而，现有方法大体上是静态的，无法自适应地跨模态和时间对演变的、个体化的风险因素进行建模。我们提出了PAFIR（一种用于跌倒风险识别和预防的个性化与自适应特征选择框架），该框架将纵向多模态健康数据上的自适应特征选择表述为一个强化学习问题。PAFIR联合建模了相关评估变量之间的结构依赖性和可穿戴设备派生的身体活动数据中的时间动态性，并使用源自稀疏跌倒发生结果的奖励信号，在重复的研究访问中学习自适应选择策略。我们将PAFIR应用于Physio fEedback Exercise pRogram (PEER) 整群随机试验的数据中。实验结果表明，与最先进的基线相比，PAFIR能更有效地捕捉特征相关性的纵向和结构模式，并实现动态的、受试者特定的特征选择。通过随时间调整所选特征，PAFIR支持更及时和个性化的跌倒预防策略。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PAFIR，一个用于个性化跌倒风险识别和预防的自适应特征选择框架。该框架将自适应特征选择建模为纵向多模态健康数据上的强化学习问题，能够有效捕捉结构依赖性和时间动态性，从而实现更及时、个性化的跌倒预防。
AI.keywords: 跌倒风险预防, 自适应特征选择, 强化学习, 纵向多模态数据, 个性化医疗
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将强化学习应用于纵向多模态健康数据的自适应特征选择，以解决老年人跌倒风险预测中因素时变性和稀疏结果的难题，对个性化医疗具有重要意义。

title: Atrial Fibrillation Detection with Arbitrary Leads via a Codebook-Based Reconstruction-Classification Framework
summary: \textbf{Background and Objective}: Reliable atrial fibrillation (AF) detection from electrocardiogram (ECG) signals remains challenging in real-world clinical settings due to variable lead configurations, cross-dataset domain shifts, and pervasive physiological and technical artifacts. So we develop a robust and generalizable deep learning model for accurate AF detection.\\ \textbf{Methods}: We propose the Dual-Codebook Graph Collaborative Network (DCGCNet), a novel end-to-end vector-quantized variational autoencoder that jointly performs AF classification and ECG reconstruction. DCGCNet introduces two key components: (1) a Local-Global Contrastive Module for learning noise-invariant representations, and (2) an Adaptive Codebook Vector Quantizer that dynamically refines codebook prototypes to better align with input data distributions, thereby preventing codebook collapse and enhancing generalization.\\ \textbf{Results}: DCGCNet achieves state-of-the-art performance in standard intra-dataset 12-lead evaluation and demonstrates exceptional cross-dataset generalization across seven diverse settings, consistently attaining AUC > 0.98 in all cases. Furthermore, it maintains high diagnostic accuracy under realistic noisy conditions, including baseline wander, powerline interference, and EMG artifacts.\\ \textbf{Conclusions}: DCGCNet establishes a new benchmark for robust, generalizable, and noise-resilient AF detection, showing strong potential for deployment in real-world clinical environments.

AI.title_translation: 基于码本重建-分类框架的任意导联房颤检测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为DCGCNet的新型深度学习模型，通过码本重建与分类联合框架，实现了在各种噪声干扰、变导联配置和跨数据集情况下的高精度房颤检测。
AI.motivation: 由于可变导联配置、跨数据集域偏移以及普遍存在的生理和技术伪影，现实临床中从心电图信号进行可靠的房颤检测仍然具有挑战性，因此需要开发一个鲁棒且可泛化的深度学习模型。
AI.method: 提出双码本图协同网络（DCGCNet），这是一个端到端的向量量化变分自编码器，联合执行房颤分类和ECG重建，并引入了局部-全局对比模块和自适应码本向量量化器。
AI.result: DCGCNet在标准的同数据集12导联评估中达到了最先进的性能，在七种不同的跨数据集设置中展示了卓越的泛化能力（所有情况下的AUC均大于0.98），并且在存在真实噪声的条件下保持了高的诊断准确率。
AI.conclusion: DCGCNet为鲁棒、可泛化且抗噪声的房颤检测建立了一个新的基准，在真实临床环境中具有巨大的部署潜力。
AI.translation:
背景与目标：由于可变导联配置、跨数据集域偏移以及普遍存在的生理和技术伪影，在现实临床环境中从心电图（ECG）信号中进行可靠的心房颤动（AF）检测仍然具有挑战性。因此，我们开发了一个用于准确房颤检测的鲁棒且可泛化的深度学习模型。
方法：我们提出了双码本图协同网络（DCGCNet），这是一个新颖的端到端向量量化变分自编码器，它联合执行房颤分类和ECG重建。DCGCNet引入了两个关键组件：（1）用于学习抗噪表示的局部-全局对比模块，以及（2）动态精炼码本原型以更好地对齐输入数据分布的自适应码本向量量化器，从而防止码本崩塌并增强泛化能力。
结果：DCGCNet在标准的同数据集12导联评估中达到了最先进的性能，并在七种不同的设置中展示了卓越的跨数据集泛化能力，所有情况下的AUC均持续大于0.98。此外，它在真实的噪声条件（包括基线漂移、工频干扰和肌电伪影）下保持了高诊断准确率。
结论：DCGCNet为鲁棒、可泛化且抗噪声的房颤检测建立了一个新的基准，显示出在真实临床环境中部署的强大潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为DCGCNet的深度学习框架，通过结合重建与分类任务以及自适应码本机制，解决了房颤检测中面临的导联可变、域偏移和噪声干扰问题，实现了高精度与强泛化能力的房颤检测。
AI.keywords: 房颤检测, 心电图 (ECG), 向量量化变分自编码器, 跨数据集泛化, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于双码本图协同网络的端到端模型，能够有效应对房颤检测中常见的变导联配置、跨数据集域偏移以及各种生理和技术伪影，展现出极强的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: Backward Layout Search for Sequence-Constrained Robotic Assembly
summary: Robotic assembly layout planning must determine the assembly site and the initial pose of each part while ensuring collision-free execution of a prescribed assembly sequence. This problem is challenging because the obstacle environment changes after each assembly step, and unassembled parts re maining in the workspace may block robot motions. We observe that the feasibility of each assembly step depends only on the initial poses of the current and later-assembled parts. Based on this dependency, we propose Backward Layout Search (BLS), which assigns initial part poses in reverse assembly order. Each expansion performs geometric, kinematic, grasp, and prescribed-motion checks, while collision masks and candidate set filtering remove infeasible initial part pose candidates. Promising partial layouts are retained through beam selection, and complete layouts are validated by full motion planning in forward assembly order. Experiments on five assembly models show that BLS produces collision-free executable layouts and reduces step evaluations and search time compared with a matched forward search.

AI.title_translation: 面向序列约束机器人装配的逆向布局搜索
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种逆向布局搜索（BLS）算法，通过按逆序规划零件初始位姿，高效解决了序列约束下机器人装配的无碰撞布局规划问题。
AI.motivation: 机器人装配布局规划需要确定装配地点和零件初始位姿以确保无碰撞执行，由于每一步后障碍环境动态变化且未装配零件可能阻塞运动，该问题极具挑战性。现有正向搜索效率低下，因此需要新的高效搜索策略。
AI.method: 提出逆向布局搜索（BLS）方法，按逆序分配零件初始位姿，每一步扩展结合几何、运动学、抓取和指定运动检查，利用碰撞掩码和候选集过滤，通过束搜索保留部分布局，最后通过正向运动规划验证完整布局。
AI.result: 在五个装配模型上的实验表明，BLS能够生成无碰撞、可执行的布局，并相比匹配的正向搜索减少了步骤评估次数和搜索时间。
AI.conclusion: 逆向布局搜索（BLS）通过按逆序分配零件初始位姿并结合束搜索和几何运动学检查，能够高效地解决序列约束下的机器人装配布局规划问题，显著优于传统的正向搜索方法。
AI.translation: 机器人装配布局规划必须确定装配地点和每个零件的初始位姿，同时确保在规定的装配序列下无碰撞执行。由于每个装配步骤后障碍环境会发生变化，且工作空间中剩余的未装配零件可能会阻塞机器人运动，这个问题非常具有挑战性。我们观察到，每个装配步骤的可行性仅取决于当前及后续装配零件的初始位姿。基于这种依赖关系，我们提出了逆向布局搜索（BLS），它以相反的装配顺序分配零件的初始位姿。每次扩展都执行几何、运动学、抓取和指定运动检查，同时碰撞掩码和候选集过滤用于剔除不可行的零件初始位姿候选。通过束搜索保留有希望的部分布局，并通过正向装配顺序的完整运动规划来验证完整的布局。在五个装配模型上的实验表明，与匹配的正向搜索相比，BLS能够生成无碰撞且可执行的布局，并减少了步骤评估次数和搜索时间。
AI.summary: 该论文针对序列约束下的机器人装配布局规划问题，提出了逆向布局搜索（BLS）算法。通过利用装配可行性的逆向依赖关系，BLS按逆序分配零件初始位姿，并结合几何运动学检查、候选过滤和束搜索，最终通过正向运动规划验证，有效降低了搜索复杂度和时间。
AI.keywords: 机器人装配, 布局规划, 逆向搜索, 运动规划, 序列约束
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种逆向布局搜索（BLS）方法来解决序列约束下的机器人装配布局规划问题。通过利用装配步骤的可行性仅取决于当前及后续装配零件初始位姿这一核心洞察，逆向规划显著减少了状态空间和搜索时间，在多个装配模型上验证了其高效性和可行性。

title: Joint Beamforming and Phase Shifts Design for RIS-Enabled RSMA-ISAC Systems
summary: This paper investigates the sensing-centric design of reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-enabled rate-splitting multiple access-integrated sensing and communication (RSMA-ISAC) systems. Specifically, we propose a new beam-gain approximation method to enhance the sensing beam gain while satisfying communication quality-of-service (QoS) constraints.Since the joint optimization of the beamforming vectors and RIS phase shifts is highly coupled and non-convex, existing methods typically rely on generic optimization solvers involving substantial computational complexity. To address this issue, we propose an efficient constraints-separation-based alternating optimization algorithm (CS-AO). Our proposed algorithm effectively decouples the optimization variables and yields closed-form solutions for all subproblems, thereby significantly reducing the computational burden. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm achieves sensing beam-gain performance comparable to successive convex approximation (SCA) and semidefinite relaxation (SDR) benchmarks, while achieving more than 120-fold and 50-fold runtime reductions. In addition, compared with conventional space-division multiple access (SDMA) schemes, the proposed design exhibits substantial sensing beam gain.

AI.title_translation: RIS赋能的RSMA-ISAC系统联合波束赋形与相移设计
AI.tldr: 本文针对RIS赋能的RSMA-ISAC系统，提出了一种基于约束分离的高效交替优化算法，在保证感知和通信性能的同时将计算时间大幅缩短50到120倍以上。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助的速率分裂多址集成传感与通信（RSMA-ISAC）系统中，波束赋形向量与RIS相移高度耦合且非凸所导致的现有方法计算复杂度过高的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的波束增益近似方法以增强感知波束增益，并设计了一种基于约束分离的交替优化算法（CS-AO），通过解耦优化变量并导出所有子问题的闭式解来降低计算复杂度。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的算法在实现与SCA和SDR基准相当的感知波束增益性能的同时，运行时间减少了120倍和50倍以上，并且相比传统SDMA方案展现出显著的感知波束增益。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的CS-AO算法成功实现了RIS辅助RSMA-ISAC系统中复杂优化变量的解耦，在保证感知性能的同时大幅降低了计算时间，优于传统SDMA方案。
AI.translation: 本文研究了可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助的速率分裂多址接入-集成传感与通信（RSMA-ISAC）系统的感知中心设计。具体而言，我们提出了一种新的波束增益近似方法，在满足通信服务质量（QoS）约束的同时增强感知波束增益。由于波束赋形向量和RIS相移的联合优化高度耦合且非凸，现有方法通常依赖于计算复杂度高的通用优化求解器。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种高效的基于约束分离的交替优化算法（CS-AO）。我们提出的算法有效地解耦了优化变量，并为所有子问题推导出了闭式解，从而显著降低了计算负担。仿真结果表明，该算法在实现与连续凸近似（SCA）和半正定松弛（SDR）基准相当的感知波束增益性能的同时，运行时间减少了120倍和50倍以上。此外，与传统的空分多址（SDMA）方案相比，所提出的设计表现出显著的感知波束增益。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了RIS辅助的RSMA-ISAC系统的感知中心设计，提出了一种新型波束增益近似方法和高效的基于约束分离的交替优化（CS-AO）算法，有效克服了传统方法计算复杂度高的难题，大幅缩短了运行时间并提升了感知性能。
AI.keywords: 可重构智能表面 (RIS), 速率分裂多址接入 (RSMA), 集成传感与通信 (ISAC), 联合波束赋形, 约束分离交替优化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的基于约束分离的交替优化算法，显著降低了RIS辅助RSMA-ISAC系统中的计算复杂度，同时保持了优异的感知和通信性能，具有极高的实用价值。

title: Reducing Technician Search Burden: A Multimodal RAG for Cessna 172 Maintenance Manual
summary: Proper use of the aircraft maintenance manual is essential for correct maintenance, providing procedures, diagrams, cautions, and specifications. However, technicians often avoid consulting it because it is difficult to navigate and time-consuming under strict schedules. Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) models have recently been introduced in aircraft maintenance, yet existing models focus solely on textual retrieval. This research therefore targeted the Cessna 172 Maintenance Manual (C172-MM), widely used in general aviation, and developed a multimodal manual retriever (MMR) capable of retrieving multimodal manual pages. Retrieval performance was evaluated using synthetic queries covering procedures, diagrams, caution/safety information, and specifications; the MMR achieved 93.37% recall@5. Beyond retrieval, a multimodal RAG (MRAG) pipeline was examined, in which retrieved pages were input to a vision-language model that generated responses to the synthetic queries, achieving 87.20% semantic similarity to ground-truth answers. Three practical feasibilities were also assessed: inference time, operational cost, and interpretability. Average retrieval time for five pages was 11.93 seconds and response generation took 4.95 seconds, at $0.0091 per query, while interpretability was validated through heatmap visualizations. These results indicate that the MRAG pipeline for the C172-MM can reduce the time technicians spend searching manuals and retrieving multimodal information.

AI.title_translation: 减轻技术人员的搜索负担：面向塞斯纳172维护手册的多模态RAG系统
AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个针对塞斯纳172飞机维护手册的多模态RAG系统，通过图文检索与大模型生成显著减轻了技术人员查阅手册的负担，并具有高准确率和实用可行性。
AI.motivation: 飞机维护手册对正确维护至关重要，但由于导航困难且耗时，技术人员在严格的工期下常常避免查阅；而现有的检索增强生成（RAG）模型仅专注于纯文本检索，缺乏对多模态内容的支持。
AI.method: 开发了多模态手动检索器（MMR）以检索多模态手册页面，并构建了多模态RAG（MRAG）管道，将检索到的页面输入视觉语言模型以生成对合成查询的回答，同时评估了推理时间、运营成本和热力图可视化带来的可解释性。
AI.result: MMR在检索性能上达到了93.37%的recall@5，MRAG管道生成的回答与真实答案达到了87.20%的语义相似度；检索5页的平均时间为11.93秒，生成响应为4.95秒，每次查询成本为0.0091美元，且通过热力图验证了可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 基于多模态RAG（MRAG）的塞斯纳172维护手册系统能够有效且高效地检索多模态信息并生成准确回答，显著降低了技术人员的搜索负担，在实际操作中具有良好的可行性。
AI.translation: 正确使用飞机维护手册对于正确维护至关重要，它提供了程序、图表、注意事项和规范。然而，技术人员往往避免查阅它，因为在严格的工期下，它很难导航且耗时。检索增强生成（RAG）模型最近已被引入飞机维护中，然而现有模型仅专注于文本检索。因此，本研究针对在通用航空中广泛使用的塞斯纳172维护手册（C172-MM），开发了一种能够检索多模态手册页面的多模态手册检索器（MMR）。使用涵盖程序、图表、注意事项/安全信息以及规格说明的合成查询评估了检索性能；MMR实现了93.37%的recall@5。除了检索之外，还检验了多模态RAG（MRAG）管道，其中检索到的页面被输入到视觉语言模型中，该模型生成了对合成查询的响应，与真实答案达到了87.20%的语义相似度。还评估了三种实际可行性：推理时间、运营成本和可解释性。检索五页的平均检索时间为11.93秒，响应生成耗时4.95秒，每次查询成本为0.0091美元，同时通过热力图可视化验证了可解释性。这些结果表明，针对C172-MM的MRAG管道可以减少技术人员花在搜索手册和检索多模态信息上的时间。
AI.summary: 该研究针对塞斯纳172维护手册开发了一种多模态检索与生成（MRAG）管道，能够有效检索图文并茂的维护页面并利用视觉语言模型生成精准回答，显著减轻了技术人员的查阅负担，并在时间、成本和可解释性上展现出良好的实际应用可行性。
AI.keywords: 多模态RAG, 飞机维护手册, 塞斯纳172, 视觉语言模型, 信息检索
AI.comments: 该论文针对飞机维护中手动查询繁琐的痛点，创新性地提出了针对塞斯纳172维护手册的多模态RAG系统（MMR与MRAG），兼顾了文本与图像的检索，并在推理时间、成本和可解释性方面进行了全面的实际可行性评估，对通用航空维护具有较高的实用价值。

title: ERASE: EaRly bAckpropagation SchEdule for Faster Training of Modern Recommendation Systems
summary: Lightweight proxy models enable rapid experimentation without repeatedly training frontier-scale systems, but their small kernels often leave modern accelerators underutilized. Conventional training compounds this inefficiency by scheduling the forward and backward passes as disjoint phases, so spare capacity in one cannot be filled by work from the other. We reinterpret the detachment mechanism of Forward-Forward (FF) as a scheduling primitive: given a local objective, detaching a block's output removes downstream gradient dependencies, making its backward pass ready when its forward pass finishes. ERASE launches each detached subgraph's backward pass early on a separate CUDA stream, overlapping it with subsequent forward work. Execution trace on a lightweight transformer demonstrates this overlap and its limit: a kernel that saturates the device leaves no capacity for concurrency. On a large-scale click-through-rate model, detaching six dense subarchitectures improves training throughput by up to $9.51\%$ while keeping normalized entropy close to the baseline.

AI.title_translation: ERASE：用于现代推荐系统更快训练的早期反向传播调度策略
AI.tldr: ERASE通过将子图反向传播提前并与前向计算重叠，显著提高了推荐系统在大规模加速器上的训练吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 轻量级代理模型无法充分利用现代加速器的算力，而传统的训练将前向和反向传递安排为不相交的阶段，导致计算资源未能得到充分利用。
AI.method: 将Forward-Forward算法的解耦机制作为调度原语，给定局部目标，解耦块输出以消除下游梯度依赖，并在独立的CUDA流上提早启动每个解耦子图的反向传播，实现与后续前向工作的重叠。
AI.result: 在轻量级Transformer上的执行轨迹证明了计算重叠的可行性；在大规模点击率预测模型上，解耦6个密集子架构使训练吞吐量提升高达9.51%，同时保持归一化熵接近基线。
AI.conclusion: ERASE通过将块输出解耦并提前启动反向传播，成功重叠了前向和反向计算，在保证模型收敛质量（归一化熵）的前提下，显著提高了大规模推荐系统的训练吞吐量。
AI.translation: 轻量级代理模型能够进行快速实验，而无需重复训练前沿规模的系统，但它们的小内核往往使现代加速器得不到充分利用。常规训练将前向和反向传递调度为不相交的阶段，从而加剧了这种效率低下，因此一个阶段的闲置容量无法由另一个阶段的工作来填补。我们将前向-前向（FF）算法的解耦机制重新解释为一个调度原语：给定一个局部目标，解耦一个块的输出可以消除下游的梯度依赖，使其反向传递在其前向传递完成时就绪。ERASE在单独的CUDA流上提早启动每个解耦子图的反向传递，将其与后续的前向工作重叠。轻量级Transformer上的执行轨迹证明了这种重叠及其限制：使设备饱和的内核没有留下并发容量。在大规模点击率模型上，解耦六个密集子架构将训练吞吐量提高了高达9.51%，同时使归一化熵接近基线。
AI.summary: ERASE是一种用于现代推荐系统更快训练的早期反向传播调度方法。它通过将前向-前向算法的解耦机制作为调度原语，提早启动解耦子图的反向传播并与后续前向计算重叠，从而解决了传统训练中前向和反向阶段不相交导致的硬件利用率低问题，显著提升了训练吞吐量。
AI.keywords: 推荐系统, 训练加速, 反向传播调度, 前向-前向算法, 计算重叠
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的训练调度机制（ERASE），将前向-前向算法（FF）的解耦机制转化为调度原语，通过提早触发局部子图的反向传播并与后续前向计算重叠，有效提升了现代推荐系统中硬件加速器的利用率和训练吞吐量。

title: DevGRU: Depth-guided Visual Navigation using a Collision-aware Recurrent Model
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026
summary: Existing visual navigation models often aim to develop foundation models that can generalize robot navigation across diverse platforms. However, many of these models are prone to collisions when deployed in complex indoor environments, particularly in structured layouts and narrow passages. To address this problem, we propose a depth image- and point-goal-conditioned navigation system, DevGRU. The proposed system employs an action predictor (AP) that generates collision-aware future trajectories, enabling effective avoidance of immediate obstacles. In conjunction with a collision predictor, the AP further compensates for errors accumulated in the goal pose estimation and proactively mitigates future deviations. To evaluate our method, we conducted experiments across nine different scenes and three state-of-the-art approaches - ViNT, NoMaD, and NavDP - as well as four additional variants of ViNT and NoMaD. In terms of navigation performance, DevGRU significantly outperforms ViNT and NoMaD by a large margin. In addition, the proposed model has a relatively small number of trainable parameters, resulting in the fastest inference time among the baselines, particularly outperforming NavDP by 7x in model size and 17x in inference time.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026

AI.title_translation: DevGRU：使用碰撞感知循环模型的深度引导视觉导航
AI.tldr: DevGRU是一种高效的深度引导视觉导航系统，能在复杂室内环境中实现低碰撞、快推理的机器人导航。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉导航模型在部署到复杂室内环境（特别是结构化布局和狭窄通道）时容易发生碰撞，且计算开销较大。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为DevGRU的深度图像和点目标条件导航系统，采用动作预测器（AP）生成碰撞感知的未来轨迹以避开即时障碍，并结合碰撞预测器来补偿目标位姿估计中累积的误差。
AI.result: 在九个不同场景的实验中，DevGRU的导航性能大幅优于ViNT和NoMaD；同时，该模型参数量较小，推理速度极快，相比NavDP在模型大小上缩小了7倍，推理速度提升了17倍。
AI.conclusion: DevGRU是一种高效、碰撞感知的视觉导航系统，在保持较小模型规模和极快推理速度的同时，显著提升了机器人在复杂环境中的导航性能。
AI.translation: 现有的视觉导航模型通常旨在开发能够跨多种平台泛化机器人导航的基础模型。然而，当部署在复杂的室内环境中（特别是在结构化布局和狭窄通道中）时，许多这类模型很容易发生碰撞。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一个以深度图像和点目标为条件的导航系统——DevGRU。该系统采用动作预测器（AP）来生成碰撞感知的未来轨迹，从而有效避开即时障碍。结合碰撞预测器，AP还能进一步补偿目标位姿估计中累积的误差，并主动减轻未来的偏差。为了评估我们的方法，我们在九个不同的场景中进行了实验，对比了三种最先进的方法（ViNT、NoMaD和NavDP）以及ViNT和NoMaD的四种额外变体。在导航性能方面，DevGRU显著优于ViNT和NoMaD。此外，该模型具有相对较少的可训练参数，从而在所有基准中实现了最快的推理时间，特别是与NavDP相比，模型大小减小了7倍，推理速度提升了17倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DevGRU，一个基于深度图像和点目标的视觉导航系统。该系统利用动作预测器和碰撞预测器生成碰撞感知的轨迹并修正误差，在室内复杂环境中实现了极快且高效的导航。
AI.keywords: 视觉导航, 深度图像, 碰撞感知, 循环模型, 机器人导航
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种轻量级的深度引导视觉导航模型DevGRU，通过动作预测器和碰撞预测器有效解决了现有通用导航模型在复杂室内环境中易发生碰撞的问题，并在推理速度和参数量上具有显著优势。

title: A Locally Deployable Tool-Grounded LLM Multi-agent Framework for Automating Methane Emission Analysis and Reporting
summary: Methane field monitoring requires the integration of sampling design, meteorological interpretation, sensor processing, plume analysis, visualization, and reporting, but these steps are often distributed across separate expert-driven workflows. We developed a locally deployable, tool-grounded large language model (LLM) multi-agent framework for our low-cost methane sensing and field-monitoring campaigns. The framework uses LLM agents as workflow coordinators that link field measurements, meteorological data, deterministic sensor-processing routines, Gaussian plume inversion, and report generation, rather than directly estimating methane concentrations or emissions. Extensive field deployments across diverse real-world environments (e.g., wastewater treatment facilities, landfills, and oil and gas sites) demonstrate that our framework can achieve 92.0\% accuracy in workflow routing and parameter extraction, 85.0\% success in emission-rate estimation and plume prediction, and 95.0\% success in generating editable reports under practical operating conditions. Compared with manual and general-purpose LLM-assisted workflows, it reduced workflow time from hours-level to minutes-level, lowered manual coordination and prompt-engineering requirements, and retained traceable plume-based outputs. In addition, most processing can be performed locally, reducing exposure of sensitive facility and field data to cloud services. These results indicate that tool-grounded LLM coordination can reduce the time, labor, usability, and data-security barriers of methane field monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 一个用于自动化甲烷排放分析与报告的本地部署工具接地大模型多智能体框架
AI.tldr: 开发了一种用于甲烷监测的本地部署多智能体大模型框架，能够自动化整合各项工作流并生成报告，大幅提高效率并保障数据安全。
AI.motivation: 甲烷现场监测涉及多个步骤且通常分布在不同的专家驱动工作流中，现有的分析和报告过程缺乏集成且耗时，同时存在数据安全隐患。
AI.method: 开发了一个本地部署、工具接地的大模型多智能体框架，利用LLM智能体作为工作流协调器，将现场测量、气象数据、确定性传感器处理程序、高斯烟羽反演和报告生成连接起来。
AI.result: 在工作流路由和参数提取上实现了92.0%的准确率，在排放率估计和烟羽预测上达到了85.0%的成功率，在生成可编辑报告上达到了95.0%的成功率，并将工作流时间从数小时缩短至几分钟，同时支持本地处理以保障数据安全。
AI.conclusion: 工具接地的大模型多智能体协调能够有效降低甲烷现场监测的时间、人工、易用性和数据安全壁垒。
AI.translation: 甲烷现场监测需要整合采样设计、气象解释、传感器处理、烟羽分析、可视化和报告，但这些步骤通常分布在不同的专家驱动工作流中。我们为低成本甲烷传感和现场监测活动开发了一个可本地部署的、基于工具接地的大模型（LLM）多智能体框架。该框架利用LLM智能体作为工作流协调器，将现场测量、气象数据、确定性传感器处理例程、高斯烟羽反演和报告生成连接起来，而不是直接估计甲烷浓度或排放量。在多样化真实环境（如污水处理设施、垃圾填埋场以及油气站点）中的广泛现场部署表明，我们的框架在实际操作条件下，工作流路由和参数提取准确率达到92.0%，排放率估计和烟羽预测成功率达到85.0%，生成可编辑报告的成功率达到95.0%。与手动和通用LLM辅助工作流相比，它将工作流时间从小时级缩短至分钟级，降低了人工协调和提示工程的需求，并保留了可追溯的基于烟羽的输出。此外，大部分处理可以在本地进行，减少了敏感设施和现场数据暴露给云服务的风险。这些结果表明，工具接地的大模型协调可以降低甲烷现场监测的时间、劳动力、易用性和数据安全壁垒。
AI.summary: 本文开发了一种本地部署的工具接地大模型多智能体框架，用于自动化甲烷排放分析与报告。该框架作为工作流协调器整合了测量、气象、传感器处理、烟羽反演和报告生成，大幅缩短了监测时间并降低了安全风险。
AI.keywords: 大模型多智能体, 甲烷排放监测, 工具接地, 本地部署, 自动化报告生成
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的本地部署工具接地多智能体大模型框架，有效整合了甲烷监测的多个复杂步骤，显著提升了工作流效率和数据安全性，对于环境监测自动化具有重要价值。

title: OmniAlign: A Unified Multilingual Aligner for Word and Sentence Alignment
summary:
Cross-lingual sequence alignment is fundamental for building and exploiting parallel corpora, spanning mappings from documents and sentences down to words and subwords. Existing tools, however, typically specialize in a single granularity, so practitioners often need separate systems for word- and sentence-level alignment---especially in multilingual and long-text settings. We present OmniAlign, a unified multilingual aligner that supports both word-level and sentence-level alignment with a single lightweight model. Built on an encoder-only backbone with strong long-context modeling, OmniAlign induces word alignments from contextualized token similarity matrices, and obtains document-level $m$--$n$ sentence alignments via sentence embeddings combined with dynamic programming. To balance fine-grained alignment accuracy and sentence-representation quality, we use a four-stage training pipeline: alignment-oriented continued pre-training, self-supervised learning, supervised fine-tuning on human annotations, and sentence-embedding distillation from a strong multilingual teacher. Experiments show that OmniAlign achieves highly competitive performance on both word- and sentence-alignment benchmarks and generalizes well to unseen language pairs. Surprisingly, later-stage supervised fine-tuning on short texts further improves alignment quality while retaining the long-context understanding acquired in earlier training, keeping the model robust on long-text word alignment.

title: COSTA: A Cluster-Centric Paradigm for Annotation-Free Open-Set Semantic Segmentation of Aerial Point Clouds with Domain Shifts
summary: Semantic segmentation of aerial point cloud is trapped in a generalization crisis under distinct domain shifts. While test-time adaptation offers a privacy-preserving and computationally efficient way to adapt pre-trained models to unlabeled target-domain data during inference, existing methods, bound to closed-set label assumptions and non-scalable point-wise segmentation pipelines, still struggle with semantic shifts. We ask: can we adapt any given pre-trained aerial point cloud segmentation model to a shifted target domain at the inference phase alone, without additional training, while segmenting target-specific categories beyond the source label space on demand? This paper introduces COSTA, which breaks this limitation by shifting from closed-set point-wise adaptation to cluster-centric open-set semantic propagation. Our core discovery is that, once effectively adapted at test time, the rich feature distribution of aerial point clouds can be distilled into a compact set of well-separated semantic centroids that are transferable across label spaces. COSTA leverages this to reformulate open-set semantic segmentation as a cluster-level propagating process: it first bridges the domain gap through proven test-time adaptation, then groups each batch of target-domain points into a small set of semantic clusters based on the similarity distribution in the adapted feature space, and finally propagates high-confidence pseudo labels obtained from an open-vocabulary vision-language model to all points through cluster-level voting. This cluster-centric paradigm enables test-time adaptation of aerial point clouds under significant domain gaps with mixed semantic shifts. With DALES as the source domain, COSTA enables on-demand segmentation across three aerial point cloud benchmarks with distinct domains and heterogeneous category spaces, achieving up to 70.09% mIoU under this new setting.

AI.title_translation: COSTA：具有域偏移的航空点云无标注开放集语义分割的集群中心范式
AI.tldr: COSTA是一种创新的集群中心范式，可在推理阶段无需额外训练，解决航空点云在显著域偏移和语义偏移下的无标注开放集语义分割问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的航空点云语义分割方法在面对明显的域偏移时泛化能力不足，且受限于闭集标签假设和不可扩展的逐点分割流水线，难以处理语义偏移。因此，需要一种在推理阶段无需额外训练、能够适应目标域并在需求超出源标签空间时进行分割的方法。
AI.method: 提出了COSTA范式：首先通过测试时适应弥合域间隙，然后根据适应后特征空间的相似度分布将目标域点分组为紧凑的语义簇，最后通过簇级投票将开放词汇视觉语言模型获得的置信度高的伪标签传播到所有点。
AI.result: 以DALES作为源域，COSTA在三个具有不同域和异构类别空间的航空点云基准测试中实现了按需分割，在此新设置下取得了高达70.09%的mIoU。
AI.conclusion: COSTA通过将测试时适应与集群中心语义传播相结合，成功实现了在存在显著域偏移和混合语义偏移情况下的航空点云开放集语义分割，无需额外训练，并在多个基准测试中取得了优异的性能。
AI.translation: 航空点云的语义分割在明显的域偏移下陷入了泛化危机。虽然测试时 adaptation 提供了一种在推理过程中将预训练模型适应到未标记目标域数据的隐私保护且计算高效的方法，但现有方法受限于闭集标签假设和不可扩展的逐点分割流水线，仍然难以应对语义偏移。我们提出疑问：是否可以在仅推理阶段将任何给定的预训练航空点云分割模型适应到发生偏移的目标域，而无需额外训练，同时按需分割超出源标签空间的目标特定类别？本文介绍了COSTA，它通过从闭集逐点适应转向集群中心开放集语义 propagation 来打破这一限制。我们的核心发现在于，一旦在测试时进行有效适应，航空点云丰富的特征分布可以被提炼成一组跨标签空间可迁移的、紧凑且分离良好的语义质心。COSTA利用这一点将开放集语义分割重新构想为一个集群级别的传播过程：它首先通过经过验证的测试时适应弥合域间隙，然后根据适应后特征空间中的相似度分布将每批目标域点分组为一小组合适的语义质心，最后通过集群级投票将从开放词汇视觉语言模型获得的置信度高的伪标签传播到所有点。这种以集群为中心的范式使得航空点云能够在具有显着域间隙和混合语义偏移的情况下进行测试时适应。以DALES作为源域，COSTA能够在具有不同域和异构类别空间的三个航空点云基准测试中进行按需分割，在此新设置下实现了高达70.09%的mIoU。
AI.summary: 论文提出了COSTA，一种针对带有域偏移的航空点云的无标注开放集语义分割集群中心范式。该方法通过测试时适应弥合域间隙，并将特征蒸馏为语义质心，利用视觉语言模型的伪标签通过簇级投票传播，从而在推理阶段无需额外训练即可实现跨标签空间的按需分割。
AI.keywords: 航空点云, 语义分割, 域适应, 开放集, 测试时适应
AI.comments: 该论文提出了COSTA，这是一个面向航空点云的无标注、开放集语义分割的集群中心范式。它打破了传统闭集逐点适应的局限，通过测试时适应和开放词汇视觉语言模型的结合，有效地解决了域偏移和语义偏移问题，具有很高的创新性和实用价值。

title: Building real-time digital twin instances with Function+Data Flow: user evaluation and extension for iterative pipelines
comments: 36 pages, 18 figures, submitted to SoSyM journal
summary:
Digital twins (DTs) increasingly leverage artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) pipelines, both to build real-time DTs from high-fidelity simulations and to instantiate them with historical data. However, engineering these pipelines remains largely ad-hoc: pipelines are hard to specify, validate, and reuse, with scarce dedicated tooling. Function+Data Flow (FDF) addresses this by defining a visual domain-specific language (DSL) that represents functions (ML models) explicitly, enabling their composition and reuse. We implemented FDF in DesCartes Builder, an integrated modeling environment supporting FDF-based DT synthesis and validation.
  In this paper, we report on an empirical user study evaluating whether FDF and DesCartes Builder can make AI-based DT development more accessible and reliable. Participants implemented a representative real-time DT prototype within DesCartes Builder, and we measured perceived usability and feature adequacy through quantitative and qualitative measures. Our results indicate that DesCartes Builder and FDF achieve a good level of usability across a broad range of potential users, and particularly for the intended audience of domain experts. The study additionally surfaces concrete strengths and areas for improvement of both the tool and the underlying FDF framework. Informed by these findings, we propose H-FDF, a Hierarchical extension of FDF supporting iterative and modular pipelines, enabling the formal specification of more complex DT pipelines such as dual training. Our findings suggest that integrated, model-driven platforms are a promising direction to transform AI-based DT engineering into a disciplined modeling practice.

AI.title_translation: 利用函数+数据流构建实时数字孪生实例：面向迭代管道的用户评估与扩展
AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种基于Function+Data Flow (FDF) 的可视化领域特定语言与建模环境DesCartes Builder，用于简化和规范基于AI的数字孪生开发，并扩展了支持复杂迭代管道的H-FDF。
AI.motivation: 当前的数字孪生（DT）越来越多地利用人工智能和机器学习管道，但工程化过程仍多为自发且缺乏专用工具，导致管道难以指定、验证和复用。因此需要一种能够使AI驱动的DT开发更具可访问性和可靠性的方法。
AI.method: 实现了一个名为DesCartes Builder的集成建模环境，支持基于FDF的数字孪生合成与验证；开展了实证用户研究，通过定量和定性方法评估了感知可用性和功能充分性；并提出了支持迭代和模块化管道的层级扩展H-FDF。
AI.result: 用户研究表明DesCartes Builder和FDF在广泛的潜在用户群体（尤其是领域专家）中实现了良好的可用性，指出了工具和框架的具体优势与改进方向，并催生了对复杂DT管道（如双重训练）支持的H-FDF扩展。
AI.conclusion: 集成化的模型驱动平台（如DesCartes Builder和FDF）能够显著提升基于AI的数字孪生开发的可用性和可靠性，是实现工程化和规范化开发的有效途径。
AI.translation:
数字孪生（DTs）越来越多地利用人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）管道，既用于从高保真模拟中构建实时DT，也用于用历史数据实例化它们。然而，设计这些管道在很大程度上仍然是临时的：管道很难指定、验证和复用，且缺乏专门的工具。函数+数据流（FDF）通过定义一个可视化领域特定语言（DSL）来解决这个问题，该语言显式地表示函数（ML模型），从而实现它们的组合和复用。我们在DesCartes Builder中实现了FDF，这是一个支持基于FDF的DT合成和验证的集成建模环境。
在本文中，我们报告了一项实证用户研究，评估FDF和DesCartes Builder是否能使基于AI的DT开发更易于访问和可靠。参与者在DesCartes Builder中实现了一个具有代表性的实时DT原型，我们通过定量和定性测量来衡量感知的可用性和功能充分性。我们的结果表明，DesCartes Builder和FDF在广大潜在用户中实现了良好的可用性，特别是对于目标受众领域专家。该研究还揭示了工具和底层FDF框架的具体优势和改进领域。在这些发现的启发下，我们提出了H-FDF，这是FDF的分层扩展，支持迭代和模块化管道，能够对更复杂的DT管道（如双重训练）进行形式化规范。我们的研究结果表明，集成的前沿模型驱动平台是将基于AI的DT工程转变为规范建模实践的有希望的方向。
AI.summary: 论文介绍了Function+Data Flow (FDF) 框架及 DesCartes Builder 环境，旨在解决基于AI的数字孪生开发缺乏专用工具的问题。通过用户评估验证了其可用性，并提出了支持更复杂迭代管道的H-FDF扩展，证明了集成模型驱动平台在数字孪生工程中的巨大潜力。
AI.keywords: Digital Twins, Function+Data Flow, Domain-Specific Language, User Evaluation, Model-Driven Engineering
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种结合Function+Data Flow (FDF) 与可视化领域特定语言(DSL)的方法，并通过实证用户研究验证了其在构建基于AI的数字孪生系统方面的可行性与高可用性。创新点在于将模型驱动的方法引入数字孪生工程，并通过H-FDF扩展支持更复杂的迭代管道，具有较高的工程实用价值。

title: Coverage-Driven RTL Assertion Generation with Formal Exploration and Neuro-Symbolic Refinement
summary: Hardware functional verification relies on high-quality assertions to expose design bugs and establish confidence in Register Transfer Level (RTL) designs. Yet existing assertion mining methods still struggle to produce complete and reliable assertion sets: random or limited traces fail to cover hard-to-reach behaviors, and one-shot generation provides little feedback about what remains unverified or how the assertion set should be improved. As a result, critical design behaviors can remain uncovered even when many assertions are generated. We present NeuroAssertion, a coverage-driven assertion generation framework that combines formal trace generation, syntax-guided synthesis (SyGuS), and an agent-inspired refinement process within a unified framework. Our framework first converts hard-to-reach control-flow conditions into formal reachability objectives, uses model checking to generate behaviorally diverse traces, and mines initial assertions from these traces with SyGuS. It then performs targeted agent-inspired refinement under verification feedback: one LLM first proposes candidate assertions for uncovered regions, and if a candidate fails formal checking, a second LLM generates a repair grammar that guides constrained symbolic synthesis in a neuro-symbolic repair procedure. Experimental results show that this framework delivers around 2X more assertions and about 2X higher mutation coverage than traditional assertion mining methods.

AI.title_translation: 基于形式化探索与神经符号学精炼的覆盖驱动RTL断言生成
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为NeuroAssertion的覆盖驱动RTL断言生成框架，通过融合形式化探索、语法引导合成与大语言模型神经符号修复，显著提升了断言的数量和变异覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 现有的断言挖掘方法难以生成完整且可靠的断言集，随机或有限的轨迹无法覆盖难以触及的行为，且单次生成缺乏对未验证部分的有效反馈，导致关键设计行为在生成大量断言后仍未被覆盖。
AI.method: 提出NeuroAssertion框架，首先将控制流条件转化为形式化可达性目标并利用模型检查生成多样化轨迹，然后结合语法引导合成（SyGuS）挖掘初始断言，最后通过受智能体启发的双LLM流程在验证反馈下进行候选断言的提出与神经符号学修复。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与传统断言挖掘方法相比，该框架能够生成大约2倍的断言数量，并实现约2倍的变异覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: NeuroAssertion框架通过结合形式化探索与神经符号学精炼，显著提高了RTL断言生成的数量、质量以及设计变异覆盖率，为硬件功能验证提供了一条强有力的自动化途径。
AI.translation: 硬件功能验证依赖于高质量的断言来暴露设计漏洞并建立对寄存器传输级（RTL）设计的信心。然而，现有的断言挖掘方法在生成完整且可靠的断言集方面仍然存在困难：随机或有限的轨迹无法覆盖难以触及的行为，且单次生成很少提供关于哪些部分仍未验证或应如何改进断言集的反馈。因此，即使生成了许多断言，关键的设计行为仍可能未被覆盖。我们提出了NeuroAssertion，这是一个覆盖驱动的断言生成框架，它在一个统一的框架内结合了形式化轨迹生成、语法引导合成（SyGuS）以及受智能体启发的精炼过程。我们的框架首先将难以触及的控制流条件转换为形式化可达性目标，使用模型检查生成行为多样化的轨迹，并通过SyGuS从这些轨迹中挖掘初始断言。然后，它在验证反馈下执行有针对性的智能体启发精炼：一个大语言模型（LLM）首先为未覆盖区域提出候选断言，如果候选断言未通过形式化检查，第二个LLM则生成一个修复文法，用于指导神经符号修复过程中的受限符号合成。实验结果表明，该框架比传统的断言挖掘方法多提供约2倍的断言，并实现约2倍的变异覆盖率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了NeuroAssertion，这是一个结合形式化轨迹生成、语法引导合成（SyGuS）和智能体灵感精炼过程的覆盖驱动断言生成框架。它通过形式化探索和神经符号学修复机制，有效解决了传统方法覆盖率低的问题，实验证明其在断言数量和变异覆盖率上均实现了约2倍的提升。
AI.keywords: 硬件验证, RTL断言生成, 形式化验证, 神经符号学, 语法引导合成
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种创新的神经符号学结合的断言生成框架（NeuroAssertion），通过结合形式化模型检查、语法引导合成和LLM智能体，有效解决了传统断言生成方法在覆盖率和完整性方面的不足，展现出显著的性能提升。

title: Partition the Support, Reconstruct the Residual: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Video Generation and World Models
summary: Training-free block-sparse attention can accelerate video transformers, but row-wise attention concentration does not by itself specify an executable sparse operator. Queries sharing a block route may have poorly overlapping supports, while retained attention mass alone does not determine the post-softmax error from skipped interactions. We show that partition geometry affects both pooled support and the predictability of the remaining residual from the sparse output. We introduce SparsePR, which combines Response-Coupled Partitioning with Probe-Fitted Residual Reconstruction. Sampled-query key responses form paired K/V groups, whose centroids induce query-response coordinates for shared routing. A small set of exact query rows then calibrates a call-specific affine correction from the sparse output within the output subspace observed in the probe residuals. Across four heterogeneous video generation and world models, SparsePR consistently reduces attention-reconstruction error. Ablations show that probe fitting accounts for most of this reduction, while response-coupled partitioning lowers hard-drop error and improves reconstruction under a finite probe budget. SparsePR preserves generation quality at 22.0-26.0% realized executed-pair density while achieving 1.48x-2.61x end-to-end speedups. Project page: https://pardistaghavi.github.io/SparsePR-website/

AI.title_translation: 划分支持集，重建残差：用于视频生成和世界模型的无需训练稀疏注意力
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SparsePR的无训练稀疏注意力方法，通过优化分区与残差重建，在视频生成和世界模型中实现了高达2.61倍的加速并保持了生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的无训练块稀疏注意力方法在加速视频Transformer时存在局限性，行级注意力集中无法直接指定可执行的稀疏算子，且保留的注意力质量无法决定跳过交互后的softmax后误差。我们需要研究分区几何形状如何影响支持集和残差的可预测性，以降低误差。
AI.method: 引入了SparsePR，包含两个核心组件：响应耦合分区（Response-Coupled Partitioning，用于形成配对的K/V组和查询响应坐标）和探针拟合残差重建（Probe-Fitted Residual Reconstruction，利用少量精确查询行校准仿射修正）。
AI.result: 在四个异构视频生成和世界模型上，SparsePR一致地减少了注意力重建误差，在22.0%-26.0%的实际执行对密度下保持了生成质量，并实现了1.48倍至2.61倍的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: SparsePR成功地在视频生成和世界模型中实现了无需训练的高效稀疏注意力，在大幅提升推理速度的同时保持了视频生成的质量。
AI.translation: 无需训练的块稀疏注意力可以加速视频Transformer，但行级注意力集中本身并不能指定可执行的稀疏算子。共享块路由的查询可能具有重叠较差的支持集，而单独保留的注意力质量并不能决定跳过交互后softmax带来的误差。我们证明了分区几何形状既影响汇聚的支持集，也影响稀疏输出中剩余残差的可预测性。为此，我们引入了SparsePR，它将响应耦合分区与探针拟合残差重建相结合。采样查询-键响应形成配对的K/V组，其质心引出用于共享路由的查询-响应坐标。然后，一小部分精确的查询行在探针残差观测到的输出子空间内，对稀疏输出进行调用特定的仿射校准修正。在四个异构视频 generation 和世界模型中，SparsePR 一致地减少了注意力重建误差。消融实验表明，探针拟合占了大部分误差减少，而响应耦合分区降低了硬丢弃误差并在有限探针预算下改善了重建。SparsePR在22.0-26.0%的实际执行对密度下保持了生成质量，同时实现了1.48倍至2.61倍的端到端加速。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SparsePR，一种用于视频生成和世界模型的无训练稀疏注意力方法。它通过响应耦合分区和探针拟合残差重建，解决了传统稀疏注意力中的几何分区和误差控制问题，在保持视频生成质量的同时实现了显著的推理加速。
AI.keywords: Sparse Attention, Video Generation, World Models, Training-Free, SparsePR
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法（SparsePR），通过响应耦合分区和探针拟合残差重建，有效解决了视频生成和世界模型中稀疏注意力的效率与精度权衡问题。创新点在于几何分区与残差修正相结合，实现了显著的端到端加速并保持了生成质量。

title: WhiteMatter: All-to-All Cross-Layer Connections via KV Mixing
summary: In a Transformer, each layer attends to past tokens only through KV produced at its own depth, despite the presence of deeper representations during autoregressive decoding. Feedback architectures allow shallow consumer layers to attend to KV produced by deeper past-token representations, but give all consumer layers the same fixed connection patterns to source layers. We propose WhiteMatter, which connects every attention layer to the representations from all layers of each past token, with connection weights that can vary across consumer layers and adapt to the source token. For each token, a router implements these connections by mixing its $L$ layer states into $k$ KV channels that are cached for subsequent tokens; each consumer layer attends to one of the channels. The number of channels $k$ controls the KV-cache size. Setting $k<L$ reduces the cache's memory footprint. In our pretraining experiments, WhiteMatter outperforms a vanilla Transformer with 50% more layers and retains most of this gain with a 50% KV-cache compression.

AI.title_translation: WhiteMatter：通过 KV 混合实现全对全跨层连接
AI.tldr: WhiteMatter 提出了一种基于 KV 混合的全对全跨层连接机制，在提升 Transformer 性能的同时实现了 KV 缓存的压缩。
AI.motivation: 传统 Transformer 中每层仅通过自身深度的 KV 关注过去的令牌，未能利用自回归解码中存在的更深层表示；而现有的反馈架构虽允许浅层关注深层表示，但缺乏灵活的、针对不同源令牌和消费层的自适应连接模式。
AI.method: 提出 WhiteMatter 架构，通过路由器将每个过去令牌的 $L$ 层状态混合成 $k$ 个 KV 通道进行缓存，每个消费层关注其中一个通道，连接权重可随消费层和源令牌自适应变化。
AI.result: 在预训练实验中，WhiteMatter 的性能超越了层数多出 50% 的标准 Transformer，并且在实现 50% 的 KV 缓存压缩时仍保留了大部分性能增益。
AI.conclusion: WhiteMatter 作为一种创新的跨层连接架构，在提升模型表达能力的同时有效控制了 KV 缓存的内存开销，展现出强大的预训练性能优势。
AI.translation: 在 Transformer 中，尽管在自回归解码过程中存在更深层的表示，但每个层仅通过自身深度产生的 KV 来关注过去的令牌。反馈架构允许浅层消费层关注由更深层过去令牌表示产生的 KV，但为所有消费层提供相同的固定连接模式到源层。我们提出了 WhiteMatter，它将每个注意力层连接到每个过去令牌的所有层的表示，其连接权重可跨消费层变化并适应源令牌。对于每个令牌，路由器通过将其 $L$ 个层状态混合到缓存用于后续令牌的 $k$ 个 KV 通道来实现这些连接；每个消费层关注其中一个通道。通道数 $k$ 控制 KV 缓存的大小。设置 $k<L$ 可以减少缓存的内存占用。在我们的预训练实验中，WhiteMatter 的性能优于层数增加 50% 的常规 Transformer，并且在进行 50% 的 KV 缓存压缩时保留了大部分增益。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 WhiteMatter，一种新型的 Transformer 跨层连接架构。它通过自适应的路由器将各层的过去令牌表示混合为压缩的 KV 通道，使所有层能够进行全对全的跨层连接。实验表明，该方法在提升模型性能的同时显著减少了 KV 缓存的内存占用。
AI.keywords: Transformer, 跨层连接, KV 缓存压缩, 自回归解码, WhiteMatter
AI.comments: WhiteMatter 通过引入基于 KV 混合的全对全跨层连接机制，不仅打破了传统 Transformer 层间独立的限制，还实现了高效的 KV 缓存压缩，兼顾了模型性能与内存效率，具有极高的实用价值。

title: An Efficient Second-Order-in-Time Penalty-Projection Ensemble Eddy Viscosity Method for Parameterized Navier-Stokes Flows
summary:
We propose a novel, robust, and second-order-accurate parameterized penalty-projection ensemble algorithm for incompressible Navier--Stokes flow problems. The resulting linearized algorithm, based on the second-order Backward Differentiation Formula (BDF-2), is computationally efficient because it shares the same coefficient matrix across all realizations for each subproblem at every time step. To enhance robustness in convection-dominated flows, the scheme incorporates Ensemble Eddy Viscosity (EEV) regularization. In addition, it is equipped with grad-div stabilization parameter $γ$, which controls the splitting error; under the assumptions of the analysis, the splitting error decreases and vanishes asymptotically as $γ\to\infty$.
  We establish the stability of the proposed scheme and rigorously prove its optimal convergence by demonstrating that, as $γ\to\infty$, the scheme converges to an equivalent coupled formulation. We further validate the method through a series of numerical experiments designed to verify the theoretically predicted convergence rates and evaluate its performance on benchmark convection-dominated problems. The numerical results are in excellent agreement with the theoretical analysis and confirm the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

AI.title_translation: 针对参数化 Navier-Stokes 流动的高效二阶时间罚投影集合涡粘方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型高效、二阶精确且鲁棒的参数化 Navier-Stokes 方程集合罚投影涡粘算法，兼具计算高效性与对流占优流动的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 为了高效且鲁棒地求解参数化不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 流动问题，特别是针对对流占优流动，传统的数值方法往往计算成本高且在稳定性上面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于二阶后向差分公式（BDF-2）、结合集合涡粘（EEV）正则化和梯度-散度稳定化参数的线性化罚投影集合算法，其中所有发现在每个时间步共享相同的系数矩阵。
AI.result: 建立了该格式的稳定性，严格证明了其最优收敛性（证明了当 $\gamma\to\infty$ 时格式收敛到等价的耦合公式），并通过数值实验验证了理论预测的收敛率并证实了其在对流占优基准问题上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功开发并理论验证了一种高效、二阶精确的参数化 Navier-Stokes 方程集合罚投影涡粘方法，数值实验验证了其理论收敛性和优异性能。
AI.translation:
我们提出了一种新颖、鲁棒且二阶精确的参数化罚投影集合算法，用于求解不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 流动问题。基于二阶后向差分公式（BDF-2）所得出的线性化算法具有计算高效性，因为它在每个时间步的每个子问题中共享相同的系数矩阵。为了增强对流占优流动中的鲁棒性，该方案结合了集合涡粘（EEV）正则化。此外，它还配备了控制分裂误差的梯度-散度稳定化参数 $\gamma$；在分析的假设下，分裂误差随着 $\gamma\to\infty$ 渐近减小并消失。
我们建立了所提方案的稳定性，并通过严格证明当 $\gamma\to\infty$ 时该方案收敛到一个等价的耦合公式，证明了其最优收敛性。我们进一步通过一系列数值实验验证了该方法，这些实验旨在验证理论预测的收敛速率，并评估其在对流占优基准问题上的性能。数值结果与理论分析高度吻合，证实了所提方案的有效性。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种针对不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 流动的高效、二阶精确的参数化惩罚投影集合算法。通过结合 BDF-2、集合涡粘正则化和梯度-散度稳定化，该方法在保持高计算效率的同时增强了对流占优流动的鲁棒性，并通过了严格的理论分析和数值验证。
AI.keywords: Navier-Stokes 方程, 罚投影法, 集合涡粘方法, BDF-2, 梯度-散度稳定化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将罚投影法、BDF-2时间离散、集合涡 viscosity (EEV) 正则化和梯度-散度稳定化相结合，用于求解参数化 Navier-Stokes 方程。这极大地提高了大规模集合模拟的计算效率与在对流占优流动中的鲁棒性。

title: Designing Social Robots for Social-Cognition Training with Autistic Adults
comments: Accepted for publication at the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026)
summary: Social robots have been widely explored as tools for autism intervention, yet this literature has focused predominantly on children and has rarely involved autistic adults as active contributors to design. This creates a mismatch between existing systems and the social-cognitive challenges autistic adults actually face in everyday life, including navigating ambiguous interpersonal contexts, managing conversational timing, and interpreting implied emotional meaning. To address this gap, we conducted an online focus group and co-design session with five autistic adults to explore what a social robot for social-cognition training should do, how it should interact, and under what conditions it would be genuinely useful. The 90-minute session combined open discussion with structured co-design activities on a shared digital whiteboard, and the resulting verbal and visual data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. The analysis yielded seven themes that define core design requirements: the robot should function as a scaffold rather than a substitute, prioritise authenticity over comfort, provide personalised and user-controlled feedback, accommodate emotional self-awareness gaps, respect privacy and contextual boundaries, support rehearsal for real-world social situations, and remain configurable in identity, form, and expression. Together, the findings suggest that autistic adults envision the robot not as a companion or live social assistant, but as a private, configurable rehearsal partner designed to support independence over time.

AI.title_translation: 为自闭症成人社会认知训练设计社交机器人
AI.tldr: 本研究通过与自闭症成人的协同设计，确定了面向自闭症成人社会认知训练的社交机器人的七大核心设计需求，发现自闭症成人更倾向于将机器人视为私密的排练伙伴而非实时社交助手。
AI.motivation: 现有的社交机器人干预研究主要集中于儿童，极少涉及自闭症成人作为设计的主动参与者，导致现有系统与自闭症成人在日常生活中实际面临的社会认知挑战（如应对模糊的人际情境、管理对话时机、解读隐含的情感含义）存在脱节。
AI.method: 通过线上焦点小组和协同设计（co-design）会话，纳入5名自闭症成人参与，结合开放式讨论和共享数字白板上的结构化协同设计活动，并使用反思性主题分析法（reflexive thematic analysis）分析口头和视觉数据。
AI.result: 分析得出七个核心设计主题：机器人应作为支架而非替代品、优先考虑真实性而非舒适度、提供个性化且用户可控的反馈、适应情感自我意识的差距、尊重隐私和情境边界、支持现实世界社交情境的排练、在身份、形式和表达上保持可配置性。
AI.conclusion: 自闭症成人将社交机器人视为一种私密的、可配置的排练伙伴，旨在支持独立性而非充当伴侣或实时社交助手。研究结果为未来针对成人的社会认知训练机器人设计提供了关键原则。
AI.translation: 社交机器人已被广泛探讨作为自闭症干预的工具，然而相关文献主要集中于儿童，且很少让自闭症成人作为设计的主动参与者。这导致现有系统与自闭症成人在日常生活中实际面临的社会认知挑战（包括应对模糊的人际情境、管理对话时机和解读隐含的情感含义）之间存在脱节。为了弥补这一空白，我们与五名自闭症成人进行了在线焦点小组和协同设计会议，以探讨用于社会认知训练的社交机器人应该做什么、应该如何互动、以及在什么条件下它才真正有用。90分钟的会议结合了开放式讨论与共享数字白板上的结构化协同设计活动，所得的言语和视觉数据采用反思性主题分析法进行分析。分析产生了七个定义核心设计需求的主题：机器人应充当支架而非替代品、优先考虑真实性而非舒适度、提供个性化且用户可控的反馈、适应情感自我意识差距、尊重隐私和情境边界、支持现实世界社交情境的排练，以及在身份、形态和表达上保持可配置性。总之，研究结果表明，自闭症成人设想机器人不是作为伴侣或实时社交助手，而是一个私密的、可配置的排练伙伴，旨在随着时间的推移支持独立性。
AI.summary: 本研究通过与五名自闭症成人的在线焦点小组和协同设计会议，探讨了用于自闭症成人社会认知训练的社交机器人的设计需求。研究采用反思性主题分析法，提炼出七个核心设计主题，指出自闭症成人将社交机器人视为一个私密的、可配置的排练伙伴，以支持长期的独立性。
AI.keywords: 社交机器人, 自闭症成人, 协同设计, 社会认知训练, 参与式研究
AI.comments: 该论文弥补了社交机器人干预研究主要集中于儿童而忽视自闭症成人的空白，并通过参与式设计（Co-design）将自闭症成人纳入设计核心，提出了极具洞察力的设计原则（如优先考虑真实性而非舒适度、作为支架而非替代品等），对未来面向成人自闭症的辅助技术开发具有重要指导意义。

title: MissDiag: Diagnostic Evaluation of Incomplete-Knowledge Robustness in KGQA and KG-RAG
summary: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) and knowledge-graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (KG-RAG) aim to ground answers in explicit graph evidence, but real-world knowledge graphs are often sparse, outdated, and incomplete. Existing robustness evaluations usually report aggregate changes in answer quality after evidence is removed or perturbed, which measures sensitivity to incomplete support but leaves the source of degradation under-specified: the same score change can conflate the type of missing evidence, the response of the evaluated system, and the sensitivity of the answer-matching protocol. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{MissDiag}, a diagnostic evaluation framework for incomplete-knowledge robustness in KGQA and KG-RAG. MissDiag keeps the question and gold answer fixed while applying structurally typed missingness interventions to benchmark-provided support graphs, enabling paired comparisons that decompose robustness changes by evidence type, system response, and evaluation protocol rather than reducing them to a single aggregate score drop. Experiments across multiple system families show that incomplete-knowledge robustness is better understood as a typed degradation phenomenon than as a uniform property: answer-adjacent evidence loss produces the largest observed degradation, source-context removal is often neutral and can be beneficial, and semantic answer matching changes absolute scores while preserving the main typed degradation patterns. By transforming aggregate robustness measurement into typed diagnostic attribution, MissDiag provides a more interpretable basis for comparing, diagnosing, and stress-testing KGQA and KG-RAG systems under incomplete knowledge.

AI.title_translation: MissDiag：KGQA与KG-RAG中不完整知识鲁棒性的诊断评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MissDiag诊断框架，通过结构化缺失干预，将KGQA和KG-RAG系统不完整知识鲁棒性的单一聚合评估转化为可解释的类型化诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有的鲁棒性评估通常只报告证据被移除或扰动后答案质量的总体聚合变化，无法区分缺失证据的类型、系统的响应以及答案匹配协议的敏感性，导致性能退化的来源不够明确。
AI.method: 提出了MissDiag诊断评估框架，通过在保持问题和标准答案不变的同时，对基准支持图应用结构化类型的缺失干预，进行配对比较，从而按证据类型、系统响应和评估协议来分解鲁棒性变化。
AI.result: 实验表明，不完整知识鲁棒性更适合被理解为一种类型化的降级现象：邻近答案的证据丢失会导致最大的性能退化，源上下文的移除通常呈中性甚至可能带来益处，而语义答案匹配改变了绝对分数但保留主要的类型化降级模式。
AI.conclusion: MissDiag框架通过结构化缺失干预和成对比较，有效解构了KGQA和KG-RAG系统在不完整知识下的鲁棒性变化，揭示了不完整性是一种类型化的降级现象，为系统的诊断和压力测试提供了可解释的基础。
AI.translation: 知识图谱问答（KGQA）和基于知识图谱的检索增强生成（KG-RAG）旨在将答案建立在显式的图谱证据之上，但现实世界的知识图谱往往是稀疏的、过时的且不完整的。现有的鲁棒性评估通常报告证据被移除或扰动后答案质量的聚合变化，这虽然衡量了对不完整支持的敏感性，但使得退化来源不够明确：相同的分数变化可能会混淆缺失证据的类型、被评估系统的响应以及答案匹配协议的敏感性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MissDiag，这是一个针对KGQA和KG-RAG中不完整知识鲁棒性的诊断评估框架。MissDiag在保持问题和标准答案不变的同时，对基准提供的支持图应用结构化类型的缺失干预，从而实现配对比较，按证据类型、系统响应和评估协议来分解鲁棒性变化，而不是将其简化为单一的聚合分数下降。多个系统系列的实验表明，不完整知识的鲁棒性最好被理解为一种类型化的退化现象，而不是一种统一的属性：邻近答案的证据丢失会产生观察到的最大退化，源上下文的移除通常是中性的甚至可能是有益的，而语义答案匹配改变了绝对分数，同时保留了主要的类型化退化模式。通过将聚合鲁棒性测量转化为类型化诊断归因，MissDiag为在不完整知识下比较、诊断和对KGQA和KG-RAG系统进行压力测试提供了更具可解释性的基础。
AI.summary: 论文提出了MissDiag，这是一个用于评估KGQA和KG-RAG系统中不完整知识鲁棒性的诊断框架。通过应用结构化类型的缺失干预和配对比较，MissDiag将单一的聚合鲁棒性测量转化为类型化的诊断归因，能够按证据类型、系统响应和评估协议分解性能变化，从而提供更具可解释性的系统压力测试基础。
AI.keywords: 知识图谱问答, 检索增强生成, 不完整知识鲁棒性, 诊断评估框架, 结构化缺失干预
AI.comments: 该论文针对知识图谱问答（KGQA）和基于知识图谱的检索增强生成（KG-RAG）中不完整知识鲁棒性评估的痛点，提出了MissDiag诊断框架。其创新之处在于通过结构化类型的缺失干预，替代了传统的单一聚合评分下降，实现了对鲁棒性变化的精细化诊断归因。

title: Bayesian Partner Modelling enables Adaptive Replanning for LLM Coordination
summary: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems often struggle to collaborate with new teammates whose strategies shift mid-task. Because agents execute multi-step or temporally extended skills, they frequently continue executing outdated plans long after public evidence shows that a partner has changed its skill. Existing methods either treat partner tracking as passive context-leaving the agent aware of the shift but slow to act-or replan indiscriminately. We introduce BayesBeliefAgent, which pairs a hierarchical LLM planner with a Bayesian tracking module. Rather than replanning constantly, our agent interrupts its current skill only when a partner's actions directly contradict the inferred skill. Beyond standard reward, we evaluate performance using replanning efficiency and the belief-action gap: the fraction of total decisions where an agent with a correct partner estimate executes a non-complementary skill. Across benchmark Overcooked environments, contradiction-conditioned control drastically narrows this belief-action gap while requiring an order of magnitude fewer replans than heuristic methods

AI.title_translation: 基于贝叶斯伙伴建模的LLM协作自适应重新规划
AI.tldr: 提出BayesBeliefAgent，利用贝叶斯伙伴建模实现条件式重新规划，解决LLM多智能体系统中的队友策略适应难题。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统在与策略中途改变的新队友合作时，往往难以协作，常常在公共证据表明队友改变技能后仍继续执行过时计划，而现有方法存在反应迟钝或盲目重新规划的问题。
AI.method: 引入BayesBeliefAgent，将分层LLM规划器与贝叶斯跟踪模块相结合，通过伙伴的行为直接反驳推断技能时才打断当前技能，进行有条件的重新规划。
AI.result: 在基准Overcooked环境中，矛盾条件控制大幅缩小了信念-行动gap，同时比启发式方法少了一个数量级的重新规划次数。
AI.conclusion: BayesBeliefAgent通过贝叶斯伙伴建模与矛盾条件控制相结合，成功解决了多智能体LLM系统中的适应性重新规划问题，实现了高效的协作。
AI.translation: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统在与策略在任务中途发生变化的新队友合作时往往举步维艰。由于智能体执行多步骤或时间跨度较长的技能，它们经常在公共证据显示搭档改变技能很久之后，仍然继续执行过时的计划。现有方法要么将伙伴追踪视为被动上下文——使智能体意识到转变但行动迟缓——要么进行不加区分的重新规划。我们引入了BayesBeliefAgent，它将分层LLM规划器与贝叶斯追踪模块配对。我们的代理不是不断地重新规划，而是在搭档的行为直接与推断出的技能相矛盾时才中断其当前的技能。除了标准奖励之外，我们还使用重新规划效率和信念-行动差距来评估性能：信念-行动差距是指对伙伴有正确估计的智能体执行非互补技能的决策总数的比例。在基准的Overcooked环境中，矛盾条件控制显著缩小了信念-行动差距，同时需要的重新规划次数比启发式方法少一个数量级。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BayesBeliefAgent，旨在解决多智能体LLM系统在队友策略变化时难以适应的问题。通过结合分层LLM规划器与贝叶斯伙伴跟踪模块，该代理仅在队友行为与推断技能直接矛盾时才中断当前技能，从而在减少重新规划次数的同时显著缩小信念-行动差距。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 多智能体协作, 贝叶斯伙伴建模, 自适应重新规划, 策略偏移
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种将分层LLM规划器与贝叶斯跟踪模块相结合的方法，有效解决了多智能体大模型系统中由于队友策略改变而导致的过时规划问题。创新点在于通过矛盾条件控制，只在必要时打断当前技能，从而在大幅减少重新规划次数的同时显著缩小了信念-行动差距。

title: A Tutorial on Weight Structure of Polar Codes
comments: This paper has been accepted by IEEE BITS: The Information Theory Magazine and will appear in the upcoming issue. 14 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables
summary: This tutorial introduces the algebraic foundations underlying the weight structure of polar codes. Using a monomial-based polynomial formalism, we explain how polar and Reed-Muller codes can be viewed as decreasing monomial codes, enabling systematic characterization and enumeration of low-weight codewords. Its goal is to provide an accessible introduction to affine automorphisms, orbit-based descriptions of minimum and low-weight codewords, and their role in weight enumeration. Through illustrative examples and high-level overviews of recursive and coset-based techniques, the paper aims to prepare readers for deeper engagement with the recent technical literature on the weight distribution of polar codes.

AI.title_translation: 极化码重量结构教程
AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于极化码重量结构代数基础的教程，介绍了利用单项式多项式形式研究极化码和Reed-Muller码的低重码与重量分布。
AI.motivation: 为了提供一个易于理解的教程，介绍极化码重量结构背后的代数基础，帮助读者更好地阅读和参与该领域最新的技术文献研究。
AI.method: 采用基于单项式的多项式形式，将极化码和Reed-Muller码视为递减单项式码，并利用仿射自同构和基于轨道的描述方法来研究低重码。
AI.result: 系统性地刻画和枚举了低重码，阐述了仿射自同构、基于轨道的极小及低重码描述及其在重量枚举中的作用。
AI.conclusion: 该教程通过代数形式和实例，为读者理解和研究极化码的重量结构及相关最新文献提供了坚实的基础。

title: Power Estimation and Optimal Work-Charging Scheduling of Construction Electric Vehicles via Mobile Charging Stations
comments: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid
summary: Construction electric vehicles (CEVs) are a promising clean alternative to diesel-powered construction equipment, but their adoption is constrained by sparse onsite charging infrastructure, limited CEV mobility, and insufficient understanding of their power consumption. We address these gaps through a field-data-driven framework coupling CEV power estimation with mobile-charging-aware work scheduling. First, using a real-world construction demonstration at the University of California, San Diego, we develop and validate a per-subactivity power estimation model for a compact electric excavator. Manually labeled video is synchronized with coarse battery state-of-charge (SOC) telematics, and constrained nonnegative least squares is used to recover each subactivity's average power consumption. The model predicts held-out test data within $17\%$ normalized mean absolute error (NMAE), and the accompanying dataset is released publicly. Second, leveraging the subactivity power estimates, we formulate a mixed-integer program that jointly optimizes CEV work and charging schedules together with the location, timing, and charging/discharging of mobile charging stations (MCSs) serving the CEVs. The optimization accounts for energy and demand charges, carbon emissions, unmet work penalties, MCS travel, and the physical and operational constraints of the CEVs and MCSs. Across realistic scenarios drawn from the demonstration, the proposed co-optimization attains the lowest operating cost in every case, being $7$--$96\%$ below the best-performing baseline, while solving most instances to proven optimality within an hour. Dataset and scripts are available at https://github.com/ghosh-avik/CEV-MCS-Power-Estimation-and-Joint-Scheduling.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid

AI.title_translation: 通过移动充电站对建筑电动车辆进行功率估计与最优工作-充电调度
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于真实数据的框架，通过子活动功耗估计模型与混合整数规划算法，实现了建筑电动车与移动充电站的联合最优调度，大幅降低了运营成本。
AI.motivation: 建筑电动车（CEV）的采用受到现场充电基础设施稀疏、CEV机动性有限以及对其功耗了解不足的限制，为此需要一个能够结合CEV功耗估计与移动充电感知工作调度的框架来填补这些研究空白。
AI.method: 首先，利用真实施工演示数据和带标签的视频结合电池状态遥测数据，通过约束非负最小二乘法开发和验证了电动挖掘机的子活动功耗模型；其次，利用功耗估计结果，构建了一个混合整数规划模型，用于联合优化CEV的工作与充电调度以及移动充电站（MCS）的位置、时间和充放电。
AI.result: 提出的子活动功耗模型在测试集上的归一化平均绝对误差（NMAE）在17%以内；联合优化方案在所有真实场景中均实现了最低的运营成本，比表现最好的基线低7%--96%，且多数实例在1小时内求解至最优。
AI.conclusion: 研究所提出的数据驱动框架和混合整数规划模型能有效降低电动工程机械的运营成本，解决了现场充电基础设施匮乏和能耗评估不足的问题。
AI.translation: 建筑电动车辆（CEV）是柴油动力施工设备的有前景的清洁替代品，但其采用受到现场充电基础设施稀疏、CEV机动性有限以及对其功耗理解不足的限制。我们通过一个由现场数据驱动的框架来解决这些差距，该框架将CEV功率估计与移动充电感知的作业调度相结合。首先，利用加州大学圣迭戈分校的真实施工演示，我们为小型电动挖掘机开发并验证了子活动功耗估计模型。将人工标注的视频与粗粒度电池荷电状态（SOC）遥测数据同步，并使用约束非负最小二乘法来恢复每个子活动的平均功耗。该模型对保留的测试数据的预测归一化平均绝对误差（NMAE）在17%以内，并且公开发布了配套数据集。其次，利用子活动功率估计，我们构建了一个混合整数规划模型，共同优化CEV的工作和充电调度，以及服务于CEV的移动充电站（MCS）的位置、时间和充/放电。该优化考虑了能量和需求电费、碳排放、未完成工作惩罚、MCS行程以及CEV和MCS的物理与运营约束。在从演示中提取的实际场景中，所提出的协同优化在每种情况下都获得了最低的运营成本，比表现最好的基线低7%--96%，同时在1小时内将大多数实例求解至已证明的最优解。数据集和脚本可在https://github.com/ghosh-avik/CEV-MCS-Power-Estimation-and-Joint-Scheduling获取。

title: Physics-Unrolled Neural Operator for Wireless Field Modeling
summary: Radio maps are essential for wireless decision-making tasks such as access-point placement, coverage planning, and localization, but their fine spatial details are governed by complex propagation effects and are costly to simulate accurately. Machine learning offers a path to high-fidelity radio-map prediction without running expensive high-fidelity simulations for every scene. However, generating high-quality training labels at scale is also difficult: the affordable labels come from finite-ray simulations, which are richer than low-fidelity inputs but carry residual Monte Carlo noise. We address this challenge with Physics-Unrolled Hybrid Neural Operator (PU-HNO), a three-stage cascade that predicts high-fidelity indoor radio maps from low-fidelity ray-tracing outputs and scene priors by progressively capturing reflection, diffraction, and scattering effects, rather than treating radio maps as generic images. We prove that, under conditionally unbiased label noise, the model can learn stable propagation structure and outperform its own training labels. Experiments across diverse floorplans show that PU-HNO outperforms image-to-image baselines, wireless learning models, and monolithic neural operators across both image-quality and wireless deployment metrics.

title: Optimal Deterministic Fully Sparse Matrix Multiplication
summary: We give the first deterministic algorithm for fully sparse matrix multiplication that attains the optimal running-time exponent. This result matches the best previously known randomized algorithm running-time exponent. Given compatible matrices $A$ and $B$ over an arbitrary associative ring with identity, with $\operatorname{nnz}(A),\operatorname{nnz}(B)=O(n^{δ_{\mathrm{in}}})$ and $\operatorname{nnz}(AB)=O(n^{δ_{\mathrm{out}}})$, our algorithm finds the support of $AB$ and computes the product exactly in $$O\!\left(n^{β_R(δ_{\mathrm{in}},\min\{δ_{\mathrm{out}},2δ_{\mathrm{in}}\})+\varepsilon}\right)$$ operations, where $β_R(δ_{\mathrm{in}},δ)$ denotes the maximum of $δ_{\mathrm{in}}$ and $ω_{δ_{\mathrm{in}},R}(a,1,b)$ over all $a,b\in[0,1]$ satisfying $a+b=δ$. For dense inputs over a commutative ring, this bound simplifies to $O(n^{ω_R((δ_{\mathrm{out}}-1)_+,1,1)+\varepsilon})$. With the current rectangular matrix multiplication bounds, this is nearly quadratic, namely $O(n^{2+\varepsilon})$, for every $δ_\mathrm{out}\le1.321334$, improving the previous deterministic range of $δ_{\mathrm{out}}\le 0.642668$. To prove this result, we develop a general deterministic recovery technique that finds and fixes sparse parts of an unknown matrix while keeping temporary errors in denser parts under control.

title: DyG$^2$T: Modeling Object Dynamics with 3D Gaussian Temporal-Spatial Particle Graph Transformer
summary: Modeling object dynamics from limited visual observations is a fundamental problem for enabling accurate motion trajectory prediction in embodied interaction scenarios. Existing dynamics modeling methods first compress reconstructed particle representations into sparse Key Points and model their evolution using locally constrained interactions, thereby discarding fine-grained local details and obscuring discriminative interaction modeling across spatial and temporal scales, leading to drifting trajectories and inaccurate appearance prediction. To tackle these issues, we propose DyG$^2$T, a dynamics modeling framework that infers object motion trajectories by spatially completing and temporally discriminating Key Point representations and modeling multi-scale interaction over particle graphs. Spatially, DyG$^2$T enriches each Key Point by aggregating neighboring raw particle positions to recover fine-grained local details, while explicitly encoding relative offsets among Key Points to enhance geometric structure perception. Temporally, we introduce a Temporal Disentangling Network (TDN) to identify dominant cross-frame variations in latent space and amplify inter-frame differences, yielding temporally discriminative representations that are subsequently aggregated via Temporal Attention to capture frame-wise temporal evolution cues. For comprehensive interaction modeling, a Particle Graph Transformer leverages global attention to preserve discriminative long-range dependencies among Key Points, mitigating representation homogenization induced by locality-constrained modeling and providing a robust basis for accurate trajectory prediction. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that DyG$^2$T achieves accurate dynamics modeling and reasoning, and exhibits strong cross-object and real-world generalization.

title: Tianmu-TC: Physics-constraints Generative Artificial Intelligence for Global Tropical Cyclone Forecasting
summary: Tropical cyclones (TCs) pose severe risks from strong winds and heavy rainfall. However, forecasting their track and intensity remains challenging due to chaotic atmosphere and the rapid amplification of initial condition errors, leading to growing forecast uncertainty. While numerical weather prediction (NWP) and deep learning models have made progress, they remain computationally demanding and often fail under complex meteorological scenarios. Here, we present Tianmu-TC, a physics-constraints generative framework for global TC forecasting. Trained on Western North Pacific data, Tianmu-TC leverages physics-constraints to generate controllable outputs with reduced uncertainty thus improving forecast reliability. Experiments show Tianmu-TC outperforms deterministic and ensemble meteorological artificial intelligence models and authoritative NWP systems such as ECMWF in global ocean basins, with significantly lower computational cost. We further show Tianmu-TC performs well in challenging scenarios such as data sparsity, anomaly tracks, rapid intensification and weakening. These findings suggest physics-constraints generative AI offers a promising approach for reliable, efficient global TC forecasting.

title: LLM-Powered Predictive Decision-Making for Sustainable Data Center Operations
summary: The growing demand for AI-driven workloads, particularly from Large Language Models (LLMs), has raised concerns about the significant energy and resource consumption in data centers. This work introduces a novel LLM-based predictive scheduling system designed to enhance operational efficiency while reducing the environmental impact of data centers. Our system utilizes an LLM to predict key metrics such as execution time and energy consumption from source code, and it has the potential to extend to other sustainability-focused metrics like water usage for cooling and carbon emissions, provided the data center can track such data. The predictive model is followed by a real-time scheduling algorithm that allocates GPU resources, aiming to improve sustainability by optimizing both energy consumption and queuing delays. With fast inference times, the ability to generalize across diverse task types, and minimal data requirements for training, our approach offers a practical solution for data center scheduling. This framework demonstrates strong potential for advancing sustainability objectives in AI-driven infrastructure. Through our collaboration with a data center, we achieved a 32% reduction in energy consumption and a 30% decrease in waiting time.

title: UMER: Unifying Embedding and Ranking via Pair-Aware Discriminative Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Universal multimodal retrieval aims to support diverse instruction-aware retrieval tasks, demanding both efficient corpus-scale matching and fine-grained semantic reasoning. Recent MLLM-based embedding methods typically derive representations from hidden states, while Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning is emerging as a promising strategy for embedding enhancement by encoding intermediate semantic evidence into the representation space. However, existing CoT methods typically use item-wise reasoning over queries and candidates in isolation, providing no explicit evidence to distinguish a positive from a semantically confusable hard negative. Moreover, contrastive embeddings capture global similarity but struggle with meta-tasks requiring answer verification, category judgment or fine-grained reasoning. In this paper, we propose UMER, a Unified Multimodal Embedding and Ranking framework for universal multimodal retrieval. UMER replaces item-wise reflection with Pair-Aware Discriminative Reasoning, which compares query--candidate pairs to identify instruction-relevant matching and discrepancy evidence. UMER jointly learns contrastive embeddings for efficient global matching and discriminative ranking for explicit pairwise relevance judgment within a single MLLM. A complementary mutual distillation strategy further transfers reliable pairwise preferences between the embedding and ranking functions. On the MMEB-V2 benchmark, UMER achieves state-of-the-art performance under comparable experimental settings while supporting budget-adjustable inference.
