title: An Experimental Study of Downwash Effects on a Continuum Manipulator Integrated with a Multirotor UAV
comments: Accepted to publish in Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: Continuum arm aerial manipulation systems leverage soft-manipulator compliance and dexterity for tasks in confined or hazardous environments, but propeller downwash can degrade performance, particularly near walls and the ground. This effect remains uncharacterized for continuum manipulators. This letter experimentally studies downwash-induced kinematic deviations of a tendon-driven continuum manipulator integrated with a multirotor platform. Under still-air conditions, the CM is compared with a constant-curvature (CC) model. Downwash- induced end-effector pose deviations are then quantified relative to the mean still-air experimental baseline at four propeller throttle levels in free space, and at maximum throttle near a wall, and near the ground. Vertical position and yaw show the largest deviations and are amplified by ground effect. A CC-guided Gaussian process regression (GPR) residual model is learned from experimental data that improves forward pose prediction RMSE (position by 89-95%, orientation by 47-79%), and support compensation-oriented, downwash-aware modeling of continuum arm aerial manipulation systems.

title: Toward Controllability-Aware Performance Measures: A Case Study on Controllable Highway Congestion
comments: Submitted to Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
summary: Advancements in emerging intelligent transportation systems (ITS) have shown immense benefit in reducing congestion, emissions, and accidents and enable lower-cost alternatives to highway lane expansion. However, there currently exists no standard metric by which agencies can assess the improvement potential from these interventions. As a result, they may fail to deploy infrastructure where it will be most promising or risk investing in infrastructure that does not meaningfully enhance performance. Our objective is to guide ITS deployment by developing a metric that quantifies the upper bound of congestion improvement from controlling speed limits on a highway. We propose controllable congestion, a metric that quantifies the maximum achievable reduction in system delay. To estimate controllable congestion, we develop a nonlinear optimization framework grounded in a reformulation of the METANET macroscopic traffic model and solved using model predictive control (MPC). Using both a synthetic scenario and highway data from the I-24 SMART Corridor in Tennessee, we find that controllable congestion is largely independent of total delay, revealing that for two days with identical travel times, controllable congestion can vary from 13\% to 80\%. We further show that the realizable share of this upper bound depends on the operational constraints imposed. On I-24, the minimum posted speed limit has little effect on controllable congestion, while frequency of speed limit update and maximum difference between adjacent gantries have large impacts. This framework allows highway operators to distinguish between congestion that is structurally unavoidable and congestion that is highly responsive to ITS, enabling more cost-effective deployment of control-based traffic infrastructure.

title: Exact SAT Solving for the Two-Dimensional Bandwidth Minimization Problem
summary: The two-dimensional bandwidth minimization problem (2DBMP) seeks an injective embedding of a guest graph into a square grid that minimizes the maximum Manhattan distance over its edges. Heuristic methods can provide strong upper bounds, but these bounds do not by themselves certify optimality. We present an efficient exact SAT-based approach for 2DBMP that incrementally searches for the minimum feasible bandwidth and certifies optimality through satisfiability and unsatisfiability results. On the standard $\lceil\sqrt n\rceil \times \lceil\sqrt n\rceil$ host grid, under a 3600 s time limit, the proposed SAT approach certifies optimal bandwidths for 41 of 43 Regular instances and 42 of 93 Harwell--Boeing instances, achieving substantially broader optimality certification within the 3600 s time limit than a previous exact approach evaluated with a 72-hour time limit. In addition, it certifies three bandwidth values that improve all previously published comparison values considered in this study and establishes all three as optimal. We further evaluate the approach on alternative host geometries, namely $2\times\lceil n/2\rceil$ and $n\times n$ grids, to assess its effectiveness beyond the standard host. Overall, the results demonstrate that the proposed SAT approach provides an effective exact method for the small- and medium-sized benchmark instances considered in this study, with fewer than 400 vertices, while heuristic methods remain important for larger and more challenging instances.

title: Cross-Modal MRI Ovary Segmentation in Endometriosis Using Unpaired TVUS Prototype Priors
summary: Transvaginal ultrasound (TVUS) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provide complementary information for endometriosis image analysis, yet existing studies mainly focus on single-modality analysis or disease classification, leaving cross-modal ovarian segmentation largely unexplored. In this work, to tackle the increased difficulty of ovary segmentation in MRI due to ovaries' small target size and ambiguous boundaries with surrounding pelvic structures, we propose a dual branch framework for ovary segmentation across TVUS and MRI. More specifically, by adapting MedSAM3 with TVUS-derived prototype bank, we aim to align anatomically consistent feature representations across both modalities. Extensive experiments are conducted on endometriosis-related TVUS and MRI datasets. We observe quantitative and qualitative improvements of over 5 percentage points for the proposed dual-branch approach compared with multiple state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, our ablation study shows the contribution of individual components such as the prototype bank and the importance of warm-up pretraining in the source TVUS domain.

title: OptiModNet: A UNet-Transformer Hybrid with Grouped-Query and Channel Attention for Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation
summary: Precise segmentation of the optic disc and cup is critical for the early detection and diagnosis of glaucoma. However, achieving consistently high performance across datasets while maintaining low computational requirements remains a significant challenge. In glaucoma detection, low-computation methods are crucial for enabling rapid, large-scale screening and facilitating deployment in resource-limited clinical environments. While deep learning models such as UNets, Vision Transformers (ViTs), and Diffusion models have demonstrated strong segmentation performance but these methods often come with substantial computational overhead. UNets are efficient at capturing local features but are limited in modeling global contextual information. Conversely, ViTs excel at long-range dependency modeling but are computationally intensive. Hybrid architectures, such as UNetR, which combine transformer-based encoders with UNet-style decoders, have shown improved performance but while incurring additional complexity. Considering these, in this work, we propose OptiModNet, a light weight novel hybrid architecture tailored for optic disc and cup segmentation. The model integrates diverse attention mechanisms at multiple stages of the network to enhance both local and global feature representation. We include an Aggregated Pyramid Loss that supervises predictions at multiple decoder depths, to promote better gradient flow and structural consistency. We evaluate OptiModNet on the REFUGE2 dataset for both optic disc and cup segmentation tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, exceeding existing approaches by over 2.5\%, while maintaining high efficiency with only 3.73 GFLOPs and 1.93M parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/SG1947/OptiModNet.

title: Sharp Sobolev Approximation on General Domains by Linearized Shallow Networks with Analytic Activations
summary: We study Sobolev approximation on bounded domains by linearized shallow neural networks whose inner parameters are prescribed independently of the target function. Our main step is a one-dimensional construction for analytic activations. We prove that quasi-Chebyshev parameter sets with univariate resolution $m$ generate fixed feature spaces attaining the sharp $H^r$-to-$H^s$ approximation order $m^{-(r-s)}$ for a class of analytic activations satisfying a quantitative non-cancellation condition on their Taylor coefficients. Combining this result with the ridge-function lifting theorem in [SIAM J. Math. Anal. 30 (1998), pp. 155-189] and its extension to arbitrary quasi-uniform direction sets established in this work, we construct tensor-product-type parameter sets that attain the sharp rate $$\|f-f_n\|_{L^2(Ω)}\lesssim n^{-\frac rd}\|f\|_{H^r(Ω)},\quad f\in H^r(Ω)$$ for all $r>0$. In contrast to the finite-difference construction in [Neural Comput. 8 (1996), pp. 164-177], whose explicit admissibility condition may require an extremely small parameter scale, the proposed parameter sets remain distributed over fixed intervals and are therefore more amenable to practical computation.

title: Which Negatives Matter? Ask Your Text Encoder: Adaptive Similarity Margins for Dense-Caption Retrieval
summary: Dense-caption retrieval has recently been improved by introducing segmentation, edge maps, LLM-filtered captions, and cross-modal modules into contrastive fine-tuning. However, these methods largely inherit the same InfoNCE objective, whose optimization can prematurely saturate under a strong pre-trained initialization: on dense captions, the loss falls below 10^{-3} on 80% of batches within the first epoch, while its gradient reaches exact zero in fp32 in 47% of measurements. We find that this behavior is closely related to the large number of near-duplicate captions in dense-caption benchmarks, where a few highly similar negatives remain unresolved after the easy majority has already been separated. As a remedy, we introduce HN-CLIP, which uses the text encoder's own text-text geometry to construct per-negative adaptive similarity margins. Specifically, a detached caption-similarity matrix is added to the negative logits, assigning larger margins to more similar captions without mining, synthesizing, or resampling negatives. The resulting objective requires only one caption-similarity matrix and a masked logit addition during training, with no auxiliary data, additional parameters, offline preprocessing, or inference-time overhead. Extensive experiments on four dense-caption retrieval benchmarks show that HN-CLIP improves over the strongest competitors by +2.4--+4.3 R@1 while training 2.4x faster than GOAL and 5.4x faster than StructXLIP. Moreover, the proposed objective improves all six tested fine-tuning frameworks on the in-domain benchmarks and reaches the strongest full-data baseline with only 20% of the training data.

title: GCNO: Gramian Chebyshev Neural Operator for Physics-Based Compression of Wireless Channels
summary: Large antenna arrays allow wireless systems to serve more users and achieve higher data rates, but they also make channel feedback expensive: the receiving device must repeatedly report a large complex-valued channel matrix to the base station. Most neural compressors treat this matrix like an image and replace it with a fixed-length code that only a matched neural decoder can interpret. The message therefore does not adapt to channel complexity, and changing the antenna count typically requires retraining. We ask whether a device can instead report only the few dominant propagation paths underlying each channel. We introduce the Gramian Chebyshev Neural Operator (GCNO), a physics-based, variable-rate compressor that identifies a sample-dependent set of path directions. GCNO uses receive-transmit channel structure to locate paths, a first-order Taylor correction to refine directions that fall between grid points, and least squares to recover their complex strengths. It is trained without path labels, and the base station reconstructs the channel analytically from the transmitted path tuples rather than through a learned decoder. Across three ray-traced environments, GCNO achieves better reconstruction accuracy at the same payload - or lower payload at the same accuracy - than neural feedback baselines, and transfers to unseen antenna counts without retraining.

title: Prior-Conditioned Gaussian Discriminants for Generalizable AI-generated Image Detection
summary: Diffusion-based generators have made synthetic images ubiquitous, but detectors often fail under simultaneous shifts in generator, prompt/style, and source-domain. We study AI-generated image detection as a transfer system described by training prior, frozen encoder feature space, and decision rule, and ask when classifier head training adds value beyond what is already separable in modern features. As a controlled diagnostic, we fit a prior-conditioned Gaussian discriminant ladder: closed-form heads built from first- and second-order feature statistics under nested covariance assumptions. On Percept-Lens, a unified protocol over 39 public datasets (7.1 million images), the best rung is frequently competitive with, and sometimes exceeds, released AI-generated image detector heads when matched on both prior and encoder. We further quantify strong sensitivity to the training prior, data-efficiency of moment-based heads, and representation dependence of Gaussian shift metrics, motivating (prior, encoder, head)-level reporting and stronger analytical baselines for AIGI transfer.

title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
summary: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with multi-turn tool-calling capabilities is essential for building autonomous agents. However, progress is fundamentally limited by the reliance on full-length trajectory imitation. For tasks involving multiple order-independent sub-goals, the optimal solution space forms a vast combinatorial diamond lattice. Forcing this rich topology into monolithic trajectories causes a severe topological collapse, indiscriminately penalizing valid alternative explorations and severely degrading policy diversity. To address this, we propose DART-SD (Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation), a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from global forcing to topology-guided localized correction. DART-SD first models the execution process as a converging Interaction-State Transition Graph (ISTG), faithfully capturing the inherent diamond topology of successful and failed exploratory paths. During autonomous rollouts, the framework identifies the Critical Topological Breakpoint (CTB) and retrieves success-supported recovery references. Finally, we introduce a progressive self-distillation paradigm through CTB-guided localized supervision, ensuring that the training loss is calculated exclusively on the generated recovery steps while strictly protecting the valid reasoning prefix from destructive gradient updates. Experiments on complex multi-turn tool-calling benchmarks demonstrate that DART-SD significantly outperforms traditional full-trajectory baselines.

title: Pairwise Ranking Outperforms Single-Action RL for Offline Explanation Selection: A Practical Lesson
comments: This is an extended version of a 3-page paper accepted to the RecSys 2026 Research and Practice Notes track
summary:
Industrial explainable-recommendation systems built on LLMs incur a substantial serving cost: each request triggers an LLM generation, with latency in the hundreds of milliseconds and cost that scales linearly with traffic. We separate generation from selection: explanations are produced ahead of time as a frozen candidate pool (six prompt styles, two commodity LLMs), and a small CPU-resident selector picks one at request time. The stack needs no GPU and returns in under 100 ms.
  Our primary benchmark is a 2,958-pair XRec Google Local subset, evaluating six offline-pool selectors (LambdaRank, PPO, GRPO, DPO, teacher-student distillation) and three KG-path selectors (random walks, edge-disjoint enumeration, MMR-reranked paths). A 300-pair MovieLens-1M split with Claude-Sonnet-4.5 references serves as an internal cross-dataset check, since no public benchmark exists for this setting. All variants use the same BERTScore-F1 protocol as XRec and G-Refer, averaged across five seeds.
  LambdaRank reaches F1 = 0.500 on Google Local, exceeding both G-Refer and XRec, and F1 = 0.329 on the MovieLens-1M check. With seed variance below 0.003 F1, the ordering is reliable: pairwise learning-to-rank outperforms single-action RL (PPO, GRPO, DPO), which use only one labelled candidate per rollout, leaving K-1 labels unused.
  The KG-path family targets a different objective: all three variants reach USR = 1.000 on Google Local and 0.997-1.000 on MovieLens-1M, since per-request path grounding yields a unique output per query, avoiding template-collapse failures affecting cached-LLM outputs.
  A generator-pool study comparing Claude 3 Haiku and Claude Haiku 4.5 shows small F1 shifts (0.001-0.006) while preserving selector ranking: selector and generator can be evaluated independently, though absolute F1 depends on the generator. End-to-end build cost is near $15 on commodity hardware.

AI.title_translation: 成对排序优于单动作强化学习用于离线解释选择：一个实践经验
AI.tldr: 工业可解释推荐系统中的大语言模型成本高昂。本文提出将解释生成与选择分离，通过CPU驻留选择器在请求时从预生成池中选择解释。结果显示，成对排序（LambdaRank）在离线解释选择中显著优于单动作强化学习，提供了一种经济高效的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的工业可解释推荐系统存在高昂的服务成本（高延迟，成本随流量线性增长），因此需要降低成本并提高效率。
AI.method: 将解释生成（提前生成，作为冻结候选池）与选择（请求时，由小型CPU驻留选择器完成）分离。在2,958对XRec Google Local子集和300对MovieLens-1M分割数据集上进行基准测试。评估了六种离线池选择器（LambdaRank, PPO, GRPO, DPO, 师生蒸馏）和三种知识图谱路径选择器。采用BERTScore-F1协议，对五个种子进行平均。进行了生成器池研究，比较了Claude 3 Haiku和Claude Haiku 4.5。
AI.result: 所提出的系统无需GPU，响应时间低于100毫秒。LambdaRank在Google Local上达到F1 = 0.500，在MovieLens-1M上达到F1 = 0.329。成对学习排序（LambdaRank）优于单动作强化学习（PPO, GRPO, DPO），因为它更好地利用了标签。知识图谱路径系列在Google Local上达到USR = 1.000，在MovieLens-1M上达到0.997-1.000，避免了缓存大语言模型输出中出现的模板崩溃问题。生成器池研究表明F1值变化很小（0.001-0.006），并保持了选择器排名，表明选择器和生成器可以独立评估。端到端构建成本在商用硬件上接近15美元。
AI.conclusion: 相较于单动作强化学习，成对学习排序是工业可解释推荐系统中离线解释选择更有效和高效的方法，显著降低了服务成本并保持了性能。生成与选择的分离是关键。
AI.translation:
基于大语言模型构建的工业可解释推荐系统会产生巨大的服务成本：每个请求都会触发一次大语言模型生成，延迟数百毫秒，且成本随流量线性增长。我们分离了生成和选择：解释作为冻结的候选池（六种提示风格，两个通用大语言模型）提前生成，一个小型CPU驻留选择器在请求时进行选择。该堆栈无需GPU，并在100毫秒内返回结果。
我们的主要基准测试是2,958对XRec Google Local子集，评估了六种离线池选择器（LambdaRank, PPO, GRPO, DPO, 师生蒸馏）和三种知识图谱路径选择器（随机游走，边不相交枚举，MMR重排序路径）。一个包含Claude-Sonnet-4.5参考的300对MovieLens-1M分割数据集作为内部跨数据集检查，因为目前没有针对此设置的公开基准。所有变体都使用与XRec和G-Refer相同的BERTScore-F1协议，并对五个种子进行平均。
LambdaRank在Google Local上达到F1 = 0.500，超过了G-Refer和XRec，在MovieLens-1M检查中达到F1 = 0.329。由于种子方差低于0.003 F1，排序是可靠的：成对学习排序优于单动作强化学习（PPO, GRPO, DPO），后者每次rollout只使用一个标记候选，导致K-1个标签未被使用。
知识图谱路径系列针对不同的目标：所有三种变体在Google Local上达到USR = 1.000，在MovieLens-1M上达到0.997-1.000，因为每个请求的路径 grounding 会为每个查询产生唯一的输出，避免了影响缓存大语言模型输出的模板崩溃失败。
一项比较Claude 3 Haiku和Claude Haiku 4.5的生成器池研究显示F1值变化很小（0.001-0.006），同时保持了选择器排名：选择器和生成器可以独立评估，尽管绝对F1值取决于生成器。端到端构建成本在商用硬件上接近15美元。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决基于大语言模型的可解释推荐系统高昂的服务成本问题，通过将解释生成与选择解耦。解释预先生成，由轻量级CPU驻留选择器在请求时进行选择。基准测试表明，LambdaRank等成对学习排序方法在离线解释选择方面显著优于单动作强化学习方法，提供了一种快速、经济高效且无需GPU的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 成对排序, 解释选择, 强化学习, 大语言模型, 可解释人工智能, 推荐系统
AI.comments: 本文为高效部署基于大语言模型的可解释推荐系统提供了一个实用且有影响力的解决方案。其关键创新在于关注点分离（生成与选择）以及经验性发现：对于特定的离线选择任务，简单的成对排序方法比复杂的强化学习更有效，尤其是在考虑标签利用率时。这为工业应用提供了宝贵的经验。

title: StateTrace: An Object-Centric Framework for Hidden-State Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Long Videos
comments: 10 pages. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026)
summary: Existing VLMs have achieved strong performance in video understanding, yet they struggle with long-video spatiotemporal reasoning when target objects become invisible, often mistaking "invisible" for "unknown". We define this challenge as hidden-state spatiotemporal reasoning: inferring object states during prolonged invisible intervals from context interactions. To address this, we propose StateTrace, a novel object-centric framework that endows VideoLLMs with an explicit mechanism for hidden state reasoning in long videos. StateTrace builds a reusable spatiotemporal state memory that organizes object trajectories, inter-object relations, and state-transition events into a structured reasoning substrate. At inference time, it retrieves question-relevant state-evolution trajectories and converts them into compact reasoning cues, enabling the model to explicitly reason about why an object disappears, how its state evolves while invisible, and whether that state should persist at query time. We further build HSR-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for hidden-state reasoning, containing 1,427 video-QA samples from 1,384 unique videos. Extensive experiments across multiple VideoLLMs show that StateTrace consistently improves performance on both public benchmarks and HSR-Bench (e.g., improving VideoLLaMA3 from 39.6 to 64.2 on HSR-Bench).
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026)

AI.title_translation: StateTrace：一个用于长视频中隐藏状态时空推理的以对象为中心的框架
AI.tldr: StateTrace是一个以对象为中心的框架，通过构建可重用的时空状态记忆和推理线索，使VideoLLMs能够对长视频中不可见对象的隐藏状态进行时空推理，并在多个基准测试中显著提高了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在视频理解方面表现出色，但在目标对象不可见时，长视频时空推理能力不足，常将“不可见”误认为“未知”。本文将此挑战定义为隐藏状态时空推理：即从上下文交互中推断长时间不可见期间的对象状态。
AI.method: 本文提出了StateTrace，一个新颖的以对象为中心的框架，为VideoLLMs提供了一个明确的隐藏状态推理机制。StateTrace构建了一个可重用的时空状态记忆，将对象轨迹、对象间关系和状态转换事件组织成结构化的推理基质。在推理时，它检索与问题相关的状态演变轨迹并将其转换为紧凑的推理线索，使模型能够明确推理对象消失的原因、不可见时其状态如何演变以及该状态在查询时是否应持续。此外，本文还构建了HSR-Bench，一个用于隐藏状态推理的诊断基准，包含来自1384个独立视频的1427个视频问答样本。
AI.result: 在多个VideoLLMs上进行的广泛实验表明，StateTrace在公共基准测试和HSR-Bench上均持续提高了性能（例如，将VideoLLaMA3在HSR-Bench上的性能从39.6提高到64.2）。
AI.conclusion: StateTrace通过引入一个明确的隐藏状态推理机制和结构化的时空状态记忆，有效解决了长视频中对象不可见时的时空推理挑战，并显著提升了现有VideoLLMs的性能。
AI.translation: 现有VLM在视频理解方面表现出色，但在目标对象不可见时，长视频时空推理能力不足，常将“不可见”误认为“未知”。本文将此挑战定义为隐藏状态时空推理：即从上下文交互中推断长时间不可见期间的对象状态。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了StateTrace，一个新颖的以对象为中心的框架，它赋予VideoLLMs一个明确的隐藏状态推理机制，用于长视频。StateTrace构建了一个可重用的时空状态记忆，将对象轨迹、对象间关系和状态转换事件组织成结构化的推理基质。在推理时，它检索与问题相关的状态演变轨迹并将其转换为紧凑的推理线索，使模型能够明确推理对象消失的原因、不可见时其状态如何演变以及该状态在查询时是否应持续。我们进一步构建了HSR-Bench，一个用于隐藏状态推理的诊断基准，包含来自1384个独立视频的1427个视频问答样本。在多个VideoLLMs上进行的广泛实验表明，StateTrace在公共基准测试和HSR-Bench上均持续提高了性能（例如，将VideoLLaMA3在HSR-Bench上的性能从39.6提高到64.2）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了StateTrace，一个以对象为中心的框架，旨在解决长视频中目标对象不可见时的隐藏状态时空推理问题。该框架通过构建一个可重用的时空状态记忆来组织对象轨迹、关系和状态转换事件，并在推理时利用这些信息生成紧凑的推理线索，以明确推理不可见对象的状态演变。实验结果表明，StateTrace显著提高了多个VideoLLMs在公共基准和新构建的HSR-Bench上的性能。
AI.keywords: 隐藏状态推理, 时空推理, 长视频, 对象中心, VideoLLM
AI.comments: StateTrace的创新之处在于其明确的隐藏状态推理机制和以对象为中心的结构化时空状态记忆，这有效地解决了现有VLMs在处理长视频中对象不可见时的推理盲点。通过构建HSR-Bench诊断基准，该工作不仅提出了解决方案，也为该领域的研究提供了新的评估工具，具有重要的研究价值。

title: FinRCA-Bench: Benchmarking Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning for Financial AI Systems
comments: 19 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/PratikGhawate/FinRCA-AI-Bench
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to support financial operations, but their apparent reasoning performance can depend on whether they receive the right evidence. In financial reconciliation, the evidence needed for diagnosis is distributed across invoices, purchase orders, approvals, allocations, payments, ledger entries, and bank activity, linked by transactional relationships rather than textual similarity. End-to-end accuracy can therefore conflate evidence access with reasoning quality. We introduce FinRCA-Bench, a deterministic synthetic benchmark of 2,250 accounts-payable-to-bank reconciliation cases spanning 14 operational tables, including 1,500 injected failures across 15 causal categories and 750 legitimate or hard-negative cases. Root-cause labels and record-level evidence contracts are hidden from the model, allowing retrieval to be evaluated independently of answer correctness. We compare Rules/SQL, classical machine learning, dense semantic retrieval, deterministic relational expansion, and Typed Provenance Graph Retrieval (TPGR), a typed traversal restricted to persisted transaction relationships. Rules/SQL reaches 84.97% held-out exact accuracy and classical ML reaches 95.44%. Holding the reasoning model, prompt, and generation settings fixed while changing only retrieval increases macro required-record recall from 0.83% to 77.70% and exact 16-class accuracy from 2.05% to 72.44%. Structural retrieval failures outnumber reasoning failures with sufficient retrieval by 95 to 15; 254 correct predictions occur despite incomplete retrieval, and strict returned-evidence contract accuracy is only 5.72%. On FinRCA-Bench, retrieval architecture strongly shapes observed AI-system performance, and a correct root-cause label is a weak proxy for an auditable diagnosis.
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/PratikGhawate/FinRCA-AI-Bench

AI.title_translation: FinRCA-Bench：金融AI系统证据检索与推理基准测试
AI.tldr: FinRCA-Bench 是一个用于评估金融AI系统在财务对账中证据检索和推理能力的合成基准。研究发现，检索架构对AI系统性能影响巨大，并且正确的根因标签并不能完全代表可审计的诊断。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在金融操作中越来越普遍，但其推理性能依赖于能否获得正确的证据。在财务对账中，诊断所需的证据分散在多种金融文档中，且通过交易关系而非文本相似性链接。因此，端到端准确性可能混淆了证据访问和推理质量。
AI.method: 引入了FinRCA-Bench，一个确定性的合成基准，包含2,250个应付账款到银行对账案例，涉及14个操作表。其中包括1,500个注入的故障（15种因果类别）和750个合法或难负例。根因标签和记录级证据合同对模型隐藏，使得检索可以独立于答案正确性进行评估。比较了规则/SQL、经典机器学习、密集语义检索、确定性关系扩展和类型化溯源图检索（TPGR）。
AI.result: 规则/SQL达到了84.97%的精确准确率，经典机器学习达到了95.44%。在推理模型、提示和生成设置不变的情况下，仅改变检索方式，宏观所需记录召回率从0.83%提高到77.70%，精确16类准确率从2.05%提高到72.44%。结构性检索失败数量是检索充分时的推理失败数量的95比15；尽管检索不完整，仍有254个正确预测；严格的返回证据合同准确率仅为5.72%。
AI.conclusion: 在FinRCA-Bench上，检索架构极大地影响了观察到的AI系统性能，并且正确的根因标签并不能完全代表可审计的诊断。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于支持金融操作，但其表观推理性能可能取决于它们是否获得了正确的证据。在财务对账中，诊断所需的证据分布在发票、采购订单、审批、分配、付款、账本分录和银行活动中，并通过交易关系而非文本相似性进行链接。因此，端到端准确性可能混淆了证据访问与推理质量。我们引入了FinRCA-Bench，一个确定性的合成基准，包含2,250个应付账款到银行对账案例，跨越14个操作表，其中包括1,500个注入的故障（涵盖15种因果类别）和750个合法或难负例。根因标签和记录级证据合同对模型隐藏，允许独立于答案正确性评估检索。我们比较了规则/SQL、经典机器学习、密集语义检索、确定性关系扩展和类型化溯源图检索（TPGR），后者是一种受限于持久化交易关系的类型化遍历。规则/SQL达到了84.97%的保留精确准确率，经典机器学习达到了95.44%。在推理模型、提示和生成设置不变的情况下，仅改变检索方式，宏观所需记录召回率从0.83%提高到77.70%，精确16类准确率从2.05%提高到72.44%。结构性检索失败数量是检索充分时的推理失败数量的95比15；尽管检索不完整，仍有254个正确预测；严格的返回证据合同准确率仅为5.72%。在FinRCA-Bench上，检索架构强烈地影响着观察到的AI系统性能，并且正确的根因标签是可审计诊断的弱代理。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了FinRCA-Bench，这是一个专为评估金融AI系统在财务对账场景中证据检索与推理能力而设计的确定性合成基准。该基准包含2,250个应付账款到银行对账案例，涵盖多种金融文档和交易关系，并注入了各类故障。通过独立评估检索和推理能力，研究发现，不同的检索架构对AI系统的性能影响显著，远超推理模型本身。实验结果表明，尽管一些传统方法表现出色，但检索的质量对于实现高准确率至关重要，且单一的正确根因标签不足以代表可审计的诊断。
AI.keywords: 金融AI, 证据检索, 推理, 基准测试, 财务对账
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个专门针对金融领域证据检索和推理的基准测试FinRCA-Bench，解决了现有基准可能混淆证据访问与推理质量的问题。其强调检索架构对AI系统性能的决定性影响，并指出可审计诊断的重要性，对金融AI系统的开发和评估具有重要指导意义。

title: Evaluating and Explaining Prompt Sensitivity of LLMs Using Interactions
comments: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 46 pages, 48 figures
summary: The remarkable capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are often undermined by their instability. Even subtle and semantically irrelevant changes in prompts can cause dramatic fluctuations in performance, a phenomenon known as prompt sensitivity. Previous studies typically evaluate prompt sensitivity by comparing the LLM's final outputs when prompts change. However, such coarse-grained metrics fail to explain the internal reasons for prompt sensitivity. In this paper, we introduce interactions as a fine-grained tool to analyze prompt sensitivity of LLMs. Specifically, we decompose the output score of the LLM into a set of interactions. Each interaction represents a nonlinear relationship involving a set of input variables. We discover that subtle changes to prompts can trigger severe instability in interactions, even when the outputs of the LLM remain the same. To this end, we propose an Interaction-based Prompt Sensitivity (IPS) metric by quantifying changes in interactions when we introduce subtle changes to prompts. We apply the IPS metric to 50 open-source LLMs and uncover four factors that reduce the prompt sensitivity of LLMs, including supervised fine-tuning, increased model scales, dense architectures, and few-shot learning. More crucially, we discover a common mechanism by which these four factors reduce prompt sensitivity: all four factors tend to reduce the prompt sensitivity of low-order interactions (i.e., interactions involving few input variables).
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 46 pages, 48 figures

AI.title_translation: 使用交互评估和解释大型语言模型的提示敏感性
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型对提示敏感。本文提出基于交互的提示敏感性（IPS）指标来解释此现象，并发现通过稳定低阶交互来降低敏感性的因素。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的能力常因其不稳定性而受损，即使是提示中细微且语义无关的变化，也可能导致性能的剧烈波动，即提示敏感性。以往粗粒度指标未能解释提示敏感性的内部原因。
AI.method: 本文引入“交互”作为分析大型语言模型提示敏感性的细粒度工具。具体来说，将大型语言模型的输出分数分解为一组交互，每个交互代表涉及一组输入变量的非线性关系。通过量化提示微小变化时交互的变化，提出了一种基于交互的提示敏感性（IPS）指标。将IPS指标应用于50个开源大型语言模型。
AI.result: 研究发现，即使大型语言模型的输出保持不变，提示的细微变化也可能触发交互的严重不稳定。有四个因素可以降低提示敏感性：监督微调、增加模型规模、密集架构和少样本学习。更重要的是，这四个因素降低提示敏感性的共同机制是它们都倾向于降低低阶交互（即涉及少量输入变量的交互）的提示敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论，大型语言模型的提示敏感性可以通过交互的不稳定性来解释，特别是低阶交互，并且监督微调、增加模型规模、密集架构和少样本学习等因素通过稳定这些低阶交互来降低提示敏感性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的卓越能力常因其不稳定性而受损。即使是提示中细微且语义无关的变化，也可能导致性能的剧烈波动，这种现象被称为提示敏感性。以往的研究通常通过比较提示变化时LLM的最终输出来评估提示敏感性。然而，这种粗粒度指标未能解释提示敏感性的内部原因。在本文中，我们引入交互作为分析LLM提示敏感性的细粒度工具。具体来说，我们将LLM的输出分数分解为一组交互。每个交互代表涉及一组输入变量的非线性关系。我们发现，即使LLM的输出保持不变，提示的细微变化也可能触发交互的严重不稳定。为此，我们通过量化提示微小变化时交互的变化，提出了一种基于交互的提示敏感性（IPS）指标。我们将IPS指标应用于50个开源LLM，并揭示了四个降低LLM提示敏感性的因素，包括监督微调、增加模型规模、密集架构和少样本学习。更重要的是，我们发现这四个因素降低提示敏感性的一个共同机制：所有这四个因素都倾向于降低低阶交互（即涉及少量输入变量的交互）的提示敏感性。
AI.summary: 大型语言模型存在提示敏感性问题，但现有方法未能解释其内部原因。本文引入“交互”作为细粒度分析工具，并提出了基于交互的提示敏感性（IPS）指标。通过将IPS应用于50个开源大型语言模型，研究发现监督微调、增加模型规模、密集架构和少样本学习能降低提示敏感性，其共同机制是稳定低阶交互。
AI.keywords: 提示敏感性, 大型语言模型, 交互, 模型鲁棒性, 微调
AI.comments: 这篇论文引入了一种新颖的细粒度方法（交互）来理解提示敏感性，超越了简单的输出比较。它识别出特定的影响因素以及一个共同的潜在机制（低阶交互），这对提高大型语言模型的鲁棒性做出了重要贡献。

title: Bridging Search and CRM: Productionizing AI Product Research Agents for Customer Re-Engagement
summary: Modern e-commerce platforms often operate search, recommendation, personalization, and CRM systems independently, limiting opportunities for proactive customer re-engagement. This is particularly challenging for exploratory intents such as best smartphones or latest 5G phones, where users may leave the platform for external research before purchasing. We present a scalable, production-deployed framework that bridges search and CRM workflows through AI-powered Product Research Agents. The system identifies users with exploratory purchase intent and low engagement, conducts grounded multi-agent product research using behavioral signals, external knowledge, and enterprise catalog data, and delivers personalized recommendations through WhatsApp. We evaluate the framework in a 23-day production deployment involving approximately 15K WhatsApp notifications for mobile product discovery. The campaign achieved substantial CTR improvements over traditional WhatsApp recommendation campaigns, with evidence of secondary engagement through message forwarding and sharing. The deployment also generated downstream purchases and GMV impact, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of AI Product Research Agents for proactive customer re-engagement and end-to-end customer journey optimization.

AI.title_translation: 连接搜索与客户关系管理：为客户再互动生产化人工智能产品研究代理
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种将搜索和客户关系管理（CRM）工作流通过AI产品研究代理相结合的框架，以主动重新吸引客户。该系统识别具有探索性购买意图和低参与度的用户，利用行为信号、外部知识和企业目录数据进行多代理产品研究，并通过WhatsApp提供个性化推荐。在为期23天的生产部署中，该活动取得了显著的点击率（CTR）提升，并对下游购买和商品总值（GMV）产生了积极影响。
AI.motivation: 现代电子商务平台通常独立运行搜索、推荐、个性化和CRM系统，这限制了主动吸引客户的机会，尤其是在用户进行外部研究以满足探索性购买意图时。
AI.method: 开发了一个可扩展的、已投入生产的框架，通过AI驱动的产品研究代理连接搜索和CRM工作流。该系统识别具有探索性购买意图和低参与度的用户，利用行为信号、外部知识和企业目录数据进行基于多代理的产品研究，并通过WhatsApp提供个性化推荐。
AI.result: 在为期23天的生产部署中，涉及约15000条WhatsApp通知，该活动实现了比传统WhatsApp推荐活动更高的点击率（CTR），并有证据表明通过消息转发和分享产生了二次参与。此外，该部署还带来了下游购买和GMV的增长。
AI.conclusion: AI产品研究代理在主动吸引客户和优化端到端客户旅程方面具有实际效果。
AI.translation: 现代电子商务平台通常独立运行搜索、推荐、个性化和CRM系统，这限制了主动吸引客户的机会。这对于探索性意图（如最好的智能手机或最新的5G手机）尤其具有挑战性，因为用户在购买前可能会离开平台进行外部研究。我们提出了一个可扩展的、已投入生产的框架，通过AI驱动的产品研究代理连接搜索和CRM工作流。该系统识别具有探索性购买意图和低参与度的用户，利用行为信号、外部知识和企业目录数据进行基于多代理的产品研究，并通过WhatsApp提供个性化推荐。我们在为期23天的生产部署中评估了该框架，涉及约15000条WhatsApp通知，用于移动产品发现。与传统的WhatsApp推荐活动相比，该活动取得了显著的点击率（CTR）提升，并有证据表明通过消息转发和分享产生了二次参与。该部署还产生了下游购买和GMV影响，证明了AI产品研究代理在主动吸引客户和端到端客户旅程优化方面的实际有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的框架，通过AI驱动的产品研究代理整合了电子商务平台的搜索和CRM系统，旨在主动重新吸引那些在探索性购买过程中离开平台的客户。该框架利用用户行为、外部知识和产品目录数据，通过WhatsApp提供个性化推荐，并在实际生产环境中取得了显著的点击率提升和商业价值。
AI.keywords: AI产品研究代理,客户再互动,搜索与CRM整合,个性化推荐,电子商务
AI.comments: 该研究有效地解决了电子商务中客户流失和再参与的挑战，通过整合搜索和CRM数据，并利用AI代理进行个性化推荐，展示了在实际生产环境中的有效性。然而，关于代理研究的“可信度”以及如何处理潜在的隐私问题可以进一步探讨。

title: Zero-Shot SAM2 Segmentation and Vision Transformer-Based Recognition of Elamite Cuneiform Symbols from Degraded Tablet Images
summary: Automated recognition of ancient cuneiform script poses a compound signal-degradation problem: the three-dimensional relief of clay tablets creates spatially varying illumination and cast shadows, surface erosion introduces structured noise that overlaps with genuine sign impressions, and severe class imbalance across 141 sign categories undermines classifier reliability. We introduce EpigraphNet, a segmentation-guided transformer pipeline evaluated on the Persepolis Fortification Archive. From 1,239 annotated tablet images, brightness-adaptive morphological preprocessing and zero-shot SAM2-Large segmentation generate clean binary symbol masks, which a fine-tuned Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16) with inverse-frequency class weighting then classifies. EpigraphNet reaches 86.41% top-1 accuracy on a 132-class benchmark, a 17.21 percentage-point gain over the strongest CNN baseline (ResNet-101, 69.20%) and 5.31-12.91% over four modern backbones (DeiT-B/16, Swin-B, ConvNeXt-B, EfficientNet-B4) under identical conditions. The full pipeline runs at approximately 18 ms per sign on an NVIDIA A100 GPU. A lower Spearman correlation between sign frequency and per-class performance indicates more balanced recognition across frequent and rare classes. Implementation is available at: github.com/r11up/sam-guided-vit

AI.title_translation: 零样本SAM2分割和基于视觉Transformer的降级泥板图像埃兰楔形文字符号识别
AI.tldr: 本文提出EpigraphNet，一个结合零样本SAM2分割和视觉Transformer的管道，用于从降级泥板图像中自动识别埃兰楔形文字，显著提高了识别准确率并解决了类不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 自动识别古代楔形文字面临复合信号降级问题，包括三维浮雕造成的光照和阴影变化、表面侵蚀引入的结构噪声以及141个字符类别间的严重类不平衡，这些都影响了分类器的可靠性。
AI.method: 本文引入EpigraphNet管道，该管道首先对1,239张带注释的泥板图像进行亮度自适应形态学预处理，然后使用零样本SAM2-Large进行分割以生成干净的二值符号掩码。最后，一个经过微调的Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16) 结合逆频率类别加权对符号进行分类。
AI.result: EpigraphNet在132个类别的基准测试中达到了86.41%的top-1准确率，比最强的CNN基线（ResNet-101）提高了17.21个百分点，比四种现代骨干网络（DeiT-B/16, Swin-B, ConvNeXt-B, EfficientNet-B4）提高了5.31-12.91%。整个管道在NVIDIA A100 GPU上每个符号运行约18毫秒。符号频率与每类性能之间较低的Spearman相关性表明对常见和稀有类别的识别更加平衡。
AI.conclusion: EpigraphNet通过结合零样本SAM2分割和视觉Transformer，显著提高了对降级泥板图像中埃兰楔形文字符号的自动识别准确率，并有效解决了信号降级和类不平衡的挑战，实现了对常见和稀有字符的更均衡识别。
AI.translation: 自动识别古代楔形文字面临复合信号降级问题：泥板的三维浮雕产生空间变化的光照和投射阴影，表面侵蚀引入与真实符号印记重叠的结构噪声，以及141个符号类别之间严重的类不平衡问题，这些都损害了分类器的可靠性。我们引入了EpigraphNet，这是一个在波斯波利斯防御工事档案上进行评估的分割引导型Transformer管道。从1,239张带注释的泥板图像中，亮度自适应形态学预处理和零样本SAM2-Large分割生成干净的二值符号掩码，然后一个经过逆频率类别加权微调的视觉Transformer (ViT-B/16) 对其进行分类。EpigraphNet在132个类别的基准测试中达到了86.41%的top-1准确率，比最强的CNN基线（ResNet-101，69.20%）提高了17.21个百分点，在相同条件下比四种现代骨干网络（DeiT-B/16, Swin-B, ConvNeXt-B, EfficientNet-B4）提高了5.31-12.91%。整个管道在NVIDIA A100 GPU上每个符号运行大约18毫秒。符号频率与每类性能之间较低的Spearman相关性表明对常见和稀有类别的识别更加平衡。实现代码可在以下网址获取：github.com/r11up/sam-guided-vit
AI.summary: 本文针对古代楔形文字识别中的信号降级和类不平衡问题，提出了一种名为EpigraphNet的分割引导型Transformer管道。该管道结合了零样本SAM2-Large分割和微调的Vision Transformer，并在埃兰楔形文字数据集上取得了显著优于传统CNN和现代骨干网络的识别准确率，同时实现了对稀有类别的平衡识别。
AI.keywords: 楔形文字识别, 零样本分割, Vision Transformer, SAM2, 埃兰文字
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过结合最新的零样本分割模型SAM2和强大的Vision Transformer架构，有效地解决了古代楔形文字识别中长期存在的图像降级和类别不平衡两大难题。其创新点在于将分割作为识别的前置步骤，并通过零样本能力减少了对大量标注数据的依赖，同时ViT的强大特征提取能力和逆频率加权策略解决了类不平衡问题。在准确率上相比现有方法有显著提升，且运行效率较高，对数字人文和文化遗产保护领域具有重要意义。

title: Shared Circuits for Shared Grammar: Tracing Subject-Verb Agreement Across Languages
comments: 25 pages including appendices, 16 figures. Accepted to COLM 2026
summary: Multilingual large language models often generalize across languages, and prior work suggests that their internal mechanisms can overlap cross-lingually. It remains unclear, however, when such sharing emerges and whether it varies with the overt realization of the same grammatical operation. We investigate this question for present-tense subject-verb agreement, a morphosyntactic process that varies substantially across languages and is only weakly expressed in English. Using activation patching and attention analysis across 29 languages and five open-source model families, we identify the attention heads causally implicated in agreement and compare these head-level signatures across languages. We find that languages with overt person/number inflection exhibit more similar agreement circuitry than non-conjugating languages, with the strongest sharing appearing when the analysis isolates recovery of the inflectional contrast itself. English provides an informative bridge case, becoming more similar to conjugating languages precisely in contexts where overt agreement is required. Finally, many implicated heads display similar attention patterns across languages, suggesting that cross-lingual overlap reflects shared functional roles as well as shared localization. Together, these results indicate that multilingual LLMs reuse partially shared computational structure for morphosyntactic agreement rather than relying on fully separate language-specific solutions.
comment: 25 pages including appendices, 16 figures. Accepted to COLM 2026

AI.title_translation: 共享电路，共享语法：跨语言追踪主谓一致性
AI.tldr: 研究表明，多语言大语言模型在处理主谓一致性时，会跨语言共享部分计算结构，尤其是在语法特征更明显的语言之间，这种共享性更强。
AI.motivation: 探究多语言大语言模型在处理主谓一致性这一跨语言差异显著的语法现象时，其内部机制何时以及如何发生跨语言共享，以及这种共享是否与语法操作的显性程度有关。
AI.method: 使用激活修复（activation patching）和注意力分析（attention analysis）技术，在29种语言和5个开源模型家族中，识别出与主谓一致性相关的注意力头，并比较这些注意力头在不同语言中的模式。
AI.result: 研究发现，具有明显人称/数格屈折变化的语言比不进行屈折变化的语言在句法一致性方面表现出更相似的电路结构，尤其是在分离屈折变化本身恢复的分析中，共享性最强。英语作为一种桥接案例，在需要显性一致性的语境下，其相似性会增强。许多相关的注意力头在不同语言中表现出相似的注意力模式，表明跨语言共享不仅体现在位置上，也体现在功能角色上。
AI.conclusion: 多语言大语言模型在处理形态句法一致性时，倾向于重用部分共享的计算结构，而非完全依赖于特定语言的独立解决方案。
AI.translation: 多语言大型语言模型通常会跨语言泛化，并且先前的工作表明它们的内部机制可能在跨语言之间存在重叠。然而，目前尚不清楚这种共享何时出现，以及它是否会随着相同语法操作的显性实现而变化。我们针对现在时态的主谓一致性这一跨语言差异显著且在英语中表达较弱的形态句法过程进行了研究。我们使用激活修复和注意力分析技术，在29种语言和5个开源模型家族中，识别出与主谓一致性相关的注意力头，并比较这些注意力头在不同语言中的模式。我们发现，具有明显人称/数格屈折变化的语言比不进行屈折变化的语言在句法一致性方面表现出更相似的电路结构，尤其是在分离屈折变化本身恢复的分析中，共享性最强。英语提供了一个有信息量的桥接案例，在需要显性一致性的语境下，其相似性会增强。最后，许多相关的注意力头在不同语言中表现出相似的注意力模式，表明跨语言共享不仅体现在位置上，也体现在功能角色上。总的来说，这些结果表明，多语言大型语言模型在处理形态句法一致性时，重用了部分共享的计算结构，而不是依赖于完全独立的特定语言解决方案。
AI.summary: 本研究利用激活修复和注意力分析技术，在29种语言和5个模型家族中，探究了多语言大语言模型在处理主谓一致性时的跨语言共享机制。研究发现，具有明显屈折变化的语言比不进行屈折变化的语言在主谓一致性方面共享更相似的内部计算结构，英语在需要显性一致性时表现出更强的共享性。这表明多语言模型在处理形态句法一致性时，会重用部分共享的计算结构，而非完全独立的语言特定解决方案。
AI.keywords: 主谓一致性,多语言模型,跨语言共享,激活修复,注意力分析
AI.comments: 这项研究巧妙地结合了激活修复和注意力分析，为理解多语言模型内部的跨语言泛化机制提供了新的视角。研究结果不仅揭示了主谓一致性这一特定语法现象的共享模式，还为通用语言模型的设计和优化提供了有价值的见解。然而，研究的局限性可能在于模型数量和语言种类的选择，未来可以扩展到更多样化的模型和语言，以进一步验证结论的普适性。

title: MARCUS: Missing-Aware Region Representation with Contextual Urban Signals for Rent Prediction
comments: 10 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026)
summary: Multimodal urban data has expanded the applications of urban region representation learning, such as functional zone identification and real estate appraisal, but also introduces challenges caused by data incompleteness. Existing studies usually handle missing data through imputation, treating missingness as noise while ignoring its potential semantic value. To address this issue, we propose MARCUS, a missing-aware region representation model that treats missingness as a contextual urban signal. MARCUS models missingness in three stages: Intra Learning jointly encodes observed features and missing patterns, Inter Learning estimates modality reliability to guide cross-modal interaction, and Fusion uses missing-aware and time-aware gating to generate the final region embedding. We apply MARCUS to rent prediction, a task with long-term trends and seasonal fluctuations, using real-world datasets from Sydney and New York. Experimental results show that MARCUS achieves state-of-the-art performance, reducing MAE by 51.35% on Sydney and 12.62% on New York compared with the best baselines. Additional experiments, including an imputation-based ablation study and randomized additional-missingness analysis, further demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026)

AI.title_translation: MARCUS：具有上下文城市信号的缺失感知区域表示用于租金预测
AI.tldr: MARCUS是一种新的区域表示模型，它将缺失数据视为一种有意义的信号，而不是噪声，并通过三阶段方法（包括显式建模缺失模式和跨模态交互）来处理缺失数据，在租金预测任务上取得了最先进的成果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过插补来处理城市区域表示学习中的数据不完整性问题，但忽略了缺失值的潜在语义价值。MARCUS旨在将缺失值视为上下文城市信号来解决这个问题。
AI.method: MARCUS通过三个阶段对缺失值进行建模：1. Intra Learning：联合编码观测到的特征和缺失模式；2. Inter Learning：估计模态可靠性以指导跨模态交互；3. Fusion：使用感知缺失和感知时间的门控来生成最终的区域嵌入。
AI.result: MARCUS在悉尼和纽约的真实世界数据集上进行了租金预测任务的评估，与最佳基线相比，在悉尼数据集上将MAE降低了51.35%，在纽约数据集上降低了12.62%，取得了最先进的性能。消融研究进一步证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MARCUS通过将缺失值视为一种有意义的信号，并采用多阶段方法来处理缺失值，从而在租金预测任务上取得了最先进的性能，证明了其在处理不完整多模态城市数据方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 多模态城市数据扩展了城市区域表示学习的应用，例如功能区识别和房地产评估，但也带来了数据不完整性带来的挑战。现有研究通常通过插补来处理缺失数据，将缺失视为噪声，而忽略其潜在的语义价值。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MARCUS，一种缺失感知的区域表示模型，它将缺失视为一种上下文城市信号。MARCUS分三个阶段对缺失值进行建模：Intra Learning联合编码观测到的特征和缺失模式，Inter Learning估计模态可靠性以指导跨模态交互，Fusion使用缺失感知和时间感知门控来生成最终的区域嵌入。我们将MARCUS应用于租金预测，这是一个具有长期趋势和季节性波动的任务，使用了来自悉尼和纽约的真实世界数据集。实验结果表明，MARCUS取得了最先进的性能，与最佳基线相比，在悉尼数据集上将MAE降低了51.35%，在纽约数据集上降低了12.62%。额外的实验，包括基于插补的消融研究和随机的附加缺失分析，进一步证明了所提出方法的有效性。
AI.summary: MARCUS是一种新颖的区域表示模型，它将缺失数据视为一种有意义的上下文城市信号，而不是简单地将其视为噪声进行插补。该模型通过三个阶段（Intra Learning、Inter Learning和Fusion）来处理缺失数据，这些阶段分别关注观测特征和缺失模式的联合编码、模态可靠性的估计以及最终区域嵌入的生成。在租金预测任务上的实验表明，MARCUS在悉尼和纽约的数据集上均取得了显著优于现有基线的最先进性能。
AI.keywords: 区域表示学习, 缺失数据, 上下文信号, 租金预测, 多模态学习
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来处理城市区域表示学习中的数据缺失问题，将缺失值视为有用的信号，而不是将其视为噪声。MARCUS模型的三阶段设计，特别是其对缺失模式和模态可靠性的显式建模，为解决不完整多模态数据问题提供了一个有前景的框架。然而，该方法在处理不同类型缺失模式（例如，完全随机缺失与非完全随机缺失）方面的泛化能力以及其在其他城市计算任务上的适用性有待进一步研究。

title: Measuring Proof Burden in Public Bounty Listings: A RentAHuman Case Study
comments: Accepted at ACM HCOMP 2026 (2026 ACM Conference on Human-AI Complementarity and Alignment), September 27-30, 2026, Alexandria, VA, USA. 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Camera-ready version; published version DOI: 10.1145/3834580.3838744
summary:
Online bounty markets let requesters advertise paid tasks. Workers may be asked not just to complete a task but to prove it, and proof can mean exposure: revealing identity or location, using a personal account, posting publicly, acting in the physical world, or repeated evidence at later checks, none disclosed by the posted price. We call these advertised requirements proof burden and measure them on RentAHuman, a 2026 market publicized as a place for AI agents to hire humans. We study what listings request, not what workers submit or experience.
  We manually audited a nonrandom May 31, 2026 snapshot: every listing our searches returned from RentAHuman and Human Pages, another such market (981 listings, all but one from RentAHuman). Two independent coders recorded 13 features (11 kinds of evidence, recurring monitoring, physical-world action) and our 0-5 Proof Burden Score; a blinded third resolved all disagreements. A planned content screen leaves 779 bounty/task listings as the primary population; 438 (56.2%) score 4 or 5, spanning 154 distinct feature combinations: a checklist, not a single score, tells workers what a listing entails.
  Platform metadata labels some requester accounts as agents or bots. Exploratory comparisons show physical-world action, location proof, or recurring monitoring in 75.0% of agent-or-bot-labeled versus 55.3% of human-labeled listings, though score-4-or-5 shares did not clearly differ. The labels are self-reported or platform-assigned, the agent-or-bot-labeled listings come from only 20 displayed names, and the comparison was chosen post hoc, after seeing the data: a hypothesis, not a confirmed difference. We contribute the 13-requirement vocabulary, the adjudicated manual audit, and this descriptive case study; the score is a secondary screening summary. The study offers no worker-validated measure or automated detector yet.

AI.title_translation: 衡量公共赏金列表中的证明负担：一个RentAHuman案例研究
AI.tldr: 该研究分析了RentAHuman平台上的赏金任务，发现许多任务要求提供身份、位置或公开活动等证明，而这些成本并未在任务标价中体现。研究提出了一个衡量“证明负担”的评分系统，并发现由AI代理或机器人发布的任务比人类发布的任务更倾向于要求提供证明。
AI.motivation: 在线赏金市场上的任务价格并未完全反映完成任务所需的证明成本，如身份暴露、位置公开或物理世界活动等，这可能误导工人。本研究旨在量化这些“证明负担”，并探索其在特定平台上的分布情况。
AI.method: 研究人员手动审核了RentAHuman和Human Pages两个在线赏金市场在2026年5月31日的一个快照，共计981个列表。他们记录了13个特征，包括11种证据类型、重复监控和物理世界活动，并根据这些特征计算了一个0-5分的“证明负担分数”。最终，有779个列表被纳入主要分析范围。此外，研究还对比了平台标记为“代理或机器人”的请求者与“人类”请求者的任务特征。
AI.result: 在779个任务列表中，有56.2%的任务（438个）的证明负担分数达到4或5分。研究发现了154种不同的证明特征组合，表明任务的具体要求多样。初步分析显示，标记为“代理或机器人”的请求者发布的任务比标记为“人类”的请求者发布任务更可能包含物理世界活动、位置证明或重复监控的要求（分别为75.0% 对比 55.3%），尽管高证明负担分数的比例差异不明显。该研究贡献了一个包含13个要素的证明要求词汇表、一个手动审计流程和一个描述性案例研究。
AI.conclusion: 在线赏金市场，如RentAHuman，存在显著的“证明负担”，即任务价格未能充分反映工人需要提供的身份证明、位置公开、物理世界活动等额外要求。虽然研究提出了衡量这些负担的方法和词汇表，但目前尚未提供工人验证的衡量标准或自动化检测工具。AI代理或机器人发布的任务可能比人类发布的任务包含更多此类证明要求。
AI.translation: 在线赏金市场允许发布者发布有报酬的任务。工人不仅可能被要求完成任务，还需要提供证明，而证明可能意味着身份或位置的暴露、使用个人账户、公开帖子、在物理世界中活动或在后续检查中反复提供证据，这些成本在标价中均未披露。我们将这些广告中要求的证明称为“证明负担”，并在RentAHuman（一个声称是人工智能代理雇佣人类的市场）上进行衡量。我们研究的是列表的发布内容，而不是工人提交的内容或经历。我们手动审计了2026年5月31日的一个非随机快照：我们从RentAHuman和Human Pages（另一个类似市场）搜索到的每一个列表（共981个列表，除一个外均来自RentAHuman）。两位独立编码员记录了13个特征（11种证据类型、重复监控、物理世界活动）以及我们的0-5分证明负担分数；一位盲评的第三方解决了所有分歧。计划的内容筛选后，将779个赏金/任务列表作为主要分析群体；其中438个（56.2%）得分为4或5分，涵盖了154种不同的特征组合：一个清单，而不是一个单一的分数，告诉工人列表的要求。平台元数据将一些发布者账户标记为代理或机器人。探索性比较显示，在标记为代理或机器人的列表中，包含物理世界活动、位置证明或重复监控的比例为75.0%，而在标记为人类的列表中为55.3%，尽管4或5分的分数比例没有明显差异。这些标签是自我报告或平台分配的，标记为代理或机器人的列表仅来自20个显示名称，并且该比较是在看到数据后才选择的事后分析：这是一个假设，而不是一个已确认的差异。我们贡献了13个要求的词汇表、经过裁决的手动审计以及这个描述性的案例研究；该分数是一个次要的筛选摘要。该研究目前不提供工人验证的衡量标准或自动化检测器。
AI.summary: 本研究对在线赏金市场RentAHuman上的任务列表进行了“证明负担”分析。研究发现，许多任务除了标价外，还隐含要求工人提供各种形式的证明，如身份暴露、位置公开或物理世界活动，而这些成本未在标价中体现。研究开发了一个衡量证明负担的评分系统和词汇表，并通过手动审计发现，大部分任务的证明负担较高。初步分析还表明，由AI代理或机器人发布的任务可能比人类发布的任务包含更多此类证明要求。
AI.keywords: 证明负担,在线赏金市场,RentAHuman,AI代理,任务审核
AI.comments: 这项研究首次量化了在线赏金市场中“证明负担”的普遍性，并提出了一个实用的评估框架。然而，研究的局限性在于其手动审计方法和非随机抽样，以及未能提供工人验证的衡量标准或自动化检测工具，这限制了其结果的普遍性和实际应用。未来的研究可以探索自动化检测方法，并纳入工人的实际经验和反馈，以更全面地评估和解决证明负担问题。

title: Symmetry of Solutions and Domain-Reduction Finite Element Method for Second-Order Linear Elliptic Dirichlet Boundary Value Problems on Bounded Domains
summary:
Combining classical group theory and partial differential equation theory, this paper investigates the symmetry group $\operatorname{Sym}(u)$ of the unique solution $u$ to the second-order linear elliptic boundary value problem on an $n$-dimensional bounded domain $Ω$
  $-\sum_{i,j=1}^{n} a_{ij}(x)u_{x_ix_j} + \sum_{i=1}^{n} b_i(x)u_{x_i} + c(x)u = f(x), x\in Ω$,
  $u(x) = h(x), x\in \partial Ω$,
  The following symmetry groups are defined and characterized respectively: the symmetry group $\operatorname{Sym}(A)$ of the second-order coefficient matrix function $A(x)=(a_{ij}(x))_{n\times n}$; the symmetry group $\operatorname{Sym}(b)$ of the first-order coefficient column vector function $b(x)=(b_{1}(x),b_{2}(x),\cdots,b_{n}(x))^{T}$; the symmetry group $\operatorname{Sym}(c)$ of the zero-order coefficient function $c(x)$; the symmetry group $\operatorname{Sym}(f)$ of the internal source function $f(x)$; and the symmetry group $\operatorname{Sym}(h)$ of the boundary source function $h(x)$. This paper rigorously proves that the common symmetry group $\operatorname{Sym}(A)\cap\operatorname{Sym}(b) \cap\operatorname{Sym}(c) \cap\operatorname{Sym}(f) \cap\operatorname{Sym}(h)$ is a subgroup of $\operatorname{Sym}(u)$. In addition, if the common symmetry group contains several mirror symmetry elements, the original second-order linear elliptic boundary value problem on the entire domain $Ω$ can be reduced to the corresponding boundary value problem on a certain subdomain. It is strictly proven in this paper that the new boundary condition imposed on the boundary of the subdomain is the homogeneous generalized Neumann boundary condition. The linear finite element method is used to numerically solve the second-order linear elliptic boundary value problem on the subdomain, thereby achieving domain reduction and significantly reducing the computational cost.

AI.title_translation: 二阶线性椭圆Dirichlet边值问题解的对称性与区域缩减有限元方法
AI.tldr: 本文结合群论和偏微分方程理论，证明了二阶线性椭圆边值问题系数和源项的共同对称群是解的对称群的子群，并基于此提出了一种区域缩减有限元方法，可显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 降低求解二阶线性椭圆Dirichlet边值问题的计算成本。
AI.method: 结合经典群论和偏微分方程理论，定义并刻画了二阶线性椭圆边值问题中系数矩阵、一阶系数向量、零阶系数函数、内部源函数和边界源函数的对称群。严格证明了这些共同对称群是解的对称群的子群。进一步，如果共同对称群包含镜面对称元素，则将原问题从整个区域缩减到子区域，并严格证明了子区域边界上的新边界条件是齐次广义Neumann边界条件。最后，使用线性有限元方法在子区域上进行数值求解。
AI.result: 严格证明了二阶线性椭圆边值问题中所有系数和源项的共同对称群是其唯一解的对称群的子群。当共同对称群包含镜面对称元素时，可以将原问题从整个区域缩减到某个子区域，且子区域边界上的新边界条件是齐次广义Neumann边界条件。这种方法通过区域缩减显著降低了计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用问题的对称性，可以将二阶线性椭圆Dirichlet边值问题在整个区域上的求解转化为在缩减子区域上的求解，从而显著降低计算成本，提高计算效率。
AI.translation:
结合经典群论和偏微分方程理论，本文研究了n维有界区域Ω上二阶线性椭圆边值问题唯一解u的对称群$\operatorname{Sym}(u)$。
该问题为：
$-\sum_{i,j=1}^{n} a_{ij}(x)u_{x_ix_j} + \sum_{i=1}^{n} b_i(x)u_{x_i} + c(x)u = f(x), x\in Ω$，
$u(x) = h(x), x\in \partial Ω$。
本文分别定义并刻画了以下对称群：二阶系数矩阵函数$A(x)=(a_{ij}(x))_{n\times n}$的对称群$\operatorname{Sym}(A)$；一阶系数列向量函数$b(x)=(b_{1}(x),b_{2}(x),\cdots,b_{n}(x))^{T}$的对称群$\operatorname{Sym}(b)$；零阶系数函数$c(x)$的对称群$\operatorname{Sym}(c)$；内部源函数$f(x)$的对称群$\operatorname{Sym}(f)$；以及边界源函数$h(x)$的对称群$\operatorname{Sym}(h)$。本文严格证明了共同对称群$\operatorname{Sym}(A)\cap\operatorname{Sym}(b) \cap\operatorname{Sym}(c) \cap\operatorname{Sym}(f) \cap\operatorname{Sym}(h)$是$\operatorname{Sym}(u)$的子群。此外，如果共同对称群包含若干镜面对称元素，则整个区域Ω上的原始二阶线性椭圆边值问题可以缩减为某个子区域上的相应边值问题。本文严格证明了施加在子区域边界上的新边界条件是齐次广义Neumann边界条件。线性有限元方法用于数值求解子区域上的二阶线性椭圆边值问题，从而实现区域缩减并显著降低计算成本。
AI.summary: 本文结合群论和偏微分方程理论，研究了二阶线性椭圆Dirichlet边值问题解的对称性。通过定义并证明了方程系数和源项的共同对称群是解的对称群的子群，该研究提出了一种区域缩减有限元方法。当存在镜面对称时，可以将原问题从整个区域缩减到子区域，并推导出新的齐次广义Neumann边界条件。该方法利用线性有限元在子区域上求解，旨在显著降低计算成本。
AI.keywords: 对称性, 区域缩减, 有限元方法, 椭圆边值问题, 群论
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将经典群论与偏微分方程理论相结合，为二阶线性椭圆边值问题的求解提供了一种利用对称性进行区域缩减的新方法。它不仅从理论上严格证明了共同对称群与解的对称群之间的关系，还提出了具体的区域缩减策略和相应的边界条件处理，并指出其在降低计算成本方面的显著优势。这种理论与实际应用相结合的研究，对于解决大规模计算问题具有重要意义。

title: Real-Time Control-Constrained DDP for Underactuated Balancing of Legged Robots
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: This paper presents a real-time control-constrained Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP) framework for underactuated legged robots. To address the limitation of classical DDP in handling control constraints, we propose an Accelerated Projected Gradient (APG)-based control-constrained DDP (ABC-DDP), which efficiently computes constrained solutions and identifies active sets without repeated Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) inversions. A virtual constraint is introduced to integrate control constraints within a feasibility-driven multiple-shooting framework, enabling stable optimization even from dynamically infeasible initializations. The proposed method supports real-time model predictive control (MPC) with short horizons under strong underactuation. Simulation results demonstrate static two-leg standing under external disturbances, along with diverse dynamic motions including slow catwalk, upright walking, and high-speed running within a unified MPC framework. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of static two-leg standing of a quadruped robot achieved using real-time finite-horizon MPC.

AI.title_translation: 欠驱动腿足机器人实时控制约束DDP平衡控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于加速投影梯度（APG）的控制约束DDP（ABC-DDP）框架，用于欠驱动腿足机器人的实时平衡控制。该方法通过引入虚拟约束和多重射击框架，有效处理控制约束，实现从动态不可行初始化的稳定优化，并在统一的MPC框架下展示了静态双腿站立和多种动态运动。
AI.motivation: 解决经典DDP在处理控制约束方面的局限性，并为欠驱动腿足机器人提供实时、稳定的平衡控制。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种加速投影梯度（APG）的控制约束DDP（ABC-DDP）方法。该方法通过APG高效计算约束解并识别活跃集，避免重复的KKT逆运算。同时，引入虚拟约束，将控制约束集成到可行性驱动的多重射击框架中，即使从动态不可行初始化也能实现稳定优化。
AI.result: 模拟结果展示了在外部扰动下的静态双腿站立，以及在统一MPC框架下的多种动态运动，包括慢走、直立行走和高速奔跑。这是首次通过实时有限视界MPC实现四足机器人静态双腿站立的演示。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的ABC-DDP框架成功地为欠驱动腿足机器人实现了实时、稳定的控制约束平衡控制，并在模拟中首次展示了四足机器人的静态双腿站立。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于欠驱动腿足机器人的实时控制约束差分动态规划（DDP）框架。为了解决经典DDP在处理控制约束方面的局限性，我们提出了一种基于加速投影梯度（APG）的控制约束DDP（ABC-DDP），它能高效计算约束解并识别活跃集，而无需重复进行Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）逆运算。通过引入虚拟约束，将控制约束集成到可行性驱动的多重射击框架中，即使从动态不可行初始化也能实现稳定的优化。所提出的方法支持在强欠驱动下，使用短视界的实时模型预测控制（MPC）。仿真结果展示了在外部扰动下的静态双腿站立，以及在统一MPC框架下的多种动态运动，包括慢走、直立行走和高速奔跑。据我们所知，这是首次通过实时有限视界MPC实现四足机器人静态双腿站立的演示。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为ABC-DDP的实时控制约束差分动态规划框架，旨在解决欠驱动腿足机器人的平衡控制问题。该方法通过结合加速投影梯度和虚拟约束，有效处理控制约束并实现稳定的优化，即使从不可行初始状态也能启动。该框架支持实时模型预测控制，并在模拟中成功展示了静态双腿站立以及多种动态步态，首次实现了四足机器人的实时MPC静态双腿站立。
AI.keywords: DDP, 欠驱动机器人, 控制约束, 模型预测控制, 腿足机器人
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了ABC-DDP框架，通过APG和虚拟约束有效地解决了经典DDP在处理控制约束方面的不足，并实现了从动态不可行初始化的稳定优化。其重要性体现在首次通过实时有限视界MPC实现了四足机器人的静态双腿站立，这对于欠驱动腿足机器人的实际应用具有重要意义。

title: Exact Robust Instability Analysis for Networked Dynamical Systems with Biological Application
summary: This paper investigates robust instability in nominally unstable uncertain networked dynamical systems, where all nominal agents share an identical single-input-single-output (SISO) linear time-invariant (LTI) system and each agent is subject to independent perturbations. This setting is motivated by the problem of sustaining periodic oscillations in nonlinear dynamics, for which exact analysis is generally intractable. We identify three classes of network structures including cyclic and certain rank-deficient networks for which the robust instability problem can be reduced to the analysis of a single representative SISO system. We derive sufficient conditions that exactly characterize the robust instability radius for these network classes. Finally, we demonstrate the practical utility of the proposed results by analyzing oscillatory behavior in a genetic regulatory network.

AI.title_translation: 具有生物学应用的网联动力系统精确鲁棒不稳定性分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种精确分析网联动力系统鲁棒不稳定性半径的方法，成功将其简化为单个系统的分析，并应用于基因调控网络。
AI.motivation: 研究名义上不稳定但存在不确定性的网络化动力系统中的鲁棒不稳定性，以解决传统非线性动力学中维持周期振荡分析通常难以处理的问题。
AI.method: 识别了三种网络结构（包括循环网络和某些降秩网络），将鲁棒不稳定性问题简化为对单个代表性SISO系统的分析，并推导出了精确表征鲁棒不稳定性半径的充分条件。
AI.result: 推导出了能够精确表征特定网络类别的鲁棒不稳定性半径的充分条件，并成功将其应用于分析基因调控网络中的振荡行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别特定的网络结构（如循环和某些降秩网络），成功将复杂网络系统的鲁棒不稳定性精确分析转化为单一系统的分析，并用基因调控网络验证了其有效性。
AI.translation: 本文研究了名义上不稳定且具有不确定性的网络化动力系统中的鲁棒不稳定性，其中所有标称智能体共享相同的单输入单输出（SISO）线性时不变（LTI）系统，且每个智能体都受到独立扰动。这一设置的动机是解决非线性动力学中维持周期振荡的问题，该问题通常难以精确分析。我们确定了三类网络结构（包括循环网络和某些降秩网络），对于这些网络结构，鲁棒不稳定性问题可以简化为对单个代表性SISO系统的分析。我们推导出了精确表征这些网络类别的鲁棒不稳定性半径的充分条件。最后，我们通过分析基因调控网络中的振荡行为，展示了所提结果的实用价值。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具有独立扰动的名义不稳定网络化动力系统的鲁棒不稳定性。通过将特定网络结构（如循环网络和降秩网络）的鲁棒不稳定性问题简化为分析单个SISO系统，本文推导出了精确的充分条件，并通过基因调控网络展示了其实际应用价值。
AI.keywords: 鲁棒不稳定性, 网络化动力系统, 线性时不变系统, 周期振荡, 基因调控网络
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将网络化动力系统的鲁棒不稳定性分析简化为单个代表性SISO系统的分析，突破了传统非线性动力学中维持周期振荡分析的棘手难题，并在生物学领域的基因调控网络中得到了实际应用。

title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks
summary: Most LLM benchmarks rank models on their ability to automate work tasks. In practice, however, models are often used to assist other (human or LLM) agents. The question that drives model selection is therefore not only which model produces the best output, but which model most improves the work of another (weaker) agent. We introduce a unified framework that evaluates the capability of models to automate and augment another agent's performance. Across seven economically grounded real-world tasks, an assistant model writes assistance text for a standardized lower-capacity worker model, which produces the deliverable. In automation mode, the assistant produces the output directly. Outputs are scored through blind pairwise comparisons by an LLM judge panel with task-specific rubrics, replicated across ten runs. Rankings across the two regimes are only modestly correlated, and the automation winner loses augmentation on five of seven tasks. Assistance is not reliably positive. The unaided worker outranks every assisted condition on three tasks, and only one model's guidance beats no guidance on average. These results suggest that automation ability is an incomplete proxy for assistance quality, motivating benchmarks that evaluate models according to the roles they play in human-AI and multi-agent systems.

AI.title_translation: CentaurBench：基准测试大语言模型在增强与自动化真实世界工作任务上的能力
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了CentaurBench基准，发现大语言模型的自动化能力并不能很好地预测其作为辅助者的表现，许多在自动化上表现优秀的模型在辅助弱小代理时效果不佳甚至起负面作用。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM基准主要根据模型自动化工作任务的能力进行排名，但在实际中模型常用于辅助其他代理。因此，选择模型的关键问题不仅在于哪个模型产生最好的输出，还在于哪个模型最能改善另一个（较弱）代理的工作。
AI.method: 引入一个统一框架，在七个经济落地的实际任务中，让助手模型为标准化低能力的工作者模型编写辅助文本以生成最终成果；在自动化模式下，助手直接生成输出。通过LLM评判小组采用任务特定评分标准进行盲测两两比较，并跨十次运行进行复制。
AI.result: 两个体制下的排名仅呈中度相关；自动化赢家在七个任务中有五个任务的辅助表现落后；辅助作用并不稳定可靠，未受帮助的工作者在三个任务中排名甚至超过了所有受帮助的条件，且平均而言只有单一模型的指导优于无指导。
AI.conclusion: 自动化能力不能作为评估辅助质量的可靠代理，因此需要建立专门评估模型在人机及多智能体系统中角色表现的新基准。
AI.translation: 大多数大语言模型（LLM）基准根据模型自动化工作任务的能力对其进行排名。然而在实践中，模型经常被用于协助其他（人类或LLM）代理。因此，驱动模型选择的问题不仅是哪个模型产生最好的输出，还有哪个模型最能改善另一个（较弱）代理的工作。我们引入了一个统一框架，评估模型自动化和增强另一个代理性能的能力。在七个经济落地的实际任务中，助手模型为标准化的低能力工作者模型编写辅助文本，由其产出交付成果。在自动化模式下，助手直接产生输出。输出通过由LLM评判小组使用特定任务评分标准进行的盲测两两比较进行评分，并在十次运行中进行复制。两种体制下的排名仅呈中度相关，且自动化赢家在七个任务中有五个任务的辅助表现失利。辅助作用并非稳健地呈正向。未受辅助的工作者在三个任务中的排名超过了所有受辅助条件，且平均而言只有单一模型的指导优于无指导。这些结果表明，自动化能力是辅助质量的一个不完全代理，这激励了根据模型在人机和多智能体系统中扮演的角色来评估模型的基准测试。
AI.summary: CentaurBench是一个旨在评估大语言模型在自动化与辅助真实世界工作任务方面能力的统一基准。研究发现，模型的自动化能力与辅助能力之间关联较弱，且强模型的辅助效果并不稳定，这表明现有的自动化基准无法全面反映模型在人机或多智能体系统中的实际价值。
AI.keywords: CentaurBench, 大语言模型, 工作任务, 自动化, 辅助能力
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了区分大模型“自动化”与“辅助”能力的基准测试CentaurBench，揭示了强模型作为辅助者的效果并不等同于其直接生成的能力，对未来人机协作和多智能体系统的研究具有重要启发意义。

title: Performance Drift Detection in Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) for IoT Environments
summary: Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) is a powerful cloud paradigm enabling data-driven intelligent applications in Internet of Things (IoT) environments, widely adopted across healthcare, smart homes, and industry due to its cost-effectiveness. However, the dynamic nature of IoT frequently alters data distributions, affecting MLaaS stability, while periodic MLaaS updates further introduce performance drift. Unlike traditional ML systems, MLaaS clients operate as black-box users without access to internal data or parameters, making drift detection particularly challenging. To address this, we propose a novel MLaaS Performance Drift Detection framework for IoT environments. The framework first employs an MLaaS extraction model that learns service behavior from input-output pairs and identifies prediction-influenced features. Building on this, the proposed MLaaS Performance Drift Detection (MPDD) model jointly captures variations in input data and MLaaS behavior. We further design an Adaptive-Temporal Performance Drift Detection Mechanism (APDDM) that dynamically adjusts monitoring frequency based on behavioral and data variations, enabling timely drift detection for effective service management. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that MPDD achieves up to 22-25% accuracy improvement over baseline drift detection methods. APDDM provides an average accuracy gain of approximately 4% and reduces the miss detection rate by around 9% compared to fixed-interval monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 面向物联网环境中机器学习即服务（MLaaS）的性能漂移检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的框架，用于解决物联网环境中黑盒MLaaS的性能漂移检测问题，显著提高了检测准确率并降低了漏检率。
AI.motivation: 物联网环境的动态性导致数据分布频繁变化，加之MLaaS的定期更新会引发性能漂移；而MLaaS客户端作为黑盒用户无法访问内部数据和参数，使得传统的漂移检测方法面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种面向IoT环境的MLaaS性能漂移检测框架，包含三个核心部分：1）利用输入输出对学习服务行为并识别特征的MLaaS提取模型；2）联合捕获输入数据和MLaaS行为变化的MPDD模型；3）根据行为和数据变化动态调整监控频率的自适应时间性能漂移检测机制（APDDM）。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，与基线方法相比，MPDD的准确率提升了22-25%；与固定间隔监控相比，APDDM的准确率平均提升了约4%，并将漏检率降低了约9%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的MPDD框架和APDDM机制能够有效解决IoT环境中黑盒MLaaS的性能漂移问题，在保证检测精度的同时减少了漏检率。
AI.translation: 机器学习即服务（MLaaS）是一种强大的云计算范式，由于其成本效益，在医疗保健、智能家居和工业等物联网（IoT）环境中被广泛采用，以实现数据驱动的智能应用。然而，IoT的动态特性经常改变数据分布，影响MLaaS的稳定性，而定期的MLaaS更新进一步引入了性能漂移。与传统的ML系统不同，MLaaS客户端作为黑盒用户运行，无法访问内部数据或参数，这使得漂移检测特别具有挑战性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种面向IoT环境的新型MLaaS性能漂移检测框架。该框架首先采用MLaaS提取模型，从输入-输出对中学习服务行为并识别受预测影响的特征。在此基础上，所提出的MLaaS性能漂移检测（MPDD）模型联合捕获输入数据和MLaaS行为的变化。我们进一步设计了一种自适应-时间性能漂移检测机制（APDDM），根据行为和数据变化动态调整监控频率，从而实现及时的漂移检测以进行有效的服务管理。在真实数据集上的大量实验表明，与基线漂移检测方法相比，MPDD的准确率提高了22-25%。与固定间隔监控相比，APDDM提供了约4%的平均准确率增益，并将漏检率降低了约9%。
AI.summary: 该论文针对物联网环境中黑盒机器学习即服务（MLaaS）的性能漂移检测难题，提出了一种新颖的检测框架。该框架通过行为学习模型、联合漂移检测模型（MPDD）以及自适应时间监控机制（APDDM），在真实数据集上显著提高了检测准确率并降低了漏检率。
AI.keywords: Machine Learning as a Service, Internet of Things, Performance Drift Detection, Adaptive-Temporal Mechanism, Black-box Users
AI.comments: 该论文针对IoT环境中黑盒MLaaS的性能漂移检测这一关键痛点，创新性地结合了输入输出行为学习与自适应时间监控机制，具有很高的实用价值和显著的性能提升。

title: MorphoGP: A Nonparametric Framework for Predicting Equilibrium Beach Profiles Under Tidal Influence
summary: The prediction of equilibrium beach profiles under tidal influence is of fundamental importance for sustainable coastal development, informing shoreline protection strategies and managing coastal ecosystems under changing environmental conditions. However, it remains challenging due to the highly nonlinear interactions among wave, tide, and sedimentary processes. Traditional empirical and numerical models often exhibit limited adaptability across diverse coastal environments, with especially pronounced limitations in beach systems where tidal processes are important . To improve data-driven prediction under these conditions, this study proposes MorphoGP, a unified category-specific Gaussian process framework for predicting equilibrium beach profiles (EBPs) under tidal influence. The framework first introduces a ContourCluster model based on contrastive learning to classify tide-influenced beach morphologies automatically. Within each morphological category, a specialized Gaussian process expert learns statistical associations between environmental descriptors including waves, tides, and sediments and the beach profile's shape. A Gating Net then integrates the outputs of all experts through a probabilistic weighting mechanism to produce the final prediction. Evaluated on data from over 180 beach profiles from tide-influenced coasts along the Chinese coast, MorphoGP achieves improved predictive performance compared with conventional and deep learning models, reducing the test RMSE by about 59.3\% compared with the best baseline and achieving a final RMSE of 0.297 m. The proposed framework provides a physically informed, data-driven tool for equilibrium beach-profile prediction under tidal influence and coastal management, while stronger process-level physical coupling remains an important direction for future development.

AI.title_translation: 考虑潮汐影响的非参数平衡海滩剖面预测框架
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了MorphoGP，一个结合对比学习和高斯过程的框架，用于预测受潮汐影响的海滩剖面。该框架能自动分类海滩形态，并为每种形态训练专门的高斯过程模型，最终通过门控网络整合预测结果。实验结果表明，MorphoGP在中国海岸的数据上表现优于传统和深度学习模型，预测精度显著提高。
AI.motivation: 预测受潮汐影响的平衡海滩剖面对于可持续海岸开发、海岸防护策略制定和海岸生态系统管理至关重要，但现有模型在处理潮汐影响方面存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为MorphoGP的统一的、类别特定的高斯过程框架。该框架首先使用基于对比学习的ContourCluster模型自动分类受潮汐影响的海滩形态。然后，在每个形态类别中，使用专门的高斯过程专家学习环境描述符（波浪、潮汐、沉积物）与海滩剖面形状之间的统计关系。最后，通过一个Gating Net，利用概率加权机制整合所有专家的输出，生成最终预测。
AI.result: 与传统和深度学习模型相比，MorphoGP在预测性能上有所提高，测试均方根误差（RMSE）降低了约59.3%，最终RMSE为0.297米。该模型在中国海岸的180多个海滩剖面数据上进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: MorphoGP提供了一个物理信息驱动、数据驱动的工具，用于预测受潮汐影响的平衡海滩剖面，并支持海岸管理。未来研究方向是加强过程层面的物理耦合。
AI.translation: 预测受潮汐影响的平衡海滩剖面对可持续海岸开发、海岸防护策略的制定以及在不断变化的环境条件下管理海岸生态系统具有根本重要性。然而，由于波浪、潮汐和沉积过程之间的高度非线性相互作用，这仍然是一个挑战。传统的经验模型和数值模型在适应不同海岸环境方面通常适应性有限，尤其是在潮汐过程重要的海滩系统中，其局限性尤为明显。为了在这种条件下改进数据驱动的预测，本研究提出了MorphoGP，一个统一的、类别特定的高斯过程框架，用于预测受潮汐影响的平衡海滩剖面（EBPs）。该框架首先基于对比学习引入了一个ContourCluster模型，用于自动分类受潮汐影响的海滩形态。在每个形态类别中，一个专门的高斯过程专家学习环境描述符（包括波浪、潮汐和沉积物）与海滩剖面形状之间的统计关联。然后，一个Gating Net通过概率加权机制整合所有专家的输出，以产生最终预测。在对中国海岸受潮汐影响的180多个海滩剖面数据进行评估后，MorphoGP与传统的和深度学习模型相比，预测性能有所提高，测试均方根误差（RMSE）降低了约59.3%，最终RMSE达到了0.297米。该框架为受潮汐影响的平衡海滩剖面预测和海岸管理提供了一个物理信息驱动的数据驱动工具，而更强的过程层面物理耦合仍然是未来发展的重要方向。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了MorphoGP，一个新颖的非参数框架，用于预测受潮汐影响的平衡海滩剖面。该框架利用对比学习自动识别和分类不同的海滩形态，并为每种形态训练专门的高斯过程模型。通过一个门控网络整合这些模型，MorphoGP能够更准确地预测海滩剖面形状，并在实验中显著优于现有模型，为海岸管理提供了有效工具。
AI.keywords: 平衡海滩剖面, 潮汐影响, 高斯过程, 对比学习, MorphoGP
AI.comments: MorphoGP框架在处理受潮汐影响的海滩剖面预测方面展现了显著的创新性，尤其是在结合了对比学习进行形态分类和高斯过程进行预测方面。其优势在于能够适应不同海滩形态并提高预测精度，这对于实际的海岸工程和管理具有重要意义。然而，如作者所指出的，未来在加强过程层面的物理耦合方面仍有提升空间。

title: SemanticSlider3D: Training-Free Continuous Semantic Editing for 3D Objects
summary: Fine-grained control over continuous semantic attributes of 3D objects is essential for 3D content creation, but is not well supported by conventional 3D modeling workflows or prompt-based interaction with existing generative AI tools. While slider-based methods have proven effective for fine-grained semantic control in 2D image generation, no equivalent approach exists for 3D. Extending these 2D methods to 3D is non-trivial due to challenges unique to 3D, including geometric integrity and cross-view coherence. We present SemanticSlider3D, a technique for continuous semantic attribute editing of 3D objects that requires no per-attribute training. Given a user-specified attribute, our pipeline constructs a semantic editing direction in the latent space of a state-of-the-art 3D generation model, presenting a diverse and coherent spectrum of 3D variations. A technical validation on a dataset of 50 3D object-attribute pairs shows our method was preferred by all five human assessors across variation range, consistency, 3D object quality, and attribute disentanglement, over a baseline combining a 2D slider with an image-to-3D model. An exploratory study with six participants demonstrates that SemanticSlider3D supported decision-making in 3D prototyping and was perceived as a valuable addition to existing workflows.

AI.title_translation: SemanticSlider3D：3D对象的免训练连续语义编辑
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SemanticSlider3D的免训练技术，实现了3D对象连续语义属性的高质量精细编辑。
AI.motivation: 传统的3D建模工作流或基于提示词的交互工具无法很好地支持对3D对象连续语义属性的精细控制，而现有的2D滑动条方法尚未有效扩展到3D领域。
AI.method: 针对用户指定的属性，在先进3D生成模型的潜在空间中构建语义编辑方向，从而呈现多样且一致的3D变化谱。
AI.result: 技术验证表明，在50个3D对象-属性对上，该方法在变化范围、一致性、3D对象质量和属性解耦方面均优于基线方法（2D滑动条结合图像到3D模型）。探索性研究也证明了其在3D原型设计中的价值。
AI.conclusion: SemanticSlider3D成功实现了3D对象的免训练连续语义编辑，在变化范围、一致性、3D质量和属性解耦方面表现优异，极大地支持了3D原型设计。
AI.translation: 对3D对象连续语义属性的精细控制对于3D内容创作至关重要，但传统的3D建模工作流或与现有生成式AI工具的基于提示词的交互对此支持不足。虽然基于滑动条的方法已被证明对2D图像生成中的精细语义控制有效，但3D领域尚无同等方法。由于3D独有的挑战（如几何完整性和跨视图一致性），将这些2D方法扩展到3D并非易事。我们提出了SemanticSlider3D，这是一种用于3D对象连续语义 attribute 编辑的技术，无需进行每个属性的训练。给定用户指定的属性，我们的流水线在先进3D生成模型的潜在空间中构建语义编辑方向，呈现出多样且一致的3D变化谱。对包含50个3D对象-属性对的数据集进行的 तकनीकी验证表明，在变化范围、一致性、3D对象质量和属性解耦方面，我们的方法得到了所有五位人类评估者的青睐，超越了结合2D滑动条与图像到3D模型的基线。一项有六名参与者参与的探索性研究表明，SemanticSlider3D支持了3D原型设计中的决策，并被认为是对现有工作流的有价值补充。
AI.summary: SemanticSlider3D是一种用于3D对象连续语义编辑的免训练技术，能够在3D生成模型的潜在空间中构建编辑方向，实现高质量、多视角一致且可控的3D内容变化。
AI.keywords: 3D对象生成, 语义编辑, 连续控制, 免训练, 3D内容创作
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将2D图像生成的滑动条语义编辑技术扩展到3D领域，提出了无需每个属性单独训练的SemanticSlider3D方法，有效解决了3D编辑中的几何完整性和多视角一致性问题，对3D内容创作具有重要意义。

title: Robust Instability Radius for Networked Dynamical Systems: Upper and Lower Bounds
summary: This paper is concerned with robust instability of uncertain network systems. We consider the multi-agent system described as a network of single-input-single-output agents with identical nominal dynamics subject to heterogeneous perturbations. The network description is formalized as a feedback interconnection of a diagonal uncertainty, nominal identical agents, and a static interconnection matrix. Assuming that the nominal network is unstable, we seek the robust instability radius (RIR), defined as the smallest norm of the stable uncertainty that renders the network stable. Conditions for the network stability are developed, and upper and lower bounds on the RIR are derived. When the network connectivity matrix is rank one and all diagonal entries share the same sign or are zero, we give conditions under which the RIR is exactly characterized by a small gain argument.

AI.title_translation: 网络化动态系统的鲁棒失稳半径：上下界
AI.tldr: 本文研究了不确定网络化动态系统的鲁棒失稳半径（RIR），推导了其上下界，并在特定条件下证明了其可由小增益定理精确表征。
AI.motivation: 为了研究具有异质摄动的不确定网络系统在标称网络不稳定时的鲁棒失稳特性，并确定能够使网络稳定的最小稳定不确定性范数（即鲁棒失稳半径，RIR）。
AI.method: 将网络描述形式化为对角不确定性、标称相同智能体和静态互联矩阵的反馈互联，建立网络稳定性条件，推导鲁棒失稳半径（RIR）的上下界，并在特殊连通矩阵情况下利用小增益参数进行精确刻画。
AI.result: 发展了网络稳定性条件，推导出了鲁棒失稳半径（RIR）的上下界；在网络连通矩阵为秩一且所有对角项同号或为零的特定条件下，给出了RIR通过小增益参数进行精确刻画的条件。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立了含异质摄动的网络化动态系统鲁棒失稳半径（RIR）的分析框架，推导出了上下界，并在特定秩一连通矩阵和同号对角元情况下，证明了RIR可由小增益定理精确表征。
AI.translation: 本文研究了不确定网络系统的鲁棒失稳问题。我们考虑了一个多智能体系统，该系统被描述为单输入单输出智能体的网络，这些智能体具有相同的标称动态特性并受到异质摄动。网络描述被形式化为对角不确定性、标称相同智能体以及静态互联矩阵的反馈互联。假设标称网络是不稳定的，我们寻求鲁棒失稳半径（RIR），其定义为使网络稳定的最小稳定不确定性范数。我们开发了网络稳定性的条件，并推导了RIR的上下界。当网络连通矩阵为秩一且所有对角项同号或为零时，我们给出了RIR可由小增益参数精确刻画的条件。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具异质摄动的多智能体网络系统在标称不稳定时的鲁棒失稳半径（RIR）。通过建立反馈互联模型，作者推导了RIR的上下界，并在特定秩一网络矩阵下证明了RIR可用小增益定理精确刻画。
AI.keywords: 鲁棒失稳, 网络化动态系统, 多智能体系统, 摄动分析, 小增益定理
AI.comments: 本文研究了具异质摄动的多智能体网络系统的鲁棒失稳半径（RIR），不仅推导出了上界和下界，还在特定条件下证明了RIR可以通过小增益定理精确刻画，具有较强的理论价值。

title: SemaPLC: A Project-Grounded, Verification-Gated Agent Harness for PLC Code Generation
summary: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) run industrial plants, and large language models can already generate independent program organization units (POUs) for them. Whether such logic integrates into an existing PLC project and then runs correctly has been checked only in limited tests. We present \textsc{SemaPLC}, a project-grounded and verification-gated agent harness assembled from conventional tools but governed by a strict completion rule. Rather than stopping when the model judges its own output adequate, \textsc{SemaPLC} declares a task complete only when logged external checks confirm it. Those checks cover the specification, the compilation, and the behavior on a live runtime. On 117 independent-POU tasks matching existing benchmarks, it attains the highest strict verified pass rate on all seven models (72.6\% mean). On a project-context track of 65 tasks whose generated logic must compile and run inside a real project, it attains the highest mean on integrated compilation, static behavior, and dynamic behavior. Of the three layers, dynamic behavior is the most revealing. We measure it by deploying the generated and the reference logic to a live PLC runtime and comparing their executed traces. All methods fall within 10 static points of one another, whereas dynamic scores separate them sharply, from 22.4 to 31.4 for the baselines against 52.2 for \textsc{SemaPLC}. Overall, our verification-gated harness raises the mean at every layer and most sharply at runtime. Execution, not static scoring, is the faithful test of whether generated control logic actually works. \textsc{SemaPLC} is open-sourced at https://github.com/midea-ai/SemaPLC.

AI.title_translation: SemaPLC：一个用于PLC代码生成的、以项目为基础且受验证门控的智能体框架
AI.tldr: SemaPLC是一个通过外部编译和运行时验证来确保大模型生成的PLC代码能在真实工业项目中正确运行的智能体框架。
AI.motivation: 虽然大语言模型可以为可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）生成独立的程序组织单元（POU），但生成的代码是否能够正确集成并运行到现有PLC项目中，目前缺乏充分的验证。
AI.method: 提出SemaPLC，一个基于项目接地（project-grounded）和验证门控（verification-gated）的智能体 harness，通过外部日志检查（涵盖规范、编译和实时运行行为）来强制完成任务，而不是依赖模型自身的判断。
AI.result: 在117个独立POU任务上，SemaPLC在7个模型上均达到了最高的严格验证通过率（平均72.6%）；在包含65个任务的项目上下文测试轨道中，其集成编译、静态行为和动态行为表现也均取得最高平均分，特别是在最关键的动态运行时测试中远超基线方法（52.2对22.4-31.4）。
AI.conclusion: SemaPLC通过严格的外部验证门控机制，显著提升了大语言模型生成PLC代码在真实工程项目中的编译通过率和动态运行正确率。
AI.translation: 可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）驱动着工业工厂，大语言模型已经能够为它们生成独立的程序组织单元（POU）。这种逻辑是否能集成到现有的PLC项目中并正确运行，以往仅在有限的测试中得到验证。我们提出了SemaPLC，这是一个由常规工具组装而成、但受严格完成规则支配的项目接地且验证门控的智能体 harness。与在模型判断自身输出足够时停止不同，SemaPLC仅在记录的外部检查确认后才宣布任务完成。这些检查涵盖了规范、编译和在实时运行时的行为。在匹配现有基准的117个独立POU任务中，它在所有七个模型上获得了最高的严格验证通过率（平均72.6%）。在包含65个任务的项目上下文轨道中（生成的逻辑必须在真实项目中编译并运行），它在集成编译、静态行为和动态行为上取得了最高平均分。在这三层中，动态行为最具揭示性。我们通过将生成逻辑和参考逻辑部署到实时PLC运行时并比较其执行轨迹来衡量它。所有方法在静态分数上相差不到10个分点，而动态分数则将它们明显区分开来，基线方法的得分从22.4到31.4不等，而SemaPLC的得分高达52.2。总的来说，我们的验证门控 harness 提高了每一层的平均水平，在运行时提高最为显著。执行（而非静态评分）才是测试生成的控制逻辑是否真正起作用的可靠方法。SemaPLC已在 https://github.com/midea-ai/SemaPLC 开源。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了SemaPLC，一种用于PLC代码生成的项目接地和验证门控智能体框架。该框架通过结合规范、编译和实时运行时的外部检查来代替模型自身的判断，显著提高了大语言模型生成的PLC代码在真实工程项目中的集成成功率和运行正确率。
AI.keywords: Programmable logic controllers, Large language models, Code generation, Verification harness, Industrial automation
AI.comments: SemaPLC创新性地引入了基于外部验证（包括编译、静态和动态运行时行为）的智能体控制机制，解决了大语言模型生成PLC代码难以融入真实工程项目的痛点，强调了实际运行测试对于工业控制逻辑验证的必要性。

title: Beyond Distortion Robustness: Rethinking Severe Cropping as Erasure-Resilient Message Embedding
summary: Robust message embedding in images is important for multimedia security applications such as copyright protection and content tracing. Existing methods are largely developed under a distortion robustness paradigm, where the embedded signal remains spatially present but is degraded by noise, blur, or compression. Severe cropping poses a fundamentally different challenge because it removes part of the carrier itself, causing partial payload disappearance rather than mere signal corruption. In this paper, we revisit robust message embedding from an erasure-resilience perspective and present CREST, a proof-of-concept framework for severe-cropping-robust embedding. CREST combines coding-theoretic redundancy with neural embedding and recovery by expanding a compact QR message into a redundant spatial payload via LT fountain coding and coupling it with cropping-aware embedding and fragment recovery. Experiments on COCO, DIV2K, and VOC2012 show that CREST improves recovery under severe cropping while maintaining competitive visual quality. Under mixed distortions with an area retention ratio of 0.7, CREST improves TRA from 18.52% to 68.45% and reduces EMR from 13.88% to 4.21% over the strongest baseline. On COCO2017, CREST still achieves 48.55--65.12% TRA when only 30--50% of the image area is retained, whereas all compared baselines fail to recover the message. These results suggest that severe cropping is better understood as an erasure problem rather than a conventional distortion problem, motivating the joint design of neural embedding and coding-based recovery.

AI.title_translation: 超越失真鲁棒性：将严重裁剪重新思考为抗擦除的消息嵌入
AI.tldr: 本文将图像严重裁剪视为擦除问题，并提出了结合LT喷泉码与神经嵌入的CREST框架，显著解决了极端裁剪下的消息丢失与恢复难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的鲁棒消息嵌入方法主要在失真鲁棒性范式下开发（信号空间降质），而严重裁剪会直接移除载体的一部分，导致部分有效载荷消失而非单纯信号损坏，因此需要从擦除鲁棒性的新视角重新审视。
AI.method: 提出CREST框架，结合编码理论冗余与神经嵌入和恢复。具体通过LT喷泉码将紧凑的QR消息扩展为冗余的空间有效载荷，并配合裁剪感知嵌入和片段恢复。
AI.result: 在COCO、DIV2K和VOC2012上的实验表明，CREST在保持具有竞争力的视觉质量的同时，显著提升了严重裁剪下的恢复能力。在面积保留率为0.7的混合失真下，与最强基线相比，TRA从18.52%提升至68.45%，EMR从13.88%降低至4.21%。在仅保留30%至50%图像区域时，仍能实现48.55%至65.12%的TRA，而所有对比基线均告失败。
AI.conclusion: 严重裁剪应被视为擦除问题而非传统的失真问题。联合设计神经嵌入与基于编码的恢复机制（如CREST）能够显著提升图像在极端裁剪和混合失真下的信息恢复能力。
AI.translation: 图像中的鲁棒消息嵌入对于版权保护和内容追踪等多媒体安全应用至关重要。现有方法主要在失真鲁棒性范式下开发，其中嵌入的信号在空间上仍然存在，但被噪声、模糊或压缩降级。严重的裁剪提出了根本不同的挑战，因为它去除了载体本身的一部分，导致部分有效载荷消失，而不仅仅是信号损坏。在本文中，我们从擦除鲁棒性的角度重新审视了鲁棒消息嵌入，并提出了CREST，这是一个用于严重裁剪鲁棒嵌入的概念验证框架。CREST通过LT喷泉码将紧凑的QR消息扩展为冗余的空间有效载荷，并将其与裁剪感知嵌入和片段恢复相结合，将编码理论冗余与神经嵌入和恢复结合起来。在COCO、DIV2K和VOC2012上的实验表明，CREST在保持具竞争力的视觉质量的同时，改善了严重裁剪下的恢复。在面积保留比为0.7的混合失真下，与最强基线相比，CREST将TRA从18.52%提高到68.45%，并将EMR从13.88%降低到4.21%。在COCO2017上，当仅保留30-50%的图像区域时，CREST仍然可以实现48.55-65.12%的TRA，而所有比较的基线都无法恢复消息。这些结果表明，严重裁剪最好被理解为擦除问题，而不是传统的失真问题，这激发了神经嵌入和基于编码的恢复的联合设计。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为CREST的框架，将严重裁剪下的图像鲁棒消息嵌入重新建模为擦除恢复问题。通过结合LT喷泉码与神经嵌入，该方法在极端裁剪和混合失真下表现出卓越的信息恢复能力，远超现有基于传统失真范式的方法。
AI.keywords: 鲁棒消息嵌入, 严重裁剪, 擦除鲁棒性, LT喷泉码, 神经图像嵌入
AI.comments: 该论文突破了传统将图像裁剪视为信号失真的局限，创新性地将严重裁剪建模为“擦除（erasure）”问题，并结合了LT喷泉码与神经嵌入技术，为应对极端裁剪条件下的鲁棒消息嵌入提供了新颖且高效的解决方案。

title: The Role of Grid Cells in Reducing Spatial Aliasing in Hippocampal Place Representations
comments: IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence, Masstricht, Netherlands, June 2026
summary: Spatial aliasing occurs when two or more distinct locations produce highly similar place-cell representations, primarily due to environmental symmetry or repetitive structures. This issue is most pronounced when place representations are constructed solely from boundary vector cell (BVC) inputs, because symmetric or repetitive structures can yield indistinguishable sensory patterns across multiple locations in an environment. This work introduces grid cell signals to mitigate spatial aliasing in such settings. Because grid cells contribute periodic, internally generated spatial signals that vary independently of environmental geometry, they play a key role in disambiguating perceptually identical locations. We integrate multiple modules of analytically constructed grid cells with BVC-driven place cells and show that this leads to a 94--99% reduction in spatial aliasing relative to a BVC-only baseline across three environments: an open environment without obstacles; an environment with a cross-shaped central obstacle creating high visual symmetry; and a maze environment. The greatest improvement occurs in the environment with the highest visual symmetry. These results indicate that grid cells provide information complementary to boundary-based inputs, yielding more reliable place representations in geometrically ambiguous environments.
comment: IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence, Masstricht, Netherlands, June 2026

AI.title_translation: 网格细胞在减少海马体位置表征空间混叠中的作用
AI.tldr: 引入网格细胞信号可以显著减少由环境对称性导致的海马体位置表征空间混叠现象。
AI.motivation: 当仅使用边界向量细胞（BVC）输入构建位置细胞表征时，环境的对称性或重复结构会导致不同的位置产生高度相似的表征（空间混叠），本研究旨在通过引入网格细胞信号来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 将多个解析构建的网格细胞模块与边界向量细胞（BVC）驱动的位置细胞相结合，并在三种不同环境（开放环境、具十字形障碍的高对称环境、迷宫环境）中进行测试。
AI.result: 与仅使用BVC的基线相比，引入网格细胞信号在三种测试环境中减少了94%至99%的空间混叠，其中在视觉对称性最高的环境中改善效果最显著。
AI.conclusion: 网格细胞提供的周期性内部空间信号与基于边界的输入信息互补，能够在几何对称或具有重复结构的复杂环境中显著减少空间混叠，生成更可靠的位置表征。
AI.translation: 当两个或多个不同的位置产生高度相似的位置细胞表征时，就会发生空间混叠，这主要是由环境对称性或重复结构引起的。当位置表征仅由边界向量细胞（BVC）输入构建时，这个问题最为明显，因为对称或重复的结构可能会在环境中的多个位置产生无法区分的感觉模式。本研究引入了网格细胞信号来缓解这种环境中的空间混叠。由于网格细胞贡献了周期性的、内部生成的空间信号，这些信号独立于环境几何形状变化，因此它们在消除感知相同位置的歧义方面起着关键作用。我们将多个解析构建的网格细胞模块与BVC驱动的位置细胞相结合，结果表明，在三种环境（无障碍的开放环境、产生高度视觉对称的十字形中央障碍环境、以及迷宫环境）中，与仅使用BVC的基线相比，空间混叠减少了94%至99%。最大的改善发生在视觉对称性最高的环境中。这些结果表明，网格细胞提供了与基于边界的输入相补充的信息，从而在几何模糊的环境中产生更可靠的位置表征。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了网格细胞在减少海马体位置表征中空间混叠的作用。通过将网格细胞的周期性信号与边界向量细胞（BVC）相结合，显著降低了对称或重复环境中的空间混叠现象，证明了网格细胞与边界输入在几何模糊环境中具有互补作用。
AI.keywords: 网格细胞, 空间混叠, 海马体位置表征, 边界向量细胞, 空间导航
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将网格细胞信号引入边界向量细胞驱动的位置细胞中，有效解决了对称或重复环境下的空间混叠问题，为理解大脑海马体与内嗅皮层的空间导航机制提供了重要的计算模型支持。

title: NanoSleep: A Parameter-Efficient Hybrid Temporal Convolutional Network for Single-Channel Sleep Stage Classification
summary: Sleep stage classification from single-channel electroencephalography (EEG) is essential for wearable and home-based sleep monitoring. However, many deep learning models achieve high accuracy at the cost of large model sizes, which limits their deployment on resource-constrained devices. In this work, we present NanoSleep, a compact hybrid temporal convolutional network for automatic sleep stage classification. NanoSleep combines a learnable Sinc-convolutional front end, a dual-branch feature extractor that fuses multi-scale temporal and spectral representations, a gated dilated temporal convolutional backbone with channel recalibration, and a conditional random field for sequence-level decoding. We further employ a weighted calibrated focal loss to address class imbalance. We evaluate NanoSleep on the Sleep-EDF and Sleep-EDF-Expanded datasets using subject-wise cross-validation. The proposed model consistently outperforms six representative baseline methods, and an ablation study confirms the contribution of each major component. These results demonstrate that NanoSleep provides an effective balance between accuracy and efficiency, making it well suited for wearable devices, home-based sleep monitoring, and resource-constrained clinical applications.

AI.title_translation: NanoSleep：用于单通道睡眠分期的参数高效混合时域卷积网络
AI.tldr: NanoSleep是一种轻量且高效的混合时域卷积网络，专为单通道脑电图睡眠分期设计，完美平衡了高精度与低资源消耗的需求。
AI.motivation: 现有的许多用于单通道脑电图睡眠分期的深度学习模型虽然精度高，但模型体积过大，限制了其在资源受限的可穿戴设备和家庭睡眠监测中的部署。
AI.method: 提出NanoSleep模型，包含可学习的Sinc卷积前端、融合多尺度时域和频域表示的双分支特征提取器、带有通道重新校准的门控扩张时域卷积骨干网络、用于序列级解码的条件随机场，并使用加权校准焦点损失来处理类别不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在Sleep-EDF和Sleep-EDF-Expanded数据集上使用受试者交叉验证进行评估，NanoSleep持续优于六种具有代表性的基线方法，消融实验证实了各个主要组件的有效性。
