title: A Few Cases Are All You Need: An Empirical Study of Annotation-Efficient LoRA Fine-Tuning of MedSAM3
summary: Medical image segmentation is essential for clinical workflows such as treatment planning and disease assessment. While specialist tools like TotalSegmentator and MRSegmentator achieve strong performance, they require large annotated datasets for training. Medical foundation models offer a promising alternative through large-scale pretraining that reduces the annotation burden for new tasks, but zero-shot performance remains limited. Parameter-efficient adaptation via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient specialization with few trainable parameters, but a key question remains: how many expert-annotated cases are needed to achieve clinically useful segmentation performance? We address this by adapting MedSAM3 with LoRA for five abdominal organs (liver, kidneys, spleen, gallbladder, and pancreas) in CT and MRI using only 1, 2, 5, and 10 annotated cases, evaluating on AMOS22 dataset. With just 10 cases, models achieve performance competitive with specialist systems trained on orders of magnitude more data. Notably, this includes reliable gallbladder segmentation (Dice 0.68 CT, 0.59 MRI) where existing tools fail almost completely (Dice 0.0004), while remaining within 5--10% of MRSegmentator for liver, kidneys, and spleen using over 100 times fewer annotations. Furthermore, external validation on the Whole Heart Segmentation dataset shows that the approach extends to cardiac segmentation, a use case beyond the scope of TotalSegmentator (MRI) and MRSegmentator, achieving competitive left ventricle (LV) performance with only 10 annotated cases. Training requires only3--5,hours per organ on a single GPU, approximately 2--3 times faster than nnU-Net. These findings suggest that ten annotated cases are sufficient for clinically useful segmentation, effectively reducing bottlenecks for both image annotation and training time.

title: Flama: a Python framework for development and deployment of production-ready APIs, machine learning, and LLM services
comments: 83 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Software available at https://github.com/vortico/flama, up-to-date documentation at https://flama.dev
summary:
We present Flama, an open-source Python framework for developing and deploying production-ready web APIs, machine learning services, and large-language-model (LLM) applications. Built on the Asynchronous Server Gateway Interface (ASGI), Flama offers a type-driven, async-first programming model that unifies REST API development, predictive model serving, and generative AI inference in one architecture.
  It is organised around seven subsystems: a component-based dependency injection system resolving handler parameters from type annotations at startup; a pluggable schema layer supporting Pydantic, Marshmallow and Typesystem behind a single adapter; an automatic CRUD generator turning a SQLAlchemy table and a schema class into REST endpoints backed by the Repository and Unit of Work patterns; a portable binary format (.flm) packaging models from scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers with their metadata for zero-code deployment; a multi-backend LLM server running vLLM (Linux/CUDA) or MLX (Apple Silicon) and exposing four wire protocols (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and a native streaming dialect) through a shared codec; a Rust-accelerated core compiled via Maturin for routing, JSON encoding, compression and parsing; and a Model Context Protocol module turning any application into an MCP server over JSON-RPC 2.0.
  Built-in capabilities include JWT authentication, two pagination strategies, background tasks in threads or processes, WebSocket endpoints, Server-Sent Event and NDJSON streaming, OpenAPI 3.2.0 generation from handler signatures, and a command-line interface for running applications and for serving, packaging and inspecting models.
  We describe the architecture, present the programming model through worked examples, and compare Flama with existing frameworks, model serving platforms and LLM inference engines.

title: CL4D: Contrastive Language-4D Pretraining for Vision-Language Reasoning in Dynamic Scenes
comments: Accepted at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
summary: 4D understanding and reasoning is a fundamental capability for embodied AI agents operating in dynamic physical environments. However, existing vision encoders are largely limited to static 2D images or 3D point clouds without temporal modeling, or to 2D videos that lack accurate geometric depth reasoning. Consequently, current approaches fail to jointly capture spatial structure and motion evolution in dynamic scenes. We present CL4D, the first foundational 4D vision encoder that directly operates on dynamic point clouds, trained with a contrastive learning objective to align spatio-temporal geometric representations with natural language descriptions. By learning a shared embedding space between text and 4D scene dynamics, CL4D enables zero-shot motion-to-text and text-to-motion retrieval in dynamic environments and serves as a foundational 4D vision encoder for downstream 4D vision-language tasks. Building on this encoder, we introduce 4DVLM, a 4D vision-language model that conditions language generation on dynamic geometric representations. 4DVLM is the first VLM designed to operate directly on 4D point clouds without relying on 2D images, 2D videos, or static 3D point clouds. We train CL4D and subsequently 4DVLM on a newly constructed dataset termed DynAction4D capturing diverse human motions across varying object interactions and scene environments. Extensive experiments across multiple 4D human action benchmarks demonstrate that CL4D achieves state-of-the-art performance, with improvements of approximately ~16.75% over prior methods. Furthermore, 4DVLM outperforms frontier video VLMs such as Gemini and GPT-5 even when these models are provided with RGB video sequences corresponding to the same scenes represented as 4D point clouds for 4DVLM.

title: FedLNS: Leverage LayerNorm Signature Modeling to Mitigate Adversarial Manipulation in Federated LLMs
summary: Federated training enables language models to learn from distributed private text, but the server cannot directly verify the local supervision or optimization process that produces each client update. A malicious client can therefore train on corrupted targets, introduce incorrect context-token associations, and degrade the global model through repeated aggregation. Such degradation can also increase the risk of unreliable or hallucinatory generation. We propose Federated Learning with Normalization Signatures (FedLNS), a server-side framework for lightweight malicious-update screening. FedLNS represents each client update through changes in trainable normalization-layer parameters and screens suspicious updates against a robust, history-aware cross-client reference. Because the signatures are extracted at the server from the returned local models, FedLNS requires no additional client-to-server parameter or metadata exchange compared to standard federated learning (FL) methods. After screening, the retained full-model updates can be aggregated using standard FL or another compatible aggregation rule. FedLNS requires no raw client data, trusted server dataset, labeled attack examples, or separately trained detector. Experiments on GPT-style, BERT-style, and LLaMA-style models trained from scratch with 200 clients show that, under 40% population-level target manipulation, FedLNS achieves lower test perplexity than the strongest of six baselines for all three architectures under both IID (independently and identically distributed) and non-IID data partitions.

title: A Multi-Agent Platform for Automated Enterprise Analytics and Insight Generation
summary: This paper proposes a multi-agent framework built on CrewAI [1] for conversational business intelligence. Five specialized AI agents operate in a sequential pipeline to process natural language queries, retrieve and analyze data, generate visualizations via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) [2], and deliver actionable insights. The platform features a defense-in-depth security architecture for multi-tenant data isolation and a query parameterization mechanism for transforming conversational insights into reusable dashboard components. Evaluation across 300 end-to-end test cases spanning synthetic and production enterprise datasets demonstrates 95.3% functional accuracy, a mean response latency of 24 seconds, and a response quality score of 4.52/5.0 as assessed by an LLM-as-a-Judge framework, with a 93.0% hallucination-free rate, representing a 22.6 percentage point accuracy improvement and 20.2% quality gain over a single-agent baseline. Cross-model evaluation across four LLM backends and human expert validation confirm architectural generalizability and evaluator reliability. An ablation study confirms that the Data Analysis and Report Aggregation agents are the primary drivers of output quality.

title: Metrics That Write Themselves: Evolving an Evaluator from Its Own Blind Spots
summary: Agents improve quickly against a reliable automatic metric and stall without one, and the applications that need them most, report generation among them, are the ones nobody knows how to score. Can the metric write itself? Saying what makes an answer good is hard; pointing at something wrong with one is easier, so the metric we evolve is a pool of small Python operators that each flag a candidate for one named defect, or abstain, and vote. Asking a model for operators directly does not work: 183 candidates realise only 96 distinct behaviours, from one narrow region of an enormous space. EvalCEGAR instead borrows counterexample-guided abstraction refinement from program verification. It reads the pool as an abstraction and searches for a collision, two answers the operators score identically, one correct and one not. That pair, not a prompt, is the authoring request, and when a collision defeats every attempt the loop widens what an operator may read rather than resampling. On MBPP+ and HumanEval+, a sandbox whose hidden unit tests give exact ground truth, the loop writes a 55-line operator that closes 15.4% of the gap between flagging nothing and a perfect filter on 428 unseen tasks (+0.0065, p=0.0010) at a quarter of our best hand-written operator's flags. On the benchmark it never saw it matches that operator's effect exactly on a third of the flags. Six of eight runs admit such an operator and all six help out of sample; our 15 hand-written operators applied together as one filter lose accuracy. An LLM judge on the same information ties that delta on a nearly disjoint set of candidates, and charges a model call per candidate forever where the operator charges none.

title: Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning
summary: JEPA-style latent world models can use Euclidean distance to a goal latent as the cost for model-predictive control (MPC). Strong decoding of task variables, however, does not guarantee that this particular cost ranks candidate action sequences by real task progress. We call the latter property \emph{decision-metric alignment}. We introduce Plan-Real Spearman, which measures latent--real rank agreement on random plans, and CEM-stage Spearman, which measures the same agreement as cross-entropy-method (CEM) search concentrates its proposal. We analyze sufficient conditions under which latent distance preserves real-cost rankings, identifying encoder distortion, terminal rollout error, and candidate margins as the controlling quantities. Guided by the observed empirical alignment gap, DA-LeWM augments LeWM with inverse-dynamics and demonstration-conditioned goal-action heads. Across all our experiments, DA-LeWM accelerates convergence and achieves higher online success than LeWM, while probe scores remain similar. These results show that action-conditioned objectives improve the geometry used by Euclidean-cost, CEM-based latent MPC.

title: Biological-Hybrid Intelligence: A Conceptual Framework for Distributed Biological--Artificial Computation
summary: Biological and artificial systems offer complementary forms of adaptation, learning, and computation, with advances in in-vitro neurotechnology increasingly enabling bidirectional coupling between them. As these systems become more tightly integrated, a key architectural question is how task-relevant computation should be distributed across both substrates. Yet existing biohybrid solutions optimise the biological substrate, the AI model, or their interface without explicitly addressing how such computation is allocated, reassigned, and evaluated. We introduce Biological-Hybrid Intelligence (BHI), a conceptual framework for distributing computation across adaptive biological and artificial substrates coupled through a bioelectronic interface and coordinated by an orchestrator. BHI treats both substrates as computational entities whose computational responsibilities may change during operation. BHI requires reciprocal co-adaptation and differs from systems that merely decode biological activity, stimulate a living substrate, or adapt a single component. BHI further defines three operating modes: adversarial, collaborative, and codependent, distinguished by whether the substrates compete, divide computational labour, or become mutually necessary for task performance. BHI provides a common basis for comparing computational frameworks, defining benchmarks for latency, viability, interface bandwidth, learning efficiency, and reproducibility. It also highlights governance considerations arising from reciprocal stimulation, adaptation, and data exchange. More broadly, BHI invites computer scientists to consider biological substrates as active computational resources and to ask not only how a task should be computed, but where its computation should reside. BHI therefore reframes biological-artificial integration as a system-level problem of computational allocation, coordination, and control.

title: Geometric Data Perturbation with Noisy-Anchor Alignment for Privacy-Preserving Collaborative Learning
comments: 72 pages total: 36-page main paper and 36-page supplementary material
summary: Geometric Data Perturbation (GDP) enables one-shot, privacy-preserving collaborative learning: each participant applies a distance-preserving transformation to its private data and uploads only the resulting representation to a central analyst. We study GDP under analyst-participant collusion, in which the analyst combines all uploaded representations with the private data and transformations disclosed by colluding participants to recover a non-colluding participant's private data. Participant-specific independent transformations resist this attack but map participants' data into incompatible representation spaces, degrading downstream model performance. Shared-anchor alignment from Data Collaboration (DC) analysis restores compatibility and improves utility, but we show that disclosing the DC anchor matrix enables exact recovery of non-colluding participants' private data even in the presence of collusion. Adding noise directly to the private-data representations mitigates this vulnerability but substantially reduces utility. We propose adding noise to the anchor representations instead. Each participant independently transforms its private data and the shared anchor matrix, perturbs only the resulting anchor representation, and uploads both representations in a single round. Using the noisy anchor representations, the analyst aligns the private-data representations by solving a Generalized Orthogonal Procrustes Problem. We characterize alignment and recovery errors, specialize a conservative sufficient condition for convergence of the alignment to our setting, and analyze three recovery attacks. Experiments on MNIST and CelebA show that, across the evaluated attacks and deployment settings, anchor noise achieves higher learning accuracy than private-data noise at comparable measured leakage, yielding a more favorable privacy-utility trade-off under the specified collusion model.

title: Enabling Reuse for Data-Sharing Pipelines in Federated Environments
summary: Data mesh architectures enable decentralized data sharing through domain-owned data products, but supporting diverse consumers in federated settings often requires customized data-sharing pipelines. As the number of consumers grows, this leads to a proliferation of pipelines, increasing design and maintenance complexity. We observe that such pipelines frequently exhibit substantial structural overlap. In this paper, we argue that reuse should serve as a guiding principle to address this challenge. We define reuse in data-sharing pipelines as the systematic use of existing data assets and transformation logic across pipelines, and identify reuse opportunities at both design time and runtime. We analyze the associated challenges and outline a reuse-oriented design approach, supported by a reference architecture. A preliminary evaluation demonstrates the potential of reuse to reduce redundancy and improve manageability, providing a pathway toward more scalable and sustainable federated data sharing.

title: GreekBarRetrieval: A Benchmark for Greek Statutory Retrieval
summary: Statutory retrieval is necessary for citation-grounded legal question answering, but remains underexplored for Greek. We introduce GreekBarRetrieval, a public retrieval benchmark derived from, and complementing GreekBarBench, which did not include retrieval. The new benchmark comprises 283 bar-exam questions, each accompanied by the facts of the case it refers to, and 6,308 candidate statutory articles to retrieve from. Questions and facts are stated in everyday language, but need to be mapped to the formal terminology of statutes and their abstract legal concepts. A further complication is that not all of the case facts are relevant to each question of a case. Experimenting with three BM25 variants and nine dense retrievers, we find that vanilla dense retrieval far outperforms vanilla sparse retrieval in Recall@100. However, LLM-based query reformulation helps BM25 close that gap, while also improving dense retrieval. With a ten-round ReAct-like LLM reformulation loop that we introduce, BM25 improves further in Recall@100 and obtains the best nDCG and MAP scores of all tested retrievers. Query reformulation also outperforms pseudo-relevance feedback, sparse-dense fusion, and English translation.

title: SED-FOD: Scattering-Aware Expert Decomposition for Few-Shot Cross-Sensor SAR Object Detection
comments: Submitted to IEEE JSTARS. 13 pages, 7 figures
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) object detection is an important part of remote sensing interpretation. However, because of variations in frequency band, resolution, background clutter, and target scattering responses, the performance of existing detectors often degrades when training and testing data are acquired from different SAR domains. Although domain adaptation methods offer a promising paradigm for solving this problem, most of them mainly pursue domain-invariant feature alignment and suppress sensor-dependent scattering characteristics that are useful for object detection. This problem becomes more challenging in few-shot scenarios, where only a few fully annotated target-domain SAR images are available. To address this issue, we propose a scattering-aware shared-specific feature decomposition framework for few-shot SAR domain adaptation object detection. We decompose detection features into a shared path and several soft-gated scattering-specific expert paths. The shared path learns transferable object structural information and is used for asymmetric domain alignment, while the scattering-specific experts adaptively compensate heterogeneous SAR responses. In addition, routing-domain auxiliary loss is introduced to encourage specific experts to capture sensor-dependent routing preferences, and an expert balancing loss is used to prevent routing collapse. Extensive experiments on four bidirectional heterogeneous SAR detection tasks between FARAD-X/FARAD-Ka and MiniSAR under different few-shot settings have been conducted and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance in both forward and reverse adaptation directions.

title: Epistemic Subordination: Generative AI and the Infrastructure of Knowledge
summary: Generative AI does not merely produce biased outputs. It encodes the majority's way of knowing as the default infrastructure of knowledge itself. We call this epistemic subordination. The training process compresses the full breadth of human expression into a single probabilistic model whose statistical baseline reflects the languages, assumptions, and cultural frameworks of the dominant culture. Minority epistemologies are not excluded but absorbed: present in the training data, yet structurally subordinated in the output. The result is not a collection of discrete biases that can be audited and corrected. It is an epistemic condition embedded in the architecture from which all outputs emerge. This unified harm cuts across three legal domains -- anti-discrimination law, cultural and linguistic rights, and democratic viewpoint pluralism -- and each fails to address it for the same structural reason: existing law regulates downstream, at the level of decisions and applications. The remedy must match the site of harm. If epistemic subordination is produced at the level of model training, then law must learn to govern at that level.

AI.title_translation: 认知从属：生成式AI与知识基础设施
AI.tldr: 生成式AI通过将多数人的认知方式编码为默认知识基础设施，导致了“认知从属”，这是一种根植于模型训练架构的统一性危害，现有法律因关注下游应用而无法解决，因此需要将法律监管提升至模型训练层面。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI不仅仅产生有偏见的输出，它通过将多数人的认知方式编码为默认的知识基础设施，从而导致了少数认知方式的结构性从属，即“认知从属”。
AI.method: 论文通过分析生成式AI的训练过程，指出其将人类表达的广度压缩成一个单一的概率模型，该模型的统计基线反映了主导文化的语言、假设和文化框架，从而导致少数认知方式在输出中被结构性从属。
AI.result: “认知从属”并非一系列可被审计和纠正的离散偏见，而是一种嵌入在生成所有输出的架构中的认知状态。这种统一的危害跨越了反歧视法、文化和语言权利以及民主观点多元化三个法律领域，但现有法律因其监管重心在下游（决策和应用层面）而未能有效解决。
AI.conclusion: 如果认知从属是在模型训练层面产生的，那么法律必须学会在此层面进行治理，以使补救措施与损害发生地相匹配。
AI.translation: 生成式AI不仅仅产生有偏见的输出，它将多数人的认知方式编码为知识本身的默认基础设施。我们称之为认知从属。训练过程将人类表达的全部广度压缩成一个单一的概率模型，其统计基线反映了主导文化的语言、假设和文化框架。少数认知方式并未被排除，而是被吸收：存在于训练数据中，但在输出中被结构性从属。结果并非一系列可以审计和纠正的离散偏见。这是一种嵌入在所有输出源头架构中的认知状态。这种统一的危害跨越了三个法律领域——反歧视法、文化和语言权利以及民主观点多元化——每个领域都因相同的结构性原因未能解决它：现有法律在下游，即决策和应用层面进行监管。补救措施必须与损害发生地相匹配。如果认知从属是在模型训练层面产生的，那么法律必须学会在此层面进行治理。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了生成式AI如何通过其训练过程，将主导文化的认知方式编码为默认的知识基础设施，从而导致少数认知方式的“认知从属”。这种从属并非离散偏见，而是根植于AI架构的深层问题。作者指出，现有法律因其关注点在下游应用层面，无法有效解决这一上游的结构性危害，因此呼吁法律监管应延伸至模型训练层面。
AI.keywords: 认知从属, 生成式AI, 知识基础设施, 偏见, 法律监管
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一个深刻且具有创新性的观点，将生成式AI的偏见问题提升到“认知从属”的哲学和结构性层面，而非仅仅是技术偏差。其重要性在于，它挑战了当前对AI偏见的理解和法律应对框架，强调了从AI设计和训练阶段进行干预的必要性，为未来AI治理提供了新的视角和方向。

title: Beyond Predictive Fairness: Quantifying Attribution Consistency Across Demographic Groups in Diabetic Retinopathy Screening
comments: Accepted for publication at the joint FAIMI, BRIDGE, and EPIMI Workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: Fairness in medical imaging is commonly evaluated through subgroup performance metrics, yet it remains unclear whether models rely on consistent visual evidence across demographic groups. This work introduces the Explanation Consistency Score (ECS), a fairness-aware metric based on Jensen-Shannon divergence that quantifies the similarity of attribution maps across subgroups. Using diabetic retinopathy screening as a case study, ECS is evaluated globally and within disease severity. Experiments reveal that while predictive performance differs across ethnic groups, explanation consistency remains relatively high and shows no significant association with performance disparities. These findings suggest that predictive fairness and explanation consistency capture complementary dimensions of model behavior, motivating fairness evaluations that extend beyond predictive performance.

AI.title_translation: 超越预测公平性：量化糖尿病视网膜病变筛查中跨人口群体的归因一致性
AI.tldr: 本文引入了解释一致性分数（ECS），一个基于Jensen-Shannon散度的公平性度量，用于量化不同人口群体间归因图的相似性。研究发现，在糖尿病视网膜病变筛查中，尽管预测性能存在差异，解释一致性仍相对较高且与性能差异无显著关联，表明预测公平性和解释一致性是模型行为的互补维度。
AI.motivation: 在医学影像领域，公平性通常通过亚组性能指标来评估，但模型是否依赖于跨人口群体的视觉证据一致性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 本文引入了解释一致性分数（ECS），这是一个基于Jensen-Shannon散度的公平性感知度量，用于量化跨亚组归因图的相似性。以糖尿病视网膜病变筛查为例，在全球和疾病严重程度内部评估了ECS。
AI.result: 实验表明，尽管预测性能在不同族裔群体之间存在差异，但解释一致性保持相对较高，并且与性能差异没有显著关联。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明，预测公平性和解释一致性捕捉了模型行为的互补维度，促使公平性评估超越预测性能。

AI.keywords: 预测公平性, 解释一致性, 糖尿病视网膜病变, 归因图, 机器学习公平性
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了“解释一致性分数”（ECS），将公平性评估的视角从单纯的预测性能扩展到了模型决策过程的透明度和一致性。它揭示了模型在不同群体间可能存在预测性能差异，但其内部的决策逻辑（归因）却可能是一致的，这为理解和提升AI模型的公平性提供了新的维度和工具。该研究对于开发更值得信赖和负责任的医疗AI系统具有重要意义。

title: Enhancing Distance-Based Graph Autoencoders with Structural Penalties for Dynamic Graph Embedding
summary: Graph autoencoders (GAEs) are widely used for learning representations of dynamic graphs. However, their optimisation objectives typically do not take structural heterogeneity across nodes into account. We propose three distance-based GAE variants that incorporate structural penalties into the reconstruction loss. All variants share a two-layer Graph Convolutional Network encoder and a Euclidean-distance decoder trained with distance-based reconstruction objectives. We extend sparsity-corrected loss with two node-level regularization terms: (i) a hub penalty based on degree centrality, and (ii) a penalty based on Natural Community Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (NC-LID). The paper is motivated by prior evidence linking high NC-LID to reduced embedding quality. The proposed methods are designed to emphasize reconstruction errors for structurally ambiguous nodes. Experiments on multiple dynamic graph data sets show that incorporating NC-LID-based regularization consistently improves reconstruction performance over the baseline without structural regularization and the method using hub-aware regularization. These findings highlight NC-LID as a useful structural signal for enhancing distance-based graph autoencoders in dynamic settings.

AI.title_translation: 用于动态图嵌入的基于结构的正则化图自编码器增强
AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种改进的图自编码器（GAE）方法，通过在重建损失中加入基于节点结构特征（如度中心性和社区内在维度NC-LID）的惩罚项，来提升动态图的节点表示学习能力。实验表明，NC-LID正则化能有效提高重建性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的图自编码器在学习动态图表示时，通常忽略了节点间的结构异质性，这可能影响嵌入质量。该研究受到NC-LID与嵌入质量之间关系的启发，旨在通过引入结构惩罚来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出三种基于距离的图自编码器变体，它们使用两层图卷积网络作为编码器，欧氏距离作为解码器。在重建损失中加入了两种节点级别的正则化项：基于度中心性的Hub惩罚，以及基于自然社区局部内在维度（NC-LID）的惩罚。
AI.result: 在多个动态图数据集上的实验表明，引入基于NC-LID的正则化项能够持续地提高重建性能，优于不含结构正则化的基线方法和仅使用Hub惩罚的方法。
AI.conclusion: NC-LID是一种有用的结构信号，可以有效增强动态图设置下的基于距离的图自编码器。通过将NC-LID正则化纳入模型，可以显著提升图表示学习的性能。
AI.translation: 图自编码器（GAEs）广泛用于学习动态图的表示。然而，它们的优化目标通常不考虑节点间的结构异质性。我们提出了三种基于距离的GAE变体，将结构惩罚纳入重建损失。所有变体共享一个两层图卷积网络编码器和一个欧氏距离解码器，通过基于距离的重建目标进行训练。我们将稀疏性校正损失扩展了两个节点级别的正则化项：（i）基于度中心性的Hub惩罚；（ii）基于自然社区局部内在维度（NC-LID）的惩罚。该研究的动机是先前的证据将高NC-LID与降低的嵌入质量联系起来。所提出的方法旨在强调结构上模糊的节点的重建误差。在多个动态图数据集上的实验表明，与不含结构正则化的基线方法和使用Hub正则化的方法相比，结合基于NC-LID的正则化在重建性能上始终得到改善。这些发现凸显了NC-LID作为一种有用的结构信号，可以增强动态环境中的基于距离的图自编码器。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种改进的图自编码器（GAE）方法，通过在重建损失中引入基于节点结构特征（如度中心性和NC-LID）的惩罚项，来增强动态图的节点表示学习。实验证明，NC-LID正则化在提高重建性能方面优于基线和Hub惩罚方法，表明其在动态图嵌入中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 图自编码器, 动态图嵌入, 结构正则化, NC-LID, 重建损失
AI.comments: 这项研究有效地解决了现有图自编码器在处理动态图时忽略节点结构异质性的问题。通过引入NC-LID等结构信息作为正则化项，显著提升了模型的重建性能，为动态图表示学习提供了新的思路。然而，计算NC-LID可能带来的额外开销以及该方法在更大规模图上的可扩展性有待进一步研究。

title: GateDiffInt: Gate-Mediated Controllable Diffusion and Multi-Intent LLM Distillation for User Behavior Modeling
summary: Existing ranking models encode intent only implicitly, making it hard to disentangle structured intents of varying strength and temporal scale. Noise and intent in behavior sequences are mutually reinforcing---we call this Noise--Intent Coupling (NIC). Noise dilutes true intents, while the lack of structured intent priors leaves denoising without a clear target.To address NIC, we propose GateDiffInt, an intent interaction framework for industrial ranking. It uses the final conversion signal to jointly align sequence denoising and intent extraction. GateDiffInt applies a controllable forward diffusion process with dual gating to enhance and denoise behavior sequences. A large language model then acts as teacher to distill four structured intents---long-term, short-term, latent, and conversion---into a lightweight student model. The enhanced sequence and structured intent representations are deeply fused via attention to produce intent-aware representations for conversion-rate prediction.Extensive experiments on public and large-scale industrial datasets show consistent gains over strong baselines. In online A/B tests serving hundreds of millions of daily active users, GateDiffInt delivers substantial GMV improvements and has been deployed to primary traffic, confirming both effectiveness and production readiness.

AI.title_translation: GateDiffInt：门控可控扩散与多意图LLM蒸馏用于用户行为建模
AI.tldr: GateDiffInt提出了一种新的意图交互框架，通过门控可控扩散对行为序列进行去噪和增强，并利用LLM蒸馏出四种结构化意图，以解决现有排序模型中隐式意图编码和噪声-意图耦合（NIC）问题，并在大规模工业应用中取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 现有排序模型仅隐式编码用户意图，难以解耦不同强度和时间尺度的结构化意图。行为序列中的噪声和意图相互增强，形成“噪声-意图耦合”（NIC），噪声稀释了真实意图，而缺乏结构化意图先验使得去噪缺乏明确目标。
AI.method: GateDiffInt是一个用于工业排序的意图交互框架，它利用最终转化信号共同对齐序列去噪和意图提取。它采用双门控的可控前向扩散过程来增强和去噪行为序列。然后，一个大型语言模型（LLM）作为教师模型，将长期、短期、潜在和转化四种结构化意图蒸馏到一个轻量级学生模型中。增强的序列和结构化意图表示通过注意力机制深度融合，以生成用于转化率预测的意图感知表示。
AI.result: 在公共和大规模工业数据集上的广泛实验表明，GateDiffInt始终优于强大的基线模型。在服务数亿日活跃用户的在线A/B测试中，GateDiffInt带来了显著的GMV提升，并已部署到主流量，证实了其有效性和生产就绪性。
AI.conclusion: GateDiffInt通过门控可控扩散和多意图LLM蒸馏有效解决了用户行为建模中的噪声-意图耦合问题，能够提取结构化意图并显著提升工业排序性能，已成功部署到实际生产环境。
AI.translation: 现有排序模型仅隐式编码意图，这使得解耦不同强度和时间尺度的结构化意图变得困难。行为序列中的噪声和意图相互增强——我们称之为噪声-意图耦合（NIC）。噪声稀释了真实意图，而缺乏结构化意图先验使得去噪没有明确目标。为了解决NIC问题，我们提出了GateDiffInt，一个用于工业排序的意图交互框架。它利用最终转化信号共同对齐序列去噪和意图提取。GateDiffInt采用双门控的可控前向扩散过程来增强和去噪行为序列。然后，一个大型语言模型充当教师，将长期、短期、潜在和转化四种结构化意图蒸馏到一个轻量级学生模型中。增强的序列和结构化意图表示通过注意力机制深度融合，以生成用于转化率预测的意图感知表示。在公共和大规模工业数据集上的广泛实验表明，GateDiffInt始终优于强大的基线模型。在服务数亿日活跃用户的在线A/B测试中，GateDiffInt带来了显著的GMV大幅提升，并已部署到主流量，证实了其有效性和生产就绪性。
AI.summary: GateDiffInt是一个新颖的工业排序意图交互框架，旨在解决用户行为建模中隐式意图编码和噪声-意图耦合（NIC）问题。它通过结合双门控的可控扩散过程来增强和去噪行为序列，并利用大型语言模型（LLM）蒸馏出长期、短期、潜在和转化四种结构化用户意图。这些增强的序列和结构化意图表示通过注意力机制深度融合，用于转化率预测。在公共和大规模工业数据集以及在线A/B测试中，GateDiffInt展示了优于现有基线的性能，并已成功部署到实际生产环境，带来了显著的GMV提升。
AI.keywords: 用户行为建模, 意图建模, 扩散模型, LLM蒸馏, 排序模型
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“噪声-意图耦合”（NIC）问题，并提出了一个结合可控扩散和LLM蒸馏的独特解决方案。通过双门控扩散过程进行序列去噪和增强，以及利用LLM提取多维度结构化意图，有效提升了用户行为建模的准确性。其在工业界大规模部署并取得显著GMV提升的成果，进一步验证了其实用价值和先进性。

title: Learning Canonical Register Automata over Ordered Data Domains
summary: Register automata are finite automata equipped with memory that recognize data languages over infinite alphabets. In this work, we investigate active learning algorithms for deterministic register automata (DRAs) over ordered data domains--covering both dense domains, such as the rationals, and non-dense domains such as the integers. We show that the active learning problem for DRAs over both dense and non-dense ordered domains can be treated within a single unified framework. More specifically, we develop and implement a polynomial-time active learning procedure for DRAs over ordered domains, using oracles for membership, equivalence and memorability queries. The memorability queries were originally introduced for learning DRAs over domains with identity tests. Our unified framework also leads to a new consequence: minimization of DRAs over the non-dense ordered domain of integers is decidable, extending a result previously known only for dense domains. Finally, we give improved complexity bounds of several decision problems for DRAs over ordered domains that are closely related to the queries used in active learning.

AI.title_translation: 有序数据域上的规范寄存器自动机学习
AI.tldr: 本文研究了有序数据域（包括稠密和非稠密）上确定性寄存器自动机（DRAs）的主动学习算法，提出了一个统一的框架，并证明了非稠密整数域上DRAs最小化的可判定性。
AI.motivation: 寄存器自动机能够识别无限字母表上的数据语言。本文旨在研究并开发针对有序数据域（包括稠密和非稠密）上的确定性寄存器自动机（DRAs）的主动学习算法。
AI.method: 提出并实现了一个多项式时间的主动学习过程，用于有序域上的DRAs，利用了成员查询、等价查询和可记忆性查询的预言机。该方法采用了一个统一的框架来处理稠密和非稠密有序域。
AI.result:
1. 为稠密和非稠密有序域上的DRAs主动学习提供了一个统一的框架。
2. 证明了非稠密整数有序域上DRAs的最小化是可判定的，扩展了先前仅适用于稠密域的结果。
3. 改进了与主动学习查询密切相关的有序域上DRAs的几个决策问题的复杂性界限。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功地为有序数据域上的DRAs主动学习提供了一个统一且高效的框架，并扩展了相关理论结果，特别是在非稠密整数域上的最小化问题。
AI.translation: 寄存器自动机是配备内存的有限自动机，可以识别无限字母表上的数据语言。在这项工作中，我们研究了在有序数据域（涵盖稠密域，如高精度有理数，以及非稠密域，如整数）上确定性寄存器自动机（DRAs）的主动学习算法。我们表明，在稠密和非稠密有序域上DRAs的主动学习问题可以在一个统一的框架内处理。更具体地说，我们开发并实现了一个多项式时间的主动学习过程，用于有序域上的DRAs，利用成员查询、等价查询和可记忆性查询的预言机。可记忆性查询最初是为学习带有身份测试的域上的DRAs而引入的。我们的统一框架也带来了一个新的结果：非稠密整数有序域上DRAs的最小化是可判定的，这扩展了先前仅适用于稠密域的结果。最后，我们改进了与主动学习中使用的查询密切相关的有序域上DRAs的几个决策问题的复杂性界限。
AI.summary: 本文研究了有序数据域上确定性寄存器自动机（DRAs）的主动学习问题，提出了一个统一的多项式时间学习框架，该框架适用于稠密和非稠密域，并利用了成员、等价和可记忆性查询。该框架不仅统一了学习方法，还证明了非稠密整数域上DRAs最小化的可判定性，并改进了相关决策问题的复杂性界限。
AI.keywords: 寄存器自动机, 主动学习, 有序数据域, 确定性寄存器自动机, 最小化
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个统一的框架来处理有序数据域上DRAs的主动学习，同时涵盖了稠密和非稠密域。通过引入可记忆性查询，该方法能够有效地学习DRAs。此外，将DRAs最小化可判定性从稠密域扩展到非稠密整数域是一个重要的理论贡献，对自动机理论和形式语言学习领域具有重要意义。

title: A shifted energy barrier approach for phase-field modeling of tensile-dominated brittle fracture
summary: The classical AT1 phase-field model contains an intrinsic energy barrier for crack nucle ation, which makes the predicted strength depend on the fracture toughness and the regularization length. For tensile-dominated brittle fracture, this barrier is shifted by mapping the Rankine criterion, evaluated on the effective stress, onto a state-dependent active-energy threshold. The prescribed tensile strength then controls crack nucleation, while the AT1 crack-density functional, stiffness degradation, and degraded stress response remain unchanged. Since the threshold depends on the current stress state, the field equations are derived from a restricted variational principle. A microforce formulation identifies the barrier shift as a dissipative resistance and provides the corresponding lower bound on the regularization length. In one-dimensional tension, closed-form solutions recover the prescribed peak strength and give a cosine-type localization profile that ap proaches the classical AT1 profile as the shift vanishes. Numerical examples show that, within the admissible range, the nucleation load is nearly insensitive to the regularization length and the predicted multiaxial nucleation states follow the Rankine envelope. Under overall compression, crack nucleation remains associated with local tensile stress concen trations. The formulation also captures the transition from strength-controlled failure for small flaws to the LEFM limit for large cracks.

AI.title_translation: 张力主导的脆性断裂的相位场模型的移位能垒方法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种移位能垒方法来改进AT1相位场模型，以更好地模拟张力主导的脆性断裂。该方法通过将Rankine准则映射到能量阈值来控制裂纹成核，从而使预测强度与断裂韧性和正则化长度无关。该方法在数值模拟中表现良好，能够准确预测峰值强度、裂纹成核行为以及大裂纹情况下的断裂力学极限。
AI.motivation: 经典AT1相位场模型在模拟脆性断裂时，其预测强度会受到断裂韧性和正则化长度的影响，这在实际应用中存在局限性。本研究旨在提出一种新的方法，以克服这些限制，并实现对张力主导的脆性断裂更准确的模拟。
AI.method: 提出了一种移位能垒方法，通过将Rankine准则映射到状态相关的能量阈值来修改AT1相位场模型。该方法通过一个受限的变分原理推导了场方程，并使用微力公式来识别能垒移位作为耗散阻力。
AI.result: 在单轴拉伸情况下，该方法能够精确恢复设定的峰值强度，并得到余弦类型的局部化剖面。数值算例表明，在允许范围内，成核载荷对正则化长度不敏感，并且预测的多轴成核状态符合Rankine包络。该方法还能捕捉从细小裂纹的强度控制失效到大裂纹的线弹性断裂力学极限的过渡。
AI.conclusion: 移位能垒方法成功地改进了AT1相位场模型，使其能够独立于断裂韧性和正则化长度来控制张力主导的脆性断裂的裂纹成核。该方法在数值模拟中表现出良好的准确性和鲁棒性，并能捕捉不同尺度裂纹的断裂行为。
AI.translation: 经典的AT1相位场模型包含一个固有的裂纹成核能量势垒，这使得预测强度依赖于断裂韧性和正则化长度。对于张力主导的脆性断裂，该势垒通过将基于有效应力评估的Rankine准则映射到一个与状态相关的激活能量阈值而被移位。预设的拉伸强度控制着裂纹成核，而AT1裂纹密度泛函、刚度退化和退化的应力响应则保持不变。由于阈值取决于当前的应力状态，因此场方程是从一个受限的变分原理推导出来的。微力公式将势垒移位识别为一种耗散阻力，并给出了相应的正则化长度下限。在单轴拉伸中，闭式解恢复了设定的峰值强度，并给出了一个余弦类型的局部化剖面，当移位消失时，该剖面趋近于经典的AT1剖面。数值算例表明，在允许的范围内，成核载荷对正则化长度几乎不敏感，并且预测的多轴成核状态遵循Rankine包络。在整体受压情况下，裂纹成核仍然与局部拉伸应力集中有关。该公式还捕捉了从细小裂纹的强度控制失效到大裂纹的线弹性断裂力学（LEFM）极限的过渡。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种移位能垒方法来改进AT1相位场模型，以解决其在模拟张力主导的脆性断裂时预测强度依赖于断裂韧性和正则化长度的问题。该方法通过将Rankine准则映射到一个状态相关的能量阈值来控制裂纹成核，从而使预测的拉伸强度由设定的值控制，而不受其他参数的影响。该方法从受限的变分原理推导得出，并能准确预测单轴和多轴拉伸下的裂纹成核行为，以及从细小裂纹到大裂纹的断裂行为的过渡。数值结果表明，该方法对正则化长度不敏感，并符合Rankine包络。
AI.keywords: 相位场模型, 脆性断裂, 移位能垒, Rankine准则, 裂纹成核
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的移位能垒方法，有效地解决了经典AT1相位场模型在模拟脆性断裂时预测强度依赖于模型参数的问题。该方法通过引入状态相关的能量阈值，实现了对裂纹成核的精确控制，并能准确预测不同加载条件和裂纹尺寸下的断裂行为。这对于需要精确预测材料强度和断裂行为的工程应用具有重要意义。然而，该方法在计算效率方面可能需要进一步优化，并且在处理复杂几何形状和多裂纹扩展方面仍有待验证。

title: Gradient Mirage: Trainable yet Label-Unidentifiable Gradients in Large Language Model Split Learning
summary: Gradient matching attacks (GMAs) in LLM split learning (SL) rely on a critical yet underexplored assumption: the gradient exposed at the split interface is a faithful derivative of the client's full-label training objective. This gradient-objective consistency allows a curious server to recover private labels by searching for a sequence whose induced gradient explains the observation. We propose Gradient Mirage, a defense that breaks this consistency without discarding the optimization utility of the backward signal. Our key idea is to induce the adversary to solve a misspecified inverse problem, in which no plausible label sequence in the sequence space can explain the observed gradients. Concretely, Gradient Mirage achieves this by inducing inconsistency across three dimensions: objective, direction, and scale. Selective Autoregressive Supervision derives the exposed gradient from a masked surrogate loss rather than the full-label objective assumed by the attacker; Scale Blinding then applies randomized multiplicative rescaling, obscuring the gradient's natural magnitude; and Directional Privatization further randomizes the gradient direction while preserving its magnitude through the von Mises-Fisher (vMF) mechanism under a directional metric differential privacy guarantee. Crucially, utility is preserved: the Top segment still learns from all target tokens via Dual-Track Backpropagation, the exposed gradient remains informative since each supervised token retains its complete autoregressive context, and Bottom-Gradient Recovery restores the effective gradient for Bottom-segment optimization. Extensive experiments show that Gradient Mirage provides substantially stronger protection than existing defenses under comparable fine-tuning performance, achieving a better privacy-utility trade-off.

AI.title_translation: 梯度海市蜃楼：大型语言模型分割学习中可训练但标签不可识别的梯度
AI.tldr: 梯度匹配攻击（GMA）在大型语言模型分割学习（SL）中依赖于梯度与完整标签训练目标的一致性。我们提出了Gradient Mirage防御，通过在目标、方向和尺度上引入不一致性来打破这种一致性，同时保留了反向信号的优化效用，从而提供更好的隐私-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的梯度匹配攻击（GMA）在大型语言模型分割学习（SL）中，依赖于梯度在分割接口处是客户端完整标签训练目标的忠实导数这一关键但未被充分探索的假设。这种梯度与目标的一致性允许服务器通过搜索序列来恢复私有标签。因此，需要一种防御机制来打破这种一致性，同时不损失优化效用。
AI.method:
Gradient Mirage通过诱导对抗者解决一个错误指定（misspecified）的逆问题来打破梯度与目标的一致性。具体而言，它在三个维度上引入不一致性：
1.  **目标不一致性（Objective Inconsistency）**：通过“选择性自回归监督”（Selective Autoregressive Supervision），暴露的梯度来自一个掩蔽的替代损失，而非攻击者假设的完整标签目标。
2.  **尺度不一致性（Scale Inconsistency）**：通过“尺度盲化”（Scale Blinding），应用随机乘法重缩放，模糊了梯度的自然幅度。
3.  **方向不一致性（Directional Inconsistency）**：通过“方向隐私化”（Directional Privatization），在方向度量差分隐私保证下，通过von Mises-Fisher (vMF) 机制随机化梯度方向，同时保留其幅度。
该方法通过“双轨反向传播”（Dual-Track Backpropagation）保留了实用性，确保Top部分从所有目标token学习，每个受监督的token保留完整的自回归上下文，并通过“底部梯度恢复”（Bottom-Gradient Recovery）恢复底部段的有效梯度。
AI.result: 实验表明，在可比的微调性能下，Gradient Mirage比现有防御提供了更强的保护，实现了更好的隐私-效用权衡。
AI.conclusion: Gradient Mirage通过在目标、方向和尺度上引入不一致性，有效地打破了大型语言模型分割学习中梯度匹配攻击所依赖的梯度与训练目标的一致性，从而在保持优化效用的同时，显著增强了隐私保护，并实现了更好的隐私-效用权衡。
AI.translation:
梯度海市蜃楼：大型语言模型分割学习中可训练但标签不可识别的梯度

摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）分割学习（SL）中的梯度匹配攻击（GMA）依赖于一个关键但未被充分探索的假设：在分割接口暴露的梯度是客户端完整标签训练目标的忠实导数。这种梯度与目标的一致性使得好奇的服务器能够通过搜索其诱导梯度解释观察结果的序列来恢复私有标签。我们提出了Gradient Mirage，这是一种在不丢弃反向信号优化效用的情况下打破这种一致性的防御机制。我们的核心思想是诱导对手解决一个错误指定的逆问题，即在序列空间中没有合理的标签序列可以解释观察到的梯度。具体来说，Gradient Mirage通过在三个维度上引入不一致性来实现这一点：目标、方向和尺度。“选择性自回归监督”使暴露的梯度源自一个掩蔽的替代损失，而非攻击者假设的完整标签目标；“尺度盲化”随后应用随机乘法重缩放，模糊了梯度的自然幅度；“方向隐私化”通过在方向度量差分隐私保证下的von Mises-Fisher (vMF) 机制进一步随机化梯度方向，同时保留其幅度。至关重要的是，实用性得到了保留：Top段仍然通过“双轨反向传播”从所有目标token中学习，暴露的梯度仍然具有信息量，因为每个受监督的token都保留了其完整的自回归上下文，并且“底部梯度恢复”恢复了底部段优化的有效梯度。广泛的实验表明，在可比的微调性能下，Gradient Mirage比现有防御提供了更强的保护，实现了更好的隐私-效用权衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Gradient Mirage，一种针对大型语言模型分割学习中梯度匹配攻击的防御机制。该防御通过在目标、方向和尺度上引入不一致性，打破了攻击者所依赖的梯度与完整标签训练目标的一致性。具体方法包括：使用掩蔽替代损失的“选择性自回归监督”；随机重缩放梯度的“尺度盲化”；以及通过vMF机制随机化梯度方向的“方向隐私化”。Gradient Mirage在保留模型优化效用的同时，显著增强了隐私保护，并在实验中展现出比现有防御更好的隐私-效用权衡。
AI.keywords: 梯度匹配攻击, 分割学习, 大型语言模型, 隐私保护, 梯度防御
AI.comments: Gradient Mirage的创新之处在于其通过多维度（目标、方向、尺度）引入不一致性来主动误导攻击者的思路，而非简单地噪声化梯度。它巧妙地将隐私保护融入到训练过程中，通过设计替代损失和梯度处理机制，在保持模型实用性的同时，有效地提高了对标签泄露攻击的鲁棒性。这种方法为分割学习中的隐私保护提供了一个新颖且高效的范式，对于未来分布式AI系统的隐私安全具有重要意义。

title: Readable, Faithful, Used: Three Dissociable Properties of Demographic Identity in a Language Model
summary: Large language models are widely used to simulate survey respondents, yet their answers are homogeneous and unfaithful to real inter-group differences. We ask where demographic group identity lives inside an LLM, how faithfully its geometry mirrors real inter-group opinion structure, and whether it uses what it encodes. Using representational similarity analysis against Pew ground truth over 169 demographic cells, we score 1,089 read-out locations in Mistral-7B and intervene causally across six attribute types. Four results. (1) The standard last-token residual read-out understates the model: attention-head read-outs dominate it in five of six types, with selection-corrected fidelity up to rho=0.63 -- roughly 70% of the measurement-reliability ceiling -- surviving a lexical-similarity control. (2) A single head (L11 H16) is significantly faithful in all six types as a fixed location, while race-based types stay weak and prompt-fragile. Both phenomena replicate -- the analogous head significant in five of six types, weakest on the same race type -- across three checkpoints of a second model family, where ten billion training tokens barely move the map. (3) Causal use does not follow fidelity: the clearest causal pathway sits in one of the least faithful types (p=0.002, cluster-robust, fixed depth), the most faithful type shows no correction-surviving single-layer effect, and replacing the entire identity moves predictions by under 2% of their error. (4) A 128-dimensional probe of the single head lands 21-31% closer to survey truth than the model's own answers -- yet recovers almost none of the per-question group ordering, no better than the answers themselves. Readable, faithfully arranged, and causally used are three dissociable properties of the same model; treating them as one claim is what keeps the "can LLMs simulate populations" debate unresolved.

AI.title_translation: 可读、忠实、被使用：语言模型中人口统计学身份的三种可分离属性
AI.tldr: 研究揭示大模型内部的人口统计学身份表征具有高度忠实度，但该表征与模型的因果生成使用相互脱节，“可读、忠实、被使用”是三种可分离的属性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被广泛用于模拟调查受访者，但其回答同质化且无法忠实反映群体间的真实差异。本研究旨在探索人口统计学群体身份在大模型内部的存储位置、其几何结构是否忠实映射真实群体意见结构，以及模型是否真正使用了所编码的信息。
AI.method: 使用表征相似性分析（RSA），以Pew研究中心关于169个人口统计学分组的真实数据为基准，对Mistral-7B模型中的1,089个读出位置进行评分，并在6种人口属性类型上进行因果干预和探针分析，并在另一模型家族的三个检查点上进行了复现验证。
AI.result: 1) 标准的最后Token残差读出低估了模型性能，注意力头读出在5/6的类型中占优，经校正后的忠实度高达rho=0.63；2) 单个固定注意力头（L11 H16）在所有6种类型中均显著忠实，而基于种族的类型忠实度低且对提示脆弱，该现象在另一模型家族中也得以复现；3) 因果使用与忠实度脱节，最清晰的因果通路出现在忠实度最低的类型之一中，而替换整个身份仅使预测改变了不足2%的误差；4) 对单个注意力头的128维探针结果比模型自身回答更接近真实调查21-31%，但几乎无法恢复具体问题上的群体排序。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部对人口统计学身份的“可读性”、“忠实排列”以及“因果使用”是三种互相分离的属性；将这三者混为一谈是导致关于“大语言模型能否模拟群体”争论不休的关键原因。
AI.translation: 大语言模型被广泛用于模拟调查受访者，但其生成的答案往往同质化，且不能忠实反映真实的群体间差异。我们探究了人口统计学群体身份在大语言模型内部的位置、其表征几何结构在多大程度上忠实地反映了真实的群体间意见结构，以及模型是否使用了其所编码的信息。通过利用表征相似性分析（RSA）对比Pew研究中心在169个人口统计分组上的基准真实数据，我们对Mistral-7B中的1,089个读出位置进行了评分，并跨六种属性类型进行了因果干预。研究得出四个结果：(1) 标准的最后一个token残差读出低估了模型的能力：在六种类型中的五种中，注意力头读出表现更优，选择校正后的忠实度最高达rho=0.63——约为测量可靠性上限的70%——且在词汇相似性控制下依然成立；(2) 单个注意力头（L11 H16）作为固定位置在所有六种类型中均显著忠实，而基于种族的类型忠实度保持较低且易受提示词影响；这两种现象在另一模型家族的三个检查点上均得以复现（相应注意力头在五种类型中显著，且在同一种族类型上最弱），即使增加100亿训练token也几乎没有改变该表征图谱；(3) 因果使用与忠实度并不一致：最清晰的因果通路位于忠实度最低的类型之一（p=0.002，聚类稳健，固定深度），而最忠实的类型在校正后未显示出单层效应，替换整个身份对预测的改变不足其误差的2%；(4) 对单个注意力头进行128维探针探测，其结果比模型自身答案接近调查真实值21-31%，但几乎未能恢复每个问题上的群体排序，表现并不优于模型自身答案。可读、忠实排列与因果使用是同一模型的三个可分离属性；将它们混为一谈正是导致“大语言模型能否模拟群体”这一争论悬而未决的原因。
AI.summary: 本研究探究了大语言模型内部人口统计学群体身份的表征与使用机制。通过对比真实调查数据与模型内部激活，研究发现注意力头能高度忠实地编码群体特征，但表征的高忠实度并未转化为因果生成中的实际使用，揭示了“可读性”、“忠实度”与“因果使用”是模型中三种可分离的属性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 人口统计学身份, 表征相似性分析, 因果干预, 群体模拟
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将大模型内部的人口统计学身份表征解构为“可读性”、“忠实度”和“因果使用”三个独立维度，揭示了表征忠实度高并不意味着模型会在生成中因果使用该信息的深层脱节，为评估大模型模拟人类群体的有效性及内在表征机制提供了重要洞见。

title: To Go Far, Go Together: Diverse Preferences Induce a Curriculum for Reward Optimization
summary: Learning a reward model from human feedback and optimizing a policy against it is one approach to aligning AI systems with individual users. From a fairness perspective, existing work improves such alignment by developing data-efficient and accurate reward models that capture minority preferences despite scarce data. We push this line of inquiry one step further and argue that data-efficient and accurate per-user reward models are not sufficient: users whose reward models are difficult to \textit{optimize} at the policy level can become a new underserved group. We start from the observation that one user's reward model can be easy to optimize from the initial policy while another's is not. We argue that, given a sufficiently diverse user population, a curriculum naturally emerges between easy- and hard-to-optimize reward models. Building on this insight, we propose CurriPO, which grows a tree-structured curriculum to accommodate diverse user-specific objectives, covering the population in a single traversal. Specifically, CurriPO automatically constructs a curriculum over diverse user reward models, allowing it to branch from the existing curriculum and reuse reward models previously incorporated into the curriculum. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to explicitly exploit multi-user structure to address optimization in AI alignment. Extensive experiments on personalized continuous control in a simulated environment show that CurriPO achieves $1.2$--$2.1\times$ the population satisfaction of the strongest baseline while substantially reducing training time. Additional analysis attributes much of this improvement to the users left underserved by conventional optimization.

AI.title_translation: 独行快，众行远：多样化偏好诱导奖励优化的课程学习
AI.tldr: 针对个性化AI对齐中部分用户奖励模型难以优化的问题，CurriPO利用多样化用户群体构建树状课程学习，大幅提升优化效率与边缘用户满意度。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化对齐方法主要关注高效构建用户奖励模型，但忽视了不同用户的奖励模型在策略层面的优化难度差异很大，导致难以优化的用户成为新的‘未充分服务群体’（underserved group）。
AI.method: 提出CurriPO框架，利用群体中易优化与难优化奖励模型之间的天然梯度自动构建树状课程（tree-structured curriculum），支持从现有课程分支并复用先前纳入的奖励模型，在单次遍历中完成对多样化用户目标的有效覆盖与策略优化。
AI.result: 在模拟环境的个性化连续控制实验中，CurriPO实现了最强基线1.2至2.1倍的群体满意度，大幅缩短了训练时间，且主要提升来自于传统优化方法中表现较差的弱势用户群体。
AI.conclusion: 利用多用户群体结构构建课程学习能够有效解决个性化奖励模型在策略优化上的差异与困难，在大幅降低训练成本的同时显著提升了对齐满意度与群体公平性。
AI.translation: 从人类反馈中学习奖励模型并针对其优化策略是使AI系统与个体用户对齐的一种方法。从公平性角度来看，现有工作通过开发数据高效且准确的奖励模型来改善这种对齐，即使在数据稀缺的情况下也能捕捉少数群体的偏好。我们进一步拓展了这一研究方向，并认为仅有数据高效且准确的单用户奖励模型是不够的：那些奖励模型在策略层面难以优化的用户可能会成为新的服务不足群体。我们从这样一个观察出发：某个用户的奖励模型可能从初始策略出发很容易优化，而另一个用户的则不然。我们认为，在给定足够多样化的用户群体的情况下，易优化和难优化的奖励模型之间会自然形成一种课程。基于这一洞察，我们提出了CurriPO，它构建了一个树状结构的课程来适应多样化的用户特定目标，并通过单次遍历覆盖整个人群。具体而言，CurriPO在多样化的用户奖励模型上自动构建课程，允许其从现有课程中分支并复用先前已纳入课程的奖励模型。据我们所知，这是首个明确利用多用户结构来解决AI对齐中优化问题的工作。在模拟环境中的个性化连续控制任务上进行的大量实验表明，CurriPO达到了最强基线1.2到2.1倍的人群满意度，同时大幅缩短了训练时间。进一步的分析将这种提升主要归功于传统优化中未得到充分服务的用户。
AI.summary: 本文针对个性化AI对齐中由于用户奖励模型优化难度不同导致的公平性问题，提出了CurriPO算法。该方法利用用户多样性构建树状课程学习结构，通过由易到难复用并分支奖励模型，有效提升了复杂偏好策略的优化效果与整体群体满意度。
AI.keywords: AI对齐, 强化学习, 课程学习, 个性化偏好, 奖励优化
AI.comments: 该论文切入视角十分新颖，敏锐地指出在AI个性化对齐中不仅存在‘数据偏好建模’的难度，还存在‘策略层优化（可优化性）’的不平等问题。通过巧妙利用多用户偏好的多样性构建课程学习树，兼顾了整体训练效率与对长尾/难优化边缘用户的公平性支持，为多用户RLHF/对齐提供了新的范式。

title: Decisive Margins in Differentially Private Voting
summary: Differential privacy protects individual voting records by injecting randomness into the published outcome, but this noise can lead to erroneous results when an election is close. We study how precise central differential privacy and local differential privacy can be for common voting rules, including Plurality, Condorcet, Maximin, Plurality with Runoff, and Single Transferable Vote (STV). Our measure of precision is the margin of victory needed for a private mechanism to return the same winner as the non-private rule with high probability. We give private algorithms for publishing the winner and prove upper bounds on the required margin for these algorithms. We also prove lower bounds showing that nontrivial margins are necessary; many of these bounds match the corresponding upper bounds up to logarithmic factors. For STV, an information-theoretic upper bound matches the lower bound, but we prove that this guarantee cannot be achieved in polynomial time unless NP $\subseteq$ BPP. This gives a rare example of a computationally tractable task that becomes intractable when one simultaneously requires differential privacy and utility.

AI.title_translation: 差分隐私投票中的决定性胜选优势
AI.tldr: 本文研究了差分隐私下常见投票规则正确选出赢家所需的胜选优势上下界，并揭示了STV规则在满足隐私与效用时会出现计算不可行性。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私通过向发布结果中注入随机噪声来保护个人选票记录，但在选情胶着（势均力敌）时，这种噪声可能导致选出错误的赢家，因此需要研究差分隐私下常见投票规则能够达到的精度极限。
AI.method: 通过定义并分析隐私机制以高概率复现非私有规则赢家所需的“胜选优势”（margin of victory）作为精度度量；针对Plurality、Condorcet、Maximin、Plurality with Runoff及STV等规则设计了中心化和本地差分隐私算法，并利用理论分析证明了所需胜选优势的上下界及计算复杂度硬度。
AI.result: 给出了多种投票规则在CDP和LDP下发布赢家的隐私算法及其所需胜选优势的上界；证明了相应的下界，且多数界在对数因子范围内与上界紧密匹配；针对STV规则，信息论上界虽与下界匹配，但证明了除非 NP ⊆ BPP，否则该保证无法在多项式时间内实现。
AI.conclusion: 在差分隐私投票中，确保正确选举结果需要候选人具备一定的非平凡胜选优势，且不同投票规则的理论界限存在显著差异；同时，隐私与效用的结合可能会使原本计算可行的投票规则在多项式时间内变得不可行。
AI.translation: 差分隐私通过向公布的结果中注入随机性来保护个体投票记录，但在选举势均力敌时，这种噪声可能会导致错误的结果。我们研究了在常见投票规则（包括多数制、孔多塞制、最大最小制、决选多数制和单记可让渡投票制 STV）下，中心化差分隐私和本地差分隐私所能达到的精确度。我们用于衡量精度的指标是胜选优势（margin of victory），即私有机制以高概率返回与非私有规则相同的获胜者所需的优势。我们提出了用于公布获胜者的私有算法，并证明了这些算法所需优势的上界。我们还证明了下界，表明非平凡的胜选优势是必不可少的；其中许多下界与相应的上界在对数因子范围内匹配。对于 STV，信息论上界与下界相匹配，但我们证明除非 NP ⊆ BPP，否则这一保证无法在多项式时间内实现。这提供了一个罕见的例子，即一个在计算上原本可行的任务在同时要求差分隐私和效用时变得不可行。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在中心化和本地差分隐私下各种常见投票规则的精度极限。研究通过“胜选优势”来量化精度，为多数制、孔多塞、最大最小、决选多数制及单记可让渡投票制（STV）等规则提供了算法及上下界分析。研究表明非平凡优势是必需的，并揭示了STV在结合差分隐私与效用要求时会从计算可行转变为计算不可行。
AI.keywords: 差分隐私, 投票规则, 胜选优势, 本地差分隐私, 计算复杂度
AI.comments: 该研究在差分隐私与社会选择理论（投票机制）的交叉领域做出了重要贡献，首次系统性地刻画了多种经典投票规则在CDP和LDP下的胜选优势上下界。特别是在STV规则下证明了隐私与效用同时满足时的计算复杂性硬度结果（NP ⊆ BPP），展示了隐私约束对算法复杂度的本质影响，具有极高的理论价值。

title: MIFR: A Modality-Invariant and Fair Representation Framework for Skin Disease Classification
comments: Accepted for publication at the First Workshop on Advancing African Medical AI through Global Integration (AFRICAI)-MICCAI 2026
summary: Skin diseases represent a major global public health burden, yet machine learning tools developed to assist in their diagnosis suffer from two critical limitations: reliance on only one modality for diagnosis and systematic performance disparities across skin tones. While existing approaches address each challenge separately, this work proposes a modality-invariant framework with fair representation (MIFR) for skin disease classification. The architecture pairs clinical photographs with dermoscopic images using ViT-based encoders, projecting each input into a high-dimensional embedding space via modality-specific projection heads. The resulting model is trained with a five-component multi-objective loss including weighted cross-entropy for classification, confusion and skin-type classification losses for fairness, per-modality supervised contrastive loss for class alignment, and a modality-invariance loss for clinical and dermoscopic modality alignment. Experiments on the HIBA+Derm7pt paired dataset and the external PAD-UFES-20 and ISIC 2019 datasets showed that modality-invariant representation learning provides competitive predictive performance compare to relevant baseline models and competitive fairness on the internal dataset. t-SNE visualizations confirmed that clinical and dermoscopic embeddings of the same disease are geometrically aligned, validating the joint objectives.
comment: Accepted for publication at the First Workshop on Advancing African Medical AI through Global Integration (AFRICAI)-MICCAI 2026

AI.title_translation: MIFR：一种用于皮肤病分类的模态不变和公平表示框架
AI.tldr: MIFR提出了一种模态不变且公平的表示框架，通过结合临床照片和皮肤镜图像来解决皮肤病诊断中对单一模态的依赖以及肤色间的性能差异问题。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习工具在皮肤病诊断中存在两个关键局限性：一是诊断仅依赖单一模态，二是跨肤色存在系统性性能差异。本研究旨在解决这些问题。
AI.method: 本研究提出了一个模态不变且公平表示框架（MIFR）。该架构使用基于ViT的编码器将临床照片和皮肤镜图像配对，并通过模态特定的投影头将每个输入投影到高维嵌入空间。模型采用包含五个组成部分的多目标损失进行训练：用于分类的加权交叉熵、用于公平性的混淆和皮肤类型分类损失、用于类别对齐的每模态监督对比损失，以及用于临床和皮肤镜模态对齐的模态不变性损失。
AI.result: 在HIBA+Derm7pt配对数据集以及外部PAD-UFES-20和ISIC 2019数据集上的实验表明，模态不变表示学习提供了与相关基线模型相比具有竞争力的预测性能，并在内部数据集上实现了具有竞争力的公平性。t-SNE可视化证实了相同疾病的临床和皮肤镜嵌入在几何上对齐，验证了联合目标。
AI.conclusion: 模态不变表示学习在皮肤病分类中展现出与基线模型相当的预测性能和公平性，并成功地对齐了不同模态的嵌入。
AI.translation: 皮肤病是全球主要的公共卫生负担，然而，用于辅助诊断的机器学习工具存在两个关键局限性：诊断仅依赖单一模态，以及跨肤色存在系统性性能差异。尽管现有方法分别解决了这些挑战，但本工作提出了一种模态不变且公平表示框架（MIFR），用于皮肤病分类。该架构使用基于ViT的编码器将临床照片与皮肤镜图像配对，通过模态特定的投影头将每个输入投影到高维嵌入空间。所得模型采用包含五个组成部分的多目标损失进行训练，包括用于分类的加权交叉熵、用于公平性的混淆和皮肤类型分类损失、用于类别对齐的每模态监督对比损失，以及用于临床和皮肤镜模态对齐的模态不变性损失。在HIBA+Derm7pt配对数据集以及外部PAD-UFES-20和ISIC 2019数据集上的实验表明，模态不变表示学习提供了与相关基线模型相比具有竞争力的预测性能，并在内部数据集上实现了具有竞争力的公平性。t-SNE可视化证实了相同疾病的临床和皮肤镜嵌入在几何上对齐，验证了联合目标。
AI.summary: 本论文提出MIFR框架，旨在解决皮肤病诊断中单一模态依赖和肤色间性能不公的问题。该框架结合临床照片和皮肤镜图像，利用基于ViT的编码器和多目标损失进行训练，以实现模态不变性、公平性和高分类性能。实验结果证实了其在预测性能和公平性方面的竞争力，并通过t-SNE可视化验证了不同模态嵌入的对齐。
AI.keywords: 皮肤病分类, 模态不变性, 公平表示, 多模态学习, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于其首次提出了一个统一的框架来同时解决皮肤病诊断中的模态依赖和公平性两大挑战。通过引入模态不变性损失和公平性损失，MIFR能够学习到更鲁棒和公正的表示，这对于实际医疗应用具有重要意义。

title: GraphK: Variable-Size Graph Generation with Efficient Edge Construction
summary: Graph generation models have advanced significantly with deep learning, yet they remain limited in scalability, flexibility, and ability to model underlying structures. We present GraphK, a novel encoder-sampler-decoder framework for graph generation that overcomes these challenges through structural flexibility and computational efficiency. Unlike autoregressive approaches constrained by vocabulary size (i.e. number of nodes in graph generation), GraphK allows for both upscaling (generating graphs with more nodes than the input) and downscaling, providing a flexible control over output graph size. By learning permutation-invariant latent representations and sampling new node embeddings via maximum likelihood estimation, GraphK generalizes across graph sizes and structures. For edge generation, we employ edge prediction with a KDTree-based top-k neighbor search in the latent space, reducing computational cost. Based on the manifold smoothness assumption, our method effectively captures graph properties. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that GraphK outperforms existing methods, accurately learns graph structures, and generates synthetic graphs without explicit definitions.

AI.title_translation: GraphK：高效边缘构建的可变大小图生成
AI.tldr: GraphK是一个新的编码器-采样器-解码器框架，用于生成可变大小的图，并通过KDTree加速边缘构建，解决了现有图生成模型在可扩展性、灵活性和结构建模方面的限制。

AI.result: 实验表明GraphK优于现有方法，能准确学习图结构，并在没有明确定义的情况下生成合成图。
AI.conclusion: GraphK通过结构灵活性和计算效率，克服了现有图生成模型在可扩展性、灵活性和建模底层结构方面的挑战，实现了可变大小图的生成和高效的边缘构建。

AI.summary: 本文提出了GraphK，一个新颖的编码器-采样器-解码器框架，用于解决现有图生成模型在可扩展性、灵活性和结构建模方面的局限性。GraphK通过学习置换不变的潜在表示和采样新的节点嵌入，实现了可变大小图的生成，并利用基于KDTree的top-k邻居搜索在潜在空间中进行高效的边缘预测。实验证明GraphK在图结构学习和合成图生成方面优于现有方法。

AI.comments: GraphK的创新之处在于其编码器-采样器-解码器框架，特别是它如何通过学习置换不变的潜在表示实现可变大小的图生成，以及利用KDTree进行高效的边缘构建，显著提升了图生成模型的灵活性和计算效率。

title: Engineering Psychological Safety in Autonomous Vehicles: A Systems-Theoretic Framework for Psychological Safety in Autonomous Vehicles and its Validation in Real-World Scenarios
summary: Despite rapid technological advances, the societal acceptability of autonomous vehicles (AVs) remains limited by psychological barriers that extend beyond traditional concerns of physical safety. While factors such as trust and perceived safety are known to influence user acceptance, there is a lack of formalized mechanisms and engineering methods to systematically identify, assess, and mitigate psychological risks arising from human-AV interactions. To address this gap, this work proposes and validates a systems-theoretic framework for the assessment of psychological safety in autonomous vehicles. First, a comprehensive psychological safety risk model is defined, extending the Systems-Theoretic Accident Model and Processes (STAMP) to incorporate key psychological constructs such as trust, perceived control, predictability, and perceived support. Based on this model, a hazard analysis method (AV-PsySafe) is developed to systematically identify psychological hazards, unsafe control actions, and loss scenarios, while introducing a Psychological Safety Integrity Level (PsySIL) to support risk prioritization. Second, the applicability and relevance of the framework are evaluated through its deployment in realistic autonomous vehicle scenarios. A structured validation approach is implemented, including a methodological guide, standardized analysis templates, and the collection of analyst feedback. The results demonstrate that the framework can be consistently applied by practitioners, producing meaningful insights into psychological risks. Overall, this work establishes both the theoretical foundations and practical feasibility of a unified approach to co-assessing psychological and physical safety in autonomous systems, contributing to more human-centred and trustworthy AV development.

AI.title_translation: 在自动驾驶汽车中构建心理安全：自动驾驶汽车心理安全的系统理论框架及其在真实场景中的验证
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个系统理论框架，用于评估自动驾驶汽车中的心理安全，并通过在真实场景中的部署验证了其适用性，旨在解决自动驾驶汽车社会接受度受心理障碍限制的问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管技术进步迅速，但自动驾驶汽车的社会接受度仍受到超出传统物理安全担忧的心理障碍限制。目前缺乏形式化的机制和工程方法来系统地识别、评估和缓解人机交互中产生的心理风险。
AI.method: 1. 定义了一个综合的心理安全风险模型，扩展了系统理论事故模型和过程（STAMP），纳入了信任、感知控制、可预测性和感知支持等关键心理构造。2. 基于此模型，开发了一种危害分析方法（AV-PsySafe），用于系统识别心理危害、不安全控制行为和损失情景，并引入了心理安全完整性等级（PsySIL）以支持风险优先级排序。3. 通过在现实自动驾驶汽车场景中部署该框架，评估了其适用性和相关性，包括实施结构化验证方法、标准化分析模板和收集分析师反馈。
AI.result: 该框架可由实践者一致应用，对心理风险产生了有意义的洞察。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为自动驾驶系统中心理和物理安全协同评估的统一方法奠定了理论基础和实践可行性，有助于开发更以人为本、更值得信赖的自动驾驶汽车。

title: SIDScope: A Diagnostic Resource for Semantic-ID Interfaces in Generative Recommendation
summary: Semantic-ID mappings are reusable interfaces between item tokenizers and generative recommenders, yet released mappings rarely state whether they are coherent, what structure they expose, how generated paths resolve, or what must be revalidated after a refresh. SIDScope is a source-traced diagnostic resource for these decisions. It normalizes item-to-code artifacts, verifies provenance and joins, profiles mapping structure, compares paired revisions, and accounts for path-to-item outcomes in generated traces. Across nine source-traced tokenizer exports from seven families on Amazon and Yelp data - eight executable routes plus one auditable snapshot - SIDScope reveals that interface health is multi-signal rather than scalar. Its central finding is mechanism-conditional: prefix alignment strongly tracks held-out candidate exposure when retrieval consumes SID prefixes, then weakens as scoring becomes prefix-independent. Trained trace accounting exposes a second hidden gap: a valid target path can survive without uniquely retrieving the target item by 1.2-3.0 percentage points. A refresh case establishes a third: repairing the mapping does not by itself restore an inherited generator; model reuse requires a separate handoff check. The package provides frozen evidence summaries, conformance reports, trace labels, table builders, and CPU-only verifiers. It supports decisions about artifact readiness, interface risks, and revalidation before model reuse.

AI.title_translation: SIDScope：生成式推荐中语义ID接口的诊断资源
AI.tldr: SIDScope是一个诊断工具，用于评估生成式推荐系统中语义ID接口的健康状况，揭示了接口健康是多信号的，并发现了前缀对齐、目标检索和模型复用方面的隐藏问题。
AI.motivation: 语义ID映射是项目分词器和生成式推荐器之间可重用的接口，但现有的映射很少说明其一致性、结构、生成路径解析方式或刷新后需要重新验证的内容。本研究的动机是创建一个诊断资源来解决这些决策问题。
AI.method: SIDScope通过以下方式运作：规范化项目到代码的工件，验证来源和连接，分析映射结构，比较配对修订，并解释生成轨迹中的路径到项目结果。它在亚马逊和Yelp数据上，对七个家族的九个源追踪分词器导出（八条可执行路径加一个可审计快照）进行了分析。该软件包提供冻结的证据摘要、符合性报告、追踪标签、表格构建器和仅CPU的验证器。
AI.result: SIDScope揭示了接口健康是多信号而非单一标量。其核心发现是机制条件性的：当检索消耗SID前缀时，前缀对齐与保留候选曝光密切相关，而在评分变得前缀无关时则减弱。训练的追踪会计暴露了第二个隐藏差距：一个有效的目标路径可以在不唯一检索目标项目的情况下存活1.2-3.0个百分点。一个刷新案例建立了第三个发现：修复映射本身并不能恢复继承的生成器；模型复用需要单独的交接检查。
AI.conclusion: SIDScope为生成式推荐系统中的语义ID接口提供了一个全面的诊断资源，揭示了接口健康的多信号特性以及与前缀对齐、目标检索和模型复用相关的关键隐藏问题。它支持在模型复用之前做出关于工件准备情况、接口风险和重新验证的决策。
AI.translation: 语义ID映射是项目分词器和生成式推荐器之间可重用的接口，但已发布的映射很少说明它们是否连贯，它们暴露出什么结构，生成的路径如何解析，或者刷新后必须重新验证什么。SIDScope是针对这些决策的源追踪诊断资源。它规范化项目到代码的工件，验证来源和连接，分析映射结构，比较配对修订，并解释生成轨迹中的路径到项目结果。通过对亚马逊和Yelp数据上七个家族的九个源追踪分词器导出——八条可执行路径加一个可审计快照——SIDScope揭示了接口健康是多信号而非单一标量。其核心发现是机制条件性的：当检索消耗SID前缀时，前缀对齐强烈追踪保留候选曝光，然后在评分变得前缀无关时减弱。训练的追踪会计暴露了第二个隐藏差距：一个有效的目标路径可以在不唯一检索目标项目的情况下存活1.2-3.0个百分点。一个刷新案例建立了第三个：修复映射本身并不能恢复继承的生成器；模型复用需要单独的交接检查。该软件包提供冻结的证据摘要、符合性报告、追踪标签、表格构建器和仅CPU的验证器。它支持在模型复用之前做出关于工件准备情况、接口风险和重新验证的决策。
AI.summary: SIDScope是一个诊断工具，用于评估生成式推荐系统中语义ID接口的健康状况。它通过规范化工件、验证来源、分析结构和追踪生成结果来工作。研究发现接口健康是多信号的，并揭示了前缀对齐对检索的影响，目标路径未能唯一检索目标项的差距，以及修复映射后模型复用需额外检查的问题。该工具提供报告和验证器，以支持关于接口风险和模型复用前重新验证的决策。
AI.keywords: 语义ID接口, 生成式推荐, 诊断工具, SIDScope, 接口健康
AI.comments: 该论文提出SIDScope，为生成式推荐系统的语义ID接口提供了一个急需的诊断工具。其创新之处在于通过多信号分析揭示了接口健康状况的复杂性，并识别出前缀对齐、目标检索唯一性和模型复用手交接等关键但常被忽视的问题。这对于提高生成式推荐系统的可靠性和可维护性具有重要意义。该工具的实际应用价值在于其能够帮助开发者在模型复用前评估工件准备情况和接口风险，从而减少潜在的错误。

title: A Real-Time Tsetlin Machine-based Non-intrusive Load Monitoring System on MCUs
comments: Accepted by International Symposium on the Tsetlin Machine (ISTM 2026)
summary: Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) systems estimate individual appliance energy consumption from a single aggregate meter, without requiring separate sensors for each device. By installing a single meter that measures a building's total electricity consumption, NILM algorithms can determine the active status of each appliance. However, traditional NILM systems use computationally intensive optimization algorithms to process offline data, limiting their capability for on-device deployment, where sensitive household data must be processed locally. This paper proposes a Tsetlin Machine (TM)-based NILM framework, targeting real-time applications on resource-constrained microcontrollers (MCUs), enabling privacy-preserving edge deployment. The problem is reformulated as a classification task, and the proposed approach achieves an average precision of 90% and recall of 96% for two-appliance classification, and 77% precision and 80% recall for four appliances on the REDD dataset. The trained model occupies only 18 KB of flash memory and achieves an inference latency of 0.43 ms on an ESP32, demonstrating its suitability for embedded NILM applications on MCUs.

AI.title_translation: 基于Tsetlin机器的实时非侵入式负荷监测系统在微控制器上的实现
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Tsetlin机器的实时非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）框架，可在资源受限的微控制器（MCU）上实现，具有高精度、低内存占用和低延迟，支持边缘隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 传统的非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）系统使用计算密集型优化算法处理离线数据，限制了其在设备上的部署能力，尤其是在需要本地处理敏感家庭数据以保护隐私的场景下。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种基于Tsetlin机器（TM）的NILM框架，将问题重新表述为分类任务，旨在实现资源受限微控制器（MCU）上的实时应用，以支持隐私保护的边缘部署。
AI.result: 该方法在REDD数据集上，对于两电器分类实现了90%的平均精度和96%的召回率；对于四电器分类实现了77%的精度和80%的召回率。训练后的模型仅占用18 KB闪存，并在ESP32上实现了0.43 ms的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在资源受限的微控制器上实现了高效、隐私保护的非侵入式负荷监测，具有低内存占用和低推理延迟，非常适用于嵌入式NILM应用。
AI.translation: 非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）系统通过单个聚合电表估算每个电器的能耗，无需为每个设备安装单独的传感器。通过安装测量建筑物总用电量的单个电表，NILM算法可以确定每个电器的运行状态。然而，传统的NILM系统使用计算密集型优化算法来处理离线数据，限制了其在设备上部署的能力，尤其是在需要本地处理敏感家庭数据以保护隐私的场景下。本文提出了一种基于Tsetlin机器（TM）的NILM框架，旨在实现资源受限微控制器（MCU）上的实时应用，从而实现隐私保护的边缘部署。该问题被重新表述为分类任务，所提出的方法在REDD数据集上，对于两电器分类实现了90%的平均精度和96%的召回率，对于四电器分类实现了77%的精度和80%的召回率。训练后的模型仅占用18 KB闪存，并在ESP32上实现了0.43 ms的推理延迟，这表明其非常适合在MCU上进行嵌入式NILM应用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的基于Tsetlin机器的非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）系统，专门针对资源受限的微控制器（MCU）进行实时部署。该系统将NILM问题转化为分类任务，克服了传统NILM系统计算密集且不适用于设备端部署的局限性。实验结果表明，该系统在精度、内存占用和推理延迟方面表现出色，有效支持了隐私保护的边缘计算应用。
AI.keywords: 非侵入式负荷监测, Tsetlin机器, 微控制器, 实时系统, 边缘计算
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将Tsetlin机器应用于NILM任务，并成功将其部署到资源受限的微控制器上，解决了传统NILM系统在实时性和隐私保护方面的挑战。该方法为边缘计算和智能家居领域提供了一个高效且可行的解决方案，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: On the quantum communication complexity of total functions
summary: We present a total function with a polylogarithmic two-message quantum protocol, whereas every randomised protocol, even with arbitrarily many rounds, requires polynomial communication.

AI.title_translation: 关于全函数的量子通信复杂度

AI.motivation: 探索量子通信在特定计算任务上相比经典随机通信的优势。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个具有特定通信复杂度的全函数，并分析了其量子协议和随机协议的通信复杂度。
AI.result: 存在一个全函数，可以通过多对数复杂度的两消息量子协议实现，而任何随机协议（即使有任意多轮）都需要多项式通信复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 量子通信在某些全函数问题上比经典随机通信具有显著的通信效率优势。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个具有多对数两消息量子协议的全函数，而每个随机协议，即使有任意多轮，也需要多项式通信。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个全函数，证明了其量子通信协议仅需多对数级的通信量和两轮消息，而任何随机经典协议，无论轮次多少，都需要多项式级的通信量，从而突显了量子通信在特定任务上的显著优势。
AI.keywords: 量子通信复杂度, 全函数, 随机协议, 量子优势
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过展示一个具体的全函数，明确地量化了量子通信相对于经典随机通信在通信复杂度上的优势，对量子计算和通信领域的理论研究具有重要意义。

title: Scoring and Gamification to Encourage Sustainable Use of Compute Clusters
comments: 5 pages, 1 figures. Accepted at the 2nd International Workshop on Low Carbon Computing (LOCO 2026), Lancaster University, United Kingdom, 10-11 September 2026. Part of the LOCO 2026 proceedings, arXiv:LOCO2026/P01
summary: The environmental cost of computing continues to grow, yet behaviour change remains limited. We present a composite sustainability score integrating average carbon intensity, resource utilisation, and embodied emissions into a single 0-100 metric designed for gamified feedback. Each component rewards a different dimension of sustainable behaviour: carbon-aware workload shifting, high resource utilisation, and selecting hardware that is commonly underutilised. This scoring system is built into an existing cluster management interface and underpins three dashboard conditions: raw metrics, composite score, and a gamified tree visualisation, which we are planning to evaluate in a 12-week within-subjects study with approximately 35 researchers. Furthermore, we open the discussion on the challenge of defining computational work `goodness' in the context of sustainability scores.
