AI.title_translation: 从威胁情报到检测：用于自动化生成 Sigma 规则的知识驱动丰富与基于模板的规则落地
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 AUTOSIGMA，一种利用知识库丰富、模板匹配和大模型验证将非结构化网络威胁情报自动转换为 Sigma 检测规则的创新系统。
AI.motivation: 高级持续性威胁（APT）演变迅速，传统的非结构化网络威胁情报（CTI）人工转化为 Sigma 规则的方式耗时、易错且无法扩展，而开源规则库难以跟上新兴威胁，因此迫切需要一种动态、自适应的自动化规则生成方法。
AI.method: 提出 AUTOSIGMA 解决方案，结合结构化知识库丰富局部输入、利用现有 Sigma 规则库进行模板化落地匹配，并采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 机制进行迭代验证。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界的 APT 报告和安全博客上的评估表明，AUTOSIGMA 在规则有效性、相关性、MITRE ATT&CK 技术覆盖率以及对输入质量的鲁棒性方面均优于其他替代方案和大模型。
AI.conclusion: AUTOSIGMA 通过知识驱动的丰富和基于模板的规则落地，成功实现了从非结构化 CTI 报告到高质量 Sigma 规则的自动化生成，且在真实世界的评估中表现优于现有的替代方案和大模型。
AI.translation: 由于高级持续性威胁（APT）的迅速演变，迫切需要建立将网络威胁情报（CTI）动态转换为可执行检测能力的机制。Sigma 规则是现代威胁检测工作流的重要组成部分，因为它们提供了一个平台无关的框架来表达检测逻辑，该逻辑可以转换为各个 SIEM 系统中的特定查询。传统的手工制作 Sigma 规则技术容易出错，且需要广泛的知识，这限制了它们的可扩展性。尽管存在开源和行业维护的 Sigma 规则存储库，但它们往往无法跟上新兴威胁的步伐，并且需要频繁定制以适应不同的操作环境。这强调了动态生成适应不断演进的攻击技术以及特定用例的规则的必要性。在这项工作中，我们设计了 AUTOSIGMA，一个将非结构化 CTI 报告转换为相关 Sigma 规则的自动化解决方案。AUTOSIGMA 没有完全依赖语言模型，而是利用结构化知识库来丰富部分输入，将丰富后的内容与现有 Sigma 规则存储库进行匹配，然后采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 机制来迭代验证规则。通过结合知识驱动的丰富、基于模板的规则落地以及多阶段解决方案，AUTOSIGMA 实现了准确、具上下文感知且相关的规则生成。对多个真实世界 APT 报告和多个安全博客的评估表明，AUTOSIGMA 在规则有效性、规则相关性、MITRE ATT&CK 技术覆盖率以及对输入质量的鲁棒性方面优于替代解决方案和大模型。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 AUTOSIGMA，一个用于将非结构化网络威胁情报（CTI）自动转化为 Sigma 检测规则的创新框架。该系统结合了结构化知识库丰富、基于模板的规则落地以及大模型迭代验证机制，能够高效生成准确且具上下文关联的检测规则。
AI.keywords: 威胁情报, Sigma规则, 自动化检测, 知识库, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文针对网络威胁情报向检测规则转化的痛点，创新性地结合了结构化知识库检索、模板化规则落地和多阶段大模型验证（LLM-as-a-Judge），显著提升了自动生成Sigma规则的准确率、鲁棒性和相关性，对自动化威胁检测具有重要的实用价值。

title: Harness Continual Learning: Continual Adaptation Beyond Model Parameters
summary: Continual learning has largely been model-centric, treating model parameters as the state that changes with sequential experience. Modern agents can also adapt through a harness of prompts, memories, tools, skills, and routing rules. Because these contents jointly shape later execution, a harness update can disrupt previously reliable behavior even when the model is frozen. This raises a new question: how can an agent continually improve its state outside the model while retaining behavior acquired earlier? We formulate Harness Continual Learning (HCL), a new continual learning paradigm in which the harness evolves around a frozen foundation model, and define the resulting loss of earlier behavior as harness-level forgetting. We instantiate HCL with four execution-facing components: the Task Interface, Experience Memory, Capability Map, and Adaptive Router. We further introduce guarded harness evolution to separate update generation from state commitment. A Continual Optimizer proposes candidate harnesses from post-execution feedback, and a Continual Evaluator commits the resulting candidate harness only after checking current improvement, historical retention, and validity. Experiments on textual reasoning, multimodal perception, and open-world interaction demonstrate capability accumulation and failure recovery, with relative gains exceeding 10% over corresponding baselines in multiple settings. Component ablations assess the contribution of each harness component, while controlled retention sweeps reveal measurable harness-level forgetting and show that the stability--plasticity trade-off can be explicitly adjusted.

AI.title_translation: 驾驭层持续学习：超越模型参数的持续适应
AI.tldr: 本文提出了驾驭层持续学习（HCL）范式，通过在冻结模型外部构建包含四个组件的受保护演化外壳，解决了智能体外部状态更新引发的遗忘问题并实现了能力的持续积累。
AI.motivation: 传统的持续学习侧重于更新模型参数，而现代大模型智能体常通过由提示词、记忆、工具、技能和路由规则组成的外部外壳（Harness）进行适应。即使模型参数保持冻结，外壳的更新也可能破坏智能体先前可靠的行为（引发外壳层遗忘）。因此需要探索如何在模型外部持续改进状态的同时保留早期获得的行为。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义了驾驭层持续学习（HCL）范式及“外壳层遗忘”（harness-level forgetting）；\n2. 实例化四个面向执行的组件：任务接口（Task Interface）、经验记忆（Experience Memory）、能力图谱（Capability Map）和自适应路由器（Adaptive Router）；\n3. 提出受保护的外壳演化（guarded harness evolution）机制，将更新生成与状态提交分离：由持续优化器基于执行后反馈提出候选外壳，由持续评估器在检验当前提升、历史保留度和有效性后才确认提交更新。
AI.result: 在文本推理、多模态感知和开放世界交互任务上的实验表明，HCL 实现了能力的持续积累和故障恢复，在多种场景下相对基线提升超过 10%；保留度测试验证了外壳层遗忘现象的存在，并证明可以显式调节稳定性与可塑性的权衡。
AI.conclusion: HCL 范式能够在冻结基础模型参数的前提下，通过对外部执行架构（Harness）的持续优化与受控提交，实现智能体能力的持续积累与故障恢复，有效缓解了外壳层遗忘问题并灵活平衡了稳定性与可塑性。
AI.translation: 持续学习在很大程度上一直是以模型为中心的，将模型参数视为随序列经验改变的状态。现代智能体还可以通过由提示词、记忆、工具、技能和路由规则构成的外壳（harness）来进行适应。由于这些内容共同塑造了后续的执行，即使模型被冻结，外壳的更新也可能会破坏先前可靠的行为。这引出了一个新的问题：智能体如何在保留早期获得的行为的同时，持续改进其在模型外部的状态？我们形式化了“驾驭层持续学习”（Harness Continual Learning, HCL），这是一种围绕冻结的基础模型演化外壳的新型持续学习范式，并将由此导致的早期行为丢失定义为“外壳层遗忘”（harness-level forgetting）。我们通过四个面向执行的组件实例化了 HCL：任务接口、经验记忆、能力图谱和自适应路由器。我们进一步引入了受保护的外壳演化机制，将更新生成与状态提交分离开来：持续优化器根据执行后的反馈提出候选外壳，而持续评估器仅在检查当前改进、历史保留度和有效性后才提交生成的候选外壳。在文本推理、多模态感知和开放世界交互上的实验证明了能力的积累和故障恢复，在多个设定下相对于相应基线的提升超过了 10%。组件消融实验评估了各个外壳组件的贡献，受控的保留度扫描揭示了可测量的外壳层遗忘，并表明稳定性与可塑性的权衡可以被显式调整。
AI.summary: 本文针对大模型智能体在外部配置更新时可能引发的能力丢失问题，提出了“驾驭层持续学习”（Harness Continual Learning, HCL）新范式。通过构建四个执行组件并采用“优化提议-评估验证”的受保护演化机制，使冻结参数的智能体能够在文本、多模态和开放世界任务中实现持续能力积累与低遗忘率。
AI.keywords: 持续学习, 智能体外壳, 外壳层遗忘, 受保护演化, 稳定性-可塑性权衡
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将持续学习的研究视角从传统的“更新模型参数”转移到“更新外部外壳/脚手架（Harness）”，精准指出了大模型智能体在外部提示、工具和记忆更新时同样面临“遗忘”问题。提出的受保护演化机制（分离生成与提交）为解决智能体外置状态的稳定性-可塑性平衡提供了行之有效的新框架。

title: One-Stage Object Detectors in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles depend on fast and reliable perception systems to detect surrounding vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, traffic signs, and other road objects in real time. This paper presents a comprehensive survey and analysis of one-stage object detectors for autonomous driving rather than an implementation of a new detection system. The survey reviews the evolution of major one-stage detectors, including YOLOv1, SSD, RetinaNet, EfficientDet, anchor-free detectors such as FCOS and CenterNet, and recent real-time models such as YOLOv10. It compares these architectures through their design choices, feature-fusion strategies, loss functions, deployment trade-offs, and reported benchmark performance. The paper also summarizes commonly used autonomous-driving datasets, evaluation metrics, open challenges, and future research directions. Overall, this survey highlights how one-stage detectors balance speed, accuracy, efficiency, and robustness, while also emphasizing the remaining gap between benchmark results and dependable real-world autonomous-driving performance.

AI.title_translation: 自动驾驶中的单阶段目标检测器
AI.tldr: 本文对自动驾驶中使用的单阶段目标检测器进行了全面调查和分析，比较了它们的架构和性能，并指出了基准测试与实际应用之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆需要快速可靠的感知系统来实时检测周围物体。本文旨在对自动驾驶中使用的单阶段目标检测器进行全面调查和分析。
AI.method: 本文对YOLOv1、SSD、RetinaNet、EfficientDet、FCOS、CenterNet和YOLOv10等主要单阶段检测器的演变进行了回顾。它通过设计选择、特征融合策略、损失函数、部署权衡和报告的基准性能来比较这些架构。此外，它还总结了常用的自动驾驶数据集、评估指标、开放挑战和未来的研究方向。
AI.result: 该调查强调了单阶段检测器如何在速度、准确性、效率和鲁棒性之间取得平衡，同时也强调了基准测试结果与可靠的实际自动驾驶性能之间仍然存在的差距。
AI.conclusion: 单阶段目标检测器在速度、准确性、效率和鲁棒性方面取得了平衡，但基准测试结果与实际自动驾驶性能之间仍存在差距。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶车辆依赖快速可靠的感知系统来实时检测周围车辆、行人、骑行者、交通标志和其他道路物体。本文对自动驾驶中的单阶段目标检测器进行了全面调查和分析，而非实现新的检测系统。该调查回顾了主要单阶段检测器的演变，包括YOLOv1、SSD、RetinaNet、EfficientDet、anchor-free检测器（如FCOS和CenterNet）以及最近的实时模型（如YOLOv10）。它通过设计选择、特征融合策略、损失函数、部署权衡和报告的基准性能来比较这些架构。本文还总结了常用的自动驾驶数据集、评估指标、开放挑战和未来的研究方向。总的来说，这项调查强调了单阶段检测器如何在速度、准确性、效率和鲁棒性之间取得平衡，同时也强调了基准测试结果与可靠的实际自动驾驶性能之间仍然存在的差距。
AI.summary: 本文对自动驾驶领域中的单阶段目标检测器进行了全面调查和分析。该调查回顾了YOLOv1、SSD、RetinaNet、EfficientDet、FCOS、CenterNet和YOLOv10等主要检测器的发展，并从设计、特征融合、损失函数、部署和性能等方面进行了比较。文章还总结了相关数据集、评估指标和未来研究方向。研究结果表明，单阶段检测器在速度、准确性、效率和鲁棒性之间取得了平衡，但与实际自动驾驶的可靠性之间仍存在差距。
AI.keywords: 单阶段目标检测器, 自动驾驶, 感知系统, YOLO, 实时检测
AI.comments: 这是一篇有价值的综述性论文，它系统地梳理了自动驾驶领域中单阶段目标检测器的发展历程和关键技术。其创新之处在于对现有模型的全面比较和对未来研究方向的展望，对于研究人员了解该领域现状和挑战具有重要意义。论文强调了基准性能与实际应用之间的差距，指出了未来研究需要关注的关键问题。

title: Orthogonal Polynomial Approximation for Matrix Log Normalization in Global Covariance Pooling
summary: Global Covariance Pooling (GCP) improves deep networks by capturing second-order feature statistics, and is especially effective for fine-grained recognition. Because covariance matrices live on the Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) manifold, a normalization step is required before the Euclidean classifier. The faithful choice is the matrix logarithm (MLN-COV), which maps the SPD manifold to its tangent space; in practice it was abandoned in favour of the matrix square root because its eigendecomposition-based gradient is numerically unstable. We show that this instability is an artifact of computing the logarithm spectrally, not of the logarithm itself. Approximating the logarithm with finite polynomials in the covariance matrix removes the eigendecomposition from both passes: every operation becomes a General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM), the gradient stays bounded on the spectral support of the pre-normalized covariance, and the unstable 1/(lambda_i-lambda_j) term never appears. The key ingredient is a mean-eigenvalue pre-normalization that centres the spectrum near 1, away from the singularity of log, with a scalar post-compensation that returns the singular part of log(A) in closed form. Our recommended normalizer is a degree-8 Chebyshev expansion evaluated by a three-term matrix recurrence, with a matching reverse recurrence for the backward pass; Legendre, Laguerre, Taylor and Pade expansions are studied as controls that isolate the roles of the basis and of the target function. On three fine-grained benchmarks and ImageNet-1k the decomposition-free logarithm is both faster and more accurate than the spectral logarithm and than the square-root approximations it replaces, and at matched basis and degree the log target beats the square-root target, confirming that the gain comes from the faithful Riemannian map rather than from a better polynomial family.

AI.title_translation: 全局协方差池化中矩阵对数归一化的正交多项式逼近
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于正交多项式逼近的矩阵对数归一化方法，用于全局协方差池化，解决了传统谱分解方法的不稳定性问题，并实现了更快的速度和更高的精度。
AI.motivation: 全局协方差池化（GCP）通过捕获二阶特征统计量来改进深度网络，尤其对细粒度识别有效。由于协方差矩阵位于对称正定（SPD）流形上，在欧几里得分类器之前需要进行归一化。矩阵对数是忠实的归一化选择，但其基于特征分解的梯度在数值上不稳定，导致实践中被矩阵平方根代替。本文旨在解决矩阵对数归一化的数值不稳定性问题。
AI.method: 研究表明不稳定性源于谱计算对数，而非对数本身。通过使用协方差矩阵的有限多项式逼近对数，消除了正向和反向传播中的特征分解，所有操作变为通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）。关键在于通过均值特征值预归一化将谱中心化到1附近，并进行标量后补偿。推荐使用8阶切比雪夫展开，通过三项矩阵递推进行评估，并采用匹配的逆递推进行反向传播。
AI.result: 在三个细粒度基准测试和ImageNet-1k上，所提出的无分解对数方法比谱对数和其替代的平方根近似方法更快、更准确。在匹配的基函数和阶数下，对数目标函数优于平方根目标函数，这证实了性能提升来自忠实的黎曼映射，而非更好的多项式族。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种稳定、快速且准确的基于正交多项式逼近的矩阵对数归一化方法，成功解决了传统矩阵对数在全局协方差池化中的数值不稳定性问题。实验结果证明，该方法不仅在速度和精度上优于现有技术，而且验证了矩阵对数作为忠实黎曼映射在理论上的优越性。
AI.translation: 全局协方差池化（GCP）通过捕获二阶特征统计量来改进深度网络，尤其对细粒度识别有效。由于协方差矩阵位于对称正定（SPD）流形上，在欧几里得分类器之前需要进行归一化步骤。忠实的选择是矩阵对数（MLN-COV），它将SPD流形映射到其切线空间；在实践中，它因其基于特征分解的梯度在数值上不稳定而被矩阵平方根取代。我们表明这种不稳定性是谱计算对数的产物，而非对数本身。用协方差矩阵的有限多项式逼近对数，消除了正向和反向传播中的特征分解：每个操作都变为通用矩阵乘法（GEMM），梯度在预归一化协方差的谱支持上保持有界，并且不稳定的1/(lambda_i-lambda_j)项永远不会出现。关键成分是均值特征值预归一化，它将谱中心化到1附近，远离对数的奇异点，并通过标量后补偿以闭合形式返回log(A)的奇异部分。我们推荐的归一化器是8阶切比雪夫展开，通过三项矩阵递推进行评估，并采用匹配的逆递推进行反向传播；作为对照，我们研究了勒让德、拉盖尔、泰勒和帕德展开，以分离基函数和目标函数的作用。在三个细粒度基准测试和ImageNet-1k上，无分解对数方法比谱对数和它替代的平方根近似方法更快、更准确，并且在匹配的基函数和阶数下，对数目标函数优于平方根目标函数，这证实了增益来自忠实的黎曼映射，而非更好的多项式族。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于全局协方差池化（GCP）中矩阵对数归一化的新型方法。针对传统矩阵对数归一化因特征分解导致的数值不稳定性问题，作者通过使用正交多项式（特别是切比雪夫展开）逼近矩阵对数，并结合均值特征值预归一化，成功避免了特征分解，将所有操作转化为通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）。实验结果表明，该方法在细粒度识别和ImageNet-1k任务上比现有谱对数和平方根近似方法更快、更准确，并证实了矩阵对数作为忠实黎曼映射的理论优势。
AI.keywords: 全局协方差池化, 矩阵对数, 正交多项式, 归一化, 细粒度识别
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一种数值稳定且高效的矩阵对数近似方法，通过多项式逼近和预归一化策略，解决了长期困扰GCP中矩阵对数归一化的数值不稳定性问题。这使得理论上更优的黎曼映射得以实际应用，为深度学习模型，特别是细粒度识别任务的性能提升提供了新的途径。其将复杂矩阵函数计算转化为通用矩阵乘法，显著提高了计算效率。

title: Self-prompting and cross-model consensus enable reproducible data extraction from scientific literature with large language models
summary: Accurately extracting nuanced, contextualized data from research articles is laborious and time intensive. Here, we investigate the performance of frontier, browser-based large language models (LLMs) to extract highly contextualized information. We demonstrate four escalating workflows, 1) given an expert curated prompt and research articles, most frontier LLMs perform well at data extraction, however can struggle with interpreting scientific context and nuance, 2) given simple instructions, LLMs can author their own prompts which were almost as eNective as expert-written prompts, 3) autonomous discovery of research literature was diNicult, agents either missed or hallucinated references, and 4) LLMs can create new datasets from published guidelines that closely match human-expert judges, but still require a human-in-the-loop. Together, these findings define an auditable division of labour in which experts specify the evidence standard, models cross-check repeated extractions and researchers resolve disputed cases, providing a practical route to scaling scientific data curation without relinquishing expert oversight.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型通过自提示和跨模型共识实现科学文献中可复现的数据提取
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够从科学文献中提取数据，在专家提示或自生成提示下表现良好，并能创建与人类专家匹配的数据集，但仍需人工监督以处理细微语境和参考文献发现。
AI.motivation: 从研究文章中准确提取细致入微、背景化的数据是费力且耗时的。
AI.method: 本研究调查了前沿的、基于浏览器的LMM在提取高度背景化信息方面的性能。研究展示了四种逐步升级的工作流程：1）给定专家策划的提示和研究文章；2）LMM根据简单指令自行编写提示；3）LMM自主发现研究文献；4）LMM根据已发布的指南创建新数据集。
AI.result: 1）在专家策划的提示下，大多数前沿LMM在数据提取方面表现良好，但可能难以解释科学背景和细微之处。2）LMM可以自行编写提示，其有效性几乎与专家编写的提示相同。3）自主发现研究文献是困难的，LMM代理要么遗漏了参考文献，要么产生了幻觉。4）LMM可以根据已发布的指南创建与人类专家判断高度匹配的新数据集，但仍然需要人工参与。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现定义了一种可审计的分工：专家指定证据标准，模型交叉检查重复提取，研究人员解决争议案件。这为在不放弃专家监督的情况下扩展科学数据整理提供了一条实用途径。
AI.translation: 从研究文章中准确提取细致入微、背景化的数据是费力且耗时的。在此，我们调查了前沿的、基于浏览器的LMM（大型语言模型）在提取高度背景化信息方面的性能。我们展示了四种逐步升级的工作流程：1）在给定专家策划的提示和研究文章的情况下，大多数前沿LMM在数据提取方面表现良好，但可能难以解释科学背景和细微之处；2）在给定简单指令的情况下，LMM可以自行编写提示，这些提示的有效性几乎与专家编写的提示相同；3）自主发现研究文献是困难的，代理要么遗漏了参考文献，要么产生了幻觉；4）LMM可以根据已发布的指南创建与人类专家判断高度匹配的新数据集，但仍然需要人工参与。总的来说，这些发现定义了一种可审计的分工，其中专家指定证据标准，模型交叉检查重复提取，研究人员解决争议案件，为在不放弃专家监督的情况下扩展科学数据整理提供了一条实用途径。
AI.summary: 本论文通过四种工作流程调查了大型语言模型（LLMs）从科学文献中提取背景化数据的能力。研究表明，LLMs在专家策划或自生成的提示下表现良好，可以创建与人类专家相当的数据集，但在自主文献发现方面存在困难，并且需要人工监督以进行细致的解释。该研究提出了一种可审计的分工，以扩展科学数据整理。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 数据提取, 科学文献, 自提示, 跨模型共识
AI.comments: 这篇论文探讨了大型语言模型在科学数据提取中的实际应用，突出了其在效率方面的潜力（自提示、数据集生成）以及当前的局限性（细微之处、参考文献发现）。所提出的“可审计的分工”是一项关键创新，为将人工智能整合到科学工作流程中提供了一个现实框架，同时保持了质量和专家监督。

title: Institutional Books - Enriched Text: A customizable multilingual open-source pipeline for denoising, deduplicating, and annotating OCR text at scale
summary:
Released in 2025, Institutional Books: Harvard Library (IB-HL) is a collection of 983,004 volumes (242B o200k_base tokens), originally digitized through Harvard Library's participation in the Google Books Library project. As researchers and developers have begun to use IB-HL, a tension has emerged between standard large-scale preprocessing practices and the goals of careful information stewardship. Many existing pipelines optimize for web text: as a result, they tend to aggressively filter, deduplicate, restrict by language, and sometimes discard meaningful metadata. Meanwhile, researchers seeking to use IB-HL duplicate effort while performing similar processing and analysis.
  We describe an approach that we call Enriched Text. Instead of producing a single 'complete' stream of tokens, we normalize the text while preserving metadata through annotations. We separate endmatter, detect per-paragraph language, identify clusters of duplicate paragraphs, and compute per-paragraph bits-per-byte scores. We provide this information through HTML-like annotations layered on top of the text. By parsing these annotations, users can tailor the output to their own needs instead of accepting a global editorial decision on content. The pipeline applies to all $\approx$250 languages in the collection.
  This report describes this project's goals, implementation, and design rationale. The release includes IB-HL-ET (an enriched-text version of IB-HL containing 217B o200k_base tokens across 983,003 volumes, organized into 1.39B annotated subtopic paragraphs) and the pipeline that produced it. These serve to make the collection easier for machines to parse and for humans to study.

AI.title_translation: 机构书籍 - 丰富文本：一个可定制的多语言开源管道，用于大规模去噪、去重和标注OCR文本
AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了一个名为“丰富文本”的可定制多语言开源管道，用于处理大型OCR文本数据集（如哈佛图书馆的机构书籍），通过保留元数据和提供细粒度标注来改进传统预处理方法，使用户能根据自身需求定制输出。
AI.motivation: 研究人员和开发者在使用大型OCR文本数据集（如哈佛图书馆的机构书籍，IB-HL）时，传统的大规模预处理方法（如积极过滤、去重、语言限制和丢弃元数据）与精细信息管理的目标之间存在矛盾。现有管道通常为网络文本优化，导致有意义的元数据丢失，且研究人员在执行类似处理和分析时重复劳动。
AI.method: 该方法名为“丰富文本”（Enriched Text）。它通过在文本上分层HTML-like标注来规范化文本，同时保留元数据。具体做法包括分离结尾部分、检测每段语言、识别重复段落簇以及计算每段的每字节比特分数。用户可以通过解析这些标注来根据自身需求定制输出，而不是接受全局性的内容编辑决策。该管道适用于收藏中所有约250种语言。
AI.result: 发布了IB-HL-ET（IB-HL的丰富文本版本），包含983,003卷中的217B o200k_base tokens，组织成1.39B带标注的子主题段落，以及生成该版本的管道。这些成果旨在使该集合更容易被机器解析和人类研究。
AI.conclusion: 该项目通过提供一个可定制的多语言开源管道和丰富文本版本的数据集，解决了传统大规模OCR文本预处理的局限性，使得大型数字化文本集合更易于机器解析和人类研究，并允许用户根据自身需求定制文本输出。
AI.translation:
2025年发布的《机构书籍：哈佛图书馆》（IB-HL）是一个包含983,004卷（242B o200k_base tokens）的馆藏，最初通过哈佛图书馆参与谷歌图书图书馆项目进行数字化。随着研究人员和开发者开始使用IB-HL，标准的大规模预处理实践与精细信息管理目标之间出现了紧张关系。许多现有管道针对网络文本进行优化：因此，它们倾向于积极过滤、去重、按语言限制，有时还会丢弃有意义的元数据。同时，寻求使用IB-HL的研究人员在执行类似处理和分析时重复劳动。
我们描述了一种我们称之为“丰富文本”的方法。我们不生成单一的“完整”token流，而是通过标注保留元数据来规范化文本。我们分离结尾部分，检测每段语言，识别重复段落簇，并计算每段的每字节比特分数。我们通过分层在文本之上的类似HTML的标注提供这些信息。通过解析这些标注，用户可以根据自己的需求定制输出，而不是接受关于内容的全局编辑决策。该管道适用于馆藏中所有约250种语言。
本报告描述了该项目的目标、实施和设计理念。本次发布包括IB-HL-ET（IB-HL的丰富文本版本，包含983,003卷中的217B o200k_base tokens，组织成1.39B带标注的子主题段落）以及生成它的管道。这些旨在使馆藏更易于机器解析和人类研究。
AI.summary: 该论文提出“丰富文本”方法，旨在解决大型OCR文本数据集（如哈佛图书馆的IB-HL）在传统大规模预处理中存在的元数据丢失和定制化不足问题。通过开发一个可定制的多语言开源管道，该方法在规范化文本的同时，通过分层HTML-like标注保留了重要的元数据，实现了结尾分离、语言检测、重复段落识别和比特分数计算。这使得用户可以根据自身需求定制文本输出，而非接受统一处理。项目发布了IB-HL-ET数据集及其生成管道，显著提升了数字化馆藏的机器可解析性和人类可研究性。
AI.keywords: OCR文本, 数据预处理, 多语言, 开源管道, 元数据标注
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于它超越了传统大规模文本预处理的“一刀切”方法，转而采用一种更精细、以用户为中心的方法。通过保留元数据并提供细粒度的标注，它赋予了研究人员根据特定需求定制文本的能力，这对于处理多语言、多源的机构书籍尤其重要。其开源性质和可扩展性也增加了其潜在影响。局限性可能在于解析和利用这些丰富标注的复杂性，以及确保其在各种研究场景中的通用性。

title: Adaptive Memory and Reflection Multi-Agent System for Medical Question Answering
summary: Accurate and responsible medical question answering (QA) is important in healthcare, where complex cases require factual knowledge and nuanced reasoning. Existing medical QA systems, typically based on single-agent architectures and static retrieval, often lack adaptability, persistent memory, and structured decision-making. This work introduces an adaptive memory and reflection (AMR) agentic system, a multi-agent framework in which specialized agents use dedicated memory and reflection-based feedback to retrieve relevant prior cases and improve subsequent reasoning. Complexity assessment routes questions through solo, collaborative, or escalated workflows, while consensus and ethical overseer modules support reasoning consolidation and output review. Evaluation on MedQA and MedMCQA demonstrates strong performance compared with several baselines. Ablation studies show that combining agent-specific memory, reflection, and external retrieval yields the strongest performance. These findings highlight the potential of structured memory and feedback for developing more trustworthy medical agents. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/mm-air/AMR-Agent.

AI.title_translation: 用于医学问答的自适应记忆与反思多智能体系统
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为AMR的自适应记忆与反思多智能体系统，用于医学问答，通过专门的智能体、记忆和反射机制来处理复杂病例并提高推理能力，在MedQA和MedMCQA上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有医学问答系统通常基于单智能体架构和静态检索，缺乏适应性、持久记忆和结构化决策能力，无法有效处理医疗领域中需要事实知识和细致推理的复杂病例。
AI.method: 本文引入了一种自适应记忆与反思（AMR）智能体系统，这是一个多智能体框架，其中专门的智能体利用专用记忆和基于反思的反馈来检索相关的先前案例并改进后续推理。复杂性评估将问题路由到独立、协作或升级工作流程中，同时共识和伦理监督模块支持推理整合和输出审查。
AI.result: 在MedQA和MedMCQA数据集上的评估表明，与多个基线相比，该系统表现出强大的性能。消融研究表明，结合智能体特定记忆、反思和外部检索能产生最强的性能。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现强调了结构化记忆和反馈在开发更值得信赖的医学智能体方面的潜力。
AI.translation: 准确和负责任的医学问答（QA）在医疗保健领域至关重要，其中复杂的病例需要事实知识和细致的推理。现有的医学问答系统，通常基于单智能体架构和静态检索，往往缺乏适应性、持久记忆和结构化决策能力。这项工作引入了一个自适应记忆与反思（AMR）智能体系统，这是一个多智能体框架，其中专门的智能体利用专用记忆和基于反思的反馈来检索相关的先前案例并改进后续推理。复杂性评估将问题路由到独立、协作或升级工作流程中，同时共识和伦理监督模块支持推理整合和输出审查。在MedQA和MedMCQA上的评估表明，与多个基线相比，该系统表现出强大的性能。消融研究表明，结合智能体特定记忆、反思和外部检索能产生最强的性能。这些发现强调了结构化记忆和反馈在开发更值得信赖的医学智能体方面的潜力。源代码已在https://github.com/mm-air/AMR-Agent 公开。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为自适应记忆与反思（AMR）的多智能体系统，旨在解决现有医学问答系统在处理复杂医疗案例时缺乏适应性、记忆和结构化决策的问题。AMR系统通过专门的智能体、记忆和反射机制来检索相关案例并优化推理过程。该系统还包含复杂性评估、共识和伦理监督模块。在MedQA和MedMCQA数据集上的评估显示，AMR系统性能优于基线，并且结合智能体特定记忆、反射和外部检索能达到最佳效果，验证了结构化记忆和反馈对于构建可信赖医学智能体的重要性。
AI.keywords: 医学问答, 多智能体系统, 自适应记忆, 反思, 医疗AI
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了自适应记忆和反思的多智能体框架，克服了传统单智能体系统在医学问答中的局限性。通过将复杂性评估、协作工作流、共识和伦理监督模块集成到系统中，显著提高了医学问答的准确性和可靠性。这种结构化的记忆和反馈机制对于开发更值得信赖和适应性强的医疗AI系统具有重要意义。

title: Counterfactual Contrastive Analysis
summary: Visual Counterfactual Explanations (VCEs) aim to explain image classifiers by generating minimally edited and realistic versions of an input image that change the classifier's prediction. Existing VCE methods are inherently classifier-dependent and therefore susceptible to classifier biases and failure modes, such as sensitivity to shortcut features and calibration errors. In this paper, we propose a classifier-free approach for visual counterfactual generation based on Contrastive Analysis (CA). Given two datasets corresponding to different classes (e.g., healthy and patients), we disentangle the generative factors that are common across the two datasets from those that are salient to each dataset, and generate counterfactual images by swapping only the salient factors. By operating directly on data distributions rather than decision boundaries, our method provides model-agnostic VCEs that are less sensitive to classifier biases. Our approach leverages the high-quality synthesis and well-structured latent space of StyleGAN2. We use the feature space F, instead than the usual W-space, to improve detail preservation. Unlike conventional CA approaches, which typically assume salient factors in only one dataset, we introduce an adapted framework and loss functions for VCE that allow multiple salient factors in each dataset. We evaluate our method on three medical imaging datasets and demonstrate superior counterfactual generation quality compared to existing approaches.

AI.title_translation: 对比反事实分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于对比分析的无分类器视觉反事实解释方法。该方法通过解耦数据集中的共同和显著生成因素来生成反事实图像，从而提供模型无关且对分类器偏差不敏感的解释，并在医学图像数据集上表现出卓越的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉反事实解释（VCE）方法依赖于分类器，容易受到分类器偏差和故障模式（如对捷径特征的敏感性和校准误差）的影响。
AI.method: 本文提出一种基于对比分析（CA）的无分类器视觉反事实生成方法。该方法通过解耦两个不同类别数据集（如健康和患者）中共同的生成因素和对每个数据集显著的因素，并通过仅交换显著因素来生成反事实图像。该方法直接作用于数据分布而非决策边界，利用StyleGAN2的高质量合成和结构化潜在空间（特别是F空间以改善细节保留）。此外，它引入了适应VCE的框架和损失函数，允许每个数据集中存在多个显著因素，这与传统CA方法不同。
AI.result: 该方法提供了模型无关的VCE，对分类器偏差不敏感。在三个医学图像数据集上进行了评估，与现有方法相比，展示了卓越的反事实生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种创新的无分类器视觉反事实生成方法，有效解决了现有方法对分类器依赖和易受偏差影响的问题，并通过在数据分布层面操作和利用StyleGAN2的优势，实现了高质量且模型无关的反事实解释。
AI.translation: 视觉反事实解释（VCE）旨在通过生成输入图像的最小编辑和真实版本来解释图像分类器，从而改变分类器的预测。现有的VCE方法本质上依赖于分类器，因此容易受到分类器偏差和故障模式的影响，例如对捷径特征的敏感性和校准误差。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于对比分析（CA）的无分类器视觉反事实生成方法。给定对应于不同类别（例如，健康和患者）的两个数据集，我们从对每个数据集显著的生成因素中解耦出两个数据集共有的生成因素，并通过仅交换显著因素来生成反事实图像。通过直接作用于数据分布而非决策边界，我们的方法提供了模型无关的VCE，对分类器偏差不敏感。我们的方法利用了StyleGAN2的高质量合成和良好结构的潜在空间。我们使用特征空间F，而不是通常的W空间，以改善细节保留。与通常假设只有一个数据集中存在显著因素的传统CA方法不同，我们引入了一个适应VCE的框架和损失函数，允许每个数据集中存在多个显著因素。我们在三个医学图像数据集上评估了我们的方法，并证明了与现有方法相比，其反事实生成质量更优。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“对比反事实分析”的无分类器视觉反事实解释（VCE）方法。针对现有VCE方法依赖分类器且易受偏差影响的问题，该方法基于对比分析，通过解耦不同类别数据集中共同和显著的生成因素，并交换显著因素来生成反事实图像。该方法直接作用于数据分布，利用StyleGAN2的F空间进行高质量合成和细节保留，并引入了适应多显著因素的CA框架。实验证明，该方法在医学图像数据集上生成了更优的反事实图像，提供了模型无关且对分类器偏差不敏感的解释。
AI.keywords: 视觉反事实解释, 对比分析, 无分类器, StyleGAN2, 医学影像
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个无分类器的视觉反事实解释方法，这直接解决了现有方法对分类器依赖性和易受偏差影响的根本问题。通过将反事实生成从模型决策边界转移到数据分布层面，并结合StyleGAN2的强大生成能力和F空间的细节保留优势，该方法提供了一种更鲁棒、更通用的解释工具。其对传统对比分析框架的修改，允许每个数据集中存在多个显著因素，也增加了其适用性。在医学影像等高风险领域，这种模型无关且可靠的解释能力尤为重要。

title: USR-Drive: Unified Driving Scene Representation via Joint Denoising of 3D Gaussians and Boxes
summary: Spatial representation learning for autonomous driving aims to map raw visual signals into structured 3D scene representations, where object-centric bounding boxes and rendering-oriented 3D primitives (\eg, 3D Gaussians) serve as two distinct yet highly complementary levels for scene understanding. Existing methods typically treat dynamic reconstruction and instance-level perception as separate tasks, despite their shared goal of estimating the underlying 3D world state. As a result, dynamic reconstruction is under-constrained while 3D detection lacks geometric grounding. To address this gap, we propose USR-Drive, a unified conditional generative framework that, given only posed multi-view driving videos, jointly recovers dense dynamic geometry and instance-level object layouts within a shared scene representation. Specifically, USR-Drive represents dense Gaussian primitives and sparse 3D bounding boxes as two aligned latent token streams and jointly denoises them with a unified multi-modal diffusion Transformer. Unlike prior paradigms that use boxes as external conditions or predict them with detached modules, USR-Drive treats them as mutually constrained state variables with a Unified Positional Encoding (UPE) that aligns heterogeneous tokens within a shared metric spatiotemporal coordinate. Via such unified representation and generative framework, the two modalities reinforce each other: geometry supplies dense metric evidence for box prediction, while boxes provide instance-level structural priors that help preserve spatial consistency and reduce ambiguity in sequential 3D geometric representation. Our approach successfully delivers state-of-the-art results for both dynamic reconstruction and 3D detection on the nuScenes and VKitti datasets.

AI.title_translation: USR-Drive：通过3D高斯和框的联合去噪实现统一驾驶场景表示
AI.tldr: USR-Drive是一个统一的生成框架，通过联合去噪3D高斯和边界框，从多视角视频中同时重建动态几何和实例级对象布局，并在两个任务上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动驾驶空间表示学习方法将动态重建（密集几何）和实例级感知（3D检测）视为独立任务，导致动态重建约束不足，而3D检测缺乏几何基础。
AI.method: USR-Drive提出了一个统一的条件生成框架。它将密集的3D高斯基元和稀疏的3D边界框表示为两个对齐的潜在令牌流，并使用统一的多模态扩散Transformer进行联合去噪。通过统一位置编码（UPE），将高斯和框作为相互约束的状态变量在共享的度量时空坐标中对齐。
AI.result: USR-Drive在nuScenes和VKitti数据集上，在动态重建和3D检测两项任务上均取得了最先进的成果。
AI.conclusion: USR-Drive通过统一表示和生成框架，成功地将动态几何重建和实例级3D检测结合起来，实现了两种模态的相互增强，并在两个任务上达到了最先进的性能，有效解决了现有方法的局限性。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶的空间表示学习旨在将原始视觉信号映射到结构化的3D场景表示中，其中以对象为中心的边界框和面向渲染的3D基元（例如3D高斯）是场景理解的两个截然不同但高度互补的层次。尽管现有的方法在估计底层3D世界状态方面有着共同的目标，但它们通常将动态重建和实例级感知视为独立的任务。因此，动态重建约束不足，而3D检测缺乏几何基础。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了USR-Drive，一个统一的条件生成框架，它仅给定带有姿态的多视角驾驶视频，即可在共享场景表示中联合恢复密集的动态几何和实例级对象布局。具体来说，USR-Drive将密集的3D高斯基元和稀疏的3D边界框表示为两个对齐的潜在令牌流，并使用统一的多模态扩散Transformer对其进行联合去噪。与使用框作为外部条件或使用独立模块预测框的现有范式不同，USR-Drive将它们视为具有统一位置编码（UPE）的相互约束的状态变量，该编码在共享的度量时空坐标中对齐异构令牌。通过这种统一的表示和生成框架，两种模态相互增强：几何为框预测提供密集的度量证据，而框提供实例级结构先验，有助于保持空间一致性并减少序列3D几何表示中的歧义。我们的方法在nuScenes和VKitti数据集上的动态重建和3D检测方面均取得了最先进的成果。
AI.summary: USR-Drive提出了一种统一的条件生成框架，通过联合去噪3D高斯基元和3D边界框，从多视角驾驶视频中同时学习密集的动态几何和实例级对象布局。该方法利用统一位置编码（UPE）对齐两种模态，使它们在共享场景表示中相互约束和增强，从而解决了现有方法中动态重建约束不足和3D检测缺乏几何基础的问题。USR-Drive在动态重建和3D检测任务上均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 统一驾驶场景表示, 3D高斯, 3D边界框, 扩散模型, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个统一的框架，将通常被视为独立任务的密集几何重建和稀疏实例级检测结合起来。通过将3D高斯和边界框视为相互约束的模态，并利用扩散Transformer进行联合去噪，有效地解决了两者之间的脱节问题。这种多模态联合学习方法为自动驾驶场景理解提供了一个新颖且高效的范式。

title: Hot Games: Towards a Holistic Assessment of the Planet Warming Emissions of Video Games based on 2024-2025 Data
summary: Following on recent reports on specific platforms or companies, this paper provides an assessment of the global impact of the production and use of video games. It draws together publicly available data on game development, hardware, games sold, download sizes, time spent playing games on different platforms, and subscriptions to multiplayer and cloud game services. It provides an update to figures published 2020 and 2022. Crucially, our account of emissions related to video games considers a wide range of categories, yet contains enough detail to be critiqued and improved in the future.

AI.title_translation: 热门游戏：基于2024-2025年数据的视频游戏对地球变暖排放的全面评估
AI.tldr: 本文基于2024-2025年数据，对视频游戏的生产和使用所产生的全球变暖排放进行了全面评估，并更新了先前的数据。
AI.motivation: 鉴于近期关于特定平台或公司的报告，本文旨在对视频游戏生产和使用对全球环境的影响进行全面评估。
AI.method: 论文整合了公开可用的数据，包括游戏开发、硬件、游戏销量、下载大小、不同平台的游戏时长以及多人和云游戏服务的订阅情况。
AI.result: 本文更新了2020年和2022年发布的数据，并对与视频游戏相关的排放进行了广泛类别的考量，其细节足以在未来进行批判和改进。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 继近期关于特定平台或公司的报告之后，本文评估了视频游戏生产和使用的全球影响。它汇集了公开可用的数据，涉及游戏开发、硬件、游戏销量、下载大小、在不同平台上玩游戏的时长以及多人和云游戏服务的订阅。本文更新了2020年和2022年发布的数据。至关重要的是，我们对与视频游戏相关的排放的描述考虑了广泛的类别，但包含足够的细节，以便将来进行批判和改进。
AI.summary: 本文旨在基于2024-2025年的最新数据，对视频游戏的生产和使用所造成的全球变暖排放进行全面评估。通过整合游戏开发、硬件、销量、下载量、游戏时长和订阅服务等公开数据，论文更新了此前的数据，并提供了一个详细的排放评估框架，旨在促进未来的审查和改进。
AI.keywords: 视频游戏, 排放评估, 全球变暖, 全面评估, 公开数据
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于其尝试对视频游戏的环境影响进行“全面”评估，超越了以往针对特定平台或公司的报告。其重要性在于提供了一个更新且细节丰富的评估框架，为后续研究和行业改进提供了基础。然而，由于依赖公开数据，其深度和准确性可能会受到数据可用性和质量的限制。

title: APEX: A Dual-Sparsity Accelerator for Precise and Efficient SNN Inference
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have emerged as an energy-efficient alternative to Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), leveraging sparse accumulate operations in the place of power-hungry multiply-and-accumulate operations. ANN-SNN conversion is a widely adopted approach to realize deep SNNs with accuracy comparable to that of ANNs. The Quantization-Clip-Floor-Shift (QCFS) activation minimizes conversion error, yet requires a large number of inference timesteps to match the source ANN accuracy on real-world vision datasets. PASCAL addresses this by proposing the Precise ANN-SNN Conversion Integrate-and-Fire (PASC-IF) neuron, which guarantees mathematical equivalence between the converted SNN and the source ANN, thereby achieving ANN-equivalent accuracy at significantly reduced timesteps. Despite this algorithmic advancement, the hardware implications of deploying the PASC-IF neuron remain unexplored. In this work, we present APEX, a dual-sparsity SNN inference accelerator that integrates the PASC-IF neuron into the LoAS hardware framework. The three-stage PASC-IF datapath is realized as a fully combinational circuit with no additional latency cost. APEX exploits dual sparsity in both input spikes and weights through a fully temporal-parallel dataflow, enabling efficient sparse computation and reduced memory traffic. Across all evaluated models, the PASC-IF neuron on average achieves up to 3% higher accuracy than the standard IF neuron, with a power overhead of only 1.3%-5.4%, an area overhead of 2.1%-2.7%, and 40% energy reduction for best accuracy configurations.

AI.title_translation: APEX：一种用于精确高效SNN推理的双稀疏加速器
AI.tldr: APEX是一种双稀疏SNN推理加速器，它将PASC-IF神经元集成到LoAS硬件框架中，实现了比标准IF神经元更高的精度和显著的能耗降低。
AI.motivation: 虽然PASC-IF神经元在算法上实现了SNN与ANN的数学等价，能在减少时间步的同时保持ANN级别的精度，但其硬件实现和部署的效率尚未被探索。现有的QCFS激活方法需要大量的推理时间步才能达到与ANN相当的精度。
AI.method: 本文提出了APEX，一个双稀疏SNN推理加速器。它将PASC-IF神经元集成到LoAS硬件框架中。PASC-IF数据通路被实现为完全组合电路，不增加额外延迟。APEX通过全时间并行数据流利用输入脉冲和权重的双重稀疏性，从而实现高效的稀疏计算并减少内存流量。
AI.result: 在所有评估模型中，PASC-IF神经元平均比标准IF神经元实现高达3%的更高精度。其功耗开销仅为1.3%-5.4%，面积开销为2.1%-2.7%。在最佳精度配置下，能耗降低了40%。
AI.conclusion: APEX加速器成功将PASC-IF神经元高效集成到硬件中，通过利用双稀疏性和全时间并行数据流，在保持低硬件开销的同时，显著提高了SNN的推理精度和能效。
AI.translation: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）已成为人工神经网络（ANNs）的节能替代方案，它利用稀疏累加操作取代了耗电的乘加操作。ANN-SNN转换是一种广泛采用的方法，可以实现与ANN精度相当的深度SNN。量化-裁剪-取整-移位（QCFS）激活函数最大限度地减少了转换误差，但需要在真实世界视觉数据集上进行大量推理时间步才能匹配源ANN的精度。PASCAL通过提出精确ANN-SNN转换积分发放（PASC-IF）神经元来解决这个问题，该神经元保证了转换后的SNN与源ANN之间的数学等价性，从而在显著减少时间步的情况下实现ANN等效的精度。尽管有这种算法上的进步，部署PASC-IF神经元的硬件影响仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了APEX，一个双稀疏SNN推理加速器，它将PASC-IF神经元集成到LoAS硬件框架中。三阶段PASC-IF数据通路被实现为完全组合电路，没有额外的延迟成本。APEX通过全时间并行数据流利用输入脉冲和权重的双重稀疏性，从而实现高效的稀疏计算并减少内存流量。在所有评估模型中，PASC-IF神经元平均比标准IF神经元实现高达3%的更高精度，功耗开销仅为1.3%-5.4%，面积开销为2.1%-2.7%，在最佳精度配置下能耗降低了40%。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了APEX，一种创新的双稀疏SNN推理加速器。APEX解决了PASC-IF神经元在硬件部署上的挑战，将其高效集成到LoAS框架中。通过利用输入脉冲和权重的双重稀疏性以及全时间并行数据流，APEX实现了高效的稀疏计算和内存流量减少。实验结果表明，APEX在提供高达3%的精度提升的同时，仅带来极低的功耗和面积开销，并能显著降低能耗。
AI.keywords: 脉冲神经网络, SNN, 硬件加速器, 双稀疏性, PASC-IF神经元
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于首次探索了PASC-IF神经元的硬件实现，并提出了一个双稀疏加速器APEX。通过将算法创新（PASC-IF）与硬件优化（双稀疏、全时间并行数据流、LoAS框架）相结合，解决了SNN在精度和能效上的关键挑战，为未来SNN硬件设计提供了重要参考。

title: Eureka: Task-Conditioned Meta-Agent Orchestration for Scientific Discovery
summary: We present Eureka, a task-conditioned Meta-Agent architecture that compiles long-horizon tasks into dynamic obligation graphs with explicit acceptance semantics. During execution, Eureka forms Macro-Agents with specialized state, memory, operators, tools, verifiers, and local topology via receding-horizon planning, architecture promotion, and minimal-sufficient compilation. When bottlenecks recur, cost-benefit-gated evolution updates the local architecture under constraints. Theoretically, we establish results on regret, planning invalidation, amortization, subtree interfaces, serializability, and verification. Experimentally, Eureka completes 170/170 recursive tasks and generates 3,948 certificates with no false acceptances. Active context compresses median input from 9,490 to 4,005 tokens; incremental processing avoids 65.38% recomputation across 12,000 tasks; 16,000 concurrent executions serialize consistently. The same Meta-Agent instantiates a Theory-Discovery Agent and a Math/Conjecture Agent. The former yields structural results in quantum-process and spacetime theory. The latter identifies bottlenecks in Riemann Hypothesis research and advances a positivity certificate for Suzuki's localized Weil quadratic form to 0 < a <= 69/200 = 0.345, reaching ~99.55% of (log 2)/2. These results suggest that scientific-agent capability depends not only on the base model but on whether an architecture can be formed to match the task's cognitive structure.

AI.title_translation: Eureka：任务条件化的元代理编排用于科学发现
AI.tldr: Eureka是一个任务条件化的元代理架构，通过动态编排和适应性进化，高效地完成复杂科学发现任务，其能力超越了单一基础模型的限制。
AI.motivation: 该论文的动机在于提升科学代理的能力，并提出这种能力不仅取决于基础模型，更取决于能否形成与任务认知结构相匹配的架构。旨在解决复杂、长周期的科学发现任务。
AI.method: Eureka是一个任务条件化的元代理架构，它将长周期任务编译成具有明确接受语义的动态义务图。在执行过程中，它通过后退视界规划、架构提升和最小充分编译来形成具有专业状态、内存、操作符、工具、验证器和局部拓扑的宏代理。当瓶颈反复出现时，成本效益门控的进化会在约束下更新局部架构。理论上，论文建立了关于后悔、规划失效、摊销、子树接口、可串行化和验证的结果。
AI.result: Eureka完成了170/170个递归任务，并生成了3,948个证书，无误接受。活跃上下文将中位数输入从9,490个令牌压缩到4,005个令牌。增量处理避免了12,000个任务中65.38%的重新计算。16,000个并发执行一致地串行化。同一个元代理实例化了一个理论发现代理，在量子过程和时空理论中产生了结构性结果；还实例化了一个数学/猜想代理，识别了黎曼假设研究中的瓶颈，并将铃木局部化Weil二次形式的正性证书推进到0 < a <= 69/200 = 0.345，达到了(log 2)/2的约99.55%。
AI.conclusion: 科学代理的能力不仅取决于基础模型，还取决于是否能形成与任务认知结构匹配的架构。Eureka提供了一个能够实现这种匹配的架构，并在实际科学发现任务中展示了其有效性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了Eureka，一个任务条件化的元代理架构，它将长周期任务编译成具有明确接受语义的动态义务图。在执行过程中，Eureka通过后退视界规划、架构提升和最小充分编译，形成具有专业状态、内存、操作符、工具、验证器和局部拓扑的宏代理。当瓶颈反复出现时，成本效益门控的进化会在约束下更新局部架构。理论上，我们建立了关于后悔、规划失效、摊销、子树接口、可串行化和验证的结果。实验上，Eureka完成了170/170个递归任务，并生成了3,948个证书，没有误接受。活跃上下文将中位数输入从9,490个令牌压缩到4,005个令牌；增量处理避免了12,000个任务中65.38%的重新计算；16,000个并发执行一致地串行化。同一个元代理实例化了一个理论发现代理和一个数学/猜想代理。前者在量子过程和时空理论中产生了结构性结果。后者识别了黎曼假设研究中的瓶颈，并将铃木局部化Weil二次形式的正性证书推进到0 < a <= 69/200 = 0.345，达到了(log 2)/2的约99.55%。这些结果表明，科学代理的能力不仅取决于基础模型，还取决于是否能形成与任务认知结构匹配的架构。
AI.summary: Eureka是一个任务条件化的元代理架构，旨在通过动态义务图、宏代理形成、后退视界规划和适应性进化来解决长周期科学发现任务。它在理论上建立了多项保证，并在实验中展示了在完成递归任务、上下文压缩、避免重复计算以及并发执行方面的卓越性能。Eureka还能实例化为理论发现和数学猜想代理，在量子理论和黎曼假设研究中取得了具体进展，强调了架构与任务认知结构匹配对科学代理能力的重要性。
AI.keywords: 元代理, 科学发现, 任务条件化, 架构进化, 宏代理
AI.comments: Eureka的创新在于其任务条件化的元代理架构，能够动态适应和进化以处理复杂、长周期的科学发现任务。通过结合宏代理、规划、进化机制和理论保证，它提供了一个强大的框架，超越了仅仅依赖基础模型的限制。其在量子理论和黎曼假设上的具体应用证明了其在实际科学研究中的潜力，为未来AI驱动的科学发现开辟了新途径。

title: Multi-Agent Off-Policy Deep Reinforcement Learning for Smart Campus Coverage
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has recently gained a great attention due to its real-time adaptation and effectiveness in complex optimization problems. This paper investigates the optimal deployment of millimeter-wave (mmWave) base stations (BSs) in a realistic, non-convex campus topology. The optimization problem is NP-hard, due to the non-convex, non-smooth nature of the max-min fairness objective. To overcome these constraints, we formulate the BS placement as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and systematically benchmark four DRL schemes: a discrete single-agent Deep Q-Network (DQN), a spatially partitioned Multi-Agent DQN, a continuous single-agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG), and a geographically partitioned multi-agent DDPG framework. Numerical evaluations reveal that the multi-agent DDPG approach substantially outperforms single-agent in dense scenarios. Additionally full coverage is achieved, and a fairness Jain's index of 0.94 is obtained. Finally, the multi-agent demonstrates highly efficient computational convergence of dense scenarios with $400$ users.

AI.title_translation: 多智能体离策略深度强化学习在智慧校园覆盖中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文通过多智能体离策略深度强化学习来解决智慧校园毫米波基站部署的NP难问题，结果表明多智能体DDPG在密集场景下表现优异，实现了全覆盖和高公平性。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习（DRL）在复杂优化问题中的实时适应性和有效性引起了广泛关注。本文旨在解决在现实、非凸的校园拓扑中毫米波（mmWave）基站（BS）最优部署的NP难问题，该问题由于最大最小公平性目标函数的非凸、非光滑性质而难以解决。
AI.method: 将基站部署问题公式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并系统地基准测试了四种DRL方案：离散单智能体深度Q网络（DQN）、空间分区多智能体DQN、连续单智能体深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）以及地理分区多智能体DDPG框架。
AI.result: 数值评估显示，多智能体DDPG方法在密集场景下显著优于单智能体方法。此外，实现了全覆盖，并获得了0.94的公平性Jain指数。多智能体方法在400个用户的密集场景中展示了高效的计算收敛性。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体DDPG方法能够有效解决智慧校园中毫米波基站的最优部署问题，在密集用户场景下表现出卓越的性能、全覆盖能力、高公平性以及高效的计算收敛性。
AI.translation: 深度强化学习（DRL）最近因其在复杂优化问题中的实时适应性和有效性而受到广泛关注。本文研究了在现实、非凸的校园拓扑中毫米波（mmWave）基站（BS）的最优部署。由于最大最小公平性目标的非凸、非光滑性质，该优化问题是NP难的。为了克服这些限制，我们将基站部署公式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并系统地基准测试了四种DRL方案：离散单智能体深度Q网络（DQN）、空间分区多智能体DQN、连续单智能体深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）以及地理分区多智能体DDPG框架。数值评估显示，多智能体DDPG方法在密集场景下显著优于单智能体。此外，实现了全覆盖，并获得了0.94的公平性Jain指数。最后，多智能体方法在400个用户的密集场景中展示了高效的计算收敛性。
AI.summary: 本研究利用深度强化学习解决智慧校园中毫米波基站的最优部署问题，该问题因非凸性而具有NP难特性。通过将基站部署建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并对比了单智能体与多智能体DQN和DDPG四种方案。结果表明，多智能体DDPG在密集用户场景下性能最佳，实现了全覆盖、高公平性（Jain指数0.94）和高效的计算收敛性。
AI.keywords: 多智能体, 深度强化学习, 毫米波, 基站部署, 智慧校园
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将多智能体深度强化学习应用于复杂的毫米波基站部署问题，特别是在非凸、NP难的现实校园拓扑中。其重要性在于提供了一种在密集用户环境下实现高效、公平覆盖的自动化解决方案，并证明了多智能体方法相较于单智能体的显著优势。

title: Malformer: A Multi-Modal Malware Detector Using Transformers
summary: Traditional malware detection systems that rely on a single representation of malware often fail to identify novel threats. These representations of malware binaries, also known as modalities, do not provide the models with sufficient information to discriminate among all samples. Additionally, individual representations introduce new failure modes, with some modality extraction being dependent upon the success of disassembling. Past works have integrated either additional modalities or more discriminative representations for classification. In this work, we present Malformer, a quadrimodal malware detection model that incorporates text, image, graph, and audio representations of Windows executables. We demonstrate that multimodal transformer fusion can enhance the performance of Windows malware detectors over that of unimodal and bimodal detectors. Malformer employs a combination of two RoBERTa encoders paired with a modified Vision Transformer for image data, WavLM for audio data, and an adaptive loss-weighting scheme to fuse modality-specific representations. Evaluated on a dataset of 201,549 binary samples, Malformer achieved 98.3% accuracy and an F1 score of 0.9833, outperforming both unimodal baselines and bimodal detectors by 4.6-17.6 percentage points. Malformer demonstrates that multimodal fusion provides a promising foundation for countering the growing scale of malware threats, equipping defenders with generalized and resilient detection capabilities.

AI.title_translation: Malformer：使用Transformer的多模态恶意软件检测器
AI.tldr: Malformer利用文本、图像、图和音频四种模态结合Transformer进行恶意软件检测，准确率高达98.3%。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于单一表示的恶意软件检测系统往往无法识别新型威胁，单个模态信息不足且容易引入新的失效模式（如依赖于反汇编的成功率），因此需要集成更多且更具判别力的表示。
AI.method: 提出了Malformer模型，包含两个RoBERTa编码器、一个改进的视觉Transformer（用于图像）、WavLM（用于音频），以及一个用于融合各模态特定表示的自适应损失加权方案。
AI.result: 在包含201,549个二进制样本的数据集上评估，Malformer达到了98.3%的准确率和0.9833的F1分数，比单模态和双模态检测器高出4.6到17.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 多模态Transformer融合（如Malformer所采用的架构）能够显著增强Windows恶意软件检测器的性能和鲁棒性，为应对日益复杂的网络安全威胁提供了有前景的解决方案。
AI.translation: 依赖于单一恶意软件表示的传统恶意软件检测系统往往无法识别新的威胁。这些被称为模态的恶意软件二进制文件表示没有为模型提供足够的信息来区分所有样本。此外，个别表示引入了新的失效模式，某些模态提取依赖于反汇编的成功与否。过去的工作整合了额外的模态或用于分类的更具判别力的表示。在这项工作中，我们提出了Malformer，这是一个四模态恶意软件检测模型，它结合了Windows可执行文件的文本、图像、图和音频表示。我们证明了多模态Transformer融合可以提高Windows恶意软件检测器的性能，超越单模态和双模态检测器。Malformer结合了两个RoBERTa编码器、一个用于图像数据的修改版视觉Transformer、用于音频数据的WavLM，以及一个用于融合模态特定表示的自适应损失加权方案。在包含201,549个二进制样本的数据集上进行评估，Malformer取得了98.3%的准确率和0.9833的F1分数，比单模态和双模态基线高出4.6到17.6个百分点。Malformer证明了多模态融合为对抗不断增长的恶意软件威胁规模提供了有前景的基础，为防御者配备了通用且具韧性的检测能力。
AI.summary: Malformer是一个基于Transformer的四模态恶意软件检测模型，它结合了Windows可执行文件的文本、图像、图和音频表示，通过多模态融合显著提升了恶意软件检测的准确率和泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 恶意软件检测, 多模态融合, Transformer, 深度学习, 信息安全
AI.comments: 创新性地引入了四模态（文本、图像、图、音频）结合Transformer融合架构来检测Windows恶意软件，展现了极高的准确率和鲁棒性，克服了传统单模态检测易受反汇编失败影响的局限。

title: Generalized Audio-Driven Synthesis of Precise Drummer Motion
comments: Best Paper Award at the 25th ACM SIGGRAPH / Eurographics Symposium on Computer Animation (SCA 2026). For Supplementary Video, see https://studios.disneyresearch.com/2026/08/18/generalized-audio-driven-synthesis-of-precise-drummer-motion/
summary: Music-driven character animation enables and enhances transformative applications in entertainment and interactive education. However, synthesizing realistic drumming motion from audio remains challenging due to the inherent tension between high-acceleration dynamics and the need for extreme spatial-temporal precision. Existing approaches, often reliant on motion matching or MIDI input, struggle with generalizing to diverse real-world audio. Moreover, the field lacks standardized evaluation metrics capable of distinguishing precise drumming from noisy motion. In this paper, we introduce a generative diffusion framework featuring a dual-objective loss function that decouples skeletal integrity from drumstick precision, thus enabling centimeter-level stick precision without sacrificing natural body dynamics. Additionally, leveraging our own dataset and data augmentation strategy, the model generalizes to non-curated, in-the-wild audio. To rigorously evaluate performance, we propose two novel metrics: an impact-to-target distance to quantify spatial precision and an audio-motion correlation score to assess temporal alignment. Our quantitative analysis and user studies demonstrate that our system generates high-quality motion that is often indistinguishable from ground-truth performances.
comment: Best Paper Award at the 25th ACM SIGGRAPH / Eurographics Symposium on Computer Animation (SCA 2026). For Supplementary Video, see https://studios.disneyresearch.com/2026/08/18/generalized-audio-driven-synthesis-of-precise-drummer-motion/

AI.title_translation: 广义音频驱动的精确鼓手动作合成
AI.tldr: 本文提出一个生成扩散框架，利用双目标损失函数和新颖的评估指标，从多样化的真实音频中合成厘米级精确且自然的鼓手动作，表现优于现有方法并与真实表演难以区分。
AI.motivation: 从音频合成逼真的鼓手动作极具挑战，因为它涉及高加速度动态和极端的时空精确性之间的固有矛盾。现有方法（依赖动作匹配或MIDI输入）难以泛化到多样化的真实世界音频。此外，该领域缺乏能够区分精确击鼓和嘈杂动作的标准化评估指标。
AI.method: 本文引入了一个生成扩散框架，其特点是采用双目标损失函数，将骨骼完整性与鼓槌精确度解耦，从而在不牺牲自然身体动态的情况下实现厘米级的鼓槌精确度。模型利用自建数据集和数据增强策略，能够泛化到非筛选的、真实世界的音频。为了严格评估性能，提出了两个新颖的指标：用于量化空间精确度的“冲击到目标距离”和用于评估时间对齐的“音频-动作相关性得分”。
AI.result: 该系统能够在不牺牲自然身体动态的情况下实现厘米级的鼓槌精确度。该模型能够泛化到非筛选的、真实世界的音频。定量分析和用户研究表明，该系统生成的高质量动作通常与真实表演难以区分。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功解决了从多样化音频合成精确且自然鼓手动作的挑战，提出了一个鲁棒的框架和新颖的评估指标，实现了高质量、逼真的结果。
AI.translation: 音乐驱动的角色动画在娱乐和互动教育中实现了并增强了变革性应用。然而，由于高加速度动态与极端时空精确性需求之间的固有矛盾，从音频合成逼真的击鼓动作仍然充满挑战。现有方法通常依赖动作匹配或MIDI输入，难以泛化到多样化的真实世界音频。此外，该领域缺乏能够区分精确击鼓和嘈杂动作的标准化评估指标。在本文中，我们引入了一个生成扩散框架，其特点是采用双目标损失函数，将骨骼完整性与鼓槌精确度解耦，从而在不牺牲自然身体动态的情况下实现厘米级的鼓槌精确度。此外，利用我们自己的数据集和数据增强策略，该模型能够泛化到非筛选的、真实世界的音频。为了严格评估性能，我们提出了两个新颖的指标：用于量化空间精确度的“冲击到目标距离”和用于评估时间对齐的“音频-动作相关性得分”。我们的定量分析和用户研究表明，我们的系统生成的高质量动作通常与真实表演难以区分。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种广义音频驱动的鼓手动作合成方法，通过引入一个生成扩散框架和双目标损失函数，解决了从多样化真实音频合成精确且自然鼓手动作的挑战。该框架实现了厘米级的鼓槌精确度，同时保持了身体动态的自然性，并能泛化到非筛选的真实世界音频。为严格评估，研究还提出了两个新颖的评估指标。定量分析和用户研究表明，其系统生成的动作质量高，常与真实表演难以区分。
AI.keywords: 音频驱动动画, 鼓手动作合成, 生成扩散模型, 运动合成, 评估指标
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了生成扩散框架和双目标损失函数，有效解决了高精度与自然动态之间的矛盾。同时，自建数据集、数据增强策略以及提出的新颖评估指标，显著提升了模型在真实世界音频上的泛化能力和评估的严谨性，对音乐驱动的角色动画领域具有重要贡献。

title: LT-Mem: Volatility-Aware Spatio-Temporal Memory for Lifelong Scene Understanding
comments: 8 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Long-term robot operation in evolving environments requires object-level understanding that persists across repeated revisits. Existing systems either overwrite history to maintain an up-to-date map or store semantic snapshots without consistent cross-session object identity, resulting in temporal amnesia: the systematic loss of object history that prevents answering queries such as "Where has the green chair been across all sessions?" We propose LT-Mem, a volatility-aware memory evolution framework that unifies spatially aligned instance-level 3D perception with volatility-conditioned temporal reasoning. First, a multi-session SLAM backbone provides spatially aligned per-object observations across sessions. Second, a reasoning layer governs how object memory evolves: deterministic evidence scoring preserves cross-session identity, and a volatility-aware policy selects among overwrite, hold, and multi-hypothesis actions based on each object's dynamics. Third, the resulting Tri-Memory structure (Live, Delta, Meta) preserves both current states and event histories, enabling longitudinal object-centric reasoning. We further introduce LT-VQA, a dataset and evaluation suite comprising multi-session recordings, persistent identity annotations, and temporal QA pairs. Experiments show that LT-Mem consistently outperforms baselines across all metrics while consuming an order of magnitude fewer tokens, and ablations confirm that gains are driven by the structured memory architecture rather than LLM capacity.
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)

AI.title_translation: LT-Mem：用于长效场景理解的波动感知时空记忆
AI.tldr: 本文提出了LT-Mem，一种结合波动感知策略与Tri-Memory结构的机器人长效时空记忆框架，解决了跨会话对象身份保持与时间推理难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人长期环境理解系统要么覆盖历史以保持地图最新，要么存储缺乏跨会话一致对象身份的语义快照，导致“时间遗忘”，无法回答跨会话的纵向对象查询问题。
AI.method: 提出LT-Mem框架，包含多会话SLAM骨干网络、波动感知记忆演化推理层（通过确定性证据评分和波动感知策略选择覆写、保持或多假设操作）以及由Live、Delta和Meta组成的Tri-Memory结构。
AI.result: 实验表明，LT-Mem在所有指标上均持续优于基线，同时消耗少一个数量级的Token。消融实验证实性能提升源于结构化记忆架构而非LLM容量。
AI.conclusion: LT-Mem通过波动感知的时空记忆架构和Tri-Memory结构，有效解决了长期机器人操作中的时间遗忘问题，在效率和性能上均显著优于现有基线。
AI.translation: 在不断变化的环境中进行长期机器人操作，需要跨越重复访问保持持久的对象级理解。现有系统要么覆盖历史以维护最新地图，要么存储缺乏一致的跨会话对象身份的语义快照，从而导致时间遗忘：系统性地丢失对象历史，从而无法回答诸如“绿色椅子在所有会话中去过哪里？”之类的查询。我们提出了LT-Mem，一个波动感知的记忆演化框架，它将空间对齐的实例级3D感知与波动条件下的时间推理统一起来。首先，多会话SLAM骨干网络提供跨会话的空间对齐的每个对象的观测。其次，推理层控制对象记忆的演化：确定性证据评分保持跨会话身份，而波动感知策略根据每个对象的动态在覆写、保持和多假设操作之间进行选择。第三，生成的Tri-Memory结构（Live、Delta、Meta）既保留了当前状态又保留了事件历史，从而实现了纵向的以对象为中心的推理。我们进一步推出了LT-VQA，这是一个包含多会话录制、持久身份标注和时间QA对的数据集和评估套件。实验表明，LT-Mem在所有指标上始终优于基线，同时消耗的Token少一个数量级，消融实验证实增益是由结构化记忆架构而不是LLM容量驱动的。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LT-Mem，一个波动感知的时空记忆演化框架，用于解决机器人长期运行中的时间遗忘问题。该框架结合了多会话SLAM、波动感知的记忆推理层以及Tri-Memory结构，并引入了LT-VQA数据集和评估套件，实现了高效且鲁棒的跨会话对象感知与时间推理。
AI.keywords: 长效场景理解, 3D感知, 时空记忆, 机器人SLAM, 视觉问答
AI.comments: 该论文针对机器人长期场景理解中的时空记忆难题，创新性地提出了LT-Mem框架及Tri-Memory结构，并引入了LT-VQA数据集，在保持高效率的同时显著提升了跨会话对象恒定性和时间推理能力。

title: Computational Features for Symbolic Melody Analysis
summary: This paper addresses the general problem of extracting music-theoretic and psychological features from symbolically encoded melodies. We review existing melodic feature extraction toolboxes, enumerate their features, and organise them into a common taxonomy. We then describe a new software library that provides implementations of all of these features in a straightforward Python package. We then demonstrate the combined feature set on the Essen Folksong Collection, using the dataset to produce a series of style classification models. These models help us answer key questions about the interpretability and dimensionality of the feature set. Our results show excellent classification accuracy using the full feature set, and promising performance for an eight-dimensional factor-analytic solution that improves the interpretability of the classifier. We distribute our new toolbox as an open-source Python package, $\mathtt{melody-features}$, which can easily be used in various applications within music analysis, music psychology, and music information retrieval.

AI.title_translation: 符号化旋律分析的计算特征
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的符号化旋律特征分类体系，并开源了Python工具箱 melody-features，通过民歌分类实验展示了其高准确率与良好的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 为了解决从符号编码的旋律中提取音乐理论和心理学特征的问题，并克服现有特征提取工具箱分散、缺乏统一分类体系以及可解释性不足的缺点。
AI.method: 回顾并组织现有旋律特征为统一的分类体系；开发新的Python软件库 melody-features 实现所有特征；在爱森民歌集（Essen Folksong Collection）上构建风格分类模型，并应用因子分析研究特征的维度和可解释性。
AI.result: 使用完整特征集获得了极佳的分类准确率，并且8维的因子分析解决方案在保持良好性能的同时显著提高了分类器的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功开发并开源了 melody-features 工具包，证明了全面旋律特征集在民歌风格分类中的有效性，同时8维因子分析方案兼顾了分类准确率与模型可解释性。
AI.translation: 本文探讨了从符号编码的旋律中提取音乐理论和心理学特征这一普遍问题。我们回顾现有的旋律特征提取工具箱，枚举其特征，并将其组织到一个共同的分类体系中。随后，我们描述了一个新的软件库，它在一个直观的Python包中提供了所有这些特征的实现。接着，我们在爱森民歌集（Essen Folksong Collection）上演示了组合特征集的应用，利用该数据集构建了一系列风格分类模型。这些模型帮助我们回答了关于该特征集的解释性和维度的关键问题。我们的结果表明，使用完整的特征集可以获得出色的分类准确度，而八维因子分析解决方案在提高分类器可解释性的同时表现出广阔的应用前景。我们将我们的新工具包作为开源Python包 $\mathtt{melody-features}$ 进行发布，它可以轻松用于音乐分析、音乐心理学和音乐信息检索中的各种应用。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一个统一的分类体系，并开发了一个名为 melody-features 的开源Python库，用于提取符号化旋律的音乐理论和心理学特征。通过在爱森民歌集上的风格分类实验，验证了该特征集的准确性与可解释性。
AI.keywords: 符号化旋律分析, 特征提取, 音乐信息检索, 风格分类, Python库
AI.comments: 该论文通过系统梳理和实现符号化旋律特征提取工具箱，并开源Python库 melody-features，为音乐学、音乐心理学和音乐信息检索提供了强有力的计算分析支持。创新点在于分类整理了现有特征并进行了实证降维和可解释性分析。

title: When Two Tracers Disagree: An Investigation of Multimodal Fusion for Clinical PET/CT Segmentation
comments: 10 pages (8 pages main content and 2 pages of references), 2 figures, 2 tables, accepted to MICCAI 2026 Cancer Prevention, Detection, and IntervenTion (CaPTion) Workshop
summary: PSMA and FDG PET/CT visualise complementary biological information in prostate cancer. Combining both tracers could capture heterogeneous tumour phenotypes that may be missed by either alone, yet there is no consensus on effective deep learning architectures for fusing these modalities. We evaluated multimodal image-fusion strategies for automatic whole-body PET/CT lesion segmentation to estimate total tumour burden. Using the public DEEP-PSMA Challenge dataset, we trained tracer-specific 3D nnU-Net baselines and compared (i) early fusion with a single encoder and one decoder (OEOD) or two decoders (OETD), and (ii) intermediate fusion via a dual-encoder cross-attention U-Net (DECA-UNet). Tracer-specific baselines performed strongly (PSMA Dice = 0.93; FDG = 0.81). Fusion yielded mixed results: OEOD produced a combined Dice of 0.90 (on an easier, non-tracer-specific task), whilst the tracer-specific fusion models reached PSMA/FDG = 0.69/0.64 (OETD) and 0.76/0.57 (DECA-UNet). Whilst fusion often provided reasonable PSMA segmentation, FDG performance degraded and no strategy consistently exceeded the single-tracer baselines. Under the evaluated setting, tracer-specific models remain the stronger baseline; clinically useful gains from multimodal fusion will likely require architectures that better preserve tracer specific representations. Our code is available at: https://github.com/JackJ3636/DEEP_PSMA_code
comment: 10 pages (8 pages main content and 2 pages of references), 2 figures, 2 tables, accepted to MICCAI 2026 Cancer Prevention, Detection, and IntervenTion (CaPTion) Workshop

AI.title_translation: 当两种示踪剂产生分歧时：临床PET/CT分割中多模态融合的探讨
AI.tldr: 本研究评估了前列腺癌PSMA和FDG PET/CT的多模态融合分割策略，发现当前融合架构未能超越单一示踪剂基线，凸显了改进示踪剂特征保留的必要性。
AI.motivation: PSMA和FDG PET/CT在前列腺癌中展示了互补的生物学信息，结合这两种示踪剂可以捕捉单一示踪剂可能漏掉的异质性肿瘤表型，但目前对于融合这些模态的有效深度学习架构尚未达成共识。
AI.method: 使用公开的DEEP-PSMA挑战数据集，训练了特定示踪剂的3D nnU-Net基线，并对比了早期融合（单编码器单解码器OEOD、单编码器双解码器OETD）以及通过双编码器交叉注意力U-Net（DECA-UNet）实现的中期融合策略。
AI.result: 单一示踪剂基线表现强劲（PSMA Dice=0.93，FDG=0.81）。然而融合策略效果参差不齐：OEOD取得了0.90的组合Dice，但OETD和DECA-UNet在特定示踪剂的分割上表现下降（PSMA/FDG分别为0.69/0.64和0.76/0.57），没有一种融合策略能 consistently 超越单示踪剂基线。
AI.conclusion: 在当前的评估设置下，单一示踪剂模型仍是更强的基线。多模态融合若要实现临床上有用的性能提升，需要开发能更好保留示踪剂特异性表征的新架构。
AI.translation: PSMA和FDG PET/CT在前列腺癌中可视化了互补的生物学信息。结合这两种示踪剂可以捕捉单一示踪剂可能漏掉的异质性肿瘤表型，然而目前对于用于融合这些模态的有效深度学习架构尚未达成共识。我们评估了多模态图像融合策略，用于自动全身PET/CT病灶分割以估计总肿瘤负荷。使用公开的DEEP-PSMA挑战数据集，我们训练了特定示踪剂的3D nnU-Net基线，并比较了（i）具有单个编码器和一个解码器（OEOD）或两个解码器（OETD）的早期融合，以及（ii）通过双编码器交叉注意力U-Net（DECA-UNet）进行的中期融合。特定示踪剂基线表现强劲（PSMA Dice = 0.93；FDG = 0.81）。融合产生了混合的结果：OEOD产生了0.90的组合Dice（在更简单的非特定示踪剂任务上），而特定示踪剂融合模型达到了PSMA/FDG = 0.69/0.64（OETD）和0.76/0.57（DECA-UNet）。虽然融合通常提供合理的PSMA分割，但FDG性能下降，且没有一种策略始终超过单一示踪剂基线。在所评估的设置下，特定示踪剂模型仍然是更强的基线；来自多模态融合的临床有用增益可能需要更好地保留示踪剂特定表征的架构。我们的代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/JackJ3636/DEEP_PSMA_code
AI.summary: 该论文研究了多模态融合策略在临床PSMA和FDG PET/CT图像联合分割中的应用，评估了早期和中期融合架构，并发现当前的融合方法未能超越单示踪剂基线模型，强调了开发能更好保持示踪剂特异性表征的新架构之必要性。
AI.keywords: 多模态融合, PET/CT分割, PSMA, FDG, nnU-Net
AI.comments: 该论文通过严谨的实验评估了前列腺癌中PSMA和FDG双示踪剂PET/CT图像的多模态融合分割性能。结果表明，当前的多模态融合策略反而不如单一示踪剂基线，揭示了多模态融合在保留各自特征表达方面的挑战，对未来医疗图像融合研究具有重要的警示和指导意义。

title: GS-VLA: Plug-and-Play Viewpoint Canonicalization for Frozen VLA Policies via Gaussian Splatting
summary: This paper proposes a lightweight, plug-and-play framework that improves robustness to viewpoint shifts in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies without policy retraining. To our knowledge, this is the first approach to directly leverage 3D Gaussian-based novel-view synthesis for observation-space adaptation in VLA policies. Current VLA performance relies on the implicit assumption that training and deployment camera configurations are identical. Our experiments show that even a small displacement of the camera mount can reduce the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark from about 90% to about 10% in the worst case. Prior approaches, such as large-scale fine-tuning or generative data augmentation, are computationally expensive and risk catastrophic forgetting. To address this, viewpoint shifts are reformulated as a localized novel-view synthesis problem. Under a Locality assumption, that camera perturbations remain within a small bounded region relative to the workspace, viewpoint normalization reduces to a scene- and policy-independent disocclusion task. Our work implements this idea with a 4M-parameter 3D-Gaussian canonicalizer prepended to a frozen VLA policy. Without modifying policy weights, GS-VLA improves performance across three orthogonal axes: (1) Policy architectures, (2) Unseen task suites, and (3) Perturbation scales. These results show that a lightweight visual module can recover a large fraction of the performance lost under viewpoint shift, without policy retraining.

AI.title_translation: GS-VLA：通过高斯散射为冻结的VLA策略提供即插即用的视角规范化
AI.tldr: GS-VLA是一个轻量级的3D高斯观察适配模块，无需重新训练即可大幅提升机器人VLA策略对相机视角变化的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略对相机视角变化非常敏感，微小的相机位移会导致成功率急剧下降，而现有的微调或生成式数据增强方法计算成本高且易导致灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出GS-VLA框架，将视角偏移重新表述为局部的从新视角合成问题，在冻结的VLA策略前置一个4M参数的3D高斯规范化模块来实现观察空间的自适应。
AI.result: 在无需修改策略权重的情况下，GS-VLA在策略架构、未见任务集和扰动尺度三个正交轴上均提升了性能，恢复了绝大部分因视角偏移而损失的性能。
AI.conclusion: GS-VLA通过在冻结的VLA策略前引入一个轻量级的3D高斯归一化器，有效解决了相机视角变化导致的性能下降问题，且无需重新训练策略。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种轻量级的、即插即用的框架，在无需重新训练策略的情况下，提高了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略对视角偏移的鲁棒性。据我们所知，这是第一种直接利用基于3D高斯的从新视角合成来进行VLA策略观察空间自适应的方法。当前VLA的性能依赖于训练和部署相机配置相同的隐式假设。我们的实验表明，即使是微小的相机安装位移，在最坏情况下也能将LIBERO基准测试的成功率从约90%降至约10%。先前的方法（如大规模微调或生成式数据增强）计算成本高昂，且存在灾难性遗忘的风险。为了解决这一问题，视角偏移被重新表述为一个局部的从新视角合成问题。在局部性假设（即相机扰动保持在相对于工作空间的较小有界区域内）下，视角归一化简化为一个与场景和策略无关的去遮挡任务。本工作通过在冻结的VLA策略前置一个400万参数的3D高斯规范化器来实现这一想法。在不修改策略权重的情况下，GS-VLA在三个正交轴上提升了性能：(1) 策略架构，(2) 未见任务集，以及 (3) 扰动尺度。这些结果表明，一个轻量级的视觉模块就可以恢复在视角偏移下丢失的大部分性能，而无需重新训练策略。
AI.summary: 论文提出了GS-VLA，一种基于3D高斯散射的轻量级即插即用框架，用于在不重新训练策略的情况下提高视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略对视角偏移的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: Vision-Language-Action, 视角规范化, 3D高斯散射, 机器人学习, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地利用了3D高斯散射技术解决VLA策略在视角偏移下的鲁棒性问题，避免了昂贵的策略微调和灾难性遗忘，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。

title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can now post-train an LLM end-to-end. They can write code, launch training, evaluate checkpoints, and improve downstream performance, raising the prospect of AI-for-AI. We argue that this picture conflates two distinct capabilities: execution-level capability, iterating within a selected training strategy; and strategy-level capability, revising the high-level judgment as experimental evidence accumulates. Analyzing a large corpus of publicly released post-training trajectories, we find that across different tasks, the agent's training strategy is locked in at the very beginning, and the entire remaining budget is spent on local adjustments within the selected strategy. We then examine three natural explanations--missing experience, missing guidance, and insufficient reasoning--with escalating interventions. Extensive experiments show that (1) an experience-driven scaffold improves execution across the board (+12.6 points on GSM8K and +40.8 on HumanEval) but leaves the strategy static; (2) human guidance effectively redirects the initial strategy, yet the agent falls back into local adjustment loops once training starts; and (3) additional inference compute pays off on easier tasks but yields almost no gain on the hardest one. In conclusion, what agents lack is neither experience, guidance, nor reasoning compute, but a mechanism for spontaneously reevaluating their strategy during execution.

AI.title_translation: AI后训练AI中缺少什么：一项实证分析
AI.tldr: LLM代理在后训练LLM时，擅长执行层面的迭代，但缺乏在实验证据积累后重新评估和调整高层策略的能力，导致其策略在一开始就被锁定。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语言模型（LLM）代理可以端到端地对LLM进行后训练，引发了“AI为AI”的前景。但作者认为这混淆了执行层能力和策略层能力，并指出当前AI后训练中可能缺少关键机制。
AI.method: 本文首先分析了大量公开的后训练轨迹语料库，发现代理的训练策略从一开始就被锁定。其次，通过逐步升级的干预措施，检验了三种自然解释：缺少经验、缺少指导和推理不足。最后，进行了广泛的实验以验证这些解释。
AI.result: 通过对大量后训练轨迹的分析发现，代理的训练策略从一开始就被锁定，剩余预算全部用于选定策略内的局部调整。通过实验发现：(1) 经验驱动的脚手架全面提升了执行能力（GSM8K提高12.6分，HumanEval提高40.8分），但策略仍然保持静态；(2) 人类指导能有效重定向初始策略，但训练一旦开始，代理又会回到局部调整循环；(3) 额外的推理计算对较简单的任务有效，但对最难的任务几乎没有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 代理所缺乏的既不是经验、指导，也不是推理计算，而是在执行过程中自发重新评估其策略的机制。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理现在可以端到端地对LLM进行后训练。它们可以编写代码、启动训练、评估检查点并提高下游性能，从而引发了“AI为AI”的前景。我们认为，这种观点混淆了两种不同的能力：执行层能力（在选定的训练策略内迭代）和策略层能力（随着实验证据的积累而修订高层判断）。通过分析大量公开的后训练轨迹语料库，我们发现，在不同任务中，代理的训练策略从一开始就被锁定，并且所有剩余预算都用于选定策略内的局部调整。然后，我们通过逐步升级的干预措施，检验了三种自然解释——缺少经验、缺少指导和推理不足。广泛的实验表明：(1) 经验驱动的脚手架全面提升了执行能力（在GSM8K上提高12.6分，在HumanEval上提高40.8分），但策略保持静态；(2) 人类指导能有效重定向初始策略，但一旦训练开始，代理又会陷入局部调整循环；(3) 额外的推理计算在较简单的任务上有所回报，但在最难的任务上几乎没有增益。总之，代理所缺乏的既不是经验、指导，也不是推理计算，而是在执行过程中自发重新评估其策略的机制。
AI.summary: 本文实证分析了大型语言模型（LLM）代理在LLM后训练中的能力。研究发现，尽管LLM代理在执行层面表现出色，能够迭代训练和优化性能，但其高层训练策略在早期就被锁定，无法根据后续实验证据进行动态调整。通过测试经验、指导和推理计算等干预措施，作者得出结论，代理缺乏的是在执行过程中自发重新评估其策略的机制，而非简单的经验、指导或计算力不足。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 后训练, 策略调整, 经验, 指导, 推理计算
AI.comments: 这篇论文揭示了当前AI在“AI为AI”范式中的一个关键局限性，即缺乏高层策略的动态调整能力。其创新点在于区分了执行层和策略层能力，并通过实证分析和受控实验验证了这一假设。这对于未来设计更自主、适应性更强的AI系统具有重要指导意义，尤其是在需要长期、多阶段优化的复杂任务中。

title: Robust Risk Under Evolving Uncertainty: A Wasserstein Counterpart of the Entropic Value-at-Risk
comments: Best Paper Award at the 2nd Workshop on Safe AI at UAI (SafeAI@UAI 2026, non-archival), Amsterdam
summary: An agent still learning its environment should be cautious while ignorant and bold once confident. The entropic value-at-risk captures this through a robust-optimization identity---a confidence level fixes the radius of a relative-entropy ball of alternative models---but that ball cannot reach catastrophes the nominal deems impossible, precisely what a safe agent must hedge. We instead use an optimal-transport ball and study the coherent risk measure it induces, the Wasserstein entropic value-at-risk. It has a variational dual mirroring the entropic formula (an inverse temperature becomes a transport price), occupies a definite place in the risk hierarchy, and provably accounts for the reachable catastrophes the entropic measure ignores; we verify both dualities numerically. Driving the transport radius by belief entropy then yields a closed-form robust dynamic-programming operator whose caution contracts as the belief sharpens, with a certified safety sandwich and a sharp safety switch.
comment: Best Paper Award at the 2nd Workshop on Safe AI at UAI (SafeAI@UAI 2026, non-archival), Amsterdam

AI.title_translation: 演化不确定性下的鲁棒风险：熵值风险的Wasserstein对应物
AI.tldr: 本文引入了Wasserstein熵值风险（WEVaR），这是一种新的鲁棒风险度量，通过最优传输球克服了传统熵值风险（EVaR）无法捕捉名义模型认为不可能的灾难性事件的局限性，并且能够在代理人信念演化时动态调整其谨慎性。
AI.motivation: 传统熵值风险（EVaR）使用相对熵球来捕捉不确定性，但该球无法触及名义模型认为不可能的灾难性事件，而这些正是谨慎代理人必须对冲的风险。
AI.method: 论文引入了一种新的相干风险度量，即Wasserstein熵值风险（WEVaR），它使用最优传输球替代相对熵球。研究了它的变分对偶性（逆温度变为传输价格），确定了它在风险等级中的位置，并证明了它能解释熵度量忽略的可达灾难。通过信念熵驱动传输半径，得到了一个闭式鲁棒动态规划算子。
AI.result: WEVaR具有镜像熵公式的变分对偶性；在风险等级中占据明确位置；可证明地解释了熵度量忽略的可达灾难；对偶性已通过数值验证。通过信念熵驱动传输半径，得到一个闭式鲁棒动态规划算子，其谨慎性随信念的清晰而收缩，并具有认证安全夹层和尖锐安全开关。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出Wasserstein熵值风险（WEVaR）作为一种在演化不确定性下更鲁棒的风险度量，它通过引入最优传输球克服了传统熵值风险在捕捉极端灾难事件方面的局限性，并展示了其理论性质和在动态规划中的应用。
AI.translation: 代理人在学习其环境时，在无知时应谨慎，一旦自信则应大胆。熵值风险通过一个鲁棒优化恒等式捕捉了这一点——一个置信水平固定了替代模型的相对熵球半径——但该球无法触及名义模型认为不可能的灾难，而这正是谨慎代理人必须对冲的。我们转而使用最优传输球，并研究其诱导的相干风险度量，即Wasserstein熵值风险。它具有镜像熵公式的变分对偶性（逆温度变为传输价格），在风险等级中占据明确位置，并可证明地解释了熵度量忽略的可达灾难；我们通过数值验证了这两种对偶性。然后，通过信念熵驱动传输半径，得到了一个闭式鲁棒动态规划算子，其谨慎性随信念的清晰而收缩，并具有认证安全夹层和尖锐安全开关。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统熵值风险（EVaR）无法捕捉名义模型认为不可能的灾难性事件的局限性，提出了一种新的相干鲁棒风险度量——Wasserstein熵值风险（WEVaR）。WEVaR通过使用最优传输球替代相对熵球，能够解释EVaR忽略的可达灾难。研究结果表明，WEVaR具有独特的变分对偶性，并在风险等级中占据明确位置。此外，通过信念熵驱动传输半径，本文推导出了一个闭式鲁棒动态规划算子，其谨慎性会随着信念的增强而降低，并具有经过认证的安全保障。
AI.keywords: 鲁棒风险, Wasserstein, 熵值风险, 最优传输, 演化不确定性
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入Wasserstein距离和最优传输理论，巧妙地解决了传统熵值风险在处理极端“不可能”灾难事件时的局限性，这是一个重要的创新。它为在演化不确定性下进行更全面的风险管理提供了一个理论上更严谨、实践中更安全的工具，特别是在代理人学习环境时，能动态调整其谨慎程度。其在动态规划中的应用也展示了该方法的广阔潜力。

title: ReWEIGH the Evidence: Calibrating Token-Level Ordinal Visual Evidence to Mitigate Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate, generating content that the input image does not support. Preventing such content during decoding calls for a candidate-specific measure of how strongly the image supports the token under consideration. The model's visual-token states offer a natural source of this evidence because projecting each state through the output head reveals which vocabulary items that position favors. These position-wise readouts cannot be pooled directly because their probability magnitudes are not comparable across visual positions. Vocabulary ranks provide a scale-invariant basis for pooling, but tokens still differ systematically in their typical rank-based evidence. We propose ReWEIGH, a training-free decoding intervention that aggregates these ranks across visual positions and compares each candidate with a token-specific reference estimated from unlabeled images. At inference, ReWEIGH caches the image evidence during prefill and applies a bounded penalty only to candidates that fall below their reference. On four 7B backbones, ReWEIGH reduces hallucinated object mentions by up to 21.3% while largely preserving or improving descriptive and general performance. With evidence cached, the average added latency is 1.33% per token, and the reductions extend across six architecture families to 32B parameters.

AI.title_translation: 重新衡量证据：校准令牌级序数视觉证据以减轻大型视觉语言模型中的幻觉

title: Subgroup performance analysis of adaptation strategies for chest X-ray foundation models
comments: Accepted at MICCAI Workshop on Fairness of AI in Medical Imaging (FAIMI) 2026
summary: Foundation models are increasingly adapted for downstream medical imaging tasks, yet the influence of the chosen adaptation strategy on subgroup fairness remains poorly understood. We investigate how three parameter-efficient adaptation techniques, including linear heads on the raw CLS token, an MLP, and an attention-pooling module over multi-layer patch features, affect both pathology classification performance and subgroup disparities when applied to the frozen Rad-DINO chest X-ray encoder. Using MIMIC-CXR, we evaluate eight pathologies across race, sex, and imaging-view subgroups on a prevalence-preserving, demographically balanced test set, and additionally probe how strongly each adapter encodes protected attributes. We find that attention pooling achieves the strongest overall discriminative performance and encodes attributes, particularly race, most strongly, but that improved overall performance does not consistently reduce subgroup disparities. Notably, stronger attribute encoding did not correspond to larger disparities: early network layers encoded race most weakly yet produced the largest subgroup performance gaps. Exploring different attention-pooling layer combinations further revealed no consistent relationship between the layers pooled, attribute encoding strength, and subgroup fairness. Our results indicate that richer, more expressive representations can improve accuracy while leaving fairness implications task-dependent and unpredictable, which must be assessed directly and per-task rather than inferred from encoding strength or overall performance alone.

title: SPK: Eliciting Structured Prior Knowledge for Interpretable Out-of-Distribution Detection in Real-Time Object Detection
summary: Object detectors often produce over-confident predictions for objects outside their training categories, leading to so-called out-of-distribution (OoD) hallucinations. Existing approaches for detecting or mitigating such hallucinations typically either construct scoring functions directly over learned object detector representations or modify the object detector itself to suppress hallucination emergence. However, the latent priors implicitly encoded in these representations remain largely unexplored and have not been explicitly decoded for OoD detection. To uncover and exploit these latent priors, we propose Structured Prior Knowledge (SPK), a hallucination-oriented framework that explicitly elicits OoD-relevant priors from pretrained object detectors. Specifically, SPK leverages in-distribution data and hallucination-inducing samples as diagnostic supervision to elicit part-level semantic concepts underlying object detector decision-making, rather than using them merely for rejection or object detector adaptation. The elicited semantic priors are further integrated with geometric and contextual priors to form a compact five-dimensional SPK representation for OoD detection. Extensive experiments across diverse object detector architectures and multiple OoD benchmarks demonstrate that SPK achieves state-of-the-art OoD detection. Our findings reveal that pretrained object detectors already encode substantially richer latent knowledge than is typically exploited for OoD detection. More importantly, this knowledge can be explicitly elicited and organized into a compact, structured, and interpretable knowledge space for prediction reliability analysis. This suggests a promising proactive route for improving object detector reliability by explicitly uncovering and leveraging latent priors. Code and data are available at: https://gricad-gitlab.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/dnn-safety/spk

title: Space-Efficient Hierholzer for Undirected Graphs
summary: We present a simple linear-time algorithm that outputs an Eulerian tour of an undirected multigraph with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges, if one exists, in $O(m)$ time and using $O(n)$ words of working memory. The input is given as read-only adjacency lists, and the output is written to an append-only stream in traversal order. Our algorithm first finds a sparse spanning circuit (a skeleton), then traverses the circuit step-by-step, repeatedly outputting further circuits rooted at the current vertex. This solves a problem left open by Ismaili Alaoui, Plump, and Wild (SOSA 2026): their space-efficient variant of Hierholzer's algorithm handles general directed multigraphs, but it is unclear how to generalize it to general undirected multigraphs. Our result completes the picture in the read-only model for space-efficient output of Eulerian tours.

title: When Readability and Source Retention Diverge: An Evaluability Gap in AI Translation
summary: Readable AI output can leave an evaluability gap: even when the source is shown, an overall-quality judgment may not reflect what an output preserves. We investigated how source-text condition and output rendering relate to perceived translation quality, and how output and system appraisals relate to trust and stated disclosure willingness in a plain-text interface. A focal 2 * 2 comparison (N=306) using TransLingo examined simple generated narratives and complex literary-philosophical prose alongside LLM-generated readability-oriented outputs and researcher-revised fidelity-oriented outputs. A descriptive stimulus audit indicated greater source retention in fidelity-oriented outputs in both source-text conditions. Factorial analyses showed a significant rendering-by-source-text-condition interaction in perceived quality. Participants rated fidelity-oriented outputs higher than readability-oriented outputs for the simple narratives, whereas no reliable rendering difference emerged for the complex prose. A corresponding source-condition-dependent pattern was observed for perceived intelligence, agency-oriented anthropomorphic attribution, and task-performance trust. A separate theory-ordered appraisal-structure SEM characterized concurrent associations among perceived quality, perceived intelligence, agency-oriented anthropomorphic attribution, task-performance trust, and stated disclosure willingness across six domains, with task-performance trust as the proximal correlate of stated willingness. The observed rating pattern distinguishes source access from source evaluability: for the complex stimuli, displaying the source did not ensure that one overall-quality rating reflected differences in retained content. It also separates support for evaluating translation output from data-handling support for decisions about what personal text to entrust to a system.

title: Does Mapping Non-Maximal Probabilities to GMM Components Matter for S-JEPA Encoder Representations?
summary: S-JEPA uses soft Gaussian mixture model (GMM) posteriors instead of hard cluster labels to preserve uncertainty. It remains unclear whether the probability values alone are sufficient, or whether it also matters which GMM components receive the non-maximal probabilities. We test this with two matched controls. FIXED-RANDPERM keeps the top-1 component and probability together with the multiset of non-maximal probability values, but reassigns those non-maximal values using a mapping fixed for each physical frame. UNIFORM-TAIL keeps the top-1 component, its probability, and total non-maximal mass but distributes that mass uniformly. Across three independent seeds, REAL SOFT outperforms both controls on two frozen Encoder readouts. It provides better recovery of the original GMM tail and greater accessibility of spectral dynamics over short time scales after controlling for the complete spectrum of the current frame. In two exposure experiments, both readouts improved overall as more frames retained the original mapping. We also descriptively follow one Phase 2 trajectory after the switch to the online GMM. These results show that the numerical probability structure of the soft target does not fully determine the learned Encoder representation. The mapping of non-maximal probabilities to GMM components also matters.

title: DA-WAM: Decision-Aligned Future Latents for Driving World Models
summary: Anticipating how scenes evolve under ego actions is fundamental to safe autonomous driving, yet the full potential of world models for decision-making remains unrealized. The critical challenge lies in ensuring that future modeling is not merely predictive, but decision-informative: the predicted future must directly shape which trajectory is selected. Existing approaches decouple future representation learning from planning optimization, or share predicted states across trajectory candidates, thereby diluting the action-specific consequences that ought to guide selection. To bridge this gap, we propose DA-WAM, a framework that unifies predictive representation learning, action-conditioned future modeling, and trajectory scoring under a single decision-making objective. DA-WAM maintains predictive supervision throughout planner optimization via an online encoder and a stable momentum target, allowing future representations to co-evolve with the driving task. An action-conditioned predictor generates a distinct future latent state per trajectory candidate, which is then evaluated by a future-latent-conditioned factorized scorer. For the expert-matched trajectory, the predicted future latent is supervised by the observed future representation, while safety-critical hard negatives provide additional supervision near planning boundaries. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while ablations and diagnostic analyses validate the key components.

title: Detecting Backdoors in Object Detection via Pre-NMS Prediction Distribution Shift
summary: Object detection models deployed in safety-critical applications remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks that cause targeted misbehaviors when a hidden trigger is present. Existing detection methods either rely on trigger inversion or exploit architecture-specific assumptions, and critically, representative existing methods fail to generalize reliably to scene-level attacks, where a single trigger induces anomalous behavior across all objects in the scene simultaneously. We present DistScan, a backdoor detection framework based on a simple but previously unexploited observation: backdoor injection systematically shifts a model's pre-NMS prediction class distribution away from its training class frequencies, even on clean inputs without any trigger present. DistScan aggregates intermediate class predictions over a clean validation set and flags a model as backdoored if the resulting distribution deviates significantly from the training class frequencies, requiring no model weight access, no trigger knowledge, and no additional training. Extensive experiments on MS-COCO and PASCAL VOC across two architectures and three scene-level attack scenarios demonstrate that DistScan substantially outperforms existing methods, improving average detection accuracy over the best-performing applicable baseline by 27.32 percentage points.

title: The Limits of Black-Box Reductions for All-Pairs Triangle Detection
summary:
For any tripartite relation $R\subseteq \mathbb{Z}^3$, the $R$-Triangle problem asks, given an edge-weighted graph, whether it contains a triangle whose weights form a triple in $R$. The All-Edge $R$-Triangle problem asks to determine for every edge whether it is contained in such a triangle. It is known that $R$-Triangle and All-Edge $R$-Triangle are subcubically fine-grained equivalent for every $R$ [Vassilevska W.-Williams'10]. However, while it is conjectured that these problems are tightly equivalent, this reduction only shows that if $R$-Triangle has an $O(n^{3-ε})$-time algorithm for some $ε>0$, then All-Edge $R$-Triangle has an $O(n^{3-ε/3})$-time algorithm. This paper provides a strong unconditional barrier to a tight equivalence: the reduction of [Vassilevska W.-Williams'10] is optimal for black-box reductions that work for arbitrary $R$.
  We give further results about black-box reductions between a variety of $R$-triangle problems. Our positive results yield new reductions between several classes of triangle and matrix problems --- for instance, we demonstrate that an $O(n^{2.53})$-time algorithm for computing equality or dominance product would imply an improvement on known algorithms for computing boolean $(\min, +)$-product, giving the first conditional lower bound for dominance and equality product. Our negative results can be thought of as barriers against natural fine-grained proof techniques. Besides the result that a tighter equivalence between $R$-Triangle and All-Edge $R$-Triangle is not possible, we also show that no appropriately "black-box" reductions are capable of demonstrating a subcubic equivalence between triangle counting and binary integer matrix multiplication, or a tight equivalence between boolean matrix multiplication and listing $n^2$ triangles, and more, despite the fact that all of these equivalences are conjectured to hold.

title: The Equality Cases of the Weak Simplex Conjecture
summary: Among $n+1$ equiprobable equal-energy signals in $\R^n$ under additive white Gaussian noise with maximum-likelihood decoding, which arrangement maximizes the probability of correct decoding? The question is Shannon's, recorded by Rice in 1950. Mulgund proved in 2026 that the regular-simplex value bounds the correct-decoding probability of every signal set at every signal-to-noise ratio, leaving open whether the simplex is the only maximizer. This paper determines the equality cases in a form stronger than uniqueness. A signal set other than a regular simplex falls strictly below the bound at every positive signal-to-noise ratio. Hence a code meeting the bound at one positive operating point is already a regular simplex, up to vertex relabeling and an orthogonal map. In probabilistic form, among the correlation matrices that signal sets induce, any matrix other than the identity gives a lower-orthant probability strictly above its independent counterpart at every finite threshold, leaving no room for a nontrivial equality. No code of ambient dimension below $n$ attains the bound. Under an energy budget $E$ with unrestricted blocklength the optimal codebook is uniquely the regular simplex of circumradius $\sqrt{E}$. Every optimal codeword therefore exhausts its allowance. Equality in the Simplex Mean Width Conjecture likewise occurs only at the regular simplex. The proof strengthens the first self-convolution step of Mulgund's argument with Royen's correlation theorem. The single-parameter rigidity is machine-checked in Lean 4.

title: Approximating Minimum Dominating Set with Few Awake Rounds
comments: Full version of a paper to appear in the 40th International Symposium on Distributed Computing (DISC 2026)
summary: We study the Minimum Dominating Set (MDS) problem in the sleeping CONGEST model (Chatterjee, Gmyr, and Pandurangan, PODC 2020), a generalization of the standard CONGEST model, in which a node may sleep in some rounds and can only compute, send messages, or receive messages when it is awake. The awake complexity of an algorithm in this model is the worst case number (over all inputs and all nodes) of rounds a node is awake for during the execution of the algorithm. While there are several $O(\log Δ)$-approximation algorithms (in expectation) for MDS that run in $O(\log^2 Δ)$ rounds, all of these have $Ω(\log^2 Δ)$ awake complexity. Whether this awake complexity can be improved is the question that drives our work. We present the first $O(\log Δ)$-approximation algorithm for MDS with $o(\log^2 Δ)$ awake complexity; our algorithm runs in $O(\log^2Δ)$ rounds with $\tilde{O}(\logΔ)$ awake complexity. We can reduce the awake complexity further, but at the cost of approximation: we present, for any $1<α\leΔ$, an algorithm in the sleeping CONGEST model that computes an $O(α\logΔ)$-approximate dominating set in expectation in $\tilde{O}(\logΔ\cdot \log_α Δ)$ rounds with $\tilde{O}(\log_α Δ)$ awake complexity. Our results depend on a generalization of the CONGEST model SetCover algorithm of Grunau, Mitrovi'c, Rubinfeld, and Vakilian (SODA 2020) that we develop. This generalization computes an $O(p\cdot q\cdot\log_pΔ)$-approximate dominating set in $O(\log_pΔ\cdot\log_qΔ)$ rounds for parameters $1<p,q\leΔ$. Our sleeping CONGEST algorithms apply a variety of techniques including sampling-based estimation and scheduling using virtual binary trees to the aforementioned 2-parameter SetCover algorithm.
