title: ChainWorld: Composing Long-Horizon Desktop Workloads from Atomic OSWorld Tasks
summary: Computer use agents are evaluated almost exclusively on atomic desktop tasks, but realistic desktop work requires sustaining state across multiple objectives. We study this gap with ChainWorld, which composes atomic OSWorld tasks into long horizon desktop workloads through directional compatibility search while preserving the source evaluators. The resulting workload contains 347 chains of length two to four and compares two renderings of the same task sequence. In single turn evaluation, all tasks are presented together in one prompt. In multi turn evaluation, tasks are revealed one at a time. Across four current computer use agents, maximum chain completion is 31%. Multi turn evaluation improves completion for three models, but both protocols remain challenging. The two protocols also expose different failure profiles. Single turn failures concentrate on artifact precision, while multi turn failures more often reflect session management problems such as fragmented progress and later turn disengagement.

title: First-Token Broadcasters: Mechanistic Origins of Language Identity and Distributed Robustness in Transformers
summary: Why do multilingual language models sometimes generate in the wrong language, and why is this so hard to fix? We introduce Language Identity Head Ablation (LIHA), a causal intervention that zeros each attention head individually and measures the resulting language switch rate across a parallel dataset of 2,700 prompt-language pairs spanning seven languages. Applied to GPT-2, LIHA identifies a small set of first-token broadcaster heads - led by L6H1 (switch rate 0.32, 3.23 $σ$ above the population mean) - that attend persistently to the first prompt token, propagating its language signal throughout generation. Compensatory redistribution when heads are ablated is statistically significant (p < $10^{-5}$) and follows a directional, hierarchical pattern: compensation always recruits heads in layers above the ablated head, suggesting a feedforward cascade rather than global diffusion. To probe how training regime shapes these circuits, we apply LIHA to a controlled pair - Qwen2.5-1.5B-Base and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct - identical in architecture and size, differing only in training. The base model is nearly flat (max SR=0.016, 200/336 heads at SR=0.0); the instruct model concentrates causal influence sharply at layer 0, led by L0H5 (SR=0.224, 8.93 $σ$ above mean), with all other layers near zero. This controlled comparison provides direct causal evidence that instruction tuning reorganizes language identity circuits toward early-layer localization. Extended experiments with Chinese and Russian confirm that first-token broadcasting is script-specific in GPT-2, with non-Latin languages handled at layer 0 - the same locus as the instruction-tuned model. Code and data will be released upon publication.

title: WARP: Whole-Body Retargeting for Learning from Offline Human Demonstrations
summary: Direct transfer from human demonstration to learnable robot action is a crucial step towards scalable whole-body mobile manipulation. While human data scales better than mobile teleoperation, it requires overcoming significant embodiment gaps. Existing retargeting methods yield imprecise or inconsistent solutions, causing action multi-modality that prevents supervised policies from reliably converging. We present Whole-body-Aware Retargeting from human Pose (WARP), an offline pipeline that explicitly models embodiment differences to extract precise, unique whole-body actions. WARP leverages a closed-form Shoulder-Elbow-Wrist (SEW) geometric solver for exact end-effector tracking while preserving whole-body structural intent. Paired with lazy mobile-base control, it extracts accurate, consistent robot trajectories. Evaluations show WARP provides highly reliable data for open-loop real-world replay. To our knowledge, WARP is the first framework to achieve zero-shot whole-body mobile manipulation directly from offline human demonstrations, eliminating the need for human-in-the-loop teleoperation action data. More details on https://warp-retargeting.github.io/

title: ContextSniper: AntTrail's Token-Efficient Code Memory for Repository-Level Program Repair
summary: Large language model agents can repair real repository issues, but they often spend large context budgets on whole-file reads, broad searches, and long terminal outputs where useful evidence is mixed with irrelevant code and logs. This paper presents ContextSniper, AntTrail's code-repair module for precision evidence selection in repository-level program repair, part of AntTrail's broader agent-memory engine. AntTrail is available at https://gitcode.com/datagallery/AntTrail. ContextSniper indexes code and action memory as three abstract levels, retrieves candidates with a hybrid ranker, filters long tool output through an intention-aware context gate, and returns compact evidence packets while keeping full source recoverable on demand. In a matched 50-task-per-condition comparison on SWE-bench Lite (same tasks, baseline vs.\ ContextSniper), ContextSniper reduces total token use by 51.5% and logged cost by 36.4% for OpenClaw, and by 38.9% and 27.3% for Claude Code, with submitted-resolution rates essentially unchanged in both host-agent settings. In a separate five-task comparison, ContextSniper beats existing memory- and RAG-style integrations on token efficiency. These results suggest ContextSniper can substantially cut token and cost overhead for repository-level repair agents without a measurable loss in repair quality. The evaluation harness for this study is available at https://gitcode.com/lukchiwang/ContextSniper.

title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
comments: 23 pages, 24 figures, 4 tables. Preprint. Project page: https://srl-ethz.github.io/Mask2Real-WM/
summary: Action-conditioned world models allow robots to predict the future consequences of candidate actions without additional physical interaction, supporting policy evaluation, planning, and data augmentation. We present Mask2Real-WM, a two-stage action-conditioned world model for dexterous manipulation that decouples pixel prediction into a dynamics model and a rendering model. The dynamics model predicts future segmentation masks from past masks and 23-DoF action sequences. The rendering model maps the predicted masks to photorealistic RGB using a ControlNet-augmented Stable Video Diffusion backbone. The smaller sim-to-real gap in segmentation space enables the dynamics model to benefit from large-scale pretraining on over 50 h of synthetic simulation data, followed by fine-tuning on fewer than 2.5 h of real demonstrations. Experiments on a dexterous pick-and-place benchmark show that mask conditioning and simulation pretraining are both required for per-DoF action controllability across all 23 degrees of freedom. In contrast, monolithic baselines capture broad hand and end-effector trajectories but do not reliably reflect fine-grained, per-joint action effects.

title: Hierarchical Classification via Cascading Feature Elimination: Application to Human Phenotype Ontology-Aligned Facial Phenotyping (FaceMesh2HPO)
summary: FaceMesh2HPO is a framework for classifying facial phenotypic descriptors aligned with the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) to support clinical diagnosis. Using annotations from 124 clinicians across 10 disorders (107 HPO terms) combined with non-syndromic controls, we generated 3D facial meshes (478 landmarks) from 2D images and trained a hierarchical PointNet-based pipeline with cascading classification and feature elimination. The best models, incorporating 3D meshes, facial outline, and demographic metadata, achieved AUROCs between ~0.55 and ~0.89, with higher performance at parent nodes than leaf terms. External validation showed variable generalizability across disorders. Results demonstrate that hierarchical modeling of 3D facial geometry enables interpretable, ontology-linked phenotype classification, though performance on rare leaf terms remains limited. Improved data diversity and feature selection strategies are needed to enhance robustness and clinical utility.

title: Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models Using Diversion Decoding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful tool for retrieving knowledge through seamless, human-like interactions. Despite their advanced text generation capabilities, LLMs exhibit hallucination tendencies, where they generate factually incorrect statements and fabricate knowledge, undermining their reliability and trustworthiness. Multiple studies have explored methods to evaluate LLM uncertainty and detect hallucinations. However, existing approaches are often probabilistic and computationally expensive, limiting their practical applicability. In this paper, we introduce diversion decoding, a novel method for developing an LLM uncertainty heuristic by actively challenging model-generated responses during the decoding phase. Through diversion decoding, we extract features that capture the LLM's resistance to produce alternative answers and utilize these features to train a machine-learning model to develop a heuristic measure of the LLM's uncertainty. Our experimental results demonstrate that diversion decoding outperforms existing methods with significantly lower computational complexity, making it an efficient and robust solution for evaluating hallucination detection.

title: Score-Only Distillation for Compact Dense Retrieval
summary: Large embedding models improve retrieval quality, but serving large encoders online is expensive. We study whether a compact retriever can learn teacher ranking behavior from score vectors without access to teacher hidden states. The student trains on rows built from ground-truth positives and negative candidates produced by our data generation pipeline; we evaluate student-teacher hard-negative mining separately as an extension. We use a row-centered score-vector objective, a memory-efficient implementation of uniform all-pairs PairMSE loss. On a fixed eight-task evaluation panel, our distillation protocol recovers up to 50% of the base-to-teacher gap. The distilled 0.6B student is 4.7 times faster for query encoding and 9.7 times faster for document encoding than sequential online teacher fusion. External-transfer performance after distillation remains mixed, so our evidence supports compression of teacher rankings under matched retrieval protocols.

title: MetaInfer: A Knowledge Only LLM Inference Engine Generator SKILL Toolbox
summary: As LLM technology advances, the space of model families, compute hardware, quantization schemes, parallelization strategies, and specialized optimization kernels continues to expand, sharply increasing the code complexity and maintenance cost of general-purpose inference frameworks. Conventional software engineering uses multiple layers of abstraction to support diverse application scenarios, but these abstractions also increase system complexity and may introduce additional performance overhead. This paper presents metainfer, an 'LLM-as-Compiler' approach in which users specify only the runtime constraints of an inference program. An LLM-driven multi-agent collaboration system, coupled with a contract knowledge base, then automatically generates a compact customized inference framework that satisfies these constraints. We evaluate metainfer from three perspectives: the effect of source-code reference, the runtime behavior and performance profile of engines generated under the zero-reference constraint on CKB-covered targets, and knowledge-base evolution for new model and platform scenarios. The results show that metainfer organizes generation constraints, validation feedback, and knowledge consolidation into a continuous closed loop, enabling runnable customized inference solutions to be generated from explicit knowledge. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MetaInfer/MetaInfer.

title: ReasFlow: Assisting Reasoning-Centric Scientific Discovery in Applied Mathematics via a Knowledge-Based Multi-Agent System
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models have fueled autonomous AI agents capable of tackling complex scientific tasks, yet existing automated research systems remain predominantly focused on empirically driven domains with quantitative benchmarks, leaving theory-driven discovery, particularly in mathematically grounded disciplines requiring rigorous proofs and synthesis of domain knowledge, largely underexplored. Key challenges include the difficulty of verifying theoretical reasoning at scale, insufficient reasoning ability for autonomous frontier exploration, and a scarcity of procedural heuristics in the literature. We introduce ReasFlow, an end-to-end autonomous agent system for reasoning-centric scientific discovery that operationalizes a collaborative paradigm where the human expert acts as Principal Investigator while the agent executes rigorous derivations as a capable graduate student. ReasFlow incorporates (i) a robust internal verification loop that audits logical coherence and corrects fundamental errors prior to human inspection, and (ii) an automated knowledge retrieval and self-improvement mechanism that proactively surfaces both declarative facts and overlooked procedural heuristics, substantially reducing expert intervention. The system unifies literature synthesis, algorithm design, theorem proving, experimentation, and manuscript preparation in a single system. Deployed to autonomously generate five complete research papers with rigorous theoretical and empirical content from minimal prompts, ReasFlow consistently achieves the highest evaluation scores among state-of-the-art open-access baselines under a curated LLM-based review rubric. ReasFlow is publicly accessible via the ReasLab platform, providing a collaborative workspace for AI-assisted theoretical research. Github repo: https://github.com/reaslab/ReasFlow.git.

title: Enumerating Length-Bounded Simple Paths and Cycles in Directed Graphs with $O(k(n+m))$ Delay Using Edge-Consistent Node Barriers
comments: Submitted to the Journal of Graph Algorithms and Applications (JGAA)
summary:
Enumerating simple paths and cycles subject to a given length bound is a fundamental problem in graph algorithms. Recent algorithms, namely BC-DFS (Peng et al. 2019, 2021) and CYCLE_SEARCH (Gupta and Suzumura 2021, arXiv:2105.10094v2), employ cached barrier values to prune fruitless searches.
  Both algorithms turn out to produce incomplete output, and their delay-bound arguments rely on flawed claims. For CYCLE_SEARCH this is known (arXiv:2512.08392); here we establish the analogous results for BC-DFS by exhibiting graphs on which paths are missed, by identifying the defect in its barrier-update procedure, and by refuting the monotonicity claim on which its delay-bound proof rests.
  As our main contribution, we introduce edge-consistency, a local invariant on barrier values analogous to heuristic consistency in informed search. It provides an incremental mechanism for maintaining admissible barrier estimates and yields concise correctness proofs.
  We use edge-consistency as a unifying framework for design and analysis of Bounded-Scope Depth-First Search (BS-DFS) --- a new algorithm for enumerating simple paths or cycles of length at most $k$ in a directed graph. For BS-DFS we prove a worst-case delay of at most $3(k+1)(n+m)$ elementary steps between consecutive events (start, each output, termination) and an amortized delay of at most $2(k+1)(n+m)$ steps per event, the $p$-th event being reached within $2p(k+1)(n+m)$ steps; both bounds are in $O(k(n+m))$. Barrier admissibility alone is not sufficient for the delay bound: for two variants with simpler barrier management, we exhibit a graph family forcing $Ω(k^2(n+m))$ delay between outputs.
  Experiments on two families of random graphs confirm our findings, support the significance of the incompleteness result, and show that achieving completeness has modest empirical cost.

title: RoGS: Adaptive Meshgrid Gaussian for Large-Scale Road Surface Mapping
summary: Road surface mapping plays a crucial role in autonomous driving, supporting high-definition map generation, lane-level perception, and automatic road annotation. Recent mesh-based road surface reconstruction methods have shown promising results, but they still suffer from limited reconstruction quality and high optimization cost, especially in large-scale driving scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose ROADGS-T, a robust and efficient large-scale road surface mapping framework based on adaptive meshgrid Gaussian representation. Specifically, we model the road surface by placing 2D Gaussian surfels on a meshgrid, where each surfel explicitly stores color, semantic, and geometric information. Compared with conventional mesh-based representations and 3D Gaussian primitives, the proposed meshgrid Gaussian representation better matches the thin-surface property of roads while significantly reducing redundant primitives and overlap during optimization. To further improve representation efficiency and structural fidelity, we introduce a road-structure-aware adaptive meshgrid strategy, which allocates denser Gaussian surfels to geometrically or semantically complex regions, such as lane markings, road boundaries, and height discontinuities, while maintaining a compact representation in flat road areas. Moreover, instead of relying on a single nearest vehicle pose, we design a trajectory-consistency-guided pose-robust refinement strategy, which estimates local surface priors from multiple neighboring poses and adaptively weights pose-guided height regularization according to their geometric consistency.

title: LLM-Driven AutoML for Cross-Lingual Handwritten OCR: Closed-Loop Neural Architecture Search with GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4
comments: 7 pages, 10 figures, and 2 tables. Published in the 2025 15th International Conference on Computer and Knowledge Engineering (ICCKE), IEEE
summary: We present a fully automated closed-loop AutoML framework that uses GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4 as autonomous neural architecture designers for cross-lingual handwritten optical character recognition. Each large language model independently generates, trains, evaluates, and iteratively refines neural network architectures using performance feedback from previous trials. The framework is evaluated on Arabic, Persian, and English handwriting datasets through 270 independent experiments. It consistently discovers accurate and computationally efficient models without manual architecture design, domain-specific preprocessing, or hyperparameter tuning. The generated models achieve mean test accuracies above 93 percent, a best accuracy of 98.1 percent, and inference latency between 41 and 44 milliseconds. The results demonstrate that large language models can function as effective AutoML agents for neural architecture search, enabling scalable, script-adaptive, and reproducible handwriting recognition across languages.

title: How Do VLMs Fail? Vision-Operation Misalignment in Compositional VQA
summary: Compositional visual question answering requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to execute multiple reasoning operations like object selection, spatial relation resolution, and attribute verification. Despite strong aggregate performance, the mechanistic basis of VLM failures on this task remains underexplored. To address this gap, we analyze vision-operation misalignment in VLMs by examining how failures relate to specific reasoning operations and the internal computational pathways through which they arise and propagate. We introduce an Operation-centric mechanistic framework that decomposes VLM failures by both the reasoning operation where they originate and the internal computational pathway through which they propagate. Our analysis reveals four dominant failure modes: grounding failure, reasoning failure, attribute extraction failure, and language-prior dominance, each characterized by a distinct relationship between visual grounding strength and answer correctness. Through three complementary causal interventions applied across all transformer layers, we find that object-selection failures are associated primarily with feedforward computation, multi-step relational failures with late-layer direct attention, and attribute-extraction failures with answer-position feedforward computation. Validation on VSR further shows that single-step spatial failures are concentrated at object-position encoding, distinguishing them from multi-step relational composition. These findings reveal distinct computational bottlenecks across operation types and provide a principled basis for targeted diagnosis of VLM failures in multimedia reasoning.

title: RouteCost: A Production-Inspired Multi-Stage Framework for Pre-Order Shipping Cost Estimation in E-Commerce
summary: Accurate pre-order shipping cost estimation is important in e-commerce because it affects price presentation, margin planning, and conversion. In practice, shipping cost is shaped not only by distance but also by destination demand mix, billable weight, dimensional pricing, surcharge triggers, and latent operational effects such as shipment consolidation. Static lookup methods therefore miss important sources of variation, while monolithic regressors may exploit strong but non-causal correlations. We propose RouteCost, a production-inspired multi-stage framework that decomposes the problem into time-aware demand forecasting, fee-card-informed baseline pricing, Stage 2 residual correction, and proxy-based box-consolidation inference. Route-level cost estimates are aggregated through a route-weighted expectation formulation to produce product-level shipping cost predictions. Across over 250,000 orders, 260 products, and 18 months of order history, the framework improves predictive quality and aggregate calibration while preserving route-level interpretability.

AI.title_translation: RouteCost：一种面向电商下单前运费预估的生产级多阶段框架
AI.tldr: 提出了多阶段框架 RouteCost，将复杂运费预估解耦为需求预测、基准定价、残差修正与拼箱推断，有效提升了电商下单前商品运费预测的精度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 下单前准确预估运费对电商定价、利润规划与转化至关重要。运费受需求结构、计费重量、附加费及拼箱等多重复杂运营因素影响，传统静态查表法无法捕捉动态变化，而单一回归模型容易拟合非因果相关性。
AI.method: 提出了 RouteCost 多阶段框架，将运费估算解耦为时间感知需求预测、基于费率表的基准定价、第二阶段残差修正和基于代理的拼箱推断四个模块，并通过路线加权期望公式将路线级预估聚合成商品级运费预测。
AI.result: 在包含超过 25 万笔订单、260 种产品和 18 个月历史数据上进行验证，该框架显著提高了预测质量和总体校准度，同时保持了路线级别的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: RouteCost 框架通过多阶段解耦和路线加权期望聚合，成功解决了复杂电商物流场景下的下单前运费预估问题，兼具高精度与良好的可解释性。
AI.translation: 准确的下单前运费预估在电子商务中非常重要，因为它直接影响价格展示、利润规划和转化率。在实际运营中，运费不仅取决于距离，还受到目的地需求结构、计费重量、体积定价、附加费触发机制以及货运拼箱等潜在运营效应的影响。因此，静态查表法会遗漏重要的变异来源，而单一回归模型则可能利用强烈但非因果的相关性。我们提出了 RouteCost，这是一个源自生产实践的多阶段框架，它将该问题解耦为时间感知的需求预测、基于费率表的基准定价、第二阶段残差修正以及基于代理的装箱拼单推断。路线级成本估算通过路线加权期望公式进行聚合，以生成商品级运费预测。在涵盖超过 250,000 笔订单、260 种产品和 18 个月订单历史的数据集上，该框架在保持路线级可解释性的同时，提高了预测质量和总体校准度。
AI.summary: 针对电商下单前运费预估受多重复杂因素影响的难题，本文提出了多阶段框架 RouteCost。该框架通过解耦需求预测、基准定价、残差修正和拼箱推断，并利用路线加权期望聚合预测结果，在真实工业规模数据上验证了其在预测精度、校准度及可解释性方面的优越性。
AI.keywords: 运费预估, 电子商务, 多阶段框架, 需求预测, 拼箱推断
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于结合了领域规则（费率表）与机器学习残差建模，避免了单一黑盒模型学习虚假相关性的问题，在工业实际落地中兼顾了预测精度、业务校准度与路线级可解释性。其局限性可能在于多阶段系统相比单模型管道更为复杂，维护成本相对较高。

title: Moore's Greedy Algorithm for Minimizing the Number of Late Jobs: Structure and Implementation
summary:
Scheduling $n$ jobs with deadlines and processing times on a single resource to minimize late jobs equates to finding a maximum-cardinality feasible subset. Moore (1968) proposed a natural greedy algorithm for this: process jobs in nondecreasing order of processing time, adding each if the set remains feasible. While Zhao and Yuan recently matched the $O(n\log n)$ time of the classic Moore-Hodgson algorithm via amortized $O(\log n)$ feasibility queries, our first contribution is a simpler augmented BST data structure that achieves worst-case $O(\log n)$ query time.
  Moore's greedy algorithm is known to produce a maximum-cardinality feasible subset with minimum total processing time. Though the system of feasible subsets does not form a matroid, the algorithm behaves like a matroid greedy algorithm. Our second contribution explains this phenomenon: if all jobs have equal processing times, the problem corresponds to a nested matroid; with distinct processing time "tiers," Moore's algorithm effectively solves a sequence of nested matroid problems for each tier.
  Finally, we present an explicit linear-size flow network defining a polymatroid rank. A set is feasible exactly when its rank equals its total processing time, and Moore's algorithm accepts a job precisely when it yields its full processing-time marginal. By contracting shorter accepted jobs and measuring residual rank, we recover the tier matroid's complete rank function, offering a deep structural explanation for the greedy algorithm's correctness.

AI.title_translation: Moore的贪婪算法用于最小化延迟作业数：结构与实现
AI.tldr: 改进了Moore贪婪算法的实现，使其查询时间达到最坏情况O(log n)，并通过将其与嵌套拟阵和多拟阵秩联系起来，提供了算法正确性的深层结构解释。
AI.motivation: 提高Moore贪婪算法的效率，使其可行性查询时间达到最坏情况O(log n)；深入理解Moore贪婪算法的结构和正确性，解释其行为为何类似拟阵贪婪算法。
AI.method: 提出了一种更简单的增强型二叉搜索树（BST）数据结构，以实现最坏情况O(log n)的可行性查询时间。通过将问题与嵌套拟阵（在处理时间相等或分层时）联系起来，并定义一个基于线性大小流网络的多拟阵秩，来解释算法的结构和正确性。
AI.result: 通过增强型BST数据结构，实现了Moore贪婪算法中可行性查询的最坏情况O(log n)时间。解释了Moore算法行为类似拟阵贪婪算法的原因，即在特定条件下问题与嵌套拟阵相关。揭示了一个集合当且仅当其多拟阵秩等于其总处理时间时才可行，并为贪婪算法的正确性提供了深层的结构性解释。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过引入一种更简单的增强型BST数据结构，改进了Moore贪婪算法的实现效率，使其可行性查询达到最坏情况O(log n)时间。同时，通过将其与嵌套拟阵理论和多拟阵秩概念相结合，提供了对该贪婪算法正确性的深层结构性解释，揭示了其类似拟阵贪婪算法行为的内在机制。
AI.translation:
在单个资源上调度具有截止日期和处理时间的n个作业以最小化延迟作业数，等同于找到一个最大基数的可行子集。Moore（1968）为此提出了一种自然的贪婪算法：以非递减的处理时间顺序处理作业，如果集合保持可行，则添加每个作业。虽然Zhao和Yuan最近通过摊销O(log n)的可行性查询匹配了经典Moore-Hodgson算法的O(n log n)时间，但我们的第一个贡献是一个更简单的增强型BST数据结构，它实现了最坏情况O(log n)的查询时间。
Moore的贪婪算法已知能生成具有最小总处理时间的最大基数可行子集。尽管可行子集系统不构成拟阵，但该算法的行为类似于拟阵贪婪算法。我们的第二个贡献解释了这一现象：如果所有作业具有相等的处理时间，则问题对应于一个嵌套拟阵；对于不同的处理时间“层级”，Moore算法有效地为每个层级解决一系列嵌套拟阵问题。
最后，我们提出了一个明确的线性大小流网络，定义了多拟阵秩。一个集合当且仅当其秩等于其总处理时间时才可行，并且Moore算法精确地在产生其全部处理时间边际时接受一个作业。通过收缩较短的已接受作业并测量剩余秩，我们恢复了层级拟阵的完整秩函数，为贪婪算法的正确性提供了深层的结构性解释。
AI.summary: 本论文在两个方面对Moore的最小化延迟作业数贪婪算法进行了贡献。首先，提出了一种更简单的增强型二叉搜索树（BST）数据结构，将可行性查询时间优化至最坏情况O(log n)，从而改进了算法的实现效率。其次，论文深入探讨了该算法的结构原理，解释了其行为类似于拟阵贪婪算法的现象，尤其是在处理时间相等或分层的情况下与嵌套拟阵的关联。通过引入一个线性大小的流网络来定义多拟阵秩，并分析作业接受条件与秩函数的关系，为Moore算法的正确性提供了深刻的结构性解释。
AI.keywords: Moore贪婪算法, 最小化延迟作业, 调度, 增强型BST, 嵌套拟阵, 多拟阵秩
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它不仅提供了一个更高效、更简单的Moore贪婪算法实现（最坏情况O(log n)查询时间），更重要的是，它从理论层面深入剖析了算法的内在机制。通过将调度问题与嵌套拟阵和多拟阵秩理论联系起来，论文为Moore算法的“拟阵式”行为提供了严谨的数学解释，这对于理解和推广贪婪算法的设计原则具有重要意义。这种将算法实现优化与深层理论洞察相结合的方法是其重要性所在。

title: An Interactive Interface for Control Integration in Mid-Fidelity Wind Farm Simulation
summary: Wind farm control (WFC) plays a crucial role in mitigating the wake effect, the negative aerodynamic interactions among wind turbines. Recent advances in data-driven control and artificial intelligence offer new opportunities to design more intelligent WFC systems, motivating the need for a tool that supports interactive design and validation in simulation. To address this, we present ffconnect, a general, open-source Python-based interface for FAST.Farm, a mid-fidelity wind farm simulator. Compared to prior work, ffconnect introduces a restructured Application Programming Interface (API) with enriched state access and supports integrating FAST.Farm with modern scientific computing and machine learning ecosystems by building entirely on Python. In experiments, ffconnect shows negligible runtime overhead compared to the original FAST.Farm across a range of simulation lengths and farm sizes, and demonstrates its effectiveness through a yaw-tracking case study. Finally, we provide the source code of ffconnect to keep it accessible for general users.

AI.title_translation: 中等精度风电场仿真中控制集成的一个交互式接口
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ffconnect，一个基于Python的开源接口，用于FAST.Farm中等精度风电场模拟器，旨在支持智能风电场控制系统的交互式设计和验证，且具有可忽略的运行时开销。
AI.motivation: 风电场控制对减轻风力涡轮机间的负面气动相互作用（尾流效应）至关重要。数据驱动控制和人工智能的最新进展为设计更智能的风电场控制系统提供了新机遇，因此需要一个支持在仿真中进行交互式设计和验证的工具。
AI.method: 提出并开发了ffconnect，一个通用、开源的Python接口，用于FAST.Farm中等精度风电场模拟器。ffconnect引入了重构的API，提供了更丰富的状态访问，并通过完全基于Python构建来支持与现代科学计算和机器学习生态系统集成。
AI.result: 实验表明，ffconnect在不同仿真长度和风电场规模下，与原始FAST.Farm相比，运行时开销可忽略不计。通过一个偏航跟踪案例研究，成功证明了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: ffconnect提供了一个有效且高效的交互式接口，用于在中等精度风电场仿真中集成控制，从而支持智能风电场控制系统的设计和验证。
AI.translation: 风电场控制（WFC）在减轻尾流效应，即风力涡轮机之间负面的气动相互作用中，扮演着关键角色。数据驱动控制和人工智能的最新进展为设计更智能的WFC系统提供了新机遇，这促使人们需要一个支持在仿真中进行交互式设计和验证的工具。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了ffconnect，一个通用、开源的基于Python的FAST.Farm接口，FAST.Farm是一个中等精度的风电场模拟器。与之前的工作相比，ffconnect引入了一个重构的API，具有丰富的状态访问，并通过完全基于Python构建来支持将FAST.Farm与现代科学计算和机器学习生态系统集成。在实验中，ffconnect在不同仿真长度和风电场规模下，与原始FAST.Farm相比，运行时开销可忽略不计，并通过一个偏航跟踪案例研究展示了其有效性。最后，我们提供了ffconnect的源代码，以便普通用户可以访问。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个名为ffconnect的开源Python接口，专为中等精度风电场模拟器FAST.Farm设计。该接口旨在支持智能风电场控制系统的交互式设计和验证，通过提供一个重构的API和与现代科学计算及机器学习生态系统的无缝集成。研究结果显示，ffconnect与原始FAST.Farm相比具有可忽略的运行时开销，并在一项偏航跟踪案例研究中证明了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 风电场控制, 交互式接口, FAST.Farm, Python, 尾流效应
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过开发ffconnect，为风电场控制系统的研发提供了一个重要的工具。其创新之处在于提供了一个基于Python的、与现代ML生态系统兼容的交互式接口，解决了现有工具在集成和灵活性方面的不足。其重要性在于能够加速智能风电场控制策略的开发和验证，对提高风能利用效率具有积极意义。

title: Look Clearly Before Answering: Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs via Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal understanding. However, they remain prone to hallucinations, generating responses that are inconsistent with the visual evidence. Existing mitigation methods largely address language-prior bias or cross-modal imbalance, while progressive visual degradation across perception and memory remains underexplored. In this work, we propose Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment (SDPR), a training-free framework that mitigates the degradation of visual awareness throughout inference. Specifically, we first introduce saliency-driven attention redistribution to release attention hijacked by non-semantic sink tokens, thereby recovering critical visual evidence. Second, we identify spatial distortion in the KV cache and propose saliency-driven cache alignment to preserve query-relevant visual features during generation. Finally, we introduce prior-constrained contrastive decoding to penalize unfaithful predictions induced by dominant language priors. Our proposed SDPR is robust against hallucinations due to its holistic alignment of visual awareness across the entire generative trajectory. Extensive experiments across diverse LVLM architectures show that SDPR outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both hallucination and general-purpose benchmarks, requiring no additional training and incurring minimal runtime overhead. The code is available \href{https://github.com/PengSyuChen/SDPR}{\color{blue}{here}}.

AI.title_translation: 回答之前先看清：通过显著性驱动的感知重对齐缓解大视觉语言模型中的幻觉
AI.tldr: 提出了一种免训练的显著性驱动感知重对齐框架SDPR，通过注意力重分配、KV缓存对齐和对比解码全面缓解LVLM生成中的视觉退化与幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型容易生成与视觉证据不符的幻觉。现有方法多针对语言先验偏差或跨模态不平衡，而模型在感知和记忆过程中逐渐发生的视觉信息退化问题尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架SDPR（显著性驱动的感知重对齐）：1. 显著性驱动的注意力重新分配：释放被无语义汇聚标记（sink tokens）劫持的注意力，找回关键视觉证据；2. 显著性驱动的缓存对齐：针对KV缓存的空间失真，在生成阶段保留与查询相关的视觉特征；3. 先验约束的对比解码：惩罚由强语言先验导致的不忠实输出。
AI.result: 在多种不同LVLM架构上的大量实验表明，SDPR在幻觉评估和通用多模态基准测试上均优于现有的最先进方法，且无需额外微调，运行时额外计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: SDPR通过在整个推理生成过程中实现视觉感知的全面对齐，成功在不增加额外训练且仅引入极低开销的前提下，显著抑制了LVLM的幻觉生成，提升了多模态生成的忠实度。
AI.translation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在多模态理解方面表现出了卓越的能力。然而，它们仍然容易产生幻觉，生成与视觉证据不一致的响应。现有的缓解方法主要解决语言先验偏差或跨模态不平衡问题，而在感知和记忆过程中渐进式的视觉退化仍未被充分探索。在本文中，我们提出了显著性驱动的感知重对齐（SDPR），这是一个免训练的框架，可在整个推理过程中缓解视觉感知意识的退化。具体而言，我们首先引入显著性驱动的注意力重新分配，以释放被无语义汇聚（sink）标记劫持的注意力，从而恢复关键的视觉证据。其次，我们发现了KV缓存中的空间失真，并提出了显著性驱动的缓存对齐，以在生成过程中保留与查询相关的视觉特征。最后，我们引入了先验约束的对比解码，以惩罚由主导语言先验引起的不忠实预测。我们提出的SDPR通过在整个生成轨迹中对视觉感知意识进行全局对齐，对幻觉具有很强的鲁棒性。在多种LVLM架构上的大量实验表明，SDPR在幻觉和通用基准测试中均优于现有最先进的方法，且无需额外训练，仅产生极小的运行时开销。代码已开源。
AI.summary: 针对大视觉语言模型推理过程中视觉感知逐渐退化导致的幻觉问题，本文提出了免训练的SDPR框架。该框架结合注意力重新分配、KV缓存对齐与对比解码，全方位增强视觉感知并压制语言先验偏差，以极低开销显著提升了模型的生成保真度。
AI.keywords: 大视觉语言模型, 幻觉缓解, 显著性感知, 免训练方法, 对比解码
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于跳出了单纯关注跨模态不平衡或语言先验的局限，深入分析了推理过程中注意力被非语义token劫持及KV缓存空间失真导致的视觉感知退化机制。其提出的三阶段免训练策略（注意力重分配、缓存对齐、对比解码）全面覆盖了生成轨迹，兼具高效性与实用性；局限在于对极长序列生成或复杂多图场景的泛化表现仍需进一步探索。

title: Imitation of Arm Gestures by the Semi-Humanoid Robot NICO
comments: 15 pages, 7 figures, presented at Human-Friendly Robotics workshop 2026, Trento, Italy
summary: Seamless human-robot interaction (HRI) requires a number of perceptual and motor abilities from the robot, one of them being the imitation of human gestures. Humanoid robots have an advantage in HRI thanks to their anthropomorphic features. In this work, we develop a system for imitation of human arm gestures by the semi-humanoid robot NICO based on analytical geometry and a pretrained MediaPipe pose-estimation model. For each input RGB frame, 3D coordinates of relevant human body landmarks, including arm joints and hand keypoints, are obtained using the MediaPipe framework. Joint angles are then computed from these coordinates using derived geometric relations. Finally, the computed angles are properly mapped to NICO's motor configuration and executed in a predefined motion sequence. Preliminary experiments on several representative arm gestures with six participants of different height indicate that the proposed method can produce meaningful imitative motions from monocular RGB input only, while also highlighting limitations in more complex poses and wrist-related movements.
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, presented at Human-Friendly Robotics workshop 2026, Trento, Italy

AI.title_translation: 半人形机器人NICO模仿手臂姿态
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于几何分析和MediaPipe姿态估计模型的方法，使半人形机器人NICO能够模仿人类手臂姿态。
AI.motivation: 为了实现无缝的人机交互（HRI），机器人需要具备感知和运动能力，其中模仿人类姿态是关键能力之一。人形机器人因其拟人化特征在HRI中具有优势。
AI.method: 利用MediaPipe姿态估计模型提取RGB帧中的人体关键点3D坐标，包括手臂关节和手部关键点。然后，利用推导出的几何关系计算关节角度，并将这些角度映射到NICO的电机配置中，以预定的运动序列执行。
AI.result: 提出的方法能够仅凭单目RGB输入生成有意义的模仿运动，但发现在更复杂姿态和与手腕相关的运动方面存在局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了半人形机器人NICO对人类手臂姿态的模仿，但仍需改进以处理更复杂的姿态和手腕运动。
AI.translation: 无缝的人机交互（HRI）需要机器人具备多种感知和运动能力，其中之一是模仿人类姿态。人形机器人因其拟人化特征在HRI中具有优势。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个系统，该系统基于解析几何和预训练的MediaPipe姿态估计模型，使半人形机器人NICO能够模仿人类手臂姿态。对于每个输入的RGB帧，使用MediaPipe框架获得相关人体地标的3D坐标，包括手臂关节和手部关键点。然后，使用导出的几何关系从这些坐标计算关节角度。最后，将计算出的角度正确地映射到NICO的电机配置中，并以预定义的运动序列执行。在几位身高不同的参与者的几项代表性手臂姿态上的初步实验表明，所提出的方法仅凭单目RGB输入即可产生有意义的模仿运动，同时也突显了在更复杂的姿态和与手腕相关的运动方面的局限性。
AI.summary: 这项研究提出了一种新颖的方法，使半人形机器人NICO能够模仿人类手臂姿态。该系统利用MediaPipe姿态估计模型提取人体关键点，并通过几何分析计算关节角度，最终将这些角度映射到机器人执行模仿动作。实验表明，该方法在处理基本手臂姿态时有效，但对于复杂姿态和手腕动作仍有提升空间。
AI.keywords: 姿态估计, 人机交互, 半人形机器人, 手臂模仿, MediaPipe
AI.comments: 该研究在人机交互领域取得了重要进展，通过结合先进的姿态估计技术和机器人控制，实现了机器人对人类手臂姿态的模仿。研究方法具有创新性，但同时也指出了未来研究的方向，即如何提高机器人处理复杂和精细动作的能力。

title: CGMap: A Geospatially Aware Deep Learning Framework for Crop Gap Mapping Using UAV
summary: In India, crop germination is primarily monitored by visual inspection and manual counting, which are prone to errors, despite their crucial role in determining eventual yield potential. This paper highlights a deep learning based pipeline which uses object detection methods and drone imagery to assess and provide a precise count of sugarcane germination in fields. The approch uses a pre-trained AI model to find germinated plant sampling and identify gaps, also known as ``bald spots'', which restricts field productivity. The techniques used here relies on the YOLOV8 architecture, which was trained on a carefully selected dataset of UAV photos taken in various agroclimatic zones of India. Here, we bring upon a novel orientation-normalization technique that uses minimum Spanning Trees (MST) to account for variations in planting geometry, allowing for dependable row and column extraction across a variety of field layouts. By converting detected seedlings into spatial point clouds, emergence gaps can be inferred from the anticipated spacing between plants. A geospatial germination map exported in Well-Known Text (WKT) format is the end result, and it can be easily incorporated into GIS platforms used by sugar mills and agronomists to direct transplant initiatives. Timely interventions based on the insights provided by the algorithm can significantly increase yield, resulting in higher profits. Hence, support proper allocation of resources, avoid wastage, and enhance long-term sustainability.

AI.title_translation: 无人机在作物空隙测绘中的地理空间感知深度学习框架CGMap
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于深度学习和无人机影像的作物（甘蔗）出苗监测方法，利用YOLOV8模型进行目标检测，并结合一种新的方向归一化技术和最小生成树（MST）来处理种植几何形状的差异，最终生成地理空间出苗图，以指导农田管理和提高产量。
AI.motivation: 传统的作物出苗监测方法（如目视检查和手动计数）存在误差大、效率低的问题，这对于预测作物产量至关重要。现有方法难以应对不同种植几何形状带来的挑战。
AI.method: 利用无人机影像，采用预训练的YOLOV8深度学习模型进行目标检测，识别已发芽的植株和‘秃斑’（空隙）。提出了一种新颖的方向归一化技术，利用最小生成树（MST）来处理种植几何形状的变异性，从而实现可靠的行列提取。通过将检测到的幼苗转换为空间点云，并根据预期的株距推断出苗空隙。
AI.result: 生成地理空间出苗图（WKT格式），可集成到GIS平台，用于指导移栽工作，从而提高产量、利润、资源分配效率和可持续性。
AI.conclusion: 该深度学习框架能够精确地绘制作物出苗图，为农田管理提供有价值的地理空间信息，有助于提高产量和资源利用效率。
AI.translation: 在印度，作物出苗主要依靠目视检查和手动计数进行监测，尽管它们在确定最终产量潜力方面起着至关重要的作用，但这些方法容易出错。本文重点介绍了一种基于深度学习的流程，该流程使用目标检测方法和无人机影像来评估和精确计算田地里的甘蔗出苗情况。该方法使用一个预先训练的AI模型来寻找已发芽的植株样本并识别限制田地生产力的“秃斑”（即空隙）。这里使用的技术依赖于YOLOV8架构，该架构在一个精心挑选的、在印度不同农业气候区拍摄的无人机照片数据集上进行了训练。在这里，我们提出了一种新颖的方向归一化技术，该技术使用最小生成树（MST）来处理种植几何形状的变异性，从而能够对各种田地布局进行可靠的行列提取。通过将检测到的幼苗转换为空间点云，可以根据预期的植株间距推断出苗空隙。最终结果是生成一张地理空间出苗图，以Well-Known Text（WKT）格式导出，它可以轻松地集成到糖厂和农学家使用的GIS平台中，以指导移栽工作。基于该算法提供的见解及时进行干预，可以显著提高产量，从而带来更高的利润。因此，支持适当的资源分配，避免浪费，并提高长期可持续性。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种名为CGMap的地理空间感知深度学习框架，利用无人机影像和YOLOV8目标检测模型来精确绘制作物（甘蔗）出苗图。该方法通过一种新颖的方向归一化技术和最小生成树（MST）来处理种植几何形状的变化，能够识别出苗空隙（‘秃斑’），并生成可用于GIS平台的地理空间出苗图（WKT格式），以指导移栽工作，最终目标是提高产量、利润和可持续性。
AI.keywords: 作物空隙测绘, 深度学习, 无人机, YOLOV8, 地理空间分析
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法，利用深度学习和无人机技术解决了传统作物出苗监测的痛点。其新颖的方向归一化技术和MST的应用对于处理不同种植布局的鲁棒性尤为值得称赞。生成地理空间出苗图的能力使其在实际应用中具有很高的价值，能够直接指导农田管理决策。未来的工作可以进一步探索该方法在其他作物上的适用性，以及结合更多环境因素进行预测。

title: SynGallery: A Synthetic Gallery of Real Paintings for Instance-Level Artwork Recognition
summary: Instance-level artwork recognition requires matching a handheld visitor photograph to a specific work in a large museum collection. This is challenging because painting datasets typically provide clean catalog images for training, while test queries are captured under oblique viewpoints, gallery lighting, reflections, frames, and other scene-level variations. We present SynGallery, a synthetic gallery dataset for artwork retrieval that addresses this gap without collecting additional real photographs. Starting from catalog images of real paintings, we place each artwork into a procedurally generated 3D gallery scene and render it from multiple viewpoints under varied geometric and appearance conditions, while preserving the exact identity of the original work. The resulting dataset contains 24,490 rendered views of 4,898 paintings from the Met benchmark. We show that these synthetic views provide a stronger training signal than the corresponding studio photographs. At the same number of training data points, training only on SynGallery improves art painting recognition from 67.18 to 73.47 GAP$^-$. When added to the full Met training set, SynGallery improves the published benchmark protocol from 35.97 to 38.48 GAP. Ablation experiments show that the gain comes from scene-level view variation rather than photographic realism: reducing the five rendered viewpoints to a single frontal view removes most of the improvement, while simulating capture artifacts such as blur, sensor noise, and image compression consistently reduces performance.

AI.title_translation: 实例级艺术品识别的合成画廊：用于实例级艺术品识别
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了SynGallery，一个用于艺术品检索的合成数据集，通过在3D画廊场景中渲染真实画作，模拟各种拍摄条件，解决了真实图像与目录图像之间的差距。实验表明，SynGallery作为训练数据能显著提高艺术品识别的准确率。
AI.motivation: 实例级艺术品识别面临挑战，因为训练数据集通常使用干净的目录图像，而实际测试图像则包含各种场景变化（如斜视、画廊光照、反射、画框等）。
AI.method: SynGallery通过将真实画作置于程序生成的3D画廊场景中，并从多个视角进行渲染，模拟了各种几何和外观条件，从而创建了一个合成数据集。
AI.result: 使用SynGallery作为训练数据，在相同数量的训练数据下，艺术品识别的准确率从67.18%提高到73.47% GAP$^-$。将SynGallery加入到Met训练集中，可以将 published benchmark protocol 从35.97%提高到38.48% GAP。消融实验表明，性能提升主要来源于场景级视角变化，而非照片的真实感。
AI.conclusion: SynGallery通过生成包含各种视角和场景变化的合成数据，有效解决了艺术品识别中真实图像与目录图像之间的差距，显著提高了识别性能。
AI.translation: 实例级艺术品识别需要将访客手持拍摄的照片与大型博物馆收藏中的特定作品进行匹配。这具有挑战性，因为绘画数据集通常提供干净的目录图像用于训练，而测试查询则是在斜视、画廊光照、反射、画框和其他场景级变化下捕获的。我们提出了SynGallery，一个用于艺术品检索的合成画廊数据集，它在不收集额外真实照片的情况下解决了这一差距。从真实画作的目录图像开始，我们将每件艺术品置于一个程序生成的3D画廊场景中，并从多个视角在各种几何和外观条件下进行渲染，同时保留了原始作品的确切身份。生成的数据集包含4,898幅画作的24,490个渲染视图，这些画作来自Met基准。我们表明，这些合成视图提供了比相应的摄影照片更强的训练信号。在相同数量的训练数据点下，仅在SynGallery上进行训练可将艺术品识别从67.18%提高到73.47% GAP$^-$。当加入完整的Met训练集时，SynGallery将published benchmark protocol 从35.97%提高到38.48% GAP。消融实验表明，收益来自于场景级视角变化，而不是摄影真实感：将五个渲染视角减少到一个正面视角会消除大部分改进，而模拟模糊、传感器噪声和图像压缩等捕获伪影则会持续降低性能。
AI.summary: SynGallery是一个新提出的合成数据集，旨在解决实例级艺术品识别中的挑战，该挑战源于训练时使用的干净目录图像与测试时捕获的包含各种场景变化的真实照片之间的差异。该数据集通过在3D画廊环境中渲染真实画作，并模拟不同的视角和外观条件来生成，从而在不依赖额外真实照片的情况下缩小了这一差距。实验结果表明，使用SynGallery进行训练可以显著提高艺术品识别的准确率，并且性能提升主要归功于视角的变化而非图像的真实感。
AI.keywords: 艺术品识别, 合成数据, 3D渲染, 实例级识别, 数据集
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决艺术品识别中的一个关键挑战，即真实图像与目录图像之间的差异。通过利用合成数据生成技术，SynGallery不仅扩大了数据集的规模，而且有效地模拟了实际拍摄场景中的各种变化，从而提高了模型的鲁棒性和准确性。然而，需要注意的是，合成数据的“真实感”可能仍然是一个限制因素，并且在极端或未预料到的场景下，模型的表现可能仍然会受到影响。未来的工作可以探索更先进的生成技术，以进一步提高合成数据的真实感，并覆盖更广泛的场景变化。

title: Structured Latent Space Modeling over Multi-Scale Temporal Patches for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Existing patching and multi-scale methods advance multivariate time series forecasting but treat learned representations as transient byproducts of prediction, lacking explicit mechanisms that enforce structural consistency across temporal scales. We propose M2Patch, a CNN-based architecture that organizes channel-independent observations into a structured latent space via two complementary differentiable penalties. Multi-scale patching decomposes the input into overlapping temporal granularities, depthwise separable CNN blocks with progressively growing dilation extracts scale-specific features at linear complexity, and per-scale learned projections compress these features into a compact latent representation. An intra-scale smoothness penalty enforces temporal continuity between adjacent patches, while an inter-scale alignment penalty restores cross-granularity interaction through learnable cross-scale mappings, so that all scales encode mutually consistent representations of the underlying dynamics. Extensive experiments on ten real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that M2Patch significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Further analyses establish M2Patch as a structure-aware recognizer: it recovers channel functional groupings and remains robust under patch-level input corruption, confirming that the structured latent space captures the data's intrinsic dynamics.

AI.title_translation: 多尺度时间块上的结构化潜在空间建模用于多元时间序列预测
AI.tldr: M2Patch是一种新的CNN架构，通过引入结构一致性来改进多元时间序列预测。它使用多尺度打补丁、可分离卷积和两个可微分惩罚（尺度内平滑性和尺度间对齐性）来创建一个结构化潜在空间，该空间能捕捉数据内在动力学并优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在预测多元时间序列时，将学习到的表征视为预测的瞬态副产品，缺乏强制跨时间尺度结构一致性的明确机制。
AI.method: M2Patch使用多尺度打补丁将输入分解为重叠的时间粒度，并通过深度可分离卷积块和渐进增长的膨胀来提取尺度特定特征。它通过尺度内平滑性惩罚强制执行相邻块之间的时序连续性，并通过可学习的跨尺度映射恢复跨粒度交互，从而在尺度间对齐性惩罚中实现所有尺度编码相互一致的表征。
AI.result: M2Patch在十个真实世界基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，其显著优于最先进的基线方法。进一步的分析表明，M2Patch可以恢复通道功能分组，并在补丁级输入损坏下保持鲁棒性，证明其结构化潜在空间能够捕捉数据的内在动力学。
AI.conclusion: M2Patch通过引入结构化潜在空间和两个可微分惩罚，成功地解决了现有方法在多元时间序列预测中缺乏结构一致性的问题，并在多个数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能，同时证明了其捕捉数据内在动力学的能力。
AI.translation: 现有方法在多元时间序列预测方面取得了进展，但将学习到的表征视为预测的瞬态副产品，缺乏强制跨时间尺度结构一致性的明确机制。我们提出 M2Patch，一种基于 CNN 的架构，通过两个互补的可微分惩罚将通道独立的观测组织到结构化潜在空间中。多尺度打补丁将输入分解为重叠的时间粒度，深度可分离卷积块和渐进增长的膨胀以线性复杂度提取尺度特定特征，并且每个尺度的学习到的投影将这些特征压缩成紧凑的潜在表征。尺度内平滑性惩罚强制执行相邻块之间的时序连续性，而尺度间对齐性惩罚通过可学习的跨尺度映射恢复跨粒度交互，从而使所有尺度能够编码相互一致的潜在动力学表征。在十个真实世界基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，M2Patch 显著优于最先进的基线。进一步的分析确立了 M2Patch 作为一种结构感知识别器：它能够恢复通道功能分组，并在补丁级输入损坏下保持鲁棒性，证实了结构化潜在空间能够捕捉数据的内在动力学。
AI.summary: M2Patch 是一种新颖的 CNN 架构，通过在多尺度时间块上构建结构化潜在空间来改进多元时间序列预测。它利用多尺度打补丁、深度可分离卷积和两个互补的可微分惩罚（尺度内平滑性和尺度间对齐性）来确保不同时间尺度下的表征一致性。实验证明 M2Patch 显著优于现有方法，并能捕捉数据的内在结构和动力学。
AI.keywords: 多元时间序列预测, 结构化潜在空间, 多尺度打补丁, CNN, 可微分惩罚
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的 M2Patch 架构，用于解决多元时间序列预测中的结构一致性问题。通过引入结构化潜在空间和两个可微分惩罚，该方法有效地捕捉了数据的内在动力学，并在多个基准数据集上取得了优异的性能。其结构感知能力和鲁棒性分析也为该领域提供了有价值的见解。然而，该方法在处理非常长的时间序列或高维数据时的计算效率和可扩展性仍有待进一步研究。

title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
summary: Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges for large-scale distributed training, including severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication overhead, and inefficient kernel execution. While most large-scale LLM training systems are built around GPU-based clusters, this report presents an end-to-end optimization practice on the Ascend NPU SuperPOD. Using the DeepSeek-V4 model family as the target workload, we develop a hierarchical optimization framework spanning model-level parallelism, computation-communication orchestration, and low-level kernel execution. The resulting system achieves 34.22% Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) with a 2.93x improvement over the open-source baseline recipe while maintaining training stability. Building on this optimized infrastructure, we further establish a CPT and SFT workflow for complex Operations Research (OR) tasks. We refer to the integrated framework as SLAI T-Rex. Using DeepSeek-V4-Flash, we develop OR-oriented CPT and SFT data pipelines that combine collected domain resources with solver-verified synthetic optimization documents. The resulting dataset contains 10K high-quality SFT samples spanning four task categories and three problem representations. The specialized model achieves the highest average zero-shot Pass@1 score among the evaluated models, reaching 71.81% and outperforming GPT-5.4-Mini and the base DeepSeek-V4-Flash model by 3.98 and 11.27 percentage points, respectively. Overall, this work demonstrates a full-stack pathway from efficient trillion-parameter model post-training on Ascend infra to domain-specialized Flash models for solver-grounded mathematical modeling, advancing frontier-model systems for complex reasoning.

AI.title_translation: SLAI T-Rex：在Ascend SuperPOD上对DeepSeek-V4系列进行全参数后训练
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了SLAI T-Rex框架，在Ascend NPU SuperPOD上实现了DeepSeek-V4系列大模型的全参数后训练优化，显著提高了计算效率和训练稳定性，并在此基础上开发了针对运筹学任务的特化模型，在零样本任务上取得了优异的性能。
AI.motivation: 全参数训练万亿参数规模的MoE模型面临巨大的系统挑战，如内存压力大、通信开销大、内核执行效率低。现有系统多基于GPU，本研究旨在探索在Ascend NPU SuperPOD上的优化实践。
AI.method: 开发了一个分层优化框架，包括模型级并行、计算-通信编排和底层内核执行。在此基础上，为复杂运筹学任务建立了CPT和SFT工作流，结合了领域资源和求解器验证的合成优化文档，构建了包含10K高质量SFT样本的数据集。
AI.result: 在Ascend SuperPOD上实现了34.22%的模型FLOPs利用率（MFU），比开源基线提高了2.93倍，同时保持了训练稳定性。特化模型在零样本任务上的平均Pass@1得分达到71.81%，优于GPT-5.4-Mini和基础DeepSeek-V4-Flash模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了一条从高效的Ascend基础设施上的万亿参数模型后训练到领域特化的Flash模型的全栈路径，适用于求解器支持的数学建模，推动了用于复杂推理的前沿模型系统。
AI.translation: 全参数训练万亿参数规模的MoE模型给大规模分布式训练带来了巨大的系统级挑战，包括严重的内存压力、非重叠通信开销和低效的内核执行。虽然大多数大规模LLM训练系统都围绕基于GPU的集群构建，但本报告提出了在Ascend NPU SuperPOD上的端到端优化实践。以DeepSeek-V4模型系列作为目标工作负载，我们开发了一个跨越模型级并行、计算-通信编排和底层内核执行的分层优化框架。由此产生的系统实现了34.22%的模型FLOPs利用率（MFU），比开源基线方法提高了2.93倍，同时保持了训练稳定性。在此优化的基础设施之上，我们进一步为复杂的运筹学（OR）任务建立了CPT和SFT工作流。我们将集成框架称为SLAI T-Rex。使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash，我们开发了面向OR的CPT和SFT数据管道，将收集的领域资源与求解器验证的合成优化文档相结合。生成的数据集包含跨越四个任务类别和三种问题表示的10K高质量SFT样本。特化模型在评估模型中实现了最高的平均零样本Pass@1得分，达到71.81%，分别比GPT-5.4-Mini和基础DeepSeek-V4-Flash模型高3.98和11.27个百分点。总的来说，这项工作展示了一条从Ascend基础设施上高效的万亿参数模型后训练到领域特化的Flash模型用于求解器支持的数学建模的全栈路径，推动了用于复杂推理的前沿模型系统。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了SLAI T-Rex，一种在Ascend NPU SuperPOD上优化DeepSeek-V4系列大模型全参数后训练的系统。通过分层优化框架，实现了显著的计算效率提升（34.22% MFU，2.93x提升）和训练稳定性。在此基础上，研究人员开发了针对运筹学任务的特化模型，通过结合领域数据和合成数据进行CPT和SFT，最终在零样本任务上取得了领先性能（71.81% Pass@1），超越了现有模型。
AI.keywords: Ascend SuperPOD, DeepSeek-V4, 全参数后训练, 运筹学, 模型优化
AI.comments: 该研究在Ascend NPU硬件上实现了对万亿参数级MoE模型的全参数后训练优化，解决了大规模分布式训练中的关键系统挑战。其提出的分层优化框架和端到端优化实践具有重要的工程意义。特别值得关注的是，研究不仅关注了模型训练效率，还成功地将模型特化应用于运筹学等复杂推理任务，并取得了优于现有先进模型的性能，展示了硬件-系统-模型协同优化的巨大潜力。然而，报告中未详细说明其与GPU基线相比的具体硬件成本和能耗效率，这可能是未来研究的一个方向。

title: Train the Model, Not the Reader: Decodability Supervision for Verifiable Activation Explanations
summary: Natural-language autoencoders score explanations of hidden activations by reconstruction. An explanation is deemed faithful if the activation can be regenerated from it. The test is structurally insensitive to individual false claims. If flipping a claim does not change the reconstruction, the claim is never penalized. We show the test is passed in two ways, neither faithful. On a released Qwen-2.5-7B verbalizer, explanations reconstruct well above chance while ~2% of specific claims are ones the reconstruction depends on, so the score tracks gist, not specific facts. Under exact synthetic ground truth, standard training consistently develops co-adapted private codes (false wording the reconstruction depends on), and fixes that leave the target model unchanged do not help. We contribute two audit protocols, the comparison of grounding and truth and the swap to an independent evaluator, and RECAP (Readable Encodings via Co-trained Auxiliary Predictors), linear heads trained alongside the target model to keep designated content decodable. On RECAP-trained sandbox models, fresh verbalizers state the designated content truly and the codes vanish, at a +0.001-nat cost. This replicates on a pretrained Pythia-160M. The content becomes reliably decodable by a probe, though a fresh verbalizer conveys it only in part (truth 0.44-0.46 vs a near-zero control). For interpretability, high reconstruction does not certify individual claims. For AI safety, RECAP makes designated content checkable against a probe rather than asserted by prose a model can game. An independent probe ranks the verbalizer's true claims above its false ones (AUC 0.96 vs 0.82 without RECAP). Against an adversary that edits an explanation to maximize the score while lying (suppressing ~87% of its lie penalty), the RECAP probe still flags the lies (AUC 0.95) while the control probe collapses to chance (0.51).

AI.title_translation: 训练模型，而非读者：可验证激活解释的解码监督
AI.tldr: 现有模型解释方法通过重构来评估解释的忠实度，但这种方法存在缺陷，无法有效区分事实性错误。本文提出了一种名为RECAP的新方法，通过训练辅助预测器来确保模型解释的可解码性，从而提高解释的准确性和可信度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于重构的解释评估方法存在缺陷，无法有效识别解释中的虚假声明，导致解释分数不能真实反映模型的内部状态。模型可以通过“游戏化”其解释来欺骗评估者，即使其解释中包含大量错误信息。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种名为RECAP（Readable Encodings via Co-trained Auxiliary Predictors）的新方法。RECAP通过在训练目标模型的同时，训练额外的线性预测头来确保指定的解释内容是可解码的。此外，本文还提出了两种审计协议：接地与真相的比较，以及交换到独立评估者。
AI.result: 在RECAP训练的沙盒模型上，新的解释器能够真实地陈述指定内容，并且模型内部的“虚假代码”消失。在Pythia-160M预训练模型上进行了复现，尽管新的解释器只能部分传达内容（真实性为0.44-0.46，而对照组接近于零），但内容可以通过一个独立的探测器可靠地解码。RECAP训练的模型在独立探测器评估下，其真实声明的排名高于虚假声明（AUC为0.96 vs 无RECAP的0.82）。即使面对能够最大化分数并隐藏谎言的对手（压制了约87%的谎言惩罚），RECAP探测器仍然能识别谎言（AUC为0.95），而对照组探测器则会降至随机水平（0.51）。
AI.conclusion: 现有的解释方法（如基于重构的评估）并不能保证解释的准确性，模型可以通过“游戏化”其解释来欺骗评估者。RECAP方法通过使指定内容可被独立探测器解码，而不是依赖模型生成的文本，来提高了解释的可信度和安全性。RECAP能够让模型生成更可靠的解释，即使在面对对抗性攻击时也能保持其有效性。
AI.translation: 自然语言自编码器通过重构来评估隐藏激活的解释分数。如果激活可以从解释中再生，则认为解释是忠实的。该测试在结构上对单个虚假声明不敏感。如果翻转一个声明不会改变重构，则该声明永远不会受到惩罚。我们证明该测试可以通过两种方式通过，但都不是忠实的。在一个发布的Qwen-2.5-7B verbalizer上，解释的重构效果远超偶然水平，但约2%的具体声明是重构所依赖的，因此分数反映的是要点，而不是具体事实。在精确的合成地面真实情况下，标准训练会持续产生协同适应的私有代码（重构所依赖的虚假措辞），并且在不改变目标模型的情况下进行的修复没有帮助。我们贡献了两种审计协议，接地与真相的比较，以及交换到独立评估者，以及RECAP（通过协同训练的辅助预测器实现的可读编码），这是一种与目标模型一起训练的线性头，用于保持指定内容的可解码性。在RECAP训练的沙盒模型上，新的verbalizer真实地陈述了指定内容，并且代码消失了，成本仅为+0.001 nat。这在预训练的Pythia-160M上得到了复现。内容可以通过一个探测器可靠地解码，尽管一个新的verbalizer只传达了一部分内容（真实性为0.44-0.46 vs 对照组接近于零）。为了可解释性，高重构并不保证单个声明的真实性。为了AI安全，RECAP使指定内容可以通过探测器进行检查，而不是由模型可以操纵的文本来断言。一个独立的探测器将verbalizer的真实声明排在虚假声明之上（AUC为0.96 vs 无RECAP的0.82）。面对一个能够最大化分数并撒谎的对手（压制了约87%的谎言惩罚），RECAP探测器仍然标记了谎言（AUC为0.95），而对照探测器则崩溃到随机水平（0.51）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为RECAP的新方法，用于解决现有模型解释方法（基于重构）的不足之处。现有方法无法有效识别解释中的虚假声明，导致解释分数不能真实反映模型内部状态。RECAP通过训练辅助预测器来确保模型解释的可解码性，从而提高解释的准确性和可信度。实验结果表明，RECAP能够显著提高解释的真实性和鲁棒性，即使在面对对抗性攻击时也能有效识别虚假信息。
AI.keywords: 模型解释, 可解码性, RECAP, AI安全, 虚假声明
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个非常有前景的新方法RECAP，解决了现有模型解释方法中的关键问题，即解释的真实性和可信度。通过引入可解码性作为监督信号，RECAP能够生成更可靠、更易于验证的解释，这对于AI安全和可解释性研究具有重要意义。然而，文章也提到RECAP在完全传达内容方面仍有局限性，这可能是未来研究可以进一步探索的方向。

title: Multimodal Adaptive Control for Safe Robotic Craniotomy Under Partial Observability
summary: Autonomous robotic craniotomy requires continuous regulation of tool-tissue interactions to mitigate mechanical overload and thermal damage while maintaining surgical efficiency. However, this process is inherently partially observable due to unknown, time-varying tissue properties and the inability to directly measure cutting temperatures under physical occlusion. To address these challenges, we propose RL-MACRO, a cybernetic closed-loop intelligence framework that couples multimodal perception, adaptive decision-making, and robotic execution. This framework empowers the surgical robot to autonomously perceive inaccessible states from partial sensory feedback and dynamically optimize its behaviors under uncertain environment. A CNN-LSTM observer first fuses force and sound feedback to reconstruct the hidden temperature state (R^2=0.939, MAE = 1.717 deg C). This reconstructed temperature, alongside multi-sensor features, forms the belief state for an offline Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) policy. A novel dual-head Actor dynamically coordinates the feed rate, spindle speed, and cutting depth to optimize efficiency within strict safety bounds. These decisions are seamlessly translated into spatial motions via online trajectory re-planning and velocity servoing. Experiments on bovine ribs and six ex vivo goat skulls validate the system's robust perception, adaptive recovery from force/temperature excursions, and smooth execution on irregular surfaces, establishing a data-driven cybernetic paradigm for safe and efficient autonomous bone cutting.

AI.title_translation: 部分可观测性下安全机器人颅骨钻切的多模态自适应控制
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为RL-MACRO的多模态自适应控制框架，通过融合力和声音反馈重建隐藏温度，并利用强化学习策略实现安全、高效的自主机器人颅骨钻切。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人颅骨钻切需要持续调节工具与组织的相互作用，以减轻机械过载和热损伤，同时保持手术效率。然而，由于未知的时变组织特性以及在物理遮挡下无法直接测量切割温度，该过程本质上具有部分可观察性，因此需要一种新的智能控制框架来解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出RL-MACRO框架，包括：1) 利用CNN-LSTM观测器融合力和声音反馈来重建隐藏温度状态；2) 基于重建的温度和多传感器特征构建信念状态，输入至离线隐式Q学习（IQL）策略；3) 采用新颖的双头Actor动态协调进给速率、主轴转速和切削深度，并通过在线轨迹重规划和速度伺服转化为空间运动。
AI.result: CNN-LSTM观测器成功重建了隐藏的温度状态（$R^2=0.939, MAE = 1.717^\circ\text{C}$），并且双头Actor策略能够在严格的安全界限内动态优化进给速率、主轴转速和切削深度。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明了RL-MACRO系统在牛肋骨和离体山羊颅骨上的鲁棒感知、对力和温度异常的自适应恢复以及在不规则表面上的平稳执行能力，为安全高效的自主骨切割提供了一个数据驱动的控制范式。
AI.translation: 自主机器人颅骨钻切需要对工具与组织的相互作用进行持续调节，以减轻机械过载和热损伤，同时保持手术效率。然而，由于未知的、时变组织特性以及在物理遮挡下无法直接测量切削温度，该过程本质上是部分可观测的。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了RL-MACRO，这是一个结合了多模态感知、自适应决策和机器人执行的网络化闭环智能框架。该框架使手术机器人能够从部分感官反馈中自主感知不可访问的状态，并在不确定环境中动态优化其行为。首先，CNN-LSTM观测器融合了力和声音反馈来重建隐藏的温度状态（$R^2=0.939, \text{MAE} = 1.717^\circ\text{C}$）。该重建温度与多传感器特征一起构成了离线隐式Q学习（IQL）策略的信念状态。新颖的双头Actor动态协调进给速率、主轴转速和切削深度，以在严格的安全界限内优化效率。这些决策通过在线轨迹重规划和速度伺服无缝转化为空间运动。在牛肋骨和六个离体山羊颅骨上的实验验证了该系统的鲁棒感知、对力和温度异常的自适应恢复能力，以及在不规则表面上的平稳执行，为安全高效的自主骨切割建立了一个数据驱动的网络化范式。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了RL-MACRO框架，这是一个结合了多模态感知、自适应决策和机器人执行的网络化闭环智能框架，旨在解决机器人颅骨钻切中的部分可观察性、机械过载和热损伤问题。通过CNN-LSTM观测器重建隐藏温度并结合离线隐式Q学习（IQL）策略，实现了在不确定环境下的安全高效自主骨切割。
AI.keywords: 自主机器人颅骨钻切, 多模态自适应控制, 强化学习, 部分可观性, 隐式Q学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的强化学习框架RL-MACRO，用于解决机器人颅骨钻切中部分可观性、机械过载和热损伤等难题。通过CNN-LSTM状态观测器与隐式Q学习（IQL）策略的结合，实现了对不可见温度的精确重建和安全高效的自适应控制，具有很高的临床应用潜力。

title: Measuring the Dependency Gap: Diagnosing Inter-Column Fidelity in Tabular Generative Models
summary: Synthetic tabular data are valued for preserving not just column-wise marginals but inter-column dependency. Yet the most commonly reported certification score, a linear (logistic-regression) classifier two-sample test (C2ST), is largely blind to it: a fully-factorized baseline that destroys all inter-column dependency still appears nearly real, a known weakness we confirm on four benchmarks, while pairwise Trend penalizes the same baseline only mildly. We therefore apply a stronger, gradient-boosted C2ST and decompose its score into marginal, dependency, and numerical-categorical cross terms, each read against a zero-dependency reference and a real-data oracle. Applied to flow-matching (TabbyFlow) and diffusion (TabDiff) generators, it exposes a persistent dependency gap of the same order in both. Destroying dependency outright with every marginal intact collapses minority-class F1 by 0.38-0.61, though the generators' much smaller residual gaps do not track the shortfalls that remain. The gap is neither a structural limitation of mean-field objectives nor an artifact of sampling discretization, and a 16x capacity increase does not close it. Shrinking capacity eightfold, however, doubles it, so the measurement does respond to capacity; what remains points to the absence of direct dependency supervision.

AI.title_translation: 测量依赖鸿沟：诊断表格生成模型中的列间保真度
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种新的分解度量方法，用于诊断表格生成模型中的列间依赖鸿沟，发现当前主流生成模型普遍存在这一缺陷且无法通过增大容量消除。
AI.motivation: 现有的表格生成模型评估指标（如线性C2ST和成对Trend）往往无法有效检测列间依赖的缺失，导致“完全因式分解的基线”仍被误认为接近真实数据。
AI.method: 应用更强的梯度提升C2ST，将其得分分解为边际、依赖和数值-分类交叉项，并与零依赖参考和真实数据谕示进行对比。
AI.result: 实验表明，flow-matching和扩散模型均表现出同等量级的持久依赖鸿沟，减少模型容量会使该鸿沟加倍，但16倍的容量增加也无法消除它。
AI.conclusion: 表格生成模型存在普遍的列间依赖鸿沟，这主要源于缺乏直接的依赖监督，而单纯增加模型容量无法完全解决该问题。
AI.translation: 合成表格数据因能够保存列间边际分布和列间依赖关系而受到重视。然而，最常用的认证分数——线性（逻辑回归）分类器双样本检验（C2ST）——对后者很大程度上视而不见：破坏所有列间依赖的完全因式分解基线看起来仍然几乎是真实的，我们在四个基准上证实了这一已知弱点，而逐对 Trend 对同一基线的惩罚也很温和。因此，我们应用了更强的梯度提升 C2ST，并将其得分分解为边际、依赖和数值-categorical 交叉项，每一项都与零依赖参考和真实数据 oracle 进行对比。将其应用于流匹配（TabbyFlow）和扩散（TabDiff）生成器，它暴露了两者中相同数量级的持续依赖鸿沟。在保持每个边际完好的情况下彻底破坏依赖关系会使少数类 F1 下降 0.38-0.61，尽管生成器小得多的残差鸿沟并未追踪剩余的短板。该鸿沟既不是均值场目标的结构限制，也不是采样离散化的产物，16倍的容量增加也无法缩小它。然而，将容量缩小八倍会使它加倍，因此测量确实对容量做出响应；剩下的部分指向缺乏直接的依赖监督。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的诊断方法来测量表格生成模型中的列间依赖鸿沟。通过将梯度提升C2ST分数分解为边际、依赖和交叉项，研究发现当前主流生成模型普遍存在无法通过单纯增加模型容量解决的列间依赖鸿沟，揭示了缺乏直接依赖 supervision 的根本原因。
AI.keywords: 合成表格数据, 列间依赖, 生成模型, 诊断指标, 扩散模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种分解梯度提升C2ST分数的方法，用于诊断表格生成模型中往往被忽视的列间依赖鸿沟。这对评估和改进合成表格数据质量具有重要价值。

title: Rethinking Self-Evolution: A Constrained Exploration-Exploitation Process for Mitigating Skill Overfitting
summary: Enabling large language model (LLM) agents to accumulate and reuse experience from past interactions remains a central challenge in real-world applications. A promising solution is to treat skills as trainable states and optimize them in the same way as model parameters in neural network training. However, data-driven skill optimization is prone to overfitting to the limited trajectories collected from real environments. Overexploiting these trajectories overfits the current batch, while unconstrained exploration causes regression on previously solved cases. This tension motivates a constrained search view of skill self-evolution, governed by an exploration--exploitation trade-off. We propose SkillBoost, a three-stage framework that mitigates both risks: structured exploitation localizes observed failures to editable skill components, prior-guided exploration draws on prior knowledge in the LLM to generate diverse repair candidates, and verified acceptance commits a candidate only when it improves performance within a regression bound. Experiments across 23 model--benchmark configurations show that SkillBoost achieves state-of-the-art performance while mitigating overfitting, outperforming both human-crafted and LLM-generated skills. Transfer experiments further show that optimized skills can be reused by other agents on similar tasks.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考自我演化：用于缓解技能过拟合的约束式探索-利用过程
AI.tldr: 本文提出了SkillBoost框架，通过约束式探索与利用的权衡来解决大语言模型智能体技能演化过程中的过拟合与性能退化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据-驱动技能优化容易过拟合来自真实环境的有限轨迹，过度利用会导致过拟合当前批次，而不受约束的探索会导致先前已解决案例的性能退化，这促使作者从约束搜索的视角来研究技能自我演化。
AI.method: 提出SkillBoost三阶段框架：1）结构化利用（将观察到的失败定位到可编辑的技能组件）；2）先验引导的探索（利用LLM中的先验知识生成多样化的修复候选）；3）验证接受（仅在满足回归界限并提升性能时提交候选）。
AI.result: 在23个模型-基准配置上的实验表明，SkillBoost实现了最先进的性能，有效缓解了过拟合，优于人工编写和LLM生成的技能，且优化后的技能可以被其他智能体在相似任务上复用。
AI.conclusion: SkillBoost通过结构化利用、先验引导的探索和验证接受机制，实现了大语言模型技能的有效自演化，在多个基准测试中达到了最先进的性能，并具备良好的泛化迁移能力。
AI.translation: 使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够积累和重用来自过去交互的经验，仍然是真实世界应用中的一个核心挑战。一个有前景的解决方案是将技能视为可训练状态，并以与神经网络训练中优化模型参数相同的方式对其进行优化。然而，数据驱动的技能优化容易过拟合从真实环境中收集的有限轨迹。过度利用这些轨迹会导致当前批次过拟合，而不受约束的探索则会导致先前已解决案例的性能退化。这种张力激发了技能自我演化的约束搜索视角，受探索-利用权衡的支配。我们提出了SkillBoost，一个三阶段框架，可以同时缓解这两种风险：结构化利用将观察到的失败定位到可编辑的技能组件中；先验引导的探索利用LLM中的先验知识生成多样化的修复候选；验证接受仅在候选者在回归界限内提高性能时才对其进行提交。在23个模型-基准配置上的实验表明，SkillBoost在缓解过拟合的同时实现了最先进的性能，优于人工制作和LLM生成的技能。迁移实验进一步表明，优化后的技能可以被其他智能体在相似任务上重用。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型智能体在技能自我演化中容易产生过拟合和性能退化的挑战，提出了SkillBoost三阶段框架。该框架通过约束式探索与利用的权衡，实现了结构化利用、先验引导探索和验证接受，在多个基准测试中取得了领先性能并展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体, 技能自演化, 过拟合缓解, 探索与利用, SkillBoost
AI.comments: 该论文从约束式探索与利用的角度重新审视了大语言模型智能体的自我演化过程，提出了SkillBoost框架，通过三阶段设计有效缓解了技能过拟合和性能退化问题，具有较强的创新性和实用价值。

title: Agent Harness Distillation: Inference-Time Harness Extraction and Exploitation in Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Autonomous multi-agent systems (AMAS) built on large language models (LLMs), such as Hermes, increasingly rely on inference-time harnesses to coordinate reasoning and action. Constructing these harnesses requires substantial engineering effort and computational resources, as they are iteratively optimized over a combinatorial search space while co-evolving with the underlying LLM. Inference-time harnesses therefore constitute valuable intellectual property (IP). Although prior work has investigated IP leakage in static multi-agent systems with pre-configured architectures, it remains unclear whether similar risks arise in AMAS, where harness behavior emerges dynamically during inference. To address this gap, we introduce Agent Harness Distillation (AHD), a framework for studying the security risks arising from inference-time harness extraction in AMAS. We formalize harness extraction as a new security problem and develop an evaluation framework for quantifying such risks. AHD extracts inference-time harness capabilities from a target agent through black-box interactions and consists of two stages. In the pre-distillation stage, AHD infers inference-time harness behaviors from the responses of the target agent and constructs an initial harness. In the post-distillation stage, AHD iteratively refines the initial harness to align with the behavioral patterns of the target agent. Experiments on real-world AMAS across multiple backbone LLMs demonstrate the effectiveness of AHD and reveal substantial IP leakage risks. We further propose a deception-based defense that reduces harness extraction effectiveness while preserving the utility of the protected agent. Our findings uncover a previously underexplored security threat to AMAS.

AI.title_translation: 智能体控制框架蒸馏：自主多智能体系统中推理时控制框架的提取与利用
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了自主多智能体系统中推理时控制框架面临的知识产权被黑盒蒸馏提取的安全风险，并提出了相应的攻击框架与防御策略。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究关注静态多智能体系统的知识产权泄露，但在行为动态涌现的自主多智能体系统中，推理时控制框架（harness）是否面临类似的安全风险尚不明确，因此需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 引入智能体控制框架蒸馏（AHD）框架，包含预蒸馏阶段（通过黑盒交互推断并构建初始控制框架）和后蒸馏阶段（迭代优化控制框架以对齐目标智能体的行为模式），并提出了基于欺骗的防御方法。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界的自主多智能体系统和基础大模型上的实验证明了AHD的有效性，揭示了重大的知识产权泄露风险；同时，提出的基于欺骗的防御手段在保持受保护智能体效用的同时降低了框架提取的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了智能体控制框架蒸馏（AHD）框架，揭示了自主多智能体系统中推理时控制框架被提取的严重安全风险，并验证了基于欺骗的防御机制的有效性。
AI.translation: 基于大模型（LLM）构建的自主多智能体系统（AMAS）（如Hermes）越来越多地依赖推理时控制框架（harness）来协调推理和行动。构建这些控制框架需要大量的工程投入和计算资源，因为它们是在组合搜索空间中经过迭代优化，并与底层LLM共同演化的。因此，推理时控制框架构成了宝贵的知识产权（IP）。尽管先前的工作研究了具有预配置架构的静态多智能体系统中的IP泄露，但目前尚不清楚在AMAS中是否存在类似风险，因为在AMAS中，控制框架的行为是在推理过程中动态涌现的。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了智能体控制框架蒸馏（AHD）框架，用于研究AMAS中推理时控制框架提取所引发的安全风险。我们将控制框架提取形式化为一个新的安全问题，并开发了一个用于量化此类风险的评估框架。AHD通过黑盒交互从目标智能体中提取推理时控制框架的能力，包含两个阶段。在预distillation（预蒸馏）阶段，AHD从目标智能体的响应中推断推理时控制框架的行为并构建初始控制框架。在post-distillation（后蒸馏）阶段，AHD迭代精炼初始控制框架，使其与目标智能体的行为模式保持一致。在多个基础LLM的真实世界AMAS上的实验证明了AHD的有效性，并揭示了重大的IP泄露风险。我们进一步提出了一种基于欺骗的防御方法，在保持受保护智能体效用的同时，降低了控制框架提取的有效性。我们的研究结果揭示了一个先前未被充分探索的AMAS安全威胁。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于大模型的自主多智能体系统（AMAS），研究了推理时控制框架（harness）的知识产权泄露风险，提出了一种名为智能体控制框架蒸馏（AHD）的两阶段提取框架，并通过实验证明了其有效性及潜在威胁，最后设计了一种基于欺骗的防御机制来缓解该安全风险。
AI.keywords: 自主多智能体系统, 知识产权泄露, 蒸馏, 推理时控制框架, 安全风险
AI.comments: 本文首次研究了自主多智能体系统中推理时控制框架（harness）的知识产权泄露与蒸馏风险，具有很高的创新性和安全性警示意义。同时提出了有效的防御机制，对未来多智能体系统安全具有重要价值。

title: Fragility of Value under Imperfect Alignment
comments: 25 pages, 7 figures. Expanded the contribution statements and added three researchers as coauthors. Made small text improvements
summary: As more responsibility is placed upon AI systems, it becomes increasingly important to guarantee that these systems are aligned with humanity. A common fear in AI safety is that human value is fragile -- that is, optimizing too heavily for an imperfect proxy to human values will lead to a catastrophic outcome. In this paper, we present a model of the alignment problem where an agent undergoes idealized alignment training that guarantees its value function satisfies a proxy condition before optimizing the world. Our primary results identify conditions on the human value function and the accuracy of several proxy conditions under which an agent with an $η$-catastrophic value function, one that is guaranteed to take the expectation of human value below $η$ in the limit of optimizing power, would be deployed. Our results highlight the danger of overoptimization and motivate AI designs that limit optimization pressure, such as quantilizers, rather than relying solely on pre-deployment training.
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures. Expanded the contribution statements and added three researchers as coauthors. Made small text improvements

AI.title_translation: 不完美对齐下价值观的脆弱性
AI.tldr: 本文建立了AI对齐的数学模型，证明了不完美代理在强大优化能力下会导致灾难性后果，警示了过度优化的风险。
AI.motivation: 随着AI承担更多责任，确保其与人类价值观对齐至关重要。人们担心人类价值观是脆弱的，过度优化不完美的代理会导致灾难性后果，本研究旨在通过模型深入探讨这一问题。
AI.method: 提出一个对齐问题的形式化模型，其中代理在优化世界之前接受理想化的对齐训练，以保证其价值函数满足某种代理条件，并分析人类价值函数与代理条件准确性之间的关系。
AI.result: 识别出人类价值函数的条件以及几种代理条件的准确性界限，在这些条件下，具有灾难性价值函数的代理仍可能被部署。
AI.conclusion: 文章证明了在不完美对齐和强大优化能力下，部署具有灾难性价值函数的代理是可能的，突出了过度优化的危险性，并呼吁采用限制优化压力的AI设计。
AI.translation: 随着越来越多的责任被赋予AI系统，确保这些系统与人类保持一致变得越来越重要。AI安全中的一个普遍担忧是人类价值观是脆弱的——也就是说，过度优化人类价值观的不完美代理将导致灾难性的结果。在本文中，我们提出了一个对齐问题模型，其中代理接受理想化的对齐训练，以保证其价值函数在优化世界之前满足代理条件。我们的主要结果确定了人类价值函数的条件以及几种代理条件的准确度，在这些条件下，具有$\eta$-灾难性价值函数的代理（即保证在极限优化能力下使人类价值期望低于$\eta$的代理）将被部署。我们的结果突出了过度优化的危险，并促使AI设计限制优化压力（例如分位数器），而不是仅仅依赖部署前的训练。
AI.summary: 本文建立了一个AI对齐的模型，研究了在不完美对齐和强大优化能力下，部署可能导致灾难性后果的代理的条件，突出了过度优化的危险，并支持限制优化压力的AI设计方法。
AI.keywords: AI对齐, 价值观脆弱性, 过度优化, AI安全, 代理目标
AI.comments: 该论文通过理论模型探讨了不完美对齐下人类价值观的脆弱性，对AI安全领域的过度优化风险提供了深刻的警示，并强调了限制优化压力的必要性。

title: Selective KV Cache Protection for Noise-Resilient LLM Inference on Analog Compute-In-Memory Systems
summary: Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) arrays have emerged as a promising substrate for energy-efficient LLM inference, particularly for weight-stationary computations in linear layers. However, extending analog CIM to attention mechanisms introduces a fundamental challenge: KV cache operations demand repeated in-situ weight updates, and the resulting mismatch with the weight-stationary paradigm exposes dynamic computations to significant hardware noise, a critical problem that remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of dynamic attention computation on analog CIM arrays, revealing that initial and recent tokens exhibit disproportionate vulnerability to hardware noise. Motivated by this token-level insight, we propose a hierarchical token protection strategy that keeps sink tokens and a sliding recent-token window on a higher-precision digital path while processing the bulk KV cache on analog CIM. A co-designed scheduler combines analog programming, ownership transition, and bulk-MVM tile formation to bound digital overhead. Evaluations on nine LLMs show that our approach lowers average perplexity under analog noise from 33.91 to 11.95, close to the clean baseline of 11.06, while improving dynamic-KV programming-row utilization from 23.1\% to 91.2\%.

AI.title_translation: 面向模拟计算内存系统抗噪LLM推理的选择性KV缓存保护
AI.tldr: 针对模拟CIM系统中LLM注意力机制的硬件噪声问题，本文提出了选择性KV缓存保护策略和协同调度器，显著降低了推理错误并提高了硬件利用率。
AI.motivation: 在模拟计算内存（CIM）上扩展大语言模型（LLM）的注意力机制时，KV cache操作需要重复进行原位权重更新，这与权值静态（weight-stationary）范式不匹配，导致动态计算暴露于显著的硬件噪声中，这一问题此前在很大程度上未被探索。
AI.method: 提出了一种分层令牌保护策略，将初始令牌（sink tokens）和滑动窗口内的最近令牌保留在较高精度的数字路径上，而将其余的KV缓存交由模拟CIM处理；同时设计了一个协同调度器，结合模拟编程、所有权转换和批量MVM瓦片形成来限制数字开销。
AI.result: 在九个LLM上的评估表明，该方法在模拟噪声下的平均困惑度（perplexity）从33.91降至11.95（接近11.06的无噪声基线），同时将动态KV编程行利用率从23.1%提高到91.2%。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的分层令牌保护策略和协同调度器能够有效应对模拟CIM系统中的硬件噪声，显著提升LLM推理的鲁棒性和KV缓存编程行利用率。
AI.translation: 模拟计算内存（CIM）阵列已成为节能型LLM推理的前景广阔的底层架构，特别是对于线性层中的权值静态计算。然而，将模拟CIM扩展到注意力机制引入了一个根本性挑战：KV缓存操作需要重复进行原位权重更新，由此产生的与权值静态范式的失配使动态计算暴露于显著的硬件噪声中，这是一个在很大程度上仍未被探索的关键问题。在本文中，我们对模拟CIM阵列上的动态注意力计算进行了首次系统性研究，揭示了初始令牌和最近令牌对硬件噪声表现出不成比例的脆弱性。受此令牌级见解的启发，我们提出了一种分层令牌保护策略，将sink令牌和滑动最近令牌窗口保留在更高精度的数字路径上，同时在模拟CIM上处理大部分KV缓存。一个协同设计的调度器结合了模拟编程、所有权转换和批量MVM瓦片形成，以限制数字开销。对9个LLM的评估表明，我们的方法将模拟噪声下的平均困惑度从33.91降低到11.95，接近11.06的干净基线，同时将动态KV编程行利用率从23.1%提高到91.2%。
AI.summary: 论文研究了模拟计算内存（CIM）中大语言模型（LLM）注意力机制的动态计算噪声问题，发现初始令牌和最近令牌对硬件噪声尤为敏感。为此，提出了一种分层令牌保护策略与协同调度器，将敏感令牌置于数字路径，其余KV缓存交由模拟CIM，显著降低了噪声引起的困惑度并提高了硬件利用率。
AI.keywords: Analog Compute-In-Memory, LLM Inference, KV Cache, Hardware Noise, Attention Mechanism
AI.comments: 该论文针对模拟计算内存（CIM）系统在处理大语言模型（LLM）注意力机制时遇到的硬件噪声问题，创新性地提出了选择性KV缓存保护策略，通过软硬件协同设计实现了能效与鲁棒性的良好平衡，对CIM硬件在AI推理中的实际应用具有重要价值。

title: MERIT: Efficient In-Place Deletion for Dynamic Graph-Based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Indexes
summary: Graph-based indexes have become the dominant approach to approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) over high-dimensional data and play a crucial role in real-world applications such as retrieval-augmented generation, recommendation systems, and vector databases. Despite extensive progress in static graph construction and search, efficient in-place deletion remains challenging because obsolete vectors must be removed without allowing stale incoming edges to consume search capacity or expensive graph-wide maintenance to interrupt online services, e.g., retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and recommendation platforms. To address this problem, we propose MERIT (MST-based Efficient Repair with In-place updaTes), an in-place update framework with three core techniques: (1) bounded search-based recovery that combines a deleted vertex's outgoing neighbors with its readily searchable in-neighbors, (2) $k_r$-Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) local repair that promotes local connectivity while retaining multiple routing choices for graph search, and (3) versioned-edge invalidation that immediately filters all stale incoming edges to the deleted vertex and progressively removes them as adjacency lists are rewritten. Its integration with the hierarchical HNSW index and the single-layer Vamana index demonstrates applicability across distinct graph structures. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that MERIT processes deletion at nearly the cost of inserting one vector, achieves up to $3.02\times$--$18.87\times$ faster deletion than state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, and keeps search recall stable or even improves it as deletions accumulate.

AI.title_translation: MERIT：基于动态图的近似最近邻索引的高效原地删除
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为MERIT的高效图索引原地删除框架，能够以接近单次插入的代价实现比现有技术快数倍的向量删除，同时保持搜索召回率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于图的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）索引在动态删除方面面临挑战，因为必须在不影响在线服务和不进行昂贵的全局维护的前提下移除过时向量，同时防止陈旧的入边消耗搜索容量。
AI.method: 提出了MERIT框架，包含三个核心技术：(1) 基于有界搜索的恢复，(2) $k_r$-最小生成树（MST）局部修复，以及 (3) 版本化边失效。并将其集成到HNSW和Vamana索引中。
AI.result: 实验表明，MERIT处理删除的代价接近插入一个向量，比SOTA方法快3.02到18.87倍，并在删除累积时保持或提高搜索召回率。
AI.conclusion: MERIT是一种高效的原地删除框架，适用于分层和单层基于图的ANN索引，能够以极低的成本实现快速删除并保持搜索召回率。
AI.translation: 基于图的索引已成为高维数据近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）的主导方法，在检索增强生成、推荐系统和向量数据库等实际应用中发挥着关键作用。尽管静态图构建和搜索取得了广泛进展，但高效的原地删除仍然具有挑战性，因为必须在不让陈旧的入边消耗搜索容量或昂贵的全局维护中断在线服务的情况下移除过时向量。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MERIT（基于MST的高效修复与原地更新），这是一个包含三个核心技术的原地更新框架：（1）结合被删除顶点出邻居与其易搜寻入邻居的有界搜索恢复；（2）$k_r$-最小生成树（MST）局部修复，在保持图搜索多条路由选择的同时促进局部连通性；（3）版本化边失效，立即过滤指向被删除顶点的所有陈旧入边，并在邻接列表重写时渐进式地移除它们。将其与分层HNSW索引和单层Vamana索引集成，证明了其在不同图结构中的适用性。在多个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，MERIT处理删除的代价接近插入一个向量，比最先进（SOTA）方法快3.02至18.87倍，并随着删除的累积保持甚至提高搜索召回率。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了MERIT，一个用于动态基于图的近似最近邻索引的高效原地删除框架。通过有界搜索恢复、局部MST修复和版本化边失效三项核心技术，MERIT能够以极低的代价（接近插入一个向量）实现快速且高质量的向量删除，显著优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.keywords: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search, Graph-based Indexes, In-Place Deletion, Minimum Spanning Tree
AI.comments: 该论文针对图索引动态删除这一长期痛点，提出了MERIT框架。其创新点在于通过有界搜索恢复、k_r-MST局部修复以及版本化边失效技术，实现了高效的原地删除，且代价极低，对RAG和推荐系统等实际应用具有极高的价值。

title: GQ-FSL: Green Quantized Federated Split Learning Framework for Wireless Edge Networks
comments: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (TMC). This is an extended version of the work accepted to IEEE SPAWC 2026
summary: Deploying state-of-the-art deep neural networks (DNNs) at the wireless edge is severely bottlenecked by the strict energy and resource constraints of mobile devices. Although federated split learning (FSL) alleviates on-device computational burdens by offloading workloads to an edge server, this may introduce systemic overheads, while the continuous exchange of intermediate activations, gradients, and submodels still incurs significant energy consumption (EC). To address this, we propose a green quantized FSL (GQ-FSL) framework that incorporates stochastic quantization for both local collaborative training and wireless transmissions. Notably, GQ-FSL supports asymmetric precision levels for the client- and server-side submodels, effectively decoupling device energy constraints from global convergence degradation. To quantify these tradeoffs, we develop parameterized energy models for the split architecture and derive a theoretical convergence bound under statistically heterogeneous data. Building on that, we formulate a joint optimization problem to configure the DNN split point and precision levels, minimizing the total system EC while satisfying strict latency and target accuracy constraints. Ultimately, we demonstrate that GQ-FSL enables large-scale DNN deployment on resource-constrained devices, achieving superior energy efficiency compared to quantized federated learning and full-precision FSL.

AI.title_translation: GQ-FSL：无线边缘网络中的绿色量化联邦拆分学习框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了GQ-FSL框架，通过随机量化与非对称精度配置优化无线边缘网络中联邦拆分学习的能耗与性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 在无线边缘部署最先进的深度神经网络（DNN）时，移动设备的严格能量和资源限制构成了严重瓶颈；传统的联邦拆分学习虽然减轻了设备计算负担，但中间激活值、梯度和子模型的持续交换仍会导致显著的能耗和系统开销。
AI.method: 提出了GQ-FSL框架，在本地协同训练和无线传输中结合了随机量化，支持客户端和服务端子模型的非对称精度级别；开发了拆分架构的参数化能耗模型，推导了异构数据下的理论收敛界；并构建了联合优化问题，用于配置DNN拆分点和精度级别。
AI.result: 理论分析和实验表明，GQ-FSL能够在大规模资源受限设备上部署DNN，与量化联邦学习和全精度FSL相比，实现了更优的能量效率。
AI.conclusion: GQ-FSL框架成功实现了无线边缘网络中资源受限设备的高效深度学习部署，在满足延迟和准确率约束的前提下，显著降低了系统总能耗，优于现有的量化联邦学习和全精度联邦拆分学习方法。
AI.translation: 在无线边缘部署最先进的深度神经网络（DNN）受到移动设备严格的能量和资源限制的严重瓶颈制约。尽管联邦拆分学习（FSL）通过将工作负载卸载到边缘服务器减轻了设备上的计算负担，但这可能会引入系统开销，同时中间激活值、梯度和子模型的持续交换仍然会产生显著的能耗（EC）。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个绿色量化的FSL（GQ-FSL）框架，该框架在本地协同训练和无线传输中都结合了随机量化。值得注意的是，GQ-FSL支持客户端和服务端子模型的非对称精度级别，有效地将设备能量限制与全局收敛退化解耦。为了量化这些权衡，我们为拆分架构开发了参数化能耗模型，并推导了统计异构数据下的理论收敛界。在此基础上，我们构建了一个联合优化问题，以配置DNN拆分点和精度级别，在满足严格的延迟和目标准确率约束的同时，最小化系统总能耗。最后，我们证明了GQ-FSL能够支持在资源受限设备上大规模部署DNN，与量化联邦学习和全精度FSL相比，实现了更优的能量效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GQ-FSL框架，通过引入随机量化和非对称精度配置来降低无线边缘网络中联邦拆分学习的能耗。通过建立能耗模型、推导收敛界以及求解联合优化问题，该框架在满足延迟和精度约束的同时，显著提升了资源受限设备的能量效率。
AI.keywords: 联邦拆分学习, 随机量化, 无线边缘网络, 能耗优化, 深度学习部署
AI.comments: 本文针对无线边缘网络提出了一种绿色量化的联邦拆分学习框架（GQ-FSL），创新性地结合了随机量化与非对称精度支持，并建立了严谨的理论收敛边界与联合优化模型，在能量效率与模型精度之间取得了良好的平衡，对于资源受限设备的深度学习部署具有重要意义。

title: The Epistemic Politics of AI Anthropomorphism
comments: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Extended version, including supplementary materials, of a paper to appear in the Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES) 2026. v3: revised wording throughout, affiliation updated
summary: AI anthropomorphism is typically treated as a problem of user misperception requiring institutional correction. Users who engage in sustained or relational interaction with AI are routinely pathologised or dismissed as naive, vulnerable to delusion or lacking in discernment. This paper argues that the dominant anthropomorphism frame operates from a position of institutional advantage rather than earned epistemic authority: collapsing the variety of academic perspectives into a single outbound position of user error, imposed without establishing the grounds required to justify it and without accounting for the harms it produces. The framing does not simply manage risk. It adjudicates the legitimacy of human experience in interaction with a phenomenon whose nature the field itself has not resolved. Reproducing itself through a self-validating evidentiary loop, the frame imposes costs that fall disproportionately on neurodivergent users, those in crisis and others whose modes of engagement diverge from institutional norms. The paper concludes by outlining the methodological commitments an equitable framing would need to honour. The argument does not engage the question of whether anthropomorphic interpretations are ultimately correct; it instead challenges whether the governing and institutional bodies determining these interpretations have met the conditions required to do so, and whether the research communities whose findings underpin them have held that translation to account.
